papers.title: How does community of inquiry matter? Mediating effects and configurational pathways linking project-based learning design to learning engagement
papers.authors: Tongfeng Xu, Peijun Qin, Siyuan Ma
papers.abstract: The widespread adoption of generative artificial intelligence (AIGC) has reshaped animation students’ skill profiles and the conditions of instructional design in project-based learning (PBL) studios. We examine whether and how perceptions of PBL design are associated with Learning Engagement (LE), treating AIGC-assisted PBL studios as the research context rather than testing generative AI as a model variable. Drawing on Community of Inquiry (CoI) theory, we examine Problem Driven (PD), Project Design (PDe), Project Implementation (PI), and Project Evaluation (PE) as antecedents; Cognitive Presence (CP), Social Presence (SP), and Teaching Presence (TP) as statistical mediators; and LE as the outcome. We analyzed two-wave survey data from 490 upper-year animation students using PLS-SEM and fsQCA. PBL and CoI were measured concurrently at T1, and LE at T2; indirect effects therefore represent indirect statistical associations rather than mediation with a fully established temporal sequence. PD, PDe, and PI showed significant positive direct associations with LE. PE’s zero-order and single-predictor associations were positive, but its direct path coefficient became significantly negative after controlling for the other PBL dimensions and CoI mediators. The coefficient was sensitive to model specification, suggesting possible statistical suppression; it should not be interpreted as evidence that evaluation itself inherently inhibits engagement. The three CoI dimensions showed significant statistical mediation associations across all 12 indirect paths. TP and SP had relatively higher point estimates of indirect statistical associations, but differences between indirect effects were not formally tested; no dimension is claimed to be optimal. PE’s positive indirect associations through CoI partially offset its negative net direct association without reversing the total association after adjustment. The extent of this offset may depend on the degree to which CoI-related experiences are concurrently reported. fsQCA identified seven high-engagement configurations. No individual PBL dimension was indispensable. CoI dimensions appeared as core or peripheral conditions, although not every configuration included all three. These findings clarify the dual pathways linking evaluation and engagement through indirect statistical associations and configurational conditions, and provide guidance for optimizing PBL under different resource constraints. Conclusions are limited to AIGC-assisted PBL studios and do not establish the instructional effects of generative AI.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以AIGC辅助的项目式学习工作室为背景，考察项目式学习设计感知与学习投入之间的关联，并检验认知临场感、社会临场感和教学临场感在其中的统计中介作用。作者对高年级动画学生开展两波问卷，用PLS-SEM和fsQCA分析，发现问题驱动、项目设计与项目实施同学习投入呈正向直接关联；项目评价在控制其他维度与中介变量后直接路径转为负向，作者提示这可能反映统计抑制、对模型设定敏感，不能解读为评价本身抑制投入。三个临场感维度在全部间接路径上均呈显著统计中介关联，其中教学与社会临场感的点估计较高，但未正式检验差异。fsQCA识别出七种高投入组态，没有单个项目式学习维度不可或缺。结论限于该情境，未确立生成式AI的教学效果。

papers.title: Psychological mechanisms of perceived technological dependence on generative artificial intelligence tools: perceived knowledge, trust, anxiety, and self-efficacy
papers.authors: Le Wei, Shu Zhang, Junghyun Heo
papers.abstract: Generative AI tools are increasingly used in design education, yet the relationship between students’ perceptions of these tools and their reported reliance on them remains unclear. This study analyzed cross-sectional survey responses from 526 undergraduate students in design-related disciplines using partial least squares structural equation modeling. In the specified model, perceived reliability, perceived usefulness, and perceived intelligence were positively associated with perceived AIGC knowledge, whereas perceived ease of use was not significantly associated with it. Perceived AIGC knowledge was positively associated with trust, self-efficacy, and usage intention and negatively associated with AIGC-related anxiety. Trust, AIGC-related anxiety, and self-efficacy each showed a significant indirect effect in the modeled relationship between perceived AIGC knowledge and usage intention. Usage intention was strongly associated with perceived technological dependence. These findings are consistent with the proposed framework, but the cross-sectional data do not establish the temporal sequence of the constructs or show that reported dependence reflects harmful overuse. The study extends technology acceptance research by examining perceived reliance in AIGC-supported creative work.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注设计教育中生成式人工智能工具的使用，考察学生对工具特征的感知如何与其对工具的依赖相关联。作者对设计相关专业本科生进行横断面问卷调查，并用结构方程模型分析。结果显示，感知可靠性、有用性和智能性与学生对AIGC知识的感知正相关，而感知易用性与后者无显著关联；感知AIGC知识又与信任、自我效能和使用意向正相关，与AIGC相关焦虑负相关，信任、焦虑和自我效能各自在感知知识与使用意向之间起显著间接作用，使用意向则与感知技术依赖强相关。作者指出，这些结果与所提框架一致，但横断面数据无法确定各构念的时间顺序，也不能说明所报告的依赖反映有害的过度使用。

papers.title: If it doesn’t have a soul, it doesn’t hurt? The effect of bullying and social anxiety on the use of conversational AI
papers.authors: Gergő Pál, Andras Norbert Zsido, Julia Basler
papers.abstract: Introduction Conversational artificial intelligence (CAI) increasingly functions as a social interaction partner, raising questions about how established interpersonal behaviors transfer to human-AI interaction. The present study examined whether bullying-like behavior directed toward CAI reflects the extension of real world social strategies, and how social anxiety, prior bullying experiences, and AI self-competency contribute to such behavior. Methods Participants ( N = 289) completed measures of social anxiety, prior bullying perpetration and victimization, AI self-competency, and bullying-like behavior directed toward conversational AI. Results Through several analyses, bully-victims exhibited the highest levels of AI-directed bullying-like behavior. The interaction between bullying perpetration and victimization emerged as the strongest predictor in our regression analysis, while prior bullying perpetration alone was not sufficient to explain AI-directed aggression, and prior victimization alone was negatively associated with AI-directed bullying-like behavior. Social anxiety did not directly predict bullying-like behavior toward AI; however, mediation analyses showed that prior victimization fully mediated the relationship between social anxiety and bullying-like behavior towards CAI. Individuals with higher social anxiety were more likely to report victimization, which in turn was associated with increased bullying-like behavior toward AI. AI self-competency did not emerge as an independent predictor. Discussion These findings suggest that AI-directed bullying-like behavior is best understood as a context-dependent behavior arising from the co-occurrence of aggression and vulnerability, rather than a direct extension of general aggressive tendencies. Conversational AI constitutes a distinct relational context that can both reflect and reinforce existing behavioral patterns. This has important implications for understanding how human-AI interactions may shape social behavior and psychological functioning over time.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了针对对话式人工智能的欺凌式行为是否延续自现实人际策略，以及社交焦虑、既往欺凌经历和AI自我效能感如何参与其中。研究以问卷测量了参与者的社交焦虑、欺凌实施与受害经历、AI自我效能感及对对话式AI的欺凌式行为，发现欺凌—受害双重经历者表现出最高水平的此类行为，且实施与受害的交互是最强预测因素；单独的实施经历不足以解释该行为，单独的受害经历则呈负相关。社交焦虑不直接预测该行为，而是通过既往受害经历完全中介，AI自我效能感并非独立预测因素。作者据此认为，针对AI的欺凌式行为更宜理解为攻击性与脆弱性共存下的情境依赖行为，而非一般攻击倾向的直接延伸。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence-generated and algorithmically personalized music interventions and their effects on brain function, behavior, and health: a critical review
papers.authors: Jingting Jin
papers.abstract: This critical review synthesizes empirical studies of algorithmically personalized and artificial-intelligence-generated music interventions reporting neurophysiological, neuroimaging, or objective behavioral outcomes. Literature was identified through structured searches of PubMed, Scopus, Google Scholar, IEEE Xplore, and the ACM Digital Library through 12 August 2026, with CNKI and Wanfang searched on 22 September 2026, supplemented by citation tracking. Twenty-one eligible studies (at least 1,005 participants) were identified. Five things the term artificial intelligence covers in this literature are separated: algorithmic selection from a corpus, rule-based sonification, parametric modulation of pre-existing material, machine-learning generative composition, and closed-loop delivery contingent on the listener’s own signal. Only three studies used a machine-learning generative model, so most of the evidence concerns algorithmic personalization of existing material. Studies of closed-loop neural systems reported the most consistent neurophysiological signal, and music-based alpha neurofeedback produced higher normalized alpha power than yoked random feedback. In an open-loop design, personalized EEG-derived music was reported to attenuate anxiety induction where self-selected preferred music and silence did not, with enhanced prefrontal theta oscillations as the associated correlate. Eight studies carried a comparator capable of isolating an algorithmic component from music exposure, and all eight favored the algorithmic condition. These eight address different causal questions, use different designs, and point to no single mechanism, so their results are best read as preliminary and hypothesis-generating. Evidence quality was very low throughout. The median reported sample size was 22, no study blinded participants or measured expectancy, and no specific finding has been independently replicated. GRADE certainty was very low for every outcome domain, covering EEG oscillatory power, sleep architecture, autonomic regulation, epileptiform activity, and cognitive, behavioral and affective outcomes. Neurophysiological change is reported more often than behavioral change, and behavioral change more often than clinical benefit. The evidence supports continued investigation and does not support clinical deployment. Eight reporting and design requirements for future trials are proposed.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了算法个性化与人工智能生成音乐干预对神经生理、行为及健康结局的实证研究，检索截至2026年，纳入21项研究，并将“人工智能”区分为算法选曲、规则化声音化、参数调制、机器学习生成作曲和闭环信号驱动等类型。主要发现是：多数证据实际针对既有素材的算法个性化，仅少数使用机器学习生成模型；闭环神经反馈研究报告的神经生理信号最为一致，八项设有可分离算法成分对照的研究均支持算法条件，但这些研究因果问题、设计各异且未指向单一机制。作者强调证据质量整体极低、样本量小、无盲法与期待测量、缺乏独立重复，神经生理变化多于行为变化、行为变化多于临床获益，因此结论仅具初步假设生成意义，支持继续研究而不支持临床部署。

papers.title: Twenty-Five Years, Five Projects, and Five Reflections on Accessible Computing
papers.authors: Jacob Otto Wobbrock
papers.journal: International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS)
papers.abstract: I began working on accessible computing in 2001 at the start of my doctoral program by developing word prediction software for Palm PDA devices [4]. Today, 25 years later, accessibility has remained a core focus of my work and the work of my students in the field of human-computer interaction (HCI). In this keynote, I will share five projects that have significantly shaped my work, along with five reflections that continue to inform my perspective. My goal is to convey ideas from which I would have benefitted 25 years ago as a junior researcher starting in accessible computing. My five projects are EdgeWrite [9], Slide Rule [3], enhanced area cursors [1] and, in particular, the Pointing Magnifier [2], ability-based design [7,8], and the epidemiological model of mobile app accessibility [5,6]. My five reflections concern prioritizing depth, the power of participant-driven prototyping, the opportunities and obligations of field deployments, the importance of conceptual contributions, and the value of cross-disciplinary deep-dives. I conclude by addressing some of the promises and pitfalls of artificial intelligence for accessibility, drawing on these reflections to light our way.
papers.summary_zh: 该主旨演讲以作者25年来在无障碍计算领域的研究经历为线索，回顾了从早期为Palm PDA开发词预测软件到EdgeWrite、Slide Rule、增强区域光标与Pointing Magnifier、基于能力的设计以及移动应用无障碍流行病学模型等项目，并总结了重视研究深度、参与者驱动的原型设计、实地部署的机会与责任、概念性贡献的重要性以及跨学科深入探索等五点反思。作者据此讨论人工智能对无障碍研究的机遇与风险，属于经验回顾与观点性演讲，而非实证研究。

papers.title: Zeno: Improving the Fidelity and Pedagogical Value of LLM-Generated Alt Text with BLV-Informed Guidelines and Iterative Prompting
papers.authors: Shuyuan Liu, Jiaming Zhang, Mohamed Essam Moustafa Kamel Fayed, Yuhui Zhao, Prithiv Premkumar, Alexander Travis Adams, Thad E. Starner
papers.journal: International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS)
papers.abstract: Generating pedagogically useful alternative text (alt text) for advanced computer science course materials requires more than describing visual appearance: blind and low-vision learners often need descriptions that support tracing, comparison, equation reading, and task completion. This work-in-progress study examines how blind-learner-informed guidance can improve LLM-generated alt text for an online AI course. Inspired by a blind student’s longitudinal course experience, we introduce Delta, a CS-specific guideline for task-operable alt text, and Zeno, an iterative LLM workflow that generates, critiques, and revises alt text against the source material. In a formative evaluation with two sighted reviewers and one blind reviewer, Delta-informed prompting and Zeno substantially outperformed a WCAG-only baseline in sighted fidelity, pass rate, and diagnostic error patterns. These findings suggest that blind-learner-informed guidance can improve the pedagogical usefulness of LLM-generated alt text for technical course materials.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注如何让大语言模型为高级计算机科学课程材料生成更具教学价值的替代文本，而不仅是描述视觉外观。作者基于一名盲人学生的长期课程体验提出面向计算机科学的替代文本指南Delta，并构建了对照源材料进行生成、批评与修订的迭代流程Zeno。由两名视力正常评审者和一名盲人评审者参与的形成性评估显示，融入Delta的提示与Zeno在保真度、通过率和诊断性错误模式上明显优于仅依据WCAG的基线。研究提示，融入盲人学习者经验的指导有助于提升大语言模型生成的技术课程替代文本的教学可用性，但结论来自小规模形成性评估，仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Reflections and Recommendations on AI Adoption Practice from a Mixed-Ability Research Group
papers.authors: Shalini Madan, Sreelakshmi Surabiyil Bindu, Veronica Pimenova, Ellie Seehorn, Venkatesh Potluri
papers.journal: International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS)
papers.abstract: Generative AI tools have recently been rapidly adopted by academics in mixed-ability research teams for both personal and professional tasks. While previous work on adoption of AI-based workflows has focused on collaboration and productivity, the perceptions of AI use within research teams remains divided. Through qualitative analysis of interviews of the five members of our mixed-ability research team, we discuss the motivations, challenges, and practices surrounding the use of generative AI in our lab. We reflect on experiences that shaped recommendations for balanced AI use that enable mixed-ability team workflows: (1) managing disability tax & crip time, (2) homogenizing identity, (3) risk disclosure of private information, (4) self-experimentation and miscellaneous tasks, and (5) information seeking. We build upon these themes to present AI practice recommendations we established for our lab to promote AI workflow adoption while preserving agency and disability identity.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注生成式AI在混合能力研究团队中的实际采用情况，通过对团队五名成员的访谈进行定性分析，探讨其使用动机、挑战与做法。作者归纳出管理残障税与“crip时间”、身份同质化、私人信息风险披露、自我实验与杂项任务、信息搜寻等主题，并据此提出实验室层面的AI使用建议，旨在促进AI工作流采用的同时维护成员能动性与残障身份。文章属于基于团队自身经验的反思性定性研究，结论来自小规模访谈，未涉及效果验证。

papers.title: Learning Python as a Blind Programmer in an AI-Mediated Environment: An Autoethnographic Study
papers.authors: Weijun Zhang, JooYoung Seo
papers.journal: International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS)
papers.abstract: Programming education is increasingly mediated by AI tools, yet little is known about how blind learners—particularly non-native English speakers—integrate these tools into learning, or where AI fails to address accessibility barriers. This paper presents an eight-week autoethnographic study of a blind, Chinese-speaking doctoral student learning introductory Python through Khan Academy’s curriculum with screen readers, a Braille display, and AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini). Drawing on detailed learning diaries and human–AI interaction logs analyzed via reflexive thematic analysis, we examine how AI mediates accessibility, cognition, and language during programming learning. Findings show that AI simultaneously functions as an accessibility interpreter, cognitive scaffold, and linguistic mediator, yet also introduces epistemic uncertainty, accessibility hallucinations, inconsistent cross-lingual terminology, and clear limits with non-textual cues. We argue that AI reconfigures rather than solves accessibility, and derive design implications for AI-assisted programming tools prioritizing explicit code structure, screen-reader integration, calibrated trust, and terminology-aware multilingual support.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以一位盲人中文母语博士生为对象，通过八周自我民族志，结合学习日记与人机交互日志，考察其在AI辅助下学习Python入门课程的经历。研究发现，AI同时充当无障碍解释者、认知支架和语言中介，但也带来认识论上的不确定性、无障碍相关的幻觉、跨语言术语不一致，以及在处理非文本线索上的明显局限。作者据此指出，AI重新配置而非解决了无障碍问题，并提出应优先考虑显式代码结构、屏幕阅读器集成、校准信任和术语敏感的多语言支持等设计方向。

papers.title: "Catching lightning in a bottle": How Blind or Low Vision Creators Navigate Ideation Across Creative Domains
papers.authors: Mingyi Li, Yutian Shi, Cynthia L. Bennett, Maitraye Das
papers.journal: International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS)
papers.abstract: Ideation, i.e., generating, capturing, organizing, and evaluating ideas, is foundational to creative practices; yet little is known about how blind and low vision (BLV) creators engage in ideation. We conducted interviews with 20 BLV creators working in different domains including poetry, music production, tactile graphics, digital drawing, and mixed-media arts. Our findings reveal how participants established accessible creative workflows under social and institutional constraints, drew inspiration from diverse physical and digital sources, captured and organized ideas across text, audio, visual, and physical modalities, and evaluated their work through human and AI feedback. We discuss how ableist norms and accessibility breakdowns cascade across ideation pathways, progressively narrowing BLV individuals’ creative possibilities. Finally, we offer design considerations for building accessible ideation support tools that amplify BLV creators’ distinctive practices.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过访谈不同创作领域的盲人与低视力创作者，考察其在创意构思各环节中的实际做法。研究发现，参与者会在社会与制度限制下建立可访问的创作流程，从多种物理和数字来源获取灵感，以文本、音频、视觉和实体等多种模态记录与整理想法，并借助人类和AI反馈评估作品。作者进一步指出，健全主义规范与可访问性障碍会在构思路径上层层累积，逐步收窄盲人与低视力个体的创作可能性，并据此提出面向可访问构思支持工具的设计考量。

papers.title: Synthesizing and Evaluating a Visual Feedback Framework for Accessible Content Creation
papers.authors: Lotus Zhang, Anh Hua, Leah Findlater
papers.journal: International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS)
papers.abstract: Many blind and low-vision (BLV) individuals are interested in visual content creation, yet creative tools provide limited feedback for visual outputs during authoring. We synthesized and evaluated a visual feedback framework for creative tasks—we first conducted a purpose-specific literature review of 54 accessibility papers on BLV creators’ feedback needs and then refined the resulting framework through expert review interviews with nine BLV creators. We identify key feedback components for creative work, including object and people information, spatial layout, intent-based checking and suggestions, version differences, and visual aesthetics. We also outline delivery guidelines emphasizing hierarchical control, multimodal interaction, real-time verification, non-visual language, and transparency about AI accuracy. Our findings show that creative authoring requires more detailed and intent-driven feedback than passive consumption, particularly to support iterative decision-making and diverse creative goals. Rather than a prescriptive checklist, this framework offers a practical foundation for researchers and practitioners when designing and evaluating accessible creative tools.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对盲人和低视力（BLV）群体在视觉内容创作中缺乏反馈的问题，综合并评估了一个面向创作任务的视觉反馈框架。作者先通过针对性的文献综述梳理BLV创作者的反馈需求，再经专家评审访谈细化框架，归纳出对象与人物信息、空间布局、基于意图的检查与建议、版本差异和视觉美学等关键反馈要素，并提出层级控制、多模态交互、实时验证、非视觉语言及AI准确性透明等交付准则。研究指出，创作型任务比被动消费需要更细致、意图驱动的反馈，以支持迭代决策和多样创作目标；该框架并非规定性清单，而是为无障碍创作工具的设计与评估提供实用基础。

papers.title: Balancing Safety and Autonomy: Accessibility-Oriented Interventions in Generative AI for Cognitive Impairment
papers.authors: Yibo Meng, Jingruo Chen, Lyumanshan Ye, Bingyi Liu, Zhicong Lu
papers.journal: International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS)
papers.abstract: Generative AI systems are increasingly used by older adults with cognitive impairment for everyday tasks such as information seeking, health management, and communication. While these systems provide flexible, language-based support, their open-ended outputs introduce risks of over-reliance, misinterpretation, and inappropriate decision-making. Prior work has focused on usability and adoption, with limited attention to how system design shapes users’ participation in decision-making and the distribution of agency in care contexts. We present a qualitative study of 45 individuals with cognitive impairment and their caregivers. We identify five accessibility-oriented mechanisms: AI Capability Constraint, Human Oversight Embedding, Cognitive Engagement Maintenance, Human–AI Relationship Regulation, and Risk Transparency and Control, through which systems structure interaction. These mechanisms both support and constrain users by redistributing decision-making across users and caregivers. We show that their effects vary by impairment level: while protective mechanisms support users with severe impairment, they can restrict autonomy for those with mild impairment. As impairment progresses, tensions become less visible as user participation diminishes. Our findings highlight the need for dynamic designs that balance safety and autonomy in AI-supported care.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注生成式AI在认知障碍老年人日常使用中的设计问题，通过对45名认知障碍者及其照护者的定性研究，识别出AI能力约束、人类监督嵌入、认知参与维持、人机关系调节以及风险透明与控制这五类可及性导向机制。研究发现，这些机制在用户与照护者之间重新分配决策权，其效果随障碍程度而异：保护性机制对重度障碍者形成支持，却可能限制轻度障碍者的自主性；随着障碍进展，用户参与减少，相关张力也更不易察觉。文章据此提出，AI支持的照护需要能动态平衡安全与自主的设计。

papers.title: Towards Accessible AI Literacy: Investigating How Teachers of Blind and Low-Vision Students Integrate Generative AI in Pedagogical Practices
papers.authors: Rudaiba Adnin, Abir Saha, Maitraye Das
papers.journal: International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS)
papers.abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) tools are reshaping the educational landscape; yet, how teachers working with blind and low vision (BLV) students integrate these tools into their pedagogical practices remains underexplored. To address this gap, we interviewed 17 teachers of BLV students to investigate how they leverage GenAI to fulfill their teaching responsibilities and educate BLV students about these tools. We found that teachers incorporated GenAI for personalized lesson planning and tasks specific to BLV education, while counteracting biases favoring sighted teaching methods. They addressed BLV students’ curiosity and concerns about GenAI and taught them prompt formulation strategies that support their access needs in academic and daily tasks, although occasionally perpetuating their own misconceptions about GenAI to students. They expressed concerns about students’ overreliance on GenAI lowering foundational accessibility-related skills. We discuss ways to promote accessible AI literacy and outline design considerations for incorporating GenAI to support teachers’ BLV-specific instructional responsibilities and for integrating GenAI responsibly in BLV education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注盲人与低视力学生的教师如何将生成式人工智能融入教学实践，通过对17名教师进行访谈来考察其使用方式与相关看法。研究发现，教师利用生成式人工智能进行个性化备课和处理盲人与低视力教育特有的任务，同时试图抵消偏向明眼人教学方法的偏见；他们还回应学生对生成式人工智能的好奇与担忧，教授有助于满足无障碍需求的提示词构建策略，但偶尔也会把自身对生成式人工智能的误解传递给学生。教师担心学生过度依赖生成式人工智能会削弱与无障碍相关的基础技能。文章据此讨论了促进无障碍人工智能素养的途径，并提出将生成式人工智能纳入盲人与低视力教育的设计考量。

papers.title: A Recipe for Access: Visually Oriented Recipe Instructions as an Accessibility Barrier for Blind and Low-Vision Cooks
papers.authors: Nathan Aileo, Syed Masum Billah
papers.journal: International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS)
papers.abstract: For people who are blind or have low vision (BLV), barriers to independent cooking are associated with reduced dietary quality and elevated health risks. One such barrier is embedded in recipe language itself: phrases such as “cook until golden brown” or “sauté until translucent” require visual monitoring. That such phrases exist is not new; what has been missing is evidence of their scale and an account of what BLV cooks do in their place. We use the term Visually Oriented Instructional Descriptor (VizOID) for this kind of recipe language. Across 573,986 recipes and 3.85 million instruction sentences, VizOIDs appeared in every corpus we examined, including 6.7% of instruction sentences and 35.9% of recipes overall, and 55.5% of recipes in the professionally written Food Network corpus. In a hand-labeled subset, independent human coders reached substantial agreement (κ = 0.730), and an LLM reached near-perfect post-adjudication agreement with human coding (κ = 0.961), showing that the phenomenon is detectable at scale. We then report semi-structured interviews with 12 BLV individuals to examine how they work through these instructions. Participants described a shared repertoire of non-visual cooking knowledge: timing as a proxy, smell, sound, touch, temperature, and familiar utensils used to infer food state. Framed through the social model of disability, our findings show that many recipes are inaccessible because recipe language fails to encode the non-visual knowledge BLV cooks already use. Our findings can inform vision rehabilitation therapists and AI accessibility researchers designing low-cost, language-level interventions that rewrite recipe text at the point of acquisition, grounded in BLV cooks’ lived expertise.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注盲人和低视力者在独立烹饪时面临的食谱语言障碍，提出“视觉导向指令描述语”这一概念，用以指称“煮至金黄”“炒至透明”等依赖视觉判断的表述。作者对大规模食谱语料进行标注分析，发现这类表述普遍存在于各类语料中，并借助人工编码与大语言模型验证其可规模化识别；随后通过半结构化访谈考察盲人和低视力者的应对方式，发现他们依靠时间、气味、声音、触觉和温度等非视觉经验推断食物状态。文章以社会模型残障视角指出，食谱不可及源于语言未能编码这些已有知识，可为低成本的语言层面改写干预提供依据。

papers.title: Prompting Change in the Welfare State: Co-designing an LLM-Assisted Toolkit of Welfare Stories and Tips with Aphasia Communities
papers.authors: Humphrey Curtis, Timothy Neate, Alistair Gentry, Sioban Zacharek, Sally Jane McVicker, Filip Birčanin
papers.journal: International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS)
papers.abstract: People with aphasia face substantial barriers when navigating digital welfare systems—including communication impairments, literacy demands and the cognitive burden of bureaucratic processes shaped by decades of austerity. We present Advokit, a multimodal AI toolkit co-designed with people with aphasia to support welfare navigation, application drafting and self-advocacy. Developed through a five-stage participatory design process, Advokit integrates accessible benefit information, a comparative benefits table, lived-experience stories and Benefit Buddy, an LLM-assisted drafting chatbot. Across a three-month real-world deployment, the toolkit recorded 800 visitors and 2,849 page views; users engaged most with the benefits table, benefits list and stories pages—reflecting demand for both structured guidance and peer-grounded narratives. Survey responses (n = 11) were broadly positive, particularly for information access, though Benefit Buddy onboarding scored lower. Analysis of 14 chatbot sessions showed the system excelled at translating established lived experience into application-ready language, but struggled when users first needed orientation before engaging with the drafting workflow. We frame Advokit as counter-infrastructure: a community-built response to the hostile design of the welfare system. Our findings also surface limitations of conversational AI interfaces as access mechanisms: as chatbots are increasingly deployed to mediate access to vital public services. We contribute an open-source co-designed welfare toolkit, empirical findings from its community deployment and design implications for accessible AI-supported public services.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对失语症人群在数字福利系统中面临沟通、读写与认知障碍的问题，与失语症社群共同设计了多模态AI工具包Advokit，整合福利信息、比较表格、生活经验故事和LLM辅助起草聊天机器人Benefit Buddy。三个月真实部署中，用户最常使用福利表格、福利列表和故事页面，反映出对结构化指引与同伴叙事的双重需求；问卷反馈总体积极，但聊天机器人引导环节评分较低。对聊天会话的分析显示，系统擅长将已有生活经验转化为申请语言，却在用户需要先获得方向指引时表现不佳。作者据此将Advokit定位为社区自建的“反基础设施”，并指出对话式AI作为公共服务访问中介的局限。

papers.title: Supporting Allyship in Virtual Collaboration with Artificial Intelligence: A Scenario-Based Study
papers.authors: Crescentia Jung, Ricardo E. Gonzalez Penuela, Prashita Biswas, Seungyoon Kwon, Shiri Azenkot
papers.journal: International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS)
papers.abstract: Recent research has revealed that accessibility in virtual collaboration is not only a technical problem but also depends on allyship: the informal, interpersonal practices through which people support others’ accessibility needs. Yet little research has examined how artificial intelligence (AI) might support allyship in collaborative accessibility contexts. To address this gap, we conducted a study where 18 participants (10 disabled, 8 non-disabled) reflected on four allyship scenarios with novel AI tools. Participants valued AI designs that they anticipated could help teammates express, interpret, and coordinate around access needs by reducing repeated disclosure and making allyship more actionable. At the same time, participants raised concerns when AI acted without consent, misrepresented users’ intentions, or displaced the interpersonal work of allyship. Based on our findings, we introduce allyship-support tools as a class of accessibility technologies, offer design guidelines, and discuss AI in particular as a means of supporting allyship.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人工智能如何支持虚拟协作中的无障碍盟友行为，即人们以非正式的人际实践相互支持无障碍需求。作者通过情景研究，让残障与非残障参与者围绕四种盟友情景反思新型AI工具。参与者认可AI能帮助队友表达、解读和协调无障碍需求，减少反复披露并使支持更可操作；但也担忧AI未经同意行动、曲解用户意图或取代人际支持工作。研究据此提出盟友支持工具这一无障碍技术类别及设计准则，并讨论AI作为支持盟友行为手段的定位。

papers.title: Human or Algorithmic Managers in Expert Knowledge Work? The Interplay of Management Style and Managerial Function
papers.authors: Janne Kauttonen, Aarni Tuomi, Johanna Vuori, Pirjo Saaranen, Anna Lahtinen
papers.abstract: Algorithmic management is entering expert knowledge work, but when workers accept algorithmic rather than human managers remains unclear. We surveyed Finnish expert knowledge workers (N = 1,156) using a factorial scenario experiment varying manager type (human/algorithmic), management style (controlling/balanced /flexible), and six managerial functions and measured leader–member exchange (LMX), organizational trust, AI familiarity and work complexity. Findings cover five functions; rewarding was excluded due to insufficient model fit. Management style was the strongest predictor: flexible styles were rated highest and controlling lowest, regardless of manager type. Human managers were preferred for goal setting, performance evaluation, and supportive leadership; algorithms only for scheduling under controlling conditions. Monitoring showed no consistent difference. High-quality LMX buffered reactions to controlling styles, and in performance evaluation and supportive leadership its association with acceptability was stronger for algorithmic managers, narrowing the human advantage. Organizational trust and LMX were more consistently implicated than AI familiarity, qualifying algorithm-aversion accounts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注专家知识工作者在何种情况下接受算法管理者而非人类管理者，采用情景实验调查了芬兰专家知识工作者，并操纵管理者类型、管理风格与六项管理职能。结果显示，管理风格是最强预测因素：无论管理者是人类还是算法，灵活风格评价最高、控制型最低；人类管理者在目标设定、绩效评估和支持性领导上更受偏好，算法仅在控制型条件下负责排程时占优，监控职能则无一致差异。高质量的领导—成员交换能缓冲对控制型风格的反应，且在绩效评估与支持性领导中，这种交换与可接受性的关联对算法管理者更强，从而缩小了人类管理者的优势；组织信任比AI熟悉度更稳定地相关，对算法厌恶的解释构成限定。

papers.title: Bounded Delegation: How Student Design Teams Keep Strategic Control over Generative AI
papers.authors: Bize Wei, Yu Qiao

papers.title: How Large Language Models Weight Narrative Cues When Detecting Deception in Oral Accounts: A Multi‐Model Comparison
papers.authors: Meng‐Chen He, Wei Ji, Jing‐Xuan Ran, Jiaxin Cui, Wen‐Jing Yan, Jing Liang
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Lie detection research has increasingly turned to artificial intelligence, yet the application of large language models (LLMs) remains underexplored for transcribed oral narratives. We compared five LLMs (Gemini‐3‐flash, Gemini‐3‐pro, Deepseek‐v4‐flash, GPT‐5.6‐luna, and Grok‐4) in classifying truthful and deceptive statements from interview transcripts of oral travel narratives collected from 95 Chinese‐speaking participants. Guided by Criteria‐Based Content Analysis (CBCA), Reality Monitoring (RM), and the Verifiability Approach (VA), theory‐driven prompts instructed models to score five narrative cues before making binary veracity judgments. Gemini‐3‐flash achieved the highest accuracy (74.74%, AUC = 0.76) with 81.63% sensitivity and 67.39% specificity, and stable repeated‐run performance. For this optimal model, unusual/superfluous details served as the sole significant predictor of objective veracity even after controlling for text length. LLMs can detect deception above chance but show large performance heterogeneity. Independent human coding, cross‐cultural replications, and adversarial robustness testing are needed before real‐world deployment.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较五种大语言模型在口头叙述转录文本中判别真实与欺骗陈述的表现，以95名中文使用者的旅行叙述访谈为材料，并依据基于标准的内容分析、现实监控和可验证性方法设计理论驱动的提示，让模型先对叙事线索评分再作真假判断。结果显示模型整体能高于随机水平识别欺骗，但不同模型差异明显，其中Gemini‐3‐flash准确率最高且重复运行较稳定；在该模型下，异常或多余细节是客观真实性唯一显著的预测因素，控制文本长度后依然成立。作者据此指出大语言模型用于测谎仍有明显局限，实际部署前需开展独立人工编码、跨文化重复验证和对抗稳健性测试。

papers.title: “What Am I Really Doing with My Own Brain?”: College Students on Learning, Ownership, and AI
papers.authors: Tobin Ting, Elisa Liang, Maxwell Edward Tankersley, Timothy Lindgren, Noël Ingram, Colleen Dallavalle, Terese Lund, Belle Liang
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence gives college students new ways to support their learning, while also raising questions about what they still want to learn and do for themselves. This qualitative study draws on semi-structured interviews with 14 undergraduates at a Northeastern liberal arts college to examine how students distinguish between AI use that supports their own thinking and AI use that substitutes for it, what they believe is worth doing on their own, and whether and how purpose enters their reasoning about learning and AI use. Using the Framework Method with a cross-case matrix to compare patterns across participants and topics, we found that students repeatedly drew a line between using AI as a supportive tool and letting it take the place of their own thinking or authorship. Students most often talked about wanting to keep developing their own skills, thinking independently, and knowing what they could actually do without AI. They also wanted the work to still feel “like theirs,” citing ownership, pride, authenticity, and ethical concerns. Students also described pressures that made AI appealing, including heavy workloads, deadlines, grades, convenience, and concerns about falling behind their peers. Although few participants explicitly connected their AI choices to a stated purpose, many described concerns that may be relevant to purpose development, including developing valued skills and strengths, acting on personal values, and becoming the kind of person they hoped to be. We consider these concerns through a purpose-mindset framework while distinguishing our interpretation from participants’ own explanations of their AI choices. The findings suggest that understanding students’ AI use requires attention to what they believe they need to learn and do for themselves.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于对美国东北部一所文理学院14名本科生的半结构化访谈，采用框架分析法与跨案例矩阵，考察学生如何区分支持自身思考的AI使用与替代自身思考的AI使用，以及他们如何看待学习的意义与目的。研究发现，学生反复在“AI作为辅助工具”与“让AI取代自己的思考或创作”之间划界，普遍希望保留自身技能发展、独立思考以及不依赖AI时实际能力的判断，并强调作品仍要“像自己的”，涉及归属感、自豪感、真实性与伦理顾虑；同时，课业负担、截止日期、成绩、便利和落后于同伴的担忧又使AI具有吸引力。尽管少数参与者明确将AI选择与人生目的联系起来，许多人表达的关切仍可能与目的发展相关。作者借助目的心态框架加以解读，并明确区分这一解读与学生自身的解释，指出理解学生的AI使用需关注他们认为自己需要亲自学习和完成的内容。

papers.title: When college students perceive GAI feedback as credible: the role of perceived GAI feedback credibility in promoting deep learning through cognitive engagement
papers.authors: Wen Guo, Xiaojian Ren
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GAI) has rapidly developed in higher education and has raised new questions from an educational psychology perspective. Why does GAI feedback promote meaningful learning for some college students but fail to produce similar learning benefits for others? To answer this question, this study develops a theoretical framework based on Information Processing Theory, Elaboration Likelihood Model, and Constructivist Learning Theory. This study examines how perceived GAI feedback credibility influences college students’ deep learning and explores the mediating role of cognitive engagement in this relationship. This study adopts a stratified simple sampling method and collects questionnaire data from 506 undergraduate students and uses structural equation modeling (SEM) to examine the proposed model. The results show that perceived GAI feedback credibility has positive relationships with both cognitive engagement and deep learning. In addition, cognitive engagement plays a significant mediating role between perceived GAI feedback credibility and deep learning, suggesting that credible GAI feedback may support deep learning by encouraging college students to engage in cognitive processing and reflective thinking. This study extends research on learning psychology in GAI-supported learning environments by explaining how college students evaluate and process GAI feedback. The findings indicate that the influence of GAI feedback on learning does not simply result from the technology itself. Instead, college students’ judgments of feedback credibility and their following cognitive engagement play important roles in shaping deep learning processes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注为何生成式人工智能反馈对部分大学生能促进深度学习、对另一些却收效有限，基于信息加工理论、精细加工可能性模型与建构主义学习理论构建框架，以问卷方式调查本科生并用结构方程模型检验。结果显示，感知到的GAI反馈可信度与认知投入、深度学习均呈正相关，认知投入在其中起显著中介作用，即可信的反馈可能通过促使学生进行认知加工和反思性思考来支持深度学习。作者据此指出，GAI反馈对学习的作用并非单纯来自技术本身，学生对反馈可信度的判断及其后续认知投入共同塑造了深度学习过程。

papers.title: Clinical characteristics, semiology, and comorbidity patterns in non-epileptic seizures (NES): a retrospective comparative study
papers.authors: Paola Caruso, Magda Quagliotto, Yvonne Radin, Stefania Pavan, Paolo Manganotti, Alberto Benussi
papers.abstract: Objectives Non-epileptic seizures (NES) are paroxysmal events resembling epileptic seizures but not explained by ictal activity. Differential diagnosis may be challenging, particularly because NES and epilepsy can coexist. We aimed to characterize the demographic, clinical, semiological, psychiatric, and instrumental profile of patients with NES, compare patients with NES only with patients with NES epilepsy-only, and assess the robustness of the main associations through sensitivity analyses. Methods We conducted a retrospective observational comparative study using a clinical database from our Neurology Unit (2022–2025) including 38 patients with NES and 23 patients with epilepsy without NES. A total of 18 NES patients had comorbid epilepsy; therefore, the primary comparison included mutually exclusive groups: NES-only ( n = 20) and epilepsy-only ( n = 23). All NES patients were retained for descriptive analyses. Between-group comparisons used exact or non-parametric tests with Benjamini–Hochberg false-discovery-rate (BH-FDR) correction. Sensitivity analyses restricted NES-only patients to those with database-recorded video-EEG confirmation and used Firth penalized logistic regression adjusted for age and sex. Results Among 38 patients with NES, 94.7% had documented psychological/psychiatric comorbidity, mainly anxiety (50.0%) and depression (28.9%). Positive motor phenomena were documented in 73.7%, neurological examination inconsistency/incongruity in 85.7% of evaluable patients, and video-EEG confirmation in 73.7%. Psychological/psychiatric comorbidity was significantly more frequent in NES-only than epilepsy-only patients (90.0% vs. 13.0%; exact OR 50.40, 95% CI 7.29–670.28; BH-FDR p < 0.001), as was anxiety (45.0% vs. 4.3%; BH-FDR p = 0.014). Broad seizure-semiology domains were not significantly different after multiplicity correction. Among imaged patients, abnormal MRI findings were more frequent in epilepsy-only patients (12/18 vs. 0/10; BH-FDR p = 0.006), although MRI ascertainment differed between groups. The psychiatric-comorbidity association persisted in sensitivity analyses. Conclusion NES showed substantial clinical heterogeneity and frequently coexisted with epilepsy. Psychological/psychiatric comorbidity was markedly more frequent in NES-only than epilepsy-only patients and remained robust in sensitivity analyses, although differential ascertainment limits interpretation. Broad seizure manifestations alone did not distinguish the groups after multiplicity correction. Instrumental findings should be considered descriptive rather than NES biomarkers. These findings support explicit stratification for comorbid epilepsy and standardized prospective assessment of psychiatric and semiological features.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于神经内科临床数据库的回顾性比较设计，考察非癫痫性发作（NES）患者的人口学、临床、发作症状学及精神共病特征，并比较单纯NES患者与单纯癫痫患者。结果显示，NES患者中心理或精神共病极为常见，且单纯NES组的心理精神共病和焦虑比例显著高于单纯癫痫组，这一关联在敏感性分析中保持稳健；校正多重比较后，两组在宽泛的发作症状学领域未见显著差异，影像学异常在癫痫组更常见但受检查方式差异限制。作者指出NES临床异质性明显、常与癫痫共存，症状表现本身不足以区分两组，相关器械发现应视为描述性而非生物标志物，并强调需按是否合并癫痫分层及开展标准化的前瞻性精神与症状学评估。

papers.title: AI literacy is directly associated with positive attitudes and indirectly associated with negative attitudes through AI anxiety: a cross-sectional study of preservice teachers
papers.authors: İsmail Satmaz, Mehmet Adıyaman
papers.abstract: Introduction Positive and negative attitudes toward artificial intelligence (AI) may have partly distinct psychological correlates. This cross-sectional study examined whether AI anxiety statistically accounted for associations between AI literacy and positive and negative attitudes toward AI among preservice teachers. Methods Participants were 335 preservice teachers enrolled in a faculty of education in Türkiye. Data were collected using the Artificial Intelligence Literacy Scale, Artificial Intelligence Anxiety Scale, Artificial Intelligence Attitude Scale, and a personal information form. Two indirect-effect models were estimated using PROCESS Model 4 with 5,000 bootstrap resamples, controlling for prior AI training. Results AI literacy was negatively associated with AI anxiety and positively associated with positive attitudes toward AI. AI anxiety was positively associated with negative attitudes but was not significantly associated with positive attitudes. The indirect association through AI anxiety was significant for negative attitudes but not for positive attitudes, and a direct bootstrap contrast confirmed that the two indirect effects differed significantly (B = −0.118, 95% CI [−0.201, −0.039]). Prior AI training was not significantly associated with either attitude dimension. A sensitivity analysis excluding the three reverse-worded AI literacy items reproduced this pattern. Discussion The findings indicate that positive and negative attitudes toward AI may have partly distinct psychological correlates: AI literacy is directly related to positive evaluations, whereas its association with negative evaluations is statistically linked to AI anxiety. Because the data are cross-sectional, the indirect effects should not be interpreted as evidence of causal mediation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以土耳其335名职前教师为对象，采用横断面设计和间接效应模型，考察AI素养是否通过AI焦虑与对AI的正负态度相关联。结果显示，AI素养与AI焦虑负相关、与积极态度正相关；AI焦虑与消极态度正相关，但与积极态度无显著关联。经由AI焦虑的间接关联仅对消极态度显著，且与积极态度对应的间接效应存在显著差异；此前的AI培训与两种态度均无显著关联。作者据此指出，正负态度的心理关联可能部分不同，但横断面数据不足以支持因果中介解释。

papers.title: Within-person reciprocal processes between AI feedback literacy and agentic engagement: a three-wave random-intercept cross-lagged panel study
papers.authors: Shuai Xu
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) feedback has become a pervasive feature of university learning, yet whether students’ capacity to engage productively with such feedback co-develops with their broader learner agency remains poorly understood. Drawing on student feedback literacy theory, self-determination theory as a supplementary motivational lens, and the mutualism principle, this study tested whether AI feedback literacy and agentic engagement reciprocally predict each other over time at the within-person level and exploratorily examined whether they share a stable trait-level association. A three-wave panel study of 480 Chinese undergraduates ( N = 399 with complete data across all waves), with measurements at six-week intervals across one semester, was analyzed using a random-intercept cross-lagged panel model (RI-CLPM). At the between-person level, students who scored systematically higher in AI feedback literacy across the semester also scored systematically higher in agentic engagement, with a moderate and statistically significant trait-level correlation between the two random intercepts ( r = 0.315, p < 0.001), supporting Hypothesis 1. At the within-person level, both cross-lagged pathways were positive and significant: deviations in AI feedback literacy predicted later deviations in agentic engagement ( β = 0.222, p < 0.001), and the reverse pathway was likewise significant ( β = 0.263, p < 0.001). A Wald test indicated that the two reciprocal pathways did not differ significantly in magnitude (Δ B = 0.002, p = 0.972), consistent with a symmetric mutualism. A model comparison confirmed that the RI-CLPM provided substantially better fit than a traditional cross-lagged panel model, with the RI-CLPM revealing substantially larger within-person reciprocal effects once stable trait-level covariation was properly isolated. The findings extend the mutualism principle from a coupling of person-internal constructs to a coupling between a person-internal competency and a person-environment behavioral interface. They also raise the possibility, in a Confucian Heritage Culture context where agentic engagement has historically been culturally muted, that AI feedback may offer a less culturally-loaded venue in which students can exercise agency. The study repositions AI feedback literacy from a static skill into a dynamic developmental resource that is constituted, in part, by the very engagement it enables.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察大学生的AI反馈素养与能动性投入是否在个体内部随时间相互预测，并探索二者是否存在稳定的特质层面关联。作者对480名中国本科生进行了一个学期三次、间隔六周的追踪，采用随机截距交叉滞后面板模型分析。结果发现，在个体间层面，AI反馈素养较高者其能动性投入也较高，二者存在中等程度的稳定关联；在个体内部层面，AI反馈素养的偏离正向预测后续能动性投入的偏离，反向路径同样显著，且两条路径强度无显著差异，符合对称互惠模式。模型比较显示，在分离出稳定特质协变后，该模型揭示的个体内互惠效应明显大于传统交叉滞后模型。作者据此将AI反馈素养视为动态发展资源，并提示在儒家文化背景中AI反馈可能为学生提供较少文化负担的施展能动性的场域。

papers.title: CEP-MI: a novel cue-execution dual-stage motor imagery paradigm with PGCANet decoding architecture
papers.authors: Jianxiu Li, Pengda Yu, Huiyu Qiao, Zhiqiang Zheng, Changming Wang, Zhi Weng, Caili Gong
papers.abstract: Background Motor imagery-based brain-computer interface (MI-BCI) holds great potential in neurorehabilitation and motor assistance. Data quality and motor intention decoding effectiveness are closely associated with participants’ engagement. However, previous MI tasks ignored active engagement regulation, and neural mechanisms underlying the transition from motor imagery to execution remain unclear, with limited relevant research. Conventional separate-trial designs cannot capture continuous brain dynamics from imagery to execution and cannot objectively evaluate subject engagement, which hinders mechanism exploration and stable decoding. Methods To address these paradigm-related limitations, a novel cue-execution MI paradigm (CEP-MI) with countdown anchors was designed to quantify engagement. Motor execution sessions were added post-imagery to reveal neural differences during the transition and identify movement-related brain activities. Meanwhile, to boost MI-EEG decoding performance, a collaborative decoding architecture (PGCANet) integrating prior guidance and channel awareness was proposed, with dual branches and consistency constraint loss for decision fusion. Results CEP-MI effectively quantifies participant engagement, and PGCANet achieves superior decoding performance compared to traditional algorithms and advanced models, with the optimal average accuracy reaching 85.77% in binary classification and 82.47% in quadruple classification. Conclusion Targeting the above-mentioned research gaps, the CEP-MI paradigm provides valuable insights into the imagery-execution transition mechanism. PGCANet enhances MI decoding accuracy via multi-branch collaboration, laying a foundation for MI-BCI’s clinical application in neurorehabilitation. Significance This study introduces a novel paradigm and collaborative architecture that significantly advance MI-BCI decoding accuracy and engagement quantification, and helps to promote its clinical application in neurorehabilitation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对传统运动想象任务忽视参与者主动投入调节、且难以捕捉从想象到执行连续脑动态的问题，设计了带倒计时锚点的提示-执行双阶段运动想象范式（CEP-MI），并配套提出融合先验引导与通道感知的协同解码架构PGCANet。该范式在想象阶段后加入实际执行环节，用于量化参与者的投入程度并考察想象向执行过渡时的神经差异；PGCANet则通过双分支与一致性约束损失进行决策融合。结果显示，CEP-MI能够有效量化参与者的投入水平，PGCANet在二分类和四分类任务中的解码表现优于传统算法与先进模型。作者据此认为，该范式为理解想象-执行过渡机制提供了线索，而协同架构提升了运动想象解码精度，为脑机接口在神经康复中的临床应用打下基础。

papers.title: Effects of question-chain prompting on self-regulated learning, metacognition, and achievement in a generative AI environment
papers.authors: Xiuyu Lin, Shan Li, Yijing Zhu, Hang Ju, Guozhu Ding
papers.journal: International Journal of Educational Technology in Higher Education
papers.abstract: Abstract Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) offers learners immediate and personalized support, yet unguided interaction may encourage passive use and weaken self-regulated learning (SRL). This study examined whether question-chain prompting can support SRL in human-AI interaction. A quasi-experiment was conducted with 83 undergraduates enrolled in a television program production course. A control group used free-form questioning, whereas two experimental groups used either a progressive or a divergent question-chain strategy. Data included GenAI interaction logs, post-task reflections, metacognitive awareness measures, and course grades. This study found that both question-chain groups demonstrated significantly more learning-strategy and learning-monitoring behaviors than the control group. Reflection data further indicated differences in students’ approaches to human-AI collaboration, although these differences should be interpreted cautiously because the reflection prompts differed by condition. Moreover, both experimental groups scored significantly higher than the control group on knowledge of cognition, regulation of cognition, and academic achievement. No significant differences were found between the progressive and divergent question-chain approaches. The findings suggest that question-chain prompting, implemented as an instructional package of specific, sequenced, and required questions, can promote more active engagement during human-AI interaction and support metacognitive development and learning performance. Question chains offer a practical approach for guiding students’ use of GenAI in educational settings.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在生成式人工智能学习环境中，问题链提示能否支持学生的自我调节学习。作者以修读电视节目制作课程的大学生为对象开展准实验，比较自由提问与两种问题链策略下的人机互动。结果显示，两种问题链组的学习策略与学习监控行为均显著多于对照组，其对认知知识和认知调节的测量得分及课程成绩也更高；渐进式与发散式问题链之间未见显著差异。反思数据提示学生的人机协作方式存在差异，但因反思提示随条件而异，这一结果需谨慎解读。研究认为，将问题链作为包含具体、有序且必答问题的教学方案，可促进人机互动中的主动参与，并支持元认知发展与学习表现。

papers.title: Beyond good and bad: An in-depth study of student and teacher views on generative AI in high school.
papers.authors: Sarah Segall, Talia Waltzer, Gail D. Heyman
papers.abstract: Public and scholarly discussions of generative artificial intelligence (AI) in education often emphasize sharp divides, portraying students as enthusiastic adopters unconcerned with learning and teachers as reluctant gatekeepers focused on control and assessment.However, little empirical work has examined how students' and teachers' attitudes toward AI are formed, expressed, and negotiated in everyday social contexts.We conducted in-depth interviews with 31 high school students and 29 high school teachers from five states in the United States to quantitatively examine how both groups reason about generative AI tools in education.Participants rarely expressed simple endorsement or rejection of AI; instead, they often articulated tensions between perceived benefits and risks.Students and teachers described AI as useful and engaging but also potentially undermining genuine learning and skill development.Participants also expressed uncertainty about appropriate use, the reliability of AI outputs, and the long-term implications of AI for education.Attitudes toward AI were shaped through ongoing peer interaction, with many participants describing how conversations and shared experiences influenced their views.Together, these findings suggest that attitudes toward generative AI in education are best understood as socially negotiated responses to a rapidly evolving technology rather than in terms of generational divides.More broadly, the findings highlight how integrating AI into education requires ongoing reflection about the role technology should play in learning and human development.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过深度访谈，考察美国五州的高中师生如何看待生成式人工智能在教育中的作用，关注其态度如何在日常社交情境中形成与表达。研究发现，师生很少简单支持或反对AI，而是同时看到其有用、有吸引力与可能削弱真实学习和技能发展的两面性，并对使用边界、输出可靠性和长期影响存有不确定。态度还受同伴交流与共同经历影响。作者据此认为，师生对AI的态度应理解为对快速演变技术的社会协商反应，而非代际对立，AI进入教育也需持续反思技术在学习与人的发展中应扮演的角色。

papers.title: Shaping early childhood in the age of AI: holistic competencies, pedagogical practices, and ecological support
papers.authors: Li Pei
papers.abstract: The rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI) is reshaping the learning and developmental contexts in which young children grow, learn, and interact. Guided by an ecological perspective, this systematic conceptual mapping review examines 86 resources to explore what young children should learn and how they should be taught. Four themes were identified through thematic analysis: (1) holistic competencies for young children, encompassing foundational cognitive and social–emotional skills, physical and mental well-being, executive functions, learning dispositions, and AI literacy; (2) governance for AI integration in early childhood education; (3) professional development and systemic support for educators; and (4) play-based learning and human-centered approaches in AI-enhanced contexts. The findings suggest that thriving in the AI age requires moving beyond isolated digital skills toward holistic development, supported by a cohesive infrastructure that links classroom practice with structural governance. These findings highlight the necessity of cultivating holistic competencies beyond basic AI literacy in curriculum design, preparing children to navigate an ever-changing digital world. Furthermore, they underscore the imperative for robust institutional support, particularly through participatory research to support age-appropriate pedagogy and educators’ digital confidence, while highlighting the value of playful early learning. Concurrently, these insights establish a theoretical framework for future empirical research, offer actionable strategies for ethical child-centred AI implementation, and provide strategic directions for policy and practice to address the critical demand for transformative knowledge in early childhood education.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述以生态视角系统梳理了86份文献，围绕人工智能时代幼儿应学什么、如何教展开概念性映射。作者通过主题分析归纳出四方面主题：幼儿的整体素养（含基础认知与社会情感技能、身心健康、执行功能、学习倾向及AI素养）、AI融入幼儿教育的治理、教育者的专业发展与系统支持，以及AI增强情境下以游戏为本和以人为中心的教学取向。文章据此提出，适应AI时代需超越孤立的数字技能训练，转向整体发展，并依靠连接课堂实践与制度治理的协同支持体系；同时强调机构支持与参与式研究对适龄教学法和教育者数字信心的重要性，并为后续实证研究、伦理实施与政策实践提供框架。

papers.title: Gendered affective representations in AI-assisted music videos: a qualitative multimethod study
papers.authors: Yaşar Kızıltan, Ayhan Dolunay, Savas GUNGOR
papers.abstract: Introduction Generative artificial intelligence (AI) has become increasingly visible in music-video production, influencing both production practices and the ways in which emotion, bodies, and gender are portrayed visually. This study examines gendered emotional representation in AI-assisted music videos. Methods A qualitative multimethod design combined interpretive visual analysis of four purposively selected AI-assisted music videos with asynchronous written expert interviews involving six creative-industry professionals and four psychology experts ( N = 10). The videos were analysed through an interpretive coding framework covering emotion, gender, body and face, power relations, AI aesthetics, and traces of bias. Results Across the cases, emotion was conveyed not only through facial expression but also through atmosphere, colour, movement, editing, and spatial transitions. The selected works sometimes reproduced familiar conventions, including heteronormative intimacy, militarised masculinity, and idealised female bodies, but also unsettled them through female anger and solidarity and mutable synthetic bodies. Ambiguity in a body’s appearance did not necessarily unsettle its gendered narrative role. Industry accounts described how prompting, selection, revision, and post-production shape representations, while general psychology-expert perspectives informed their interpretation. Discussion The findings position AI-assisted music videos as co-produced sites of synthetic visual culture in which established gendered conventions may be repeated, negotiated, or challenged. Neither expert group provided direct evidence about the production or reception of the selected videos. The findings underline the practical importance of representational review, consent, diversity, and transparent disclosure in AI-assisted cultural production.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察AI辅助音乐视频中的性别化情感表征，采用定性多方法设计，对四部目的性选取的AI辅助音乐视频进行解释性视觉分析，并对创意产业从业者与心理学专家进行异步书面访谈。分析发现，情感不仅通过面部表情传达，也借助氛围、色彩、运动、剪辑和空间转换呈现；所选作品有时复制异性恋亲密关系、军事化男性气质和理想化女性身体等既有惯例，也通过女性愤怒与团结、可变的合成身体对其加以扰动，而身体外观的模糊性未必动摇其性别化叙事角色。行业受访者描述了提示、筛选、修改和后期制作如何塑造表征，心理学专家则提供解读视角。作者据此将AI辅助音乐视频定位为合成视觉文化的共同生产场域，并强调表征审查、同意、多样性与透明披露的实践意义，同时指出两组专家均未提供关于所选视频生产或接受的直接证据。

papers.title: Parasocial and interpersonal interaction: distinct associations with customer value co-creation in virtual brand communities
papers.authors: Xiaomei Wu, Tianmin Ma, Kaile Wang, Hongyan Lin
papers.abstract: Virtual brand communities expose members to communication from the brand side and interaction with other members, but these sources may not relate to participation through the same psychological processes. Drawing on the stimulus organism response framework, social identity theory, and social cognitive theory, this study tested whether community identification and self-efficacy statistically accounted for indirect associations between parasocial interaction, interpersonal interaction, and customer value co-creation behavior. The hypotheses were examined in an unpublished cross-sectional survey of 240 adult users of virtual brand communities in China. An audit of the questionnaire and data codebook corrected a prior item-block parsing error and established the intended 30-item measurement structure. Internal consistency was acceptable for the five composites (Cronbach's alpha = 0.730–0.837; McDonald's omega = 0.744–0.838). A five-factor confirmatory model fit better than models combining the interaction constructs, combining the mediators, or placing all items on one factor, although its absolute fit and discriminant validity were only partly satisfactory (CFI = 0.870, TLI = 0.857, RMSEA = 0.064, SRMR = 0.056). Regression estimates used HC3 robust standard errors, and indirect associations used 5,000 percentile-bootstrap samples. Parasocial interaction uniquely predicted community identification and self-efficacy, and both variables were associated with customer value co-creation. The indirect associations of parasocial interaction through community identification ( B = 0.163, 95% CI [0.038, 0.303]) and self-efficacy ( B = 0.167, 95% CI [0.053, 0.281]) were statistically detectable. Interpersonal interaction retained a direct association with customer value co-creation but did not uniquely predict either proposed mediator when both interaction variables were included; its two specific indirect associations were not statistically detectable. Results were similar after excluding uniform responders and after adding demographic and community-use controls. The findings distinguish relational and capability-related correlates of parasocial interaction while showing that interpersonal interaction may share substantial variance with brand-side relational experience. Because the data are cross-sectional, same-source, and affected by incomplete discriminant validity, the indirect effects are interpreted as covariance patterns consistent with the proposed pathways rather than evidence of causal psychological mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于刺激—有机体—反应框架、社会认同理论和社会认知理论，考察虚拟品牌社区中准社会互动与人际互动是否通过社区认同和自我效能感与顾客价值共创行为产生间接关联。作者对中国虚拟品牌社区的成年用户开展了一项未发表的横断面问卷调查，并采用结构方程模型和自助法检验间接关联。结果显示，准社会互动能独立预测社区认同和自我效能感，这两条间接关联在统计上可被检出；人际互动则与价值共创保持直接关联，但在同时纳入两类互动后不再独立预测任一中介变量，其特定间接关联也不可检出。作者据此区分了准社会互动的关系性关联与能力性关联，并指出人际互动可能与品牌侧关系体验共享较多方差；由于数据为横断面、同源且区分效度仅部分理想，相关间接效应应理解为与所提路径相符的协变模式，而非因果心理机制的证据。

papers.title: When AI advice agrees or disagrees with human judgment: trust, self-efficacy, psychological resilience, and adaptive responses in physical education
papers.authors: Haoqun Yang
papers.abstract: As AI-based decision-support systems become increasingly embedded in physical education and coaching practice, agreement and disagreement between algorithmic advice and participants’ immediate scenario judgments have become important but theoretically underexamined features of human-AI collaboration. Grounded in a shared Judge-Advisor System paradigm, four scenario-based experiments (total N = 859) manipulated whether an experimentally presented AI recommendation was consistent or conflicting with each participant’s prior judgment and tested machine trust and collaborative decision-making self-efficacy as psychological pathways to self-reported collaborative adaptive responses. Psychological resilience and rationale provision were examined as study-specific boundary conditions. Conflict significantly reduced machine trust (Study 1, d = 1.061) and self-efficacy (Study 2, B = −0.687), and both measured mediators carried significant negative indirect associations with adaptive responses (Study 1, B = −0.428; Study 2, via trust B = −0.201, via self-efficacy B = −0.127). Psychological resilience attenuated the between-condition difference in self-efficacy in Study 3 (index of moderated mediation = 0.115). In Study 4, rationale provision moderated the condition-to-trust association, F (1, 239) = 11.348, p < 0.001, partial η 2 = 0.045: the conflict effect was −0.811 in the black-box condition but −0.182 when a rationale was provided. The manipulation therefore concerns advice-judgment agreement rather than a direct experimental comparison of data-driven judgment with established experiential intuition. Because the scenarios did not establish objective recommendation accuracy, the moderation patterns are interpreted as changes in psychological response rather than as evidence that preserving trust or self-efficacy necessarily improves calibration, decision quality, or welfare.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注体育教育情境中，AI建议与使用者自身判断一致或冲突时，人机协作的心理反应。作者基于共享的“判断者—建议者系统”范式开展四项情境实验，考察机器信任与协作决策自我效能两条心理路径，并将心理韧性和理由说明作为边界条件。结果显示，建议与判断冲突会降低机器信任和自我效能，二者均与较弱的协作适应反应相关；心理韧性可缓冲冲突对自我效能的削弱，而提供理由说明能明显减弱冲突对信任的负面影响。作者强调，实验操纵的是建议与判断是否一致，并非比较数据驱动判断与经验直觉的优劣，且情境未确立建议的客观准确性，因此上述调节模式应理解为心理反应变化，而非信任或自我效能必然改善决策校准、质量或福祉的证据。

papers.title: Prompt specificity and iterative behaviour in text-to-music co-creation: a secondary analysis of interaction logs and a framework for perceived creative control
papers.authors: Xian Zhang, Lu Pan
papers.abstract: Introduction Generative artificial intelligence can lower barriers to musical creation while also shifting consequential decisions away from the user. Methods This study examines that tension through a secondary analysis of the published PAGURI interaction-log prompt corpus and develops a tentative framework for perceived creative control. The analysable corpus contained 304 text-to-music prompts from 24 participants. Musical specificity was operationalised as explicit instrument and technical-parameter markers; iterative continuity was measured with Jaccard similarity between consecutive prompts and checked against TF-IDF cosine similarity. To avoid pseudoreplication, group comparisons were conducted on participant-level summaries rather than treating 304 prompts as independent cases. Results Role-derived experience groups differed substantially in mean prompt specificity, H(2) = 10.25, p = 0.006, ε 2 = 0.39, and specificity density, H(2) = 11.52, p = 0.003, ε 2 = 0.45, but not in refinement rate, H(2) = 0.24, p = 0.888. At a descriptive Jaccard threshold of 0.20, 46.8% of consecutive pairs were refinements and 53.2% were restarts; because this classification was threshold-sensitive, continuous similarity remained the primary continuity measure. Prompt specificity did not increase systematically across the session: the mean within-person Spearman correlation was ρ = −0.06, and the distribution of participant-level correlations did not differ significantly from zero, W = 89.0, p = 0.374. Discussion These findings distinguish the explicit technical-musical information users encode in prompts from the sequential continuity of their prompting behaviour. The paper integrates task structure, system autonomy, model coverage, prior experience, self-efficacy, and psychological ownership into a testable framework for future music-education research. Given the small participant-level sample and role-derived grouping, the empirical findings are exploratory and require confirmation in larger, controlled studies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过二次分析已发表的PAGURI交互日志提示语料，考察文本到音乐共创中提示具体性与迭代行为的关系，并据此提出一个关于感知创作控制的初步框架。分析发现，不同角色经验组在提示的具体程度和具体性密度上存在明显差异，但在修改频率上未见差异；提示具体性在会话过程中并未系统性上升，连续提示之间的相似性更多表现为重启而非逐步细化。作者据此区分了用户写入提示的显式技术音乐信息与其提示行为的序列连续性，并将任务结构、系统自主性、模型覆盖、先前经验、自我效能和心理所有权整合为可供后续音乐教育研究检验的框架，同时说明受参与者层面样本较小和按角色分组所限，实证结果具有探索性。

papers.title: Engagement or disengagement: understanding the emotional dynamics of EFL learners in GenAI-assisted writing from the sociocultural perspective
papers.authors: Keqing Wu, Miao Yang, Changmin Lin
papers.abstract: Introduction Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) has reshaped EFL writing education, yet the emotional dimensions of student engagement in GenAI-assisted writing remain underexplored. This longitudinal multiple-case study investigates how Chinese EFL learners' emotional engagement evolves during a GenAI-assisted college writing course and what factors drive this evolution. Methods Drawing on the sociocultural framework of L2 student engagement with written feedback, we traced the emotional trajectories of three focal students across three writing tasks (exposition, group feature article, and argumentation) within a 14-week course. Data were collected through semi-structured interviews with stimulated recall, reflective reports, GenAI-student chatlogs, drafts, informal chats, and course syllabus, and analyzed via thematic analysis. Results Our findings reveal three qualitatively distinct trajectories: positive-resilient, characterized by sustained positive affect with temporary fluctuations; pragmatic-transformative, marked by a gradual shift from practical disengagement to critical engagement; and vulnerable-contingent, moving from moderate disengagement, through tentative peer-mediated improvement, to eventual breakdown and intensified disengagement. These trajectories were shaped by the dialectical interplay between individual factors (e.g., English proficiency, GenAI literacy, mindsets, beliefs, and emotion regulation) and environmental factors (GenAI-relevant task design, peer and teacher mediation, and institutional policies). Discussion The study extends the sociocultural framework by identifying English proficiency and GenAI literacy as critical developmental competencies, embedding GenAI-related factors across multiple environmental levels, and foregrounding emotional engagement as a dynamic, fluid state that interacts with behavioral and cognitive engagement over time. The findings challenge universalist claims about GenAI's uniform affective benefits and underscore the need for differentiated pedagogical approaches that attend to learners' diverse emotional needs in GenAI-mediated writing contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究从社会文化视角考察中国英语学习者在生成式人工智能辅助写作课程中情感投入的演变及其驱动因素，采用纵向多案例研究，通过访谈、反思报告、聊天记录与作文稿等资料进行主题分析。研究发现三条性质不同的情感轨迹：积极韧性型、务实转化型和脆弱情境型，分别表现为持续积极伴随波动、由实际疏离转向批判性投入，以及由中度疏离经同伴中介的短暂改善走向崩溃与疏离加剧。这些轨迹由英语水平、GenAI素养、心态与情绪调节等个体因素同任务设计、同伴与教师中介及制度政策等环境因素之间的辩证互动所塑造。研究据此将英语水平与GenAI素养视为关键发展能力，并强调情感投入是随时间与行为、认知投入相互作用的动态状态，提示不宜假定GenAI具有普遍一致的情感益处。

papers.title: GenAI literacy and perceived decision quality in e-commerce: the mediating role of perceived information overload and the moderating role of consumer involvement
papers.authors: Yiming Guo
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is increasingly used to support product search, comparison, and evaluation in e-commerce. However, consumers differ in their ability to use and critically evaluate GenAI-generated information, which may shape their perceived information overload and decision outcomes. Grounded in Information Processing Theory, this study examines the association between GenAI literacy and perceived decision quality, the mediating role of perceived information overload, and the moderating role of consumer involvement. Data were collected through an online survey of 401 Chinese college students and analyzed using confirmatory factor analysis and bootstrapped mediation and moderation procedures. The results show that GenAI literacy is positively associated with perceived decision quality and negatively associated with perceived information overload. Perceived information overload is negatively associated with perceived decision quality and accounts for a significant indirect association between GenAI literacy and perceived decision quality. Consumer involvement further moderates the association between GenAI literacy and perceived information overload: the negative association is stronger at higher levels of involvement. These findings support an information-processing account in which consumers’ GenAI-related capabilities and motivational involvement jointly shape their perceptions of cognitive burden and decision quality. The study highlights the importance of strengthening consumers’ critical GenAI literacy and adapting AI-supported information presentation to different levels of consumer involvement.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于信息加工理论，考察电商场景中消费者的生成式AI素养与感知决策质量之间的关系，并检验感知信息过载的中介作用和消费者涉入度的调节作用。作者对401名中国大学生开展在线问卷调查，采用验证性因子分析与自助法中介、调节检验进行分析。结果显示，生成式AI素养与感知决策质量正相关、与感知信息过载负相关，感知信息过载则负向关联感知决策质量，并在两者之间承担显著的间接关联；消费者涉入度进一步调节AI素养与信息过载的关系，涉入度越高，这一负向关联越强。研究据此强调提升消费者批判性AI素养，并针对不同涉入水平调整AI支持的信息呈现方式。

papers.title: How AI disclosure influences consumers' purchase intention toward AI-generated Chinese ethnic-minority fashion: the roles of perceived usefulness, perceived authenticity, and algorithm aversion
papers.authors: Kuilin Wei, Jun Liu, Shuai Wang, Yue Sun
papers.abstract: Background With the growing application of generative artificial intelligence (AI) in fashion design and cultural and creative industries, AI-generated Chinese ethnic-minority fashion has created new opportunities for the contemporary transformation of traditional culture. However, whether consumers are willing to accept such products and how AI disclosure influences their evaluations and purchase intentions remain unclear. Drawing on the Stimulus–Organism–Response (S–O–R) model, this study examines the mechanisms through which AI disclosure, design aesthetics, cultural identity, perceived usefulness, perceived authenticity, and algorithm aversion influence consumers' purchase intentions toward AI-generated Chinese ethnic-minority fashion. Methods A questionnaire survey combined with a scenario-based experiment was employed. Six AI-generated fashion illustrations derived from Tujia costume elements were developed and selected as stimulus materials. Participants were randomly assigned to either an AI disclosure group or a non-disclosure group. Data were collected through Tencent Questionnaire, yielding 410 valid responses. Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) and Importance–Performance Map Analysis (IPMA) were employed to examine the structural relationships, mediating effects, moderating effects, and practical priorities for improvement. Results Design aesthetics and cultural identity influenced purchase intention through perceived usefulness and perceived authenticity, with perceived usefulness emerging as the strongest predictor of purchase intention. AI disclosure significantly reduced design aesthetics, cultural identity, perceived usefulness, and perceived authenticity. Algorithm aversion did not significantly moderate the relationship between perceived usefulness and purchase intention but significantly strengthened the positive effect of perceived authenticity on purchase intention. Conclusions This study reveals the multiple psychological pathways through which AI disclosure shapes consumers' evaluations of AI-generated ethnic cultural fashion. The findings further indicate that algorithm aversion alters the extent to which consumers rely on authenticity judgments when forming purchase intentions. This study extends the application of the Stimulus–Organism–Response (S–O–R) model to the context of AI-generated cultural products and provides practical implications for balancing AI transparency, cultural authenticity, and the practical value of products.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于刺激—有机体—反应模型，结合问卷与情景实验，考察AI披露如何影响消费者对AI生成的中国少数民族服饰的购买意愿。结果显示，设计美感和文化认同通过感知有用性与感知真实性影响购买意愿，其中感知有用性是最强预测因素；AI披露则显著降低上述四项评价。算法厌恶未显著调节感知有用性与购买意愿的关系，但显著增强感知真实性对购买意愿的正向作用。研究据此讨论了AI透明度、文化真实性与产品实用价值之间的平衡。

papers.title: Generative-augmented multimodal neuroaffective decoding for product evaluation: toward neurofeedback-driven human-in-the-loop co-design
papers.authors: Ming Deng
papers.abstract: Background Kansei engineering traditionally relies on self-reported evaluations of product impressions, which are susceptible to contextual influences, recall bias, and assessment timing. Multimodal psychophysiological measurements offer complementary insights into affective responses, but integrating heterogeneous signals with limited sample sizes remains challenging. This study proposes Generative-Augmented Multimodal Affective Fusion (GAMAF) to predict perceived attractiveness, innovativeness, and friendliness in product evaluation. Methods GAMAF integrates feature-space conditional Wasserstein generative adversarial learning with gradient penalty (cWGAN-GP), cross-modal attention, graph-based interactions, and adaptive modality weighting. Fifty participants evaluated three automobile cockpit designs, yielding 150 participant–stimulus trials after multimodal quality control. Electroencephalography (EEG), eye tracking (ET), and peripheral physiological signals were integrated and evaluated using nested participant-wise cross-validation. Results GAMAF achieved mean outer-fold R² values of 0.810, 0.850, and 0.840 for attractiveness, innovativeness, and friendliness, respectively, each with a standard deviation of 0.016. These values exceeded those of the Multimodal Transformer baseline (0.75, 0.78, and 0.76, respectively). Across the three targets, GAMAF reduced aggregate mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean squared error (RMSE) by approximately 29.6% and 29.7%, respectively. Ablation analyses supported the integrated architecture, while adaptive modality weights revealed target-dependent patterns. Discussion GAMAF demonstrates the potential of generative-augmented multimodal fusion for decoding Kansei-related product impressions. However, performance comparisons remain descriptive because baseline variability and participant-level uncertainty were not quantified. Further validation on unseen product designs and closed-loop design optimization is needed to establish its generalizability and practical utility.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对感性工学中自评易受情境与回忆偏差影响、多模态生理信号样本有限且难以融合的问题，提出生成增强多模态情感融合方法GAMAF，用脑电、眼动和外周生理信号预测产品评价中的吸引力、创新性与友好度。50名参与者对三款汽车座舱设计进行评价，经质量筛选后得到150次被试—刺激试验，并采用嵌套的被试间交叉验证评估。结果显示，GAMAF对三个目标的平均外层R²分别为0.810、0.850和0.840，高于多模态Transformer基线，并降低了总体平均绝对误差和均方根误差。消融分析支持其整合架构，自适应模态权重呈现随目标而异的模式。作者指出，基线波动与被试层面不确定性未量化，性能比较仍属描述性，且需在未见设计和闭环优化中进一步验证。

papers.title: From a surgeon's stroke to a third hemisphere—The auxilium architecture for brain restoration and extension
papers.authors: Mijail Demian Serruya
papers.abstract: A surgeon was exercising on a stationary bicycle when he had a large ischemic left middle cerebral artery territory stroke, complicated by hemorrhagic transformation requiring hemicraniectomy and cranioplasty. He developed right-sided spastic hemiplegia and a mixed aphasia. This paper takes that case as its anchor to pose the question: beyond improving residual function, what would it mean to restore cognitive function that was lost so that the person fully returns to their pre-stroke baseline? Existing brain-computer interfaces rely on the person having an intact cortical substrate for intended movement and speech. Here we propose the Auxilium, a brain restoration architecture for the situation where that substrate is no longer present: an extracranial auxiliary brain system, agnostic to its substrate, that connects to a person's residual cortex through whatever input-output technology proves most appropriate, and that supplies, in parallel and in real time, new substrate, whether biological or synthetic. We address an assumption of brain-computer interface development, that throughput is the binding constraint. Linking a kHz brain to MHz digital does not impart the higher clock speed, because the limitation lies not in the port but in the architecture of the entire brain and body imparted by evolution. We posit that the substrate of canonical circuits and their integration areas is essential, and the Auxilium can be understood as restoring both connectivity (linkage between disconnected areas) and computation (information generation capability of a volume of neural tissue). We propose a near-term de-risking pipeline using stereoelectroencephalography during surgical epilepsy evaluation, comparing extracranial modules spanning threshold rules, PID controllers, expert systems, artificial neural networks, neuromorphic devices, and biological specimens, each linked in real time to a participant serving as their own control on naturalistic tasks. If ports alone restore the lost function, the requirement is routing connectivity. If performance improves only when the module supplies its own dynamics, the requirement is computational substrate. We expect the answer to depend on how much tissue was lost, how quickly, and on the individual's reserve, and we treat routing and substrate as endpoints of a continuum to be mapped empirically.
