papers.summary_zh: 该文以外科医生大面积缺血性卒中后遗留偏瘫与混合性失语为引，提出一个理论架构问题：脑机接口能否不止改善残余功能，而是恢复已丧失的认知功能。作者提出Auxilium架构，设想在颅外接入一个不依赖特定基质的辅助脑系统，通过合适的输入输出技术与残余皮层相连，并行实时提供生物或合成的新基质，并把恢复连通与恢复计算作为两个核心需求。文章还质疑将吞吐量视为脑机接口瓶颈的假设，认为限制来自整个脑与身体的演化架构。作者提出利用手术癫痫评估中的立体脑电，将多种颅外模块与参与者实时连接、以自身为对照开展自然任务，以区分仅需路由连通还是需要计算基质，并预期答案取决于组织损失量、速度与个体储备。

papers.title: Data-driven subgroups of adolescent depression: integrating EEG-derived brain networks, childhood trauma, and depressive symptoms
papers.authors: Xuan Liu, Yexian Zeng, Xiaofeng Lan, Muqin Zhang, Weicheng Li, Zhanjie Luo, Guanxi Liu, Yiyun Xue, Yuping Ning, Yanling Zhou
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Adolescent major depressive disorder (MDD) is characterized by marked clinical heterogeneity and heightened sensitivity to psychosocial adversity, particularly childhood trauma. Ongoing neurodevelopment and brain plasticity during adolescence may limit the applicability of adult-derived neurobiological models. Previous studies have rarely integrated large-scale network connectivity, trauma exposure, and symptom dimensions within a single multivariate framework and have largely relied on functional magnetic resonance imaging or univariate electroencephalographic (EEG) measures. Methods This cross-sectional case-control study included 67 medication-free adolescents with MDD and 35 matched healthy controls. Resting-state source-space EEG functional connectivity was estimated. Sparse canonical correlation analysis (sCCA) was used to identify multivariate associations between network connectivity and clinical and childhood-trauma measures. Moderation analysis examined whether network connectivity moderated the association between trauma and depression severity. K-means clustering of sCCA-derived canonical variates was used to identify data-driven patient subgroups. Results Adolescents with MDD showed lower default mode network (DMN)-limbic network (LMN) connectivity than healthy controls. The only sCCA mode meeting the prespecified robustness criteria linked physical abuse, emotional neglect, and anxiety/somatization to distributed connectivity features, particularly those involving the frontoparietal, limbic, visual, and salience networks. Within-visual-network connectivity moderated the association between childhood trauma and depression severity. Clustering identified two patient subgroups with distinct symptom and network profiles. Conclusions EEG-derived network measures may help characterize the interplay between childhood trauma and clinical heterogeneity in adolescent MDD. These preliminary findings require replication in larger, independent samples. Clinical trial number not applicable
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注青少年重性抑郁障碍的临床异质性，尝试将静息态脑电源空间功能连接、童年创伤与症状维度纳入同一多变量框架，以识别数据驱动的患者亚组。研究采用横断面病例对照设计，比较青少年患者与健康对照的网络连接，并用稀疏典型相关分析考察连接与创伤、症状的关联。结果显示，患者默认网络与边缘网络连接低于对照；唯一满足稳健性标准的关联模式将躯体虐待、情感忽视和焦虑/躯体化与额顶、边缘、视觉及突显网络等分布式连接特征联系起来，且视觉网络内部连接调节了童年创伤与抑郁严重度的关联。聚类进一步分出两个症状与网络特征不同的患者亚组，作者强调这些初步发现尚需在更大独立样本中验证。

papers.title: Real-Time Vigilance Monitoring via Biosignals: A Scoping Review
papers.authors: Junghoon Chung, Ji-Eun Kim
papers.journal: Proceedings of the Human Factors and Ergonomics Society Annual Meeting
papers.abstract: This scoping review aims to identify types of computational models that use physiological signals for real-time vigilance monitoring. Vigilance, or the ability to sustain attention over time, is essential in domains such as driving, aviation, and industrial operations, where lapses can cause serious harm. Following PRISMA guidelines, the review searched IEEE, ProQuest, PubMed, and ScienceDirect and identified 16 studies that examined vigilance and real-time monitoring systems. Most studies applied supervised machine learning, mainly for binary classification of vigilance states such as alert versus drowsy, and were concentrated in automotive contexts. Electroencephalography (EEG) was the most commonly used sensor, while heart rate variability (HRV), electrooculography (EOG), photoplethysmography (PPG), and galvanic skin response (GSR) appeared less frequently. Overall, current systems still prioritize threshold-based detection over continuous tracking of vigilance changes. The review highlights the need for multimodal sensing, real-world validation, and adaptive modeling frameworks to support reliable deployment across diverse operational environments.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述依据PRISMA流程检索多个数据库，梳理了利用生理信号进行实时警觉度监测的16项研究，重点考察所用计算模型的类型。研究发现，多数研究采用监督机器学习，主要对警觉与困倦等状态做二分类，且集中于汽车场景；脑电是最常用的传感器，心率变异性、眼电、光电容积脉搏波和皮肤电反应使用较少。总体而言，现有系统仍偏重基于阈值的检测，而非对警觉度变化的连续追踪，作者据此指出多模态传感、真实环境验证与自适应建模是可靠部署的关键方向。

papers.title: Brain-Computer Interfaces for AAC: Hybrid SSVEP + Eye-Tracking for Faster Selection Rates
papers.authors: Lola Peres
papers.journal: Proceedings of the Human Factors and Ergonomics Society Annual Meeting
papers.abstract: Augmentative and alternative communication systems are essential for people with severe speech and motor impairments, yet many interfaces remain slow, effortful, and error-prone. This study evaluated a hybrid brain-computer interface that combines steady-state visually evoked potentials (SSVEP) with eye-tracking to improve selection speed, reliability, and usability. Participants completed symbol selection, short phrase construction, and correction tasks under three conditions: SSVEP-only, eye-tracking-only, and hybrid SSVEP plus eye-tracking. In the hybrid condition, gaze rapidly narrowed the likely target region, while SSVEP classification confirmed user intent. Outcomes included selection rate, accuracy, errors, correction time, communication throughput, workload, effort, trust, and preference. The hybrid interface achieved the strongest performance, with faster selection than SSVEP-only and better control than eye-tracking-only. It also reduced accidental selections and correction burden, particularly in dense layouts and longer tasks. Results further emphasized personalized gaze thresholds, SSVEP windows, and visual layouts for sustained, practical AAC use across diverse user needs.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对严重言语与运动障碍者使用的辅助沟通系统操作慢、费力且易出错的问题，评估了一种将稳态视觉诱发电位（SSVEP）与眼动追踪结合的混合脑机接口，并让参与者分别在仅SSVEP、仅眼动追踪和混合三种条件下完成符号选择、短语构建与纠错任务。结果显示，混合条件下眼动先快速缩小候选区域、SSVEP再确认意图，选择速度快于仅SSVEP，控制表现优于仅眼动追踪，同时减少了误选和纠错负担，在密集布局和较长任务中尤为明显。作者据此强调，需针对不同用户需求个性化设置注视阈值、SSVEP时间窗和视觉布局，以支持持续、实用的辅助沟通使用。

papers.title: AI Tutors in Technical Training: Trust, Feedback Timing, and Skill Transfer in Maintenance Tasks
papers.authors: Lola Peres
papers.journal: Proceedings of the Human Factors and Ergonomics Society Annual Meeting
papers.abstract: Technical maintenance training requires learners to develop procedural accuracy, diagnostic reasoning, error recovery, and confidence under realistic conditions. This study examined how AI tutor feedback timing influences trust, over-reliance, and skill transfer in maintenance tasks. Participants completed procedures under three conditions: immediate feedback, delayed feedback, and adaptive feedback triggered by hesitation, repeated errors, or safety-critical risk. Outcomes included training accuracy, recovery quality, completion time, cognitive workload, tutor trust, feedback acceptance, and unaided transfer performance. Immediate feedback improved early accuracy and reduced procedural errors but increased step-by-step dependence and weakened independent troubleshooting. Delayed feedback produced mixed effects, supporting autonomy for some learners while increasing frustration and avoidable mistakes for others. Adaptive feedback produced the strongest results by allowing independent attempts while intervening when support was needed. It improved unaided transfer, error recovery, procedural sequencing, and trust calibration. Overall, AI tutors were most effective when feedback scaffolded learning without replacing trainee judgment.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了维护任务技术培训中AI导师的反馈时机如何影响信任、过度依赖与技能迁移，参与者分别在即时反馈、延迟反馈和按需触发的自适应反馈条件下完成操作程序。结果显示，即时反馈虽提升了早期准确率并减少程序性错误，却加剧了逐步依赖、削弱了独立排障能力；延迟反馈效果不一，对部分学习者支持自主性，对另一些人则增加挫败感和可避免的错误。自适应反馈效果最强，它允许学员先独立尝试、在需要时介入，从而改善了无辅助迁移、错误恢复、程序顺序和信任校准。作者据此认为，AI导师在提供学习支架而不替代学员判断时最为有效。

papers.title: Do You Feel Like Using GenAI? Scenario Emotional Valence Impact on Potential Generative Artificial Intelligence Use
papers.authors: Grace S. Oswald, Benjamin A. Clegg
papers.journal: Proceedings of the Human Factors and Ergonomics Society Annual Meeting
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (genAI) is becoming increasingly ubiquitous, creating questions about what factors are influencing its use. This study explored whether emotions in decision-making scenarios impact the use of genAI writing tools. We presented 35 writing-based scenarios, some associated with the six basic human emotions (sadness, anger, enjoyment, fear, surprise, disgust) and others created as neutral emotional conditions. College student participants were asked whether they would use a genAI tool to complete the task, and then to identify the emotion present. Most participants varied their decision to use AI tools. There were significant effects of emotion on the potential use of genAI assistance, with a higher intended adoption for fear and surprise contexts. Emotion strength also influenced potential AI use, with reported AI trust and task complexity increasing in stronger-rated scenarios. However, the overall rate of AI use was generally low. Implications for automation use and trust theories are discussed.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察决策情境中的情绪效价是否影响大学生使用生成式AI写作工具的意愿，向参与者呈现与六种基本情绪相关及中性情绪的写作情境，询问其是否会用AI完成并识别情境情绪。结果显示，多数参与者的使用决定随情境变化，恐惧和惊讶情境下的预期采用率较高；情绪强度也影响使用意愿，情境评分越强，报告的AI信任与任务复杂度越高，但整体AI使用率偏低。文章据此讨论了对自动化使用与信任理论的启示。

papers.title: When AI Enters the Pencil Box: A Longitudinal Study of Child–LLM Writing Collaboration in a Chinese Primary School
papers.authors: Junrong Song, Zheng Wei, Changyang He, Junxiang Liao, Xian Xu, David Kei Man Yip
papers.abstract: We report a qualitative study spanning more than six months with upper-primary students (ages 9–12) in southern China using a local LLM (Doubao) for writing. Two interview waves with ten students (nine re-interviewed) and six teachers (three re-interviewed) reveal a set of recurring shifts in our focal cohort: from novelty to strategy, from anthropomorphic “companion/virtual teacher” to tool-like framing, and from quick unsticking to guarded use shaped by dependence, fairness, and exam-transfer Footnote1 concerns. Students valued speed and breadth but noted mechanical tone, age/style mismatch, and weak transfer to AI-free tests. We map a Control × Dependency framework and before/after transitions, and surface tensions around classroom norms and equity amid policy ambiguity and uneven AI literacy. We suggest process-visible, agency-preserving integration: sentence- and phrase-level provenance with mandatory micro-edits, task-specific scaffold ceilingsFootnote2, and process-anchored assessment schemes that explicitly factor in AI-use traces.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以中国南方一所小学的高年级学生为对象，开展为期六个多月的定性研究，考察其使用本地大语言模型辅助写作的协作过程。通过两轮学生与教师访谈，作者发现学生对AI的定位从新奇体验和拟人化“伙伴/虚拟教师”逐步转向工具化理解，使用方式也从快速求助转为因依赖、公平和考试迁移等顾虑而有所保留；学生认可速度与广度，但指出语气机械、年龄与风格不匹配、对无AI测试迁移较弱。文章据此提出控制与依赖框架，并建议采用过程可见、保留学生能动性的整合方式，如句词级来源标注与强制微编辑、任务特定的支架上限，以及纳入AI使用痕迹的过程性评价。

papers.title: Does Code-Switching Disrupt Emotion Recognition? A Valence–Arousal Analysis of Affective Misalignment in Multilingual Human–AI Interaction
papers.authors: HeeSoo Kim
papers.abstract: As multilingual communication increasingly involves code-switching, emotion recognition in mixed-language input has become a key challenge for human–AI interaction. This study examines emotion classification under English–Spanish and Spanish–English code-switching conditions using the valence–arousal framework. Five large language models (GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-5, Llama-3, Llama-4, and Claude Opus 4.7) were evaluated on 7,560 inputs across five code-switching ratios. Performance was assessed using accuracy, Macro-F1, and mixed-effects logistic regression, while errors were categorized as valence shifts, arousal shifts, or same-region confusions. Increasing code-switching produced a small but significant accuracy decline in both language directions. Under English-to-Spanish conditions, models generally preserved valence while showing greater arousal instability. Under Spanish-to-English conditions, GPT-5 showed increased valence-shift errors and was the only model with a significant direction–error-type association. Aggregate metrics can obscure distinct forms of affective misalignment. The proposed framework enables dimension-level comparison of error patterns across models, language directions, and code-switching ratios.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察多语言人机交互中语码转换是否干扰大语言模型的情感识别，以效价—唤醒框架评估五种模型在英西、西英双向混合语言输入下的情绪分类表现。结果显示，语码转换比例升高会带来幅度不大但显著的准确率下降；英译西条件下模型多能保持效价而唤醒维度更不稳定，西译英条件下GPT-5的效价偏移错误增多，且是唯一呈现方向与错误类型显著关联的模型。作者据此指出，总体指标可能掩盖不同形式的情感错位，所提框架可在维度层面比较模型、语言方向与转换比例下的错误模式。

papers.title: Data science for K-12: A design-based research study
papers.authors: Andrew A. Tawfik, Luiz Barboza, Andrew McGregor Olney, Yeonji Jung
papers.abstract: Abstract Data science is a field that merges advancements in computer science, statistics, and machine learning. To date, much data science instruction has been through graduate programs or self-directed course offerings. There are therefore fewer opportunities for formal data science education, especially for K-12 educators and learners who have limited exposure to these fields. While some efforts have emerged to introduce data science in pre-college settings, there is little research regarding learning design strategies that support data science for inservice teachers. As such, this project employs a design-based research (DBR) approach to develop accessible and engaging open-access learning resources as a way to reduce barriers to data science instruction across the educational spectrum. Given the gap regarding data science in K-12, our DBR study identifies the following design elements: (a) revised data science content scope, (b) design standardization for interactive learning, (c) reframing data science for case-based learning, (d) artificial intelligence (AI) towards data personalization, and (e) data science coding through goal-based learning. The project also introduces aspects of the curriculum via a teacher professional development, which provides important insights and challenges regarding data science at the middle and high school levels. Implications for learning design, open-educational resources, data science standards, and others are discussed.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对K-12阶段数据科学教育机会有限、尤其缺乏支持在职教师的教学设计策略这一问题，采用基于设计的研究方法开发开放获取的学习资源。研究识别出修订的数据科学内容范围、交互式学习的设计标准化、以案例为基础重构数据科学、面向数据个性化的AI应用，以及通过目标导向学习开展数据科学编程等设计要素，并通过教师专业发展活动引入课程，揭示了中学阶段数据科学教学的重要见解与挑战。文章据此讨论了学习设计、开放教育资源与数据科学标准等方面的启示。

papers.title: Human-Centered AI Metacognition: Development and Validation of a Scale for Preserving Cognitive Autonomy in Human–AI Collaboration
papers.authors: Huanhua Lu, Ruihan Chen, Ran Wei
papers.abstract: The rapid advancement of generative artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming human cognitive activities and creating a growing need to preserve cognitive autonomy in human–AI interactions. Although recent research has examined metacognition in AI-mediated environments, existing work has primarily focused on improving AI use and human–AI collaboration, with less attention to how individuals regulate the role and extent of AI involvement in their own cognitive activities. To address this gap, the present study introduced Human-Centered AI Metacognition (HC-AIM), defined as the capacity to recognize AI capabilities and limitations, monitor AI-generated information, and regulate the extent to which AI participates in one’s own cognitive activities while maintaining cognitive autonomy. Across three studies, we developed the Chinese version of the Human-Centered AI Metacognition Scale (HC-AIMS) and conducted an initial psychometric evaluation. Study 1 examined the scale structure using exploratory factor analysis and supported a predominantly unidimensional structure with good internal consistency. Study 2 examined this structure using confirmatory factor analysis and provided evidence of its convergent validity through its association with general metacognition. Study 3 further replicated the scale structure and internal consistency and examined its relationships with AI literacy, collaborative AI metacognition, and autonomous cognitive offloading. HC-AIM was positively associated with all three constructs. Comparisons of theoretically specified factor models provided preliminary evidence of empirical distinguishability between HC-AIM and both AI literacy and collaborative AI metacognition, despite substantial correlations with these constructs. HC-AIM was also positively associated with autonomous cognitive offloading, providing complementary self-reported criterion-related evidence for its validity. Taken together, the findings suggest that HC-AIM represents a contextualized, human-centered form of metacognitive regulation that is closely related to broader metacognitive and AI-related competencies while specifically emphasizing the regulation of AI participation in human cognition. The Chinese version of the HC-AIMS provides a theoretically grounded starting point for investigating human cognition and cognitive autonomy in AI-mediated environments.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对生成式人工智能介入认知活动后如何保持认知自主性的问题，提出“人本AI元认知”（HC-AIM）概念，并开发中文版量表进行心理测量学检验。作者通过三项研究依次开展探索性因素分析、验证性因素分析与效度关联检验，发现该量表主要呈单维结构且内部一致性良好，HC-AIM与一般元认知、AI素养、协作式AI元认知及自主性认知卸载均呈正相关，并在理论上可区分的因子模型比较中显示出与AI素养、协作式AI元认知的初步区分证据。研究据此认为，HC-AIM是一种情境化、以人为本的元认知调节能力，为考察AI中介环境下的认知自主性提供了理论基础的测量起点。

papers.title: From AI labels to trust: cognitive pathways linking authenticity judgments, risk perception, and trust in AI-generated videos
papers.authors: Jiabin Fu, Yi Zhang, Shu Zhang
papers.abstract: Background The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence-generated content (AIGC) has raised concerns regarding the authenticity and trustworthiness of synthetic media. Although AI disclosure labels are increasingly used as transparency mechanisms, the cognitive processes through which these cues influence trust formation remain unclear. Objective This study aimed to develop and test a cognitive pathway model explaining how AI disclosure labels, authenticity judgments, perceived risk, cognitive processing styles, and literacy factors shape trust toward AI-generated videos. Methods A 2 × 2 between-subjects experiment was conducted with 617 participants randomly assigned to four conditions involving AI-generated instructional videos with different AI label and video quality combinations. Participants evaluated authenticity, systematic and heuristic processing, trust, perceived risk, adoption intention, sharing intention, AI literacy, and media literacy. Regression, bootstrapped mediation, and moderation analyses were performed. Results AI disclosure labels significantly reduced perceived authenticity but did not directly affect trust, adoption, sharing intention, or perceived risk. Trust formation occurred through cognitive pathways: systematic processing increased trust, whereas heuristic processing reduced trust. Authenticity enhanced trust and lowered perceived risk, with perceived risk mediating the authenticity–trust relationship. Trust positively predicted adoption and sharing intentions, while AI and media literacy moderated selected relationships. Conclusion Trust in AI-generated videos was not directly determined by transparency labels alone. Instead, the observed associations among authenticity judgments, perceived risk, information processing, and trust were consistent with a multi-stage cognitive interpretation, although the cross-sectional post-exposure measurement of these constructs does not establish their temporal or causal sequence.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注AI披露标签如何影响人们对AI生成视频的信任，基于认知路径模型开展了一项2×2组间实验，让参与者观看不同标签与画质组合的教学视频并评价真实性、加工方式、信任与风险等。结果显示，AI标签显著降低了感知真实性，却未直接改变信任、风险感知或采纳与分享意愿；信任主要通过认知路径形成，系统式加工提升信任，启发式加工则降低信任，真实性判断经由感知风险影响信任，信任进而正向预测采纳和分享意愿，AI素养与媒介素养调节了部分关系。作者据此指出，透明度标签本身不足以决定信任，真实性、风险与信息加工的多阶段认知解释更符合观察到的关联，但横断面测量无法确立因果顺序。

papers.title: Generative artificial intelligence use and interpersonal educational interaction among nursing students: self-regulated learning as a statistical mediator
papers.authors: Jianyun Li, Ershan Xu, Li Li, Lijuan Huang, Yan Pu, Ruirui Huang
papers.abstract: Background Generative artificial intelligence (GAI) is reshaping health sciences education. For nursing students, educational interaction (EI), self-regulated learning (SRL), and GAI interaction are all particularly important. However, these relationships and their processes remain underexplored. Methods A total of 1020 nursing students were recruited from one medical university in Hunan Province in China. The Demographics Questionnaire, the Chinese version of Student-GAI interaction scale, the Educational Interaction Scale, and the Self-regulated Learning Questionnaire were administered. SPSS 22.0 and AMOS 24.0 software were used to analyze the data. Results The mean scores of student-GAI interaction (SGI) and EI were 14.80 ± 2.27 and 70.90 ± 8.15, respectively. Significant positive relationships were found among all three variables (all P < 0.01). Both SGI (β = 0.256) and SRL (β = 0.520) positively were associated with EI (both P < 0.001). Furthermore, SGI showed a significant direct association with EI, with a direct effect value of 0.92 ( P < 0.001). SRL statistically mediated the association between SGI and EI, with a significant indirect effect value of 0.44. The mediating effect represented 32.35% of the total effect ( P < 0.001). Dimension-specific analyses revealed that the mediating effect was strongest for student-teacher interaction (45.41%) and student-content interaction (41.54%). Conclusions SGI is positively associated with EI among nursing students, both directly and indirectly through SRL. Educational strategies that encourage effective GAI use and strengthen SRL may be associated with enhanced EI in nursing education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察护理专业学生与生成式人工智能的互动（SGI）与其教育互动（EI）之间的关系，并检验自我调节学习（SRL）是否在其中起统计中介作用。研究在一所医科大学招募护理学生，使用问卷测量这三个变量并进行中介分析。结果显示，SGI、SRL与EI两两呈正相关；SGI与EI存在直接关联，同时SRL显著中介了这一关联，中介效应约占总效应的三成，其中在学生—教师互动和学生—内容互动维度上的中介比例更高。作者据此提出，鼓励有效使用生成式人工智能并加强自我调节学习，可能与护理教育中教育互动的提升相关；但研究为横断面设计，只能说明统计关联而非因果效果。

papers.title: Between-group differences in resting-state functional connectivity within the brain’s extended triple-network following genuine and sham chiropractic adjustments: a quasi-experimental pilot trial
papers.authors: Stephanie G. B. Sullivan, Margaret Sliwka, Emily D. Drake, Tyson Michael Perez
papers.abstract: Introduction Chiropractic research has traditionally focused on subjective, pain-related outcomes; however, emerging evidence suggests that chiropractic care may also influence neurophysiological functioning. This pilot study aimed to assess the feasibility of a neurophysiological assessment battery and explore differences in brain and autonomic nervous system (ANS) responses following genuine versus sham chiropractic adjustments. Methods In this pilot quasi-experimental, sham-controlled trial, 30 adults received a single session of either genuine or sham instrument-assisted chiropractic care. Resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) and electrocardiography (ECG) were collected at baseline, immediately post-intervention, and one week later. Feasibility outcomes included study procedures and participant blinding. Exploratory outcomes included changes in EEG functional connectivity (FC) and heart rate variability (HRV). Results The study protocol was feasible to implement, and participant blinding was successful. Compared with sham care, genuine chiropractic care was associated with increased resting-state FC within a broadly distributed cluster spanning cortical regions of the brain’s extended triple-network, including the medial frontoparietal, dorsolateral frontoparietal, and mid-cingulo-insular networks, in the delta and theta frequency bands. No between-group differences were observed for HRV measures. Discussion These findings suggest that genuine chiropractic adjustments may differentially influence resting-state functional connectivity within large-scale brain networks compared with sham care. Although no effects on HRV were observed, the neurophysiological findings support further investigation in a fully powered randomized controlled trial to confirm these effects and determine their clinical significance. Trial registration and funding This trial was prospectively registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT05249530) and funded by Life University (Marietta, GA, USA).
papers.summary_zh: 该初步研究考察真实与模拟脊椎按摩调整后静息态脑功能连接及自主神经反应的组间差异，并评估神经生理测评方案的可行性。30名成人接受单次真实或模拟干预，在基线、干预后即刻及一周后采集脑电与心电数据。结果显示方案可行且盲法成功；与模拟组相比，真实调整与扩展三网络多个皮层区域在delta和theta频段的静息态功能连接增强相关，而心率变异性未见组间差异。作者据此认为真实调整可能对大规模脑网络连接产生不同影响，但结果属探索性，需更大样本随机对照试验确认。

papers.title: Generative AI as a team moderator in CSCL : Facilitating students' multidimensional engagement through adaptive scaffolding for socially shared regulation of learning
papers.authors: Dengkang Chen, Yi Zhang, Heng Luo, Fucheng Guo, Yijie Lu, Xiao-Ge Guo
papers.abstract: Abstract Socially shared regulation of learning (SSRL) is essential for successful collaboration, yet effectively scaffolding it remains challenging because regulatory needs are dynamic and context‐dependent. While generative AI (GenAI) offers potential for adaptive support, current applications in collaborative learning largely position it as a content‐oriented tutor for knowledge explanation or idea generation, leaving its role as a process‐oriented team moderator for scaffolding SSRL processes underexplored. To address this gap, we conducted a 16‐week quasi‐experiment with 64 undergraduates in China, comparing adaptive SSRL scaffolding delivered by a GenAI agent in the adaptive‐SSRL condition with static scaffolding via structured digital worksheets in the static‐SSRL condition. Survey data and group discussion transcripts were analysed using statistical methods and epistemic network analysis. Results indicated several differences in students' multidimensional engagement between the two conditions: (1) Behaviourally, the adaptive‐SSRL group showed significantly higher participation equality, although participation intensity did not differ significantly between groups. (2) Cognitively, the adaptive‐SSRL group demonstrated deeper cognitive engagement, reflected in more advanced cognitive presence phases and more integrative, solution‐oriented discourse patterns. (3) Emotionally, the adaptive‐SSRL group reported significantly higher overall emotional engagement, particularly feeling more relaxed during collaboration and more connected with peers. These findings extend human–AI collaboration research by showing that GenAI can function as an SSRL‐informed team moderator rather than a content‐oriented tutor. They also offer design implications for GenAI‐enabled adaptive SSRL scaffolding and human–AI role division in CSCL. Practitioner notes What is already known about this topic Socially shared regulation of learning (SSRL) is critical for successful collaboration and is closely associated with the quality of student engagement. While static scaffolds (eg, worksheets) provide a basic regulatory structure, they fail to adapt to the dynamic and emergent needs of collaborating teams. Generative AI (GenAI) is increasingly used for personalised content support, yet its potential as a process‐oriented team moderator remains underexplored. What this paper adds This study introduced SSRLAgent, a GenAI agent grounded in SSRL theory and established principles of collective metacognitive support, to provide adaptive and interactive regulatory scaffolding. In a 16‐week quasi‐experiment, we compared GenAI‐enabled adaptive SSRL scaffolding (SSRLAgent) with static scaffolding (structured digital worksheets) in CSCL. Adaptive‐SSRL scaffolding was associated with higher‐quality engagement: greater participation equality, deeper cognitive engagement and higher overall emotional engagement. Implications for practice and/or policy The study underscores the necessity of shifting SSRL scaffolding from static, ‘one‐size‐fits‐all’ support to adaptive GenAI interventions to improve collaborative engagement. The findings provide design guidance for developing SSRL agents that are embedded in the shared interaction space and responsive to groups' moment‐to‐moment regulatory needs. The study suggests a productive human–AI division of labour: GenAI agents can support process coordination and regulatory prompting, while teachers and peers remain essential for relationally complex forms of support that collaborative learning requires.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注生成式AI能否在计算机支持的协作学习（CSCL）中充当面向过程的团队调节者，而非仅作内容辅导，并为此开发了基于社会共享学习调节（SSRL）理论的SSRLAgent。作者以64名中国本科生开展16周准实验，将GenAI提供的自适应SSRL支架与结构化数字工作表的静态支架进行比较，结合问卷数据与小组讨论转录进行分析。结果显示，自适应组在行为上参与更平等（参与强度无显著差异），在认知上表现出更深入的认知临场阶段和更整合、面向解决方案的话语模式，在情感上整体投入更高，协作时更放松、与同伴更有联结感。研究据此讨论了从静态统一支架转向自适应GenAI支架的设计启示，以及GenAI负责过程协调与调节提示、教师和同伴承担关系性支持的人机分工。

papers.title: The effect of text–picture consistency on memory integration in college students: Evidence from ERPs
papers.authors: Wen Jia, Keke Wang, Xiaomei Zhao
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: In multimedia learning, individuals often need to integrate textual and visual information. The neural mechanisms underlying how consistency between text and pictures affects memory integration remain unclear. AIM: To examine the effect of text-picture consistency on memory integration in college students and to determine the processing time at which this effect occurs. SAMPLE: = 21.64 ± 2.30) participated in this experiment. METHODS: An adapted pictorial demonstration paradigm was employed. Participants sequentially learned two pairs of text-picture stem facts (consistent vs. inconsistent), separated by an interval, followed by a recognition test for stem and integrated facts. Behavioural and event-related potential (ERP) data were recorded simultaneously. RESULTS: Under the text-picture consistency condition, college students showed significantly better memory integration performance than under the inconsistency condition (58% vs. 48%). EEG results showed that the text-picture inconsistency condition (i.e., the picture and text within a single stem fact were semantically mismatched) elicited a larger P600 wave (500-800 ms) than the text-picture consistency condition, suggesting that text-picture inconsistency primarily induces conflict and integration difficulties during late cognitive processing. No significant differences were observed in the early N400 component. CONCLUSION: Text-picture consistency facilitates memory integration primarily during late processing, aligning with cognitive theories of multimedia learning. Educationally, it serves as a key quality indicator for multimedia material design. Instructors should prioritize semantic alignment and assess knowledge integration during evaluation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察文本与图片的一致性如何影响大学生的记忆整合及其发生的时间进程，采用改编的图示范式，让参与者先后学习一致或不一致的文本—图片事实对，并进行再认测验，同时记录行为与脑电数据。结果显示，一致条件下的记忆整合成绩明显优于不一致条件，且不一致条件在晚期加工阶段诱发更大的P600波，而早期N400成分未见显著差异。作者据此认为，文本—图片一致性主要在晚期认知加工中促进记忆整合，这一结果与多媒体学习的认知理论相符，并提示教学材料设计应重视语义对齐，在评价中关注知识整合。

papers.title: From growth mindset to social-emotional skills in early and mid-adolescence: A educational-cultural examination of an integrated mind-body-behavior framework
papers.authors: Tong Zhou, Yi Liao, Xiaoyu Cheng, 刘丽薇, Wei Chen
papers.abstract: Background Social-emotional learning (SEL) is a core educational goal, yet little is known about how adolescents’ cognitive beliefs, body-related self-perceptions, and everyday health behavior jointly relate to social-emotional skills across diverse cultural contexts and school stages. Objective Based on mindset theory and self-regulation perspectives, we examined an integrated Mind-Body-Behavior framework in which growth mindset, positive body image, and health behavior show a theoretically specified pattern of associated with adolescents’ social-emotional skills. Sample Participants were 62,105 adolescents from 15 regions where data were drawn from the OECD 2023 Study on Social and Emotional Skills. Methods A two-stage quantitative design combined structural equation modeling and machine learning. Results Growth mindset was associated with social-emotional skills both directly and indirectly associations via body image and health behavior. The direct association was substantially stronger than the combined indirect associations, indicating partial rather than complete support for the full proposed pattern. Scalar invariance across the seven clusters was not supported, so cluster-level comparisons were treated as descriptive. Associations differed between cohorts: the association between growth mindset and body image was stronger in the younger cohort, whereas the association between health behavior and social-emotional skills was stronger in the older cohort. Conclusions The study contributes an integrated view of how beliefs, body-related self-perception, and health behavior relate to social-emotional skills. The framework shows that cognitive, body-related, and behavioral domains each relate to adolescents’ social-emotional skills and that these relations change between school stages.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于思维模式理论与自我调节视角，考察成长型思维、积极身体意象和健康行为如何共同关联青少年的社会情感技能，并比较不同文化集群与学段间的差异。研究采用结构方程模型与机器学习相结合的两阶段定量设计，分析多地区青少年数据，发现成长型思维既直接关联社会情感技能，也通过身体意象和健康行为产生间接关联，但直接关联明显强于间接路径的合计，因此所提出的整体路径仅获部分支持。测量等值性未获支持，集群比较仅作描述性处理；两个学段间关联模式不同，成长型思维与身体意象的关联在低龄段更强，健康行为与社会情感技能的关联在较高龄段更强。研究据此提出认知信念、身体感知与日常行为各自关联社会情感技能且随学段变化的整合视角。

papers.title: Patterns of morphology in children’s print: estimates of polymorphemic vocabulary using an innovative, AI-informed database of British and American word families
papers.authors: Clarence Green, Elfrieda H. Hiebert, Averil Coxhead
papers.abstract: Background Morphological complexity is a pervasive feature of the vocabulary children encounter in print, yet resources for investigating morphology remain limited. What morpheme patterns do children encounter in print? Which morphemes cover how many polymorphic words in reading experiences? In this study we introduce the British and American Word Families (BAWF) project, an innovative open database of ∼378,000 words, and use it to address questions such as these. Methods GPT-4.1 was fine-tuned using ∼6000 morphologically-coded words from an existing human-generated database (Morpholex). The fine-tuned LLM coded word-parts in all Wiktionary words attested in large British and American corpora. Performance was evaluated via agreement with existing databases. Classical roots were attributed to a subset of words by mapping a list of roots from Wikipedia to all related entries in Wiktionary. The resulting BAWF database is then used to estimate morpheme patterns across databases of children’s texts and further developed as an online application. Results LLM word part predictions are good and fall within the range of agreement typical of existing databases. Nonetheless, output contains some error/noise. In children’s print, polymorphemic words increase across picturebooks to juvenile fiction and school-reading programs. Greek-Latin root words occur early and commonly. Estimates include that ∼100 prefixes/suffixes may account for nearly all derivations. The BAWF itself is released open-source https://cgg-projects.github.io/BAWF_V1/ , with many lexical, morphological, and psycholinguistic variables, including but not limited to frequency, family size, and morpheme-counts. Discussion The contribution suggests that instruction that prioritizes high-yield morphemes could give children access to large word families. These morphemes are present and common early in print. The BAWF (V1) helps see which may be useful to teach. Users can generate custom wordlists, targeting particular features and families, and access linked dictionary/etymological information. The platform includes AI-assisted searches, explanations, parsing review/corrections, and instructional support. The BAWF project will develop over time, incorporating additional variables (e.g., morphological transparency), improving accuracy and the user interface.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究构建了英美元词族数据库（BAWF），用经人工标注词素数据微调的GPT-4.1为大型语料库中的词条自动切分词素，并据此考察儿童印刷文本中的词素分布。结果显示，模型预测与既有数据库的一致性处于可接受范围，但输出仍含噪声；多词素词从图画书到少年小说和学校阅读材料逐渐增多，希腊-拉丁词根出现较早且常见，约百个前后缀即可覆盖几乎所有派生词。作者据此提出，优先教授高产词素可能让儿童接触到大量词族，并强调数据库为选词教学提供参考，同时提示自动标注的误差和平台后续改进的必要。

papers.title: Monitoring AI-generated English research texts: lexical-semantic accuracy, source fidelity, and revision performance
papers.authors: Jing Zhao, Lei Chen, Xi Bai
papers.abstract: Introduction Linguistically fluent AI-generated English texts can conceal lexical-semantic shifts, altered concept boundaries, source omissions, and unsupported causal formulations. This study compared English paragraphs generated under general and source-constrained conditions and examined how learners' global judgments and localized problem marking were associated with subsequent written revision. Methods Seventy-three agricultural and forestry students evaluated two English paragraphs generated from Chinese source materials under a fixed sequence of general and source-constrained prompts, then selected and revised one paragraph. The linked corpus comprised 146 AI-generated texts, 73 revised texts, 146 global judgment records, 657 expert rating records, 562 coded terminology units, and 511 participant-marked problems. Expert assessments covered lexical-semantic accuracy, source fidelity, and global discourse organization, while revision analyses examined global judgment discrepancy, localized problem marking, and individual-difference variables. Results Source-constrained texts received higher lexical-semantic accuracy scores (mean difference = 0.846, t = 10.634, p < 0.001, d z = 1.245) and source-fidelity scores (mean difference = 0.855, t = 8.819, p < 0.001, d z = 1.032), while global discourse organization differed little between conditions. Lexical-semantic accuracy was strongly associated with source fidelity ( b = 0.522, p < 0.001), whereas the 5,000-resample bootstrap interval for the product of the adjusted coefficients linking these measures to discourse organization spanned zero. After controlling for selected source-text quality, localized problem marking and domain knowledge were positively associated with revised quality, trust in AI-generated language output was negatively associated, and global judgment discrepancy showed no unique association. Discussion Source comparison and localized problem identification were more closely associated with successful written revision than agreement with expert global judgments. These findings highlight the importance of attending to linguistic form, semantic boundaries, and source information when evaluating and revising AI-generated English research texts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了学习者在评估和修改AI生成的英文研究文本时，其全局判断与局部问题标记如何与后续修改表现相关联。73名农林学生在一般提示与来源约束提示下评估两段由中文材料生成的英文段落，并选择其中一段进行修改，专家则从词汇语义准确性、来源忠实度和整体语篇组织三方面评分。结果显示，来源约束条件下的文本在词汇语义准确性和来源忠实度上得分更高，而语篇组织差异不大；局部问题标记和领域知识与修改质量正相关，对AI语言输出的信任则呈负相关，全局判断偏差与修改质量无独特关联。作者据此指出，比较来源信息与识别局部问题比认同专家的全局判断更与成功修改相关，并提示评估AI生成文本时需关注语言形式、语义边界和来源信息。

papers.title: AI feedback does not motivate by itself: a motivational-meaning model for university physical education
papers.authors: Xiangyu Wang, Yongwei Wang
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) can convert movement into scores, visual overlays, and corrective prompts, but technical precision does not determine how learners interpret that feedback. We develop a motivational-meaning model for university physical education (PE), integrating self-determination theory, feedback literacy, self-regulated learning, and motor-learning research. Its contribution is a context-specific account of how pedagogical framing, social visibility, and embodied verification organize the interpretation of an AI-feedback event. Informational and controlling meaning are distinguished from subsequent psychological-need experiences. Blocked translation denotes a temporary difficulty establishing a defensible basis for action, rather than a third motivational meaning. The model also proposes self-regulatory appropriation as the transfer of an externally supported feedback process into independent monitoring and adjustment; its distinctiveness from established self-regulation constructs remains an empirical question. Seven proposition groups specify separable predictions concerning framing, actionable information, contestability, evaluative exposure, discrepancy repair, skill transfer, and a secondary pathway to continued participation. The outcome structure distinguishes system engagement, acquisition performance, retention and transfer, affect and well-being, and voluntary physical activity. Continued participation is treated as a distal hypothesis requiring longitudinal evidence and attention to prior activity, health, habit, and opportunity. We outline independent measurement of event interpretation and need experience, tests that separate technical from perceived accuracy, and ethical, multilevel research designs. The model offers testable design principles rather than evidence that AI feedback improves learning or participation.
papers.summary_zh: 该文提出一个面向大学体育教学的“动机—意义”模型，整合自我决定理论、反馈素养、自我调节学习与运动学习研究，用以解释AI反馈事件如何被学习者解读。模型区分信息性与控制性意义及随后的心理需求体验，将“受阻转化”视为暂时难以建立行动依据而非第三种动机意义，并提出自我调节性挪用这一迁移过程。七组命题分别涉及框架、可操作信息、可争议性、评价性暴露、差异修复、技能迁移及持续参与的次要路径，结果结构涵盖系统参与、习得表现、保持与迁移、情感福祉和自愿身体活动。作者强调持续参与仍是需纵向证据的远端假设，模型提供可检验的设计原则，而非AI反馈能改善学习或参与的证据。

papers.title: Effects of a somatic dance course on body image, embodied self-awareness, and disordered eating risk in female university students: a quasi-experimental study
papers.authors: 尹佳鸽
papers.abstract: Introduction Body image concerns and disordered eating risk are common among female university students, and contemporary frameworks increasingly emphasize positive body image and embodiment. This quasi-experimental, pre-post controlled study examined whether an 8-week somatic-oriented improvisational dance course, delivered as a non-competitive university body education elective and compared with regular university physical education electives, was associated with changes in body appreciation, embodied self-awareness, disordered eating risk, functionality appreciation, and body surveillance. Methods A total of 128 female undergraduates were allocated to the somatic dance course or comparison condition (64 per group). Post-intervention questionnaires were completed by 115 participants, and the main attention-check-passing analysis sample comprised 103 participants. Group differences were estimated using ANCOVA models adjusted for baseline scores, with baseline BMI as an additional covariate. Results Relative to regular university physical education electives, the somatic dance course was associated with greater post-intervention body appreciation (BAS-2), embodied self-awareness (SBC), and functionality appreciation (FAS) and lower body surveillance (OBCS-BS). Adjusted group differences were statistically significant for BAS-2, SBC, FAS, and OBCS-BS, whereas the group difference in disordered eating risk (EAT-26) was not statistically significant. Exploratory change-score mediation analyses did not support an indirect pathway through change in embodied self-awareness. Conclusion The 8-week somatic dance course was associated with short-term group differences in positive body-image and embodiment-related outcomes among female university students. The group difference in disordered eating risk was not statistically significant, and mediation pathways were not supported, indicating the need for rigorous randomized studies with longer follow-up.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以女性大学生为对象，采用准实验前后测对照设计，考察为期8周的身心取向即兴舞蹈课程（作为非竞争性大学身体教育选修课）相比常规体育选修课，是否与身体欣赏、具身自我觉察、功能欣赏、身体监控及进食障碍风险的变化相关。结果显示，舞蹈课程组在身体欣赏、具身自我觉察和功能欣赏上高于对照组，身体监控低于对照组，且这些组间差异经基线调整后具有统计显著性；但进食障碍风险的组间差异不显著，探索性中介分析也未支持经由具身自我觉察变化的间接路径。作者据此认为，该课程与短期积极身体意象和具身相关结果的组间差异相关，但对进食障碍风险的作用未获支持，仍需随机对照和更长随访研究。

papers.title: The mediating role of artificial intelligence perception and creative idea generation in the impact of sustainable leadership on digital transformation and circular economy awareness
papers.authors: Ceyda Yerdelen-Kaygin, Mustafa Altıntaş, Ethem Topçuoğlu, Onur Oktaysoy, Erdoğan Kaygın, Volkan Tatar, Burcu Turan-Torun, Bilal Kobanoğlu
papers.abstract: Introduction Today, sustainable leadership is a strategic leadership approach that addresses environmental, social, and economic priorities from a holistic perspective while at the same time driving digital transformation processes. The research aims to explain how sustainable leaders mobilize organizational resources, technological infrastructure, and human creativity within the framework of Dynamic Capabilities Theory. Methods The research was conducted on 456 white-collar employees working in small and medium-sized enterprises operating in Giresun, Kars, and Kırşehir provinces. The data collected by the convenience sampling method were analyzed using the PLS-SEM method with the SmartPLS 4.1.1 program. Results The analysis results show that sustainable leadership has significant and positive effects on perceptions of artificial intelligence, the generation of creative ideas, digital transformation, and awareness of the circular economy. It was found that the perception of artificial intelligence (AI) has a significant effect on both digital transformation and awareness of the circular economy. It was also determined that creative idea generation has significant effects on digital transformation and awareness of the circular economy. The results of the mediation analyses revealed a partial mediating role for all variables. Discussion The findings reveal that sustainable leadership is not limited to the environmental and social responsibility dimension and is a strategic element that directs digital transformation processes, shapes perceptions towards artificial intelligence, and encourages organizational creativity.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以动态能力理论为框架，考察可持续领导如何通过员工的人工智能感知与创意想法生成，影响中小企业的数字化转型和循环经济意识。作者对土耳其三地中小企业员工进行问卷调查，并用偏最小二乘结构方程模型分析数据。结果显示，可持续领导对人工智能感知、创意想法生成、数字化转型和循环经济意识均有正向影响，人工智能感知与创意想法生成也分别与后两者相关，并在其中起部分中介作用。文章据此认为，可持续领导不只涉及环境与社会责任，还可能通过塑造技术认知和组织创造力来推动数字化转型。

papers.title: “I Just Needed Someone to Listen”: A Community Discussion Analysis of Redditors’ Discourse About Using General-Purpose LLMs for Therapy
papers.authors: Hansen Lee, Jinkyung Park, Bart P. Knijnenburg
papers.abstract: Despite increasing efforts of legislatures to prohibit specialized AI-driven apps from providing therapeutic decision-making, general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being used as alternative tools for mental health support. In this paper, we examine the increased adoption of AI for mental health through the lens of proponents’ and opponents’ discussions on public forums. Through a qualitative analysis of 67 Reddit discussion threads (totaling 2948 comments), we offer an in-depth investigation of the various contexts in which users rely on (or fail to rely on) AI for mental health support, as well as an analysis of the main discussions (including positions for and against the use of AI for therapy) within the community. By critically reflecting on our findings, we highlight ethical considerations and discuss how research, design and regulation of AI tools can help improve mental health support for users with complicated needs while mitigating potential harms.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过定性分析 Reddit 上 67 个讨论帖（共 2948 条评论），考察公众围绕使用通用大语言模型获取心理支持的正反讨论。分析呈现了用户在哪些情境下依赖或未能依赖这类 AI 工具，并梳理了社区中支持与反对 AI 治疗的主要立场。作者据此反思相关伦理问题，讨论研究、设计与监管如何在不忽视复杂需求用户的前提下改善心理支持并降低潜在伤害。

papers.title: Technology‐Supported Formative Assessment in Higher Education: AI , Learning Analytics and the Future of Assessment for Learning
papers.authors: Aydın Bulut
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Purpose This study examines the intellectual and thematic development of technology‐supported formative assessment (TSFA) in higher education and its convergence with feedback, learning analytics, artificial intelligence (AI) and self‐regulation. Design/Methodology/Approach A scoping review integrating bibliometric mapping, qualitative thematic synthesis and SWOT analysis was conducted on TSFA literature published between 2000 and 2026 (August). Findings The findings reveal accelerated growth after 2020 and a shift from technology‐centred applications towards learner‐centred, adaptive and data‐informed formative assessment. However, theoretical fragmentation, limited longitudinal evidence, ethical concerns and geographical inequalities remain. Originality/Value The study conceptualises TSFA as a technology‐mediated formative ecosystem integrating technological capacity, pedagogical regulation, learner agency and human judgement. Practical Implications Institutions should prioritise human‐centred AI integration, transparent governance, equitable access and professional development to ensure that technology supports rather than replaces formative pedagogical judgement.

papers.title: Prompt‐based emotional scaffolding in generative AI : Effects on self‐regulated learning and socio‐emotional outcomes
papers.authors: Elena-Alexandra Diordiev, Valdemar Aksel Stenberdt, Guido Makransky
papers.abstract: Abstract While generative AI (GenAI) tools are emerging as educational resources, general‐purpose applications like ChatGPT are not explicitly designed to support the metacognitive and socio‐emotional dimensions of learning, often failing to address students' emotional states or promote independent thinking. In response, this study introduces a CVT‐SRL GenAI Support Framework integrating control‐value theory (CVT) and self‐regulated learning (SRL) and tests a learner‐centred GenAI chatbot design employing prompt‐based SRL scaffolding and emotional support. In a preregistered experiment in an authentic educational setting, 144 high school students were randomly assigned to one of three conditions: (1) ChatGPT, (2) SRLbot (GenAI with SRL scaffolding), (3) emotional SRLbot (GenAI with SRL and emotional support). Outcomes included conceptual knowledge and transfer, trace‐based and self‐reported engagement in SRL phases (forethought, performance, self‐reflection), enjoyment, boredom, hopelessness, self‐efficacy and trust. Data were collected at pretest, posttest and 4‐week follow‐up. Across conditions, students showed improvements in conceptual knowledge and transfer from pretest to posttest, with no significant condition differences in post‐to‐follow‐up change. Both SRLbot and Emotional SRLbot were associated with higher self‐reported enjoyment and lower boredom than ChatGPT and elicited trace‐based SRL behaviours. Moreover, Emotional SRLbot prompted greater engagement in performance‐phase and self‐reflection processes than the other conditions. These findings provide preliminary evidence that GenAI agents integrating SRL and emotional scaffolding can support more positive emotional states and task‐level SRL behaviours than general‐purpose GenAI, highlighting control‐value appraisals as a promising target for emotionally supportive SRL design. Future research should explore longitudinal effects on SRL skill development and independent regulation. Practitioner notes What is already known about this topic Generative AI (GenAI) tools such as ChatGPT have shown promise in enhancing learning outcomes, but they also present challenges in supporting socio‐emotional needs, fostering metacognition and promoting higher‐order thinking. Applying self‐regulated learning (SRL) frameworks in chatbot‐assisted learning has been found to foster learner autonomy, long‐term engagement and improved learning outcomes. Achievement emotions experienced during learning play a critical role in supporting self‐regulated learning, motivation and academic achievement. Interventions that target learners' perceptions of control and value through reappraisal can effectively foster positive emotions. What this paper adds An investigation of the impact of three GenAI conversational agents (standard ChatGPT, an SRL agent and an emotionally supportive SRL agent) on cognitive and socio‐emotional outcomes as well as task‐level self‐regulatory behaviours among high school students in an authentic classroom setting. Preliminary evidence that integrating prompts which target self‐regulated learning phases and learners' emotional states, as well as address perceptions of control and value can increase students' enjoyment of concrete learning situations and reduce boredom more effectively than standard ChatGPT. Insights into how theoretically grounded GenAI agents that incorporate SRL and emotional scaffolding may support students' emotional engagement and task‐level self‐regulatory behaviours during a short classroom learning activity. Implications for practice and/or policy Prompt engineering can be used to simulate emotional support and personalize guidance based on SRL and emotion regulation principles, providing design considerations for future learner‐centred GenAI systems. Developers and educators aiming to design pedagogically meaningful GenAI tools should focus on scaffolding SRL both cognitively and emotionally, to support the affective and self‐regulatory dimensions of learning. We make the technical specifications and system prompts publicly available.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对通用生成式AI难以支持学习中的元认知与情绪维度这一问题，提出整合控制—价值理论与自我调节学习的GenAI支持框架，并在真实课堂中比较了标准ChatGPT、带自我调节学习支架的SRLbot和兼具情绪支持的Emotional SRLbot三种条件对高中生概念知识、迁移、学习情绪与任务层面自我调节行为的影响。结果显示，三种条件下学生的概念知识与迁移均有提升，但条件间无显著差异；两种支架版本比标准ChatGPT带来更高的愉悦感和更低的无聊感，并引发更多可追踪的自我调节学习行为，其中情绪支持版本在表现阶段与自我反思阶段的参与度更高。作者据此认为，融入自我调节学习与情绪支架的GenAI智能体有助于改善学习情绪和任务层面的自我调节行为，控制—价值评价可作为情绪支持设计的一个有前景的切入点，但相关证据仍属初步，对自我调节学习技能发展与独立调节的长期影响尚待研究。

papers.title: Interplay of action-based prediction and top-down attention: EEG evidence for joint modulation of late perceptual processing
papers.authors: Thomas Holstein, Jean-Christophe Sarrazin, Bruno Berberian, Andrea Desantis
papers.abstract: Voluntary action shapes our perception through sensory predictions of its consequences. These predictions are thought to inhibit perceptual processing of predicted outcomes, leading to sensory attenuation. However, some studies have reported findings that contrast with this effect, suggesting that the influence of predictions may reflect, or interact with, attentional processes. Here, we investigated the interplay of action-based prediction and top-down attention on early and late perceptual processing, with prediction and attention referring to the likelihood of a sensory event and its behavioral relevance, respectively. Electroencephalography (EEG) was recorded while participants viewed two sequential gratings. The orientation of the first was either predicted and self-generated or unpredicted and externally generated. Participants judged the tilt direction of the second grating relative to the first but responded only when the grating appeared in a task-relevant color. EEG analyses revealed no modulation of early visual potentials (N1a), but modulations at later processing stages. Specifically, the P3b exhibited reduced amplitude for predicted compared to unpredicted stimuli, but only when they were task-relevant, whereas task-relevance enhanced the P3b only for unpredicted stimuli. Interestingly, multivariate pattern analysis showed significant temporal clusters for decoding the grating's orientation exclusively for predicted and task-relevant stimuli, although decoding performance did not significantly differ between conditions. Furthermore, predicted and task-relevant stimuli elicited faster behavioral responses, with prediction-related P3b latency differences correlating with reaction-time differences. Overall, converging findings from the P3b, multivariate, time-frequency and behavioral analyses provide suggestive evidence that top-down attention and action-based prediction may jointly facilitate late perceptual and decision-related processing.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察基于动作的预测与自上而下注意如何共同影响早期和晚期知觉加工，以脑电记录参与者在预测或非预测、任务相关或无关条件下观看连续光栅时的反应。结果显示早期视觉成分未受调节，而晚期P3b在预测且任务相关时波幅降低，任务相关性仅对非预测刺激增强P3b；多变量分析仅在预测且任务相关条件下能解码光栅朝向，且预测与任务相关刺激引发更快行为反应。作者据此提出，自上而下注意与动作预测可能共同促进晚期知觉和决策相关加工，但证据具有提示性。

papers.title: GenAI-supported internal feedback intervention for writing improvement: The roles of evaluative judgment and student-AI interaction in a cluster-randomized experimental study
papers.authors: Shijun Cindy Chen, Christian Dieter Schunn, Jie Cao, Seyyed Kazem Banihashem, Dragan Gašević, Yizhou Fan

papers.title: Thinking, Feeling, and Acting with Generative AI: Affective, Behavioral, and Cognitive Engagement and Perceived Human–AI Outcomes
papers.authors: Amir Mahmood, Chaocheng Zhou, Xiao Huang, Nadia Rehman, Misbah Shafait Abbasi, Akpaasou Daniel Terver
papers.abstract: Generative AI requires students not only to adopt technology but also to engage critically, behaviorally, cognitively, and emotionally with its outputs. This study develops and tests the AI Engagement ABC+ Model, a domain-specific adaptation of the affective–behavioral–cognitive engagement framework. The model differentiates positive and negative AI affect, three behavioral functions, creation, verification, and community participation, and two cognitive regulatory functions, strategic and critical cognition. A cross-sectional online survey collected data from 1250 students representing 15 nationalities at eight universities in China. Partial least squares structural equation modeling was used to examine 15 hypothesized associations between seven first-order engagement facets and four self-reported AI-supported outcomes: perceived Output Quality, Creativity, Integrity, and Trust Calibration. Fourteen hypotheses were supported. Verification Behavior had the largest estimated coefficient among the included predictors of Integrity (β = 0.303) and perceived Output Quality (β = 0.269) and was also associated with perceived Trust Calibration (β = 0.191). Critical Cognition had the largest estimated coefficient among the included predictors of perceived Trust Calibration (β = 0.270), and Community Behavior was positively associated with Integrity (β = 0.290) and Creativity (β = 0.240). Positive AI Affect was associated with perceived Output Quality (β = 0.214) and Creativity (β = 0.139), whereas Negative AI Affect was negatively associated with Trust Calibration (β = −0.137) but was unrelated to Integrity. The model explained 25.7% of the variance in Creativity, 25.2% in Integrity, 20.8% in perceived Output Quality, and 17.6% in Trust Calibration. Positive Q2_predict values provided additional evidence of out-of-sample predictive relevance. The findings support a differentiated view of GenAI engagement in which specific affective, behavioral, and cognitive facets are associated with distinct perceived outcomes. The model offers a theoretically structured basis for further research on responsible GenAI engagement, while its cross-sectional self-report design precludes causal or objective-performance conclusions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于情感—行为—认知参与框架提出并检验了AI参与ABC+模型，通过一项横断面在线调查，考察学生与生成式AI互动时的不同参与面向与自评结果之间的关系。研究发现，验证行为与感知输出质量、诚信和信任校准均呈正相关，批判性认知与信任校准的关联最强，社区参与则与诚信和创造力正相关；积极AI情感与输出质量和创造力相关，消极AI情感仅与信任校准负相关。作者据此主张对生成式AI参与作区分性理解，同时说明横断面自评设计无法支持因果或客观绩效结论。

papers.title: Generative AI summarization tools and deep reading comprehension among Chinese university students: the mediating role of elaborative processing and the moderating role of reading motivation
papers.authors: Ruyu Bai
papers.abstract: Generative AI tools that condense texts into summaries have become a routine part of student reading routines, and educators increasingly worry that convenient summaries displace the effortful processing on which deep comprehension depends. This study drew on cognitive offloading theory and the levels-of-processing framework to test a moderated mediation model in which elaborative processing statistically links generative AI summarization tool use to deep reading comprehension, and reading motivation moderates the negative association between tool use and processing. Undergraduate students ( N = 608; 53.6% female; mean age 19.9 years) from three universities in Changchun, China, completed a six-item scale of generative AI summarization tool use, an eight-item elaborative processing scale adapted from the deep-processing subscale of the R-SPQ-2F, a seven-item reading motivation measure adapted from the Motivation for Reading Questionnaire, and a researcher-developed deep reading comprehension test. Scale reliabilities were satisfactory (Cronbach alpha = 0.88, 0.87, and 0.86). Tool use correlated negatively with elaborative processing ( r = −0.41) and comprehension ( r = −0.24); elaborative processing correlated positively with comprehension ( r = 0.59). PROCESS analyses (Model 7) with 5,000 bootstrap resamples showed that tool use negatively predicted elaborative processing ( b = −0.310, p < 0.001) and that this association weakened as reading motivation rose (interaction b = 0.433, p < 0.001). Elaborative processing, in turn, predicted comprehension ( b = 10.097, p < 0.001), whereas the residual direct path of tool use did not reach significance. The indirect effect of tool use on comprehension through elaborative processing was significant and negative at low (−6.142, 95% BC CI [−7.353, −5.091]) and average (−3.130, [−3.851, −2.497]) reading motivation but nonsignificant at high reading motivation (−0.117, [−0.876, 0.629]); the index of moderated mediation was 4.374 [3.428, 5.402]. These results are consistent with an account in which elaborative processing statistically links summary reliance to lower deep reading, with reading motivation associated with a weaker negative indirect association; given the cross-sectional design, the modeled paths represent associations rather than established causal effects. They suggest that motivation-oriented reading instruction should accompany, rather than follow, the integration of AI tools into academic reading.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于认知卸载理论与加工水平框架，考察生成式AI摘要工具使用与大学生深度阅读理解的关系，并检验精细加工的中介作用与阅读动机的调节作用。研究以中国长春三所高校的本科生为对象，采用量表与阅读理解测验收集数据，通过有调节的中介模型分析变量间的统计关联。结果显示，工具使用与精细加工及阅读理解均呈负相关，精细加工与理解呈正相关；工具使用负向预测精细加工，且这一关联随阅读动机升高而减弱。经由精细加工的中介效应在低、中等阅读动机下显著为负，在高动机下不显著，直接路径亦不显著。作者据此指出，精细加工在统计上连接了摘要依赖与较低的深度阅读，阅读动机则与较弱的负向间接关联相联系；由于采用横断面设计，所建路径仅为关联而非因果效应，并建议将动机导向的阅读教学与AI工具融入学术阅读同步推进。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence literacy, artificial intelligence anxiety, and career optimism among university music students: a cross-sectional study
papers.authors: Yang Du
papers.abstract: Objective To examine the levels of artificial intelligence (AI) literacy, AI anxiety, and career optimism among university music students, their associations, and the independent associations of AI literacy and AI anxiety with career optimism after adjustment for relevant background factors. Methods A cross-sectional survey was conducted from May to July 2026 among students from five undergraduate music institutions in eastern China using convenience sampling. A total of 453 valid questionnaires were included in the analysis. Participants completed the Artificial Intelligence Literacy Scale for Chinese College Students (AILS-CCS), the Chinese version of the Artificial Intelligence Anxiety Scale (AIAS), and the Career Optimism Subscale (COS). Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, independent-samples t tests , one-way analysis of variance, Pearson correlation analysis, and hierarchical multiple linear regression. Results Mean scores for AI literacy, AI anxiety, and career optimism were 52.97 ± 10.05, 83.85 ± 22.96, and 37.87 ± 8.02, respectively. Students with prior AI training and those reporting more frequent AI use showed higher AI literacy and career optimism and lower AI anxiety. AI literacy was positively associated with career optimism (r = 0.444, p < 0.001), whereas AI anxiety was negatively associated with career optimism (r = −0.461, p < 0.001). After adjustment for gender, year of study, music specialization, prior AI training, and frequency of AI use, AI literacy remained positively associated with career optimism (β = 0.314, p < 0.001), whereas AI anxiety remained negatively associated with career optimism (β = −0.326, p < 0.001). The final model explained 33.0% of the variance in career optimism. Conclusion AI literacy and AI anxiety were independently associated with career optimism among university music students. These findings suggest that students' perceptions of AI-related competence and technological concerns are relevant to their career expectations. Music institutions may consider AI education that combines practical competence with critical understanding of AI's implications for artistic identity, professional value, and future career development. Future longitudinal research is needed to clarify the temporal relationships among AI literacy, AI anxiety, and career optimism.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注高校音乐学生的AI素养、AI焦虑与职业乐观之间的关系，采用横断面问卷调查，以中国东部五所音乐院校的学生为对象，在控制相关背景因素后检验AI素养和AI焦虑与职业乐观的独立关联。结果显示，AI素养与职业乐观呈正相关，AI焦虑与职业乐观呈负相关，且调整性别、年级、专业方向、既往AI培训和使用频率后，这两种关联仍然存在。作者据此认为，学生对自身AI能力的感知和对技术的担忧与其职业期待相关，音乐院校可考虑将实践能力与对AI在艺术身份、职业价值等方面影响的批判性理解结合起来开展AI教育，但相关结论受横断面设计限制，尚不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: Effects of AI-mediated real-time feedback on motivation and motor skill learning in traditional ethnic sports education: testing self-determination theory mechanisms
papers.authors: Yuequan Qin, Yang Yu, Guizhen Chen, Huasheng Huang, 韦东谊
papers.abstract: Introduction Traditional ethnic sports such as Zhuang Daoyin demand precise movement, yet conventional demonstration–imitation–verbal correction limits feedback timeliness and individualization. Artificial intelligence (AI) real-time posture feedback offers a scalable option, but most evaluations emphasize technical outcomes and overlook learning processes. Grounded in self-determination theory (SDT), this study tested whether and how AI real-time feedback improves motivation and motor skill by engaging basic psychological needs, with competence as the hypothesized pathway. Methods In a 12-week field experiment, 12 intact classes (307 students; control n = 152, AI n = 155) were randomly allocated at the class level to an AI real-time feedback group or a traditional teaching group; three instructors each taught two classes per condition. Both groups received identical instruction; conditions differed only in feedback source during practice (RTMPose-based concurrent vs. teacher-led terminal feedback). Need satisfaction, motivational regulation (relative autonomy index, RAI), motor skill, and course satisfaction were assessed at pre- and post-test, and analyzed with linear mixed models and structural equation modeling (lavaan, MLR). Results The AI group showed significantly greater gains in competence ( d = 0.36, p = 0.003), autonomy ( d = 0.40, p = 0.001), motor skill ( d = 0.30, p = 0.010), and learning interest ( d = 0.38, p = 0.003), whereas relatedness was unaffected ( p = 0.974); intraclass correlations were negligible. In the structural model (CFI = 0.94, RMSEA = 0.04, SRMR = 0.04), group predicted competence ( β = 0.17), competence predicted RAI ( β = 0.34), and RAI predicted motor skill ( β = 0.30); the autonomy and relatedness paths were nonsignificant. The effect of AI feedback on motor skill was fully mediated by the competence-to-RAI sequence (indirect p = 0.023; direct p = 0.097). Discussion AI real-time feedback improved motor skill by strengthening competence and supporting motivational internalization, while leaving relatedness unaffected—providing discriminant evidence that the tool acts through its affordances rather than diffuse enthusiasm. Systems enhancing performance and learning should prioritize feedback that makes progress legible, within a human–AI division of labor where teachers provide relational support. In conclusion, AI real-time posture feedback can enhance motivation and motor skill learning by satisfying learners’ competence need.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于自我决定理论，在传统民族体育教学中检验AI实时姿态反馈能否通过满足基本心理需求来提升学习动机与动作技能，采用整班随机分组的田野实验，比较AI实时反馈与传统教师反馈两种条件。结果显示，AI组在胜任感、自主性、动作技能和学习兴趣上的提升均大于传统组，而关联感未受影响；结构模型进一步表明，AI反馈对动作技能的效应由“胜任感—相对自主性”这一序列完全中介，自主性与关联感路径不显著。作者据此认为，AI反馈主要通过让学习进步变得可见来起作用，而非笼统地激发热情，并提示在人机分工中教师仍应承担关系性支持的角色。

papers.title: A study of the impact of AI-employee collaboration on employee innovation behavior
papers.authors: Yan Guanyu, Niu Chenchen
papers.abstract: Introduction With the deep integration of digitalization and generative artificial intelligence, artificial intelligence has transformed from a mere technical tool into a core collaborative partner within modern workplaces and human‑resource management. As an interdependent human‑AI working mode characterized by complementary task division, joint task accomplishment, complementary decision‑making, and continuous iterative interaction between employees and AI agents, AI‑employee collaboration is conceptually distinct from simple AI adoption, instrumental AI use, and AI‑assisted technical systems. Drawing on social cognitive theory, the present study aims to investigate how AI‑employee collaboration predicts employee innovation behavior, alongside the mediating role of self‑efficacy and the moderated‑mediation boundary condition of servant leadership. Methods Three‑wave time‑lagged questionnaire data were collected from 259 employees working in internet‑service, finance, and catering industries across Beijing and Jinan. Hierarchical regression and bootstrap approaches were adopted to test the proposed moderated‑mediation model. Results The results show that AI‑employee collaboration exerts a significant positive predictive effect on employee innovation behavior. Self‑efficacy partially mediates the relationship between AI‑employee collaboration and employee innovation behavior. Moreover, servant leadership positively moderates the link between AI‑employee collaboration and self‑efficacy and further strengthens the indirect predictive effect of AI‑employee collaboration on employee innovation behavior through self‑efficacy. Discussion This research enriches existing literature by providing incremental empirical evidence for the internal cognitive mechanism and contextual boundary of AI‑driven employee innovation. Theoretically, it unpacks the cognitive “black box” connecting AI‑employee collaboration and employee innovation and identifies servant leadership as a key situational contingency factor. Practically, these findings deliver concrete, actionable managerial insights for digitally transforming organizations to leverage AI tools and unlock employees’ innovative potential.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于社会认知理论，考察员工与AI代理的协作如何预测员工创新行为，并检验自我效能感的中介作用及服务型领导的调节作用。作者对互联网服务、金融和餐饮行业员工开展三阶段滞后问卷调查，采用层级回归与bootstrap方法分析。结果显示，人机协作对员工创新行为具有显著的正向预测作用，自我效能感部分中介这一关系；服务型领导正向调节人机协作与自我效能感的联系，并进一步增强经由自我效能感的间接预测效应。研究据此讨论了人机协作影响创新的认知机制与情境边界，并为组织借助AI激发员工创新潜力提供管理启示。

papers.title: A non-randomized trial of the effects of transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation on cognitive performance and resting state connectivity
papers.authors: F. M. Filbey, C. Tyler Short, A. Leazure, N. E. Nekoui, T. Brown, S. Kroener, C. Liu
papers.abstract: Background Transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation (taVNS) has shown promise for enhancing cognition and emotion regulation. To date, most human studies have focused on narrow learning paradigms that limit our understanding of how taVNS influences complex, integrative cognitive operations. Moreover, the underlying mechanisms of taVNS are still not well understood. Objective Building on preclinical findings that vagus nerve stimulation enhances cognitive flexibility and memory in animal models, this study investigated whether acute taVNS can modulate executive function and neural connectivity in healthy adults. Methods Using a quasi-experimental design, forty healthy participants received either active or sham taVNS while completing executive function tasks and adaptive cognitive training (BrainHQ). High-density electroencephalography (EEG) was recorded during stimulation to assess cortical activity and functional connectivity across frequency bands. Results Multivariate analyses demonstrated significant effects of taVNS on cognitive function and EEG. Post-hoc group comparisons showed that compared to sham stimulation, active taVNS was associated with improved BrainHQ performance and decreased delta-band connectivity in left frontal, central, and parietal regions. Delta-band connectivity during active taVNS was positively associated with pre-to-post improvements in mood. No difference in executive function tasks was found between active and sham taVNS. Sensitivity analyses using adjusted models showed that these effects were sensitive to age, sex, and education. Conclusion By evaluating multiple dimensions of executive function, these exploratory findings suggest that active taVNS may influence selected aspects of executive performance and frontal–parietal delta connectivity, potentially reflecting enhanced neural efficiency arising from the interaction between vagally mediated neuromodulation and continuously adaptive cognitive demands. However, these effects did not survive multiple-comparison correction and should therefore be interpreted cautiously and replicated in larger, prospectively powered studies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究采用准实验设计，考察健康成人接受经皮耳迷走神经刺激（taVNS）时执行功能与脑电连接的变化，参与者在刺激期间完成执行功能任务和自适应认知训练，并同步记录高密度脑电。结果显示，与伪刺激相比，主动taVNS与认知训练表现改善及左额、中央和顶区delta频段连接下降相关，且该连接与情绪改善呈正相关；但两组在执行功能任务上无差异，效应也对年龄、性别和教育程度敏感。作者指出，这些探索性发现提示taVNS可能影响部分执行表现和额顶delta连接，但效应未通过多重比较校正，需谨慎解读并在更大样本中验证。

papers.title: Higher education assessments in the age of GenAI: a systematic review
papers.authors: Helen Crompton, Diane Burke
papers.journal: International Journal of Educational Technology in Higher Education
papers.abstract: Abstract Assessment in higher education has long centered on core principles such as validity, authenticity, and alignment with learning outcomes, alongside ongoing debates about how best to support academic integrity and meaningful feedback. The emergence of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is now placing renewed pressure on these established principles, prompting institutions to reconsider how assessment is designed, delivered, and evaluated. While a growing body of research has examined GenAI’s role in teaching and learning broadly, less synthesis exists on how it is reshaping assessment specifically, and how these shifts relate to long-standing assessment theory and practice. This systematic review provides an up-to-date examination of empirical research published between 2024 and 2026 on how GenAI is influencing assessment practices and supporting educators in assessing student learning. Using PRISMA, 72 studies were identified and analyzed. The findings show that research was conducted across 24 countries and 20 academic disciplines. Two overarching research purposes emerged: (1) investigating the use of GenAI in assessment and (2) examining perceptions of GenAI in assessment. Qualitative approaches were the most common research methodology. Three major assessment design approaches emerged in response to GenAI: (1) process orientation, (2) authenticity, and (3) oral and dialogical approaches. Five ways educators used GenAI across the assessment process were identified: (1) creating assessments, (2) practice for assessments, (3) grading, (4) transparency of learning, and (5) feedback. Together, these findings situate GenAI’s influence with the broader trajectory of assessment scholarship and provides researchers, educators, institutional leaders, and policymakers a clearer picture of how assessment practices are being negotiated in response to GenAI
papers.summary_zh: 该综述以PRISMA方法系统梳理了2024至2026年间72项关于生成式人工智能如何影响高等教育评估的实证研究，覆盖多国与多学科，多为质性取向。作者归纳出两类研究目的：考察GenAI在评估中的使用，以及考察对GenAI用于评估的认知；并提炼出三种评估设计取向，即过程导向、真实性和口头与对话式方法，以及教育者在评估全过程中的五种用法，包括创建评估、评估练习、评分、学习透明度和反馈。文章将这些发现置于评估研究的既有脉络中，为研究者、教育者、院校管理者和政策制定者理解评估实践如何因应GenAI而调整提供了整体图景。

papers.title: Integrating Generative AI Into an Undergraduate Research Methods Course: Evaluating Student Perceptions, AI Competency, and Intention to Use
papers.authors: Hee-Sun Choi
papers.journal: Proceedings of the Human Factors and Ergonomics Society Annual Meeting
papers.abstract: College students increasingly use generative AI, yet formal undergraduate classroom implementation remains limited. This study evaluated a structured generative AI training in an undergraduate research methods course, examining its impact on students’ perceptions, self-rated competency, and future intention to use. Early in the semester, students received a lecture on generative AI tools, applications, and ethical issues, including bias, plagiarism, and data privacy. Two optional assignments provided hands-on practice using AI for literature searching and academic writing. After the course, 24 of 195 enrolled students completed a survey. Respondents reported low-to-moderate initial AI familiarity and competency. The lecture was well received and led to confidence in citing and disclosing AI use. Students expressed moderately positive intentions to use AI for future studying and research activities, while reporting concerns about accuracy and academic integrity. Findings suggest that structured, evidence-based AI training may support responsible use in undergraduates while addressing persistent ethical and practical concerns.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在一门本科研究方法课程中引入结构化生成式人工智能培训，通过讲授工具应用与伦理议题并安排可选的文献检索和学术写作练习，考察学生对AI的认知、自评能力及未来使用意愿。课后调查显示，受访学生初始AI熟悉度和能力处于低至中等水平，对讲座评价积极，并在引用和披露AI使用方面更有信心；他们对未来学习和研究中使用AI持中等偏正面意愿，同时担忧准确性和学术诚信。作者据此认为，结构化、基于证据的AI培训可能有助于本科生负责任地使用AI，但仍需应对持续的伦理与实践顾虑。

papers.title: Exploring collaborative problem-solving in AI-assisted robotics education
papers.authors: Christian Basil Omeh, Elias Oupa Mashile
papers.abstract: Prompt engineering (PE) involves creating, improving, and deploying prompts to improve large language model (LLM) performance. Despite its increasing importance, many students lack skills in this area. Although frameworks for prompt design and process exist, theory-based instructional tools for improving prompt engineering skills are uncommon for developing collaborative problem-solving (CPS) skills in Robotics Education. This study adopted a PE strategy in AI-assisted robotics education, particularly for developing CPS. PE has four scaffolding stages: Alignment, Adaptation, Autonomy, and Innovation, and was analysed through four PE codes: Alignment Specification, Adaptive Refinement, Auditing, and Innovation. This study adopted a non-randomised, multi-site, criterion-group comparative design, with 243 undergraduate students categorised according to their ability group. This study used epistemic network analysis (ENA) to identify the co-occurrences of PE and CPS skills and examine the differences in conversation patterns among ability groups. The findings revealed distinct PE–CPS discourse configurations across ability groups. These results underscore the pedagogical value of scaffolding in developing PE skills and fostering students’ productivity in a synergetic learning environment.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注AI辅助机器人教育中，学生如何通过提示工程（PE）发展协作问题解决（CPS）能力，并比较不同能力组在对话中PE与CPS技能的共现模式。研究采用非随机、多站点、标准组比较设计，以243名本科生为对象，运用认知网络分析（ENA）考察对话模式差异。结果显示，不同能力组呈现出不同的PE–CPS话语配置，说明提示工程支架在培养学生提示技能和提升协同学习环境中的学习产出方面具有教学价值。不过，该研究为组间比较，相关差异不宜直接解释为支架的因果效果。

papers.title: GenAI-supported interactive learning and Chinese language arts (Yuwen) engagement: the mediating role of grit in an explanatory mixed-methods study
papers.authors: Hung, Zhitong Yu, Meng-Te Hung, Stacy E. Smith
