papers.abstract: This study examined secondary school students’ self-reported use of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) as an AI-supported interactive learning environment and its association with engagement in Chinese language arts (Yuwen) learning. Drawing on interactive learning environment perspectives and character strengths theory, the study tested whether grit mediated the association between GenAI use and Yuwen engagement. An explanatory mixed-methods design was adopted. In the quantitative phase, survey data from 455 students were analyzed using confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) and regression-based mediation analysis. Results showed that GenAI use was positively associated with grit and Yuwen engagement, and grit partially mediated the association between GenAI use and engagement. In the qualitative phase, student interviews contextualized the quantitative findings by showing two self-reported orientations toward GenAI-supported learning: dialogic learning partner use and answer-extraction use. Dialogic use involved iterative questioning, revision, and sustained effort, whereas answer-extraction use emphasized efficiency and task completion. These findings suggest that GenAI’s value for Yuwen engagement depends not only on use itself but also on how students engage with GenAI as an interactive learning environment.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察中学生使用生成式人工智能作为互动学习环境与语文学习投入之间的关系，并检验坚毅是否在其中起中介作用。研究采用解释性混合方法，先对问卷数据做验证性因子分析和基于回归的中介分析，再通过学生访谈补充解释。结果显示，生成式人工智能使用与坚毅和语文投入均呈正相关，坚毅部分中介了这一关联；访谈进一步区分出把人工智能当作对话式学习伙伴与当作答案提取工具两种使用取向，前者涉及反复提问、修改和持续投入，后者侧重效率与完成任务。作者据此指出，生成式人工智能对语文学习投入的价值不仅取决于是否使用，也取决于学生如何将其作为互动学习环境来使用。

papers.title: Critical thinking in generative AI use: Development and validation of the GAICU scale for university students
papers.authors: Moyan Li, Li Guo

papers.title: Neurovascular coupling in simultaneous EEG-fNIRS studies: A scoping review of analytical frameworks and clinical applications
papers.authors: Wsu Yu, Rajamanickam Yuvaraj, Stéphane Perrey, Hasan Ayaz, Wei‐Peng Teo
papers.abstract: Simultaneous electroencephalography (EEG) and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) have been used across cognitive and physiological states and in diverse clinical populations. However, the interpretation of cross-modal coupling remains difficult because findings from different analytical frameworks, populations, and experimental conditions have not been systematically mapped. This scoping review followed the Arksey and O'Malley framework and the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR). PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, EBSCO, and IEEE Xplore were searched through February 10, 2026, for studies that quantitatively related simultaneously recorded EEG and fNIRS signals. Two reviewers independently screened the records. Findings were synthesized narratively, and analytical pipelines were mapped across the signal domain, feature extraction, coupling metric, and temporal lag handling. Fifty-seven studies were included. Amplitude-based studies related event-related potentials and oscillatory EEG features to focal hemodynamic responses, with associations varying across electrophysiological features, cortical regions, and task conditions. Frequency- and scale-specific analyses identified band-dependent relationships, while coupling at ultra-slow scales showed sensitivity to vascular and systemic physiological influences. Studies that explicitly modeled timing identified several-second offsets in some paradigms, while directional estimates varied across tasks and recording states. Network analyses showed partial and context-dependent correspondence between EEG- and fNIRS-derived measures, while model-based approaches characterized multivariate and predictive cross-modal relationships. Across frameworks, observed coupling differed with recording state, frequency band, cortical region, and temporal lag handling rather than representing a single quantity. Clinical findings were heterogeneous, and most condition-specific patterns were supported by small and methodologically diverse evidence bases. These findings support framework-matched analysis and pipeline-explicit reporting when interpreting EEG-fNIRS coupling.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了同步脑电与功能性近红外光谱（EEG-fNIRS）研究中神经血管耦合的分析框架及临床应用，采用范围综述方法对多数据库文献进行检索与叙事性综合。纳入研究显示，基于幅值、频率与尺度特异性、时间建模、网络分析及模型驱动等不同框架得到的耦合结果并不一致，耦合表现随记录状态、频段、皮层区域和时间滞后处理方式而变化，而非单一固定量。临床证据亦呈异质性，多数疾病相关模式基于样本小且方法多样的证据。作者据此强调，解读EEG-fNIRS耦合需采用与框架匹配的分析，并明确报告分析流程。

papers.title: Decoding spatial attention in the cocktail party problem using whole-head high-density fNIRS
papers.authors: Sudan Duwadi, De’Ja Rogers, Alex D. Boyd, Laura B. Carlton, Yiwen Zhang, Anna Kawai Gaona, Aneesa Diya Pathiyaparambath, Ravin Chaudhury, Grace Magee, Bernhard B Zimmermann, Walker Joseph O’Brien, Alexander von Lühmann, David A. Boas, Meryem A. Yücel, Kamal Sen
papers.abstract: Spatial attention is critical for solving the cocktail party problem, a longstanding problem in neuroscience and artificial speech recognition. The ability to decode where humans are attending in a cocktail party like scene would empower applications in brain computer interfaces and assistive devices such as hearing aids. Here we demonstrate that, in an overt attention task, the attended spatial location can be decoded robustly from single trial hemodynamic responses, using a whole head high density fNIRS system. We also identify critical brain regions that make the highest contribution to decoding accuracy. Specifically, we find that decoding based on a small fraction of channels located within the left and right inferior parietal lobule (IPL) achieves maximal decoding accuracy comparable to all channels. Decoding fell close to chance in a covert auditory condition in which participants held central fixation while attending to the same talkers, indicating that auditory attention alone without orientation is not sufficient for decoding. Finally, control experiments suggest that overt-condition decoding is influenced by sustained eye position/gaze direction, not eye movement. These results support the development of fNIRS-integrated BCIs and assistive devices controlled by overt spatial attention.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察能否用全头高密度功能性近红外光谱（fNIRS）在鸡尾酒会场景中解码听者所注意的空间位置，并比较外显与内隐注意条件下的差异。结果显示，在外显注意任务中，单试次血流动力学反应即可较稳定地解码注意方位，且仅取左右顶下小叶（IPL）内少量通道即可达到与全部通道相当的准确率；而在要求保持中央注视的内隐听觉条件下，解码接近随机水平，说明缺乏朝向的纯听觉注意不足以支撑解码。控制实验进一步提示，外显条件下的解码受持续眼位或注视方向影响，而非眼动本身。作者据此认为，这些结果支持开发由外显空间注意控制的fNIRS脑机接口与助听器等辅助设备，但相关结论限于该实验任务与条件。

papers.title: Exploring foreign language learners' GenAI-coexisted peer argumentation
papers.authors: Qin Zhou

papers.title: Generative AI as a cognitive partner: personalised GPTs and differentiated learning in undergraduate teacher education
papers.authors: Jason Zagami
papers.abstract: Abstract Generative artificial intelligence is increasingly framed as a catalyst for deeper learning rather than simple automation. This design-based study investigated how personalised GPT agents were used as cognitive partners by pre-service teachers in an undergraduate Initial Teacher Education course in Digital Technologies within a Bachelor of Education (Secondary) programme. Drawing on distributed cognition, constructivism, cognitive load theory, and critical AI literacy, the intervention embedded personalised GPT agents within a university Canvas Learning Management System. Fourteen students configured and used agents aligned to curriculum goals, teaching contexts, pedagogical preferences, and weekly Prompt–Reflect–Refine tasks. Data included approximately 7,000 AI interactions, reflective journals, assessed lesson and assessment artefacts, and tutorial-group discussions. A hybrid inductive–deductive thematic analysis identified four recurrent functions in students’ use of the agents: conceptual tutor, co-designer, reflective mirror, and cognitive challenger. Across data sources, students reported clearer conceptual support, iterative planning, and reflective prompting, alongside risks of over-reliance, factual drift, and culturally narrow exemplars. The study contributes a context-specific model for LMS-integrated generative AI that foregrounds partnership, personalisation, judgement, and ethical reflexivity. Findings should be interpreted cautiously because the study was small-scale, single-site, and partly reliant on self-reported reflection.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究采用基于设计的方法，考察职前教师如何在本科数字技术课程中将个性化GPT智能体作为认知伙伴使用，并分析其配置与使用方式。通过对约七千次AI交互、反思日志、课程作业和小组讨论的混合主题分析，研究归纳出智能体的四种反复出现的功能：概念导师、共同设计者、反思镜鉴和认知挑战者；学生报告了概念支持更清晰、规划更具迭代性和反思提示等益处，同时也出现过度依赖、事实漂移和文化视野狭窄的示例等风险。文章据此提出一个嵌入学习管理系统的生成式AI情境化模型，强调伙伴关系、个性化、判断与伦理反思，并提示结论受小规模、单一站点和部分依赖自我报告的限制。

papers.title: The Impact of the Integration of Artificial Intelligence and Search Technology on Online Purchase Intentions
papers.authors: Meina Zhao
papers.journal: Journal of the Association for Information Systems
papers.abstract: Based on Service-Dominant Logic (SDL) theory, this study surveyed 409 users who had used Taobao’s AI Universal Search and used structural equation modeling to explore the mechanisms through which AI-integrated search technology promotes online purchase intention. The findings indicate that AI and search technology influence customers’ purchase intent through value co-creation, personalization, and decision-making time. Based on the structural equation model, the study compares the extent to which decision-making time and value co-creation factors influence purchase intention. The research offers practical implications for the platform economy by highlighting the enabling effects of large language models and the provision of precise supply-demand matching. The results indicate that platforms should optimize AI search results to reduce customers’ decision-making time.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于服务主导逻辑理论，以使用淘宝AI通用搜索的用户为对象，通过问卷调查与结构方程模型，考察人工智能与搜索技术整合如何影响在线购买意愿。研究发现，价值共创、个性化与决策时间是该影响的主要中介路径，且决策时间与价值共创因素对购买意愿的作用程度存在差异。文章据此强调大语言模型的赋能作用与精准供需匹配，并建议平台优化AI搜索结果以缩短用户决策时间，但相关结论基于特定平台用户样本，推广需谨慎。

papers.title: AI Ingratiation in Content Generation: A Dual-Pathway Model of Intimacy and Authenticity
papers.authors: Xiaochen Liu, Lu Chen, Shouwang Lu
papers.journal: Journal of the Association for Information Systems
papers.abstract: As generative AI becomes increasingly embedded in content generation, understanding how its interaction styles shape user responses is critical. This study examines AI ingratiation—AI-generated expressions of praise and flattery—and its effects on user perceptions and behavioral outcomes. A 2×2 online experiment reveals that AI ingratiation increases perceived intimacy but decreases perceived authenticity. Building on these perceptual responses, perceived intimacy and perceived authenticity jointly transmit the effects of AI ingratiation to user satisfaction and content iteration intention, indicating significant indirect effects through these dual mediating pathways. We further examine the moderating role of AI literacy and find that users with higher self-reported AI usage literacy are more responsive to AI ingratiation. Specifically, higher AI literacy strengthens the positive effect of AI ingratiation on perceived intimacy, which in turn enhances user satisfaction. Finally, a multi-group analysis reveals significant differences between advertising and academic contexts, suggesting that the effects of AI ingratiation vary across content generation scenarios. These findings highlight the dual-pathway and context-dependent nature of AI ingratiation in human–AI interaction.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察生成式AI在内容生成中使用的恭维式表达（AI ingratiation）如何影响用户感知与行为，采用2×2在线实验，并比较广告与学术两种情境。结果显示，AI恭维会提升用户的亲密感感知，却降低真实性感知；这两种感知共同中介了恭维对用户满意度和内容迭代意愿的间接影响。研究还发现，自报AI使用素养较高的用户对恭维更敏感，素养会增强恭维对亲密感的正向作用，进而提升满意度；且广告与学术情境间存在显著差异，说明此类效应具有双路径和情境依赖特征。

papers.title: Not All GenAI Disclosures Are Alike: How the Stage of GenAI Involvement Shapes Purchase Intention for Digital Games
papers.authors: Fangzhan Lin, Ke Xu, Zhongyun Zhou
papers.journal: Journal of the Association for Information Systems
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is increasingly used in digital game development, and disclosures on digital platforms make such use more visible to players. Prior research offers conflicting predictions regarding how users respond to such disclosure. Research on AI-generated products suggests that disclosure can reduce valuation because it weakens source-related beliefs tied to human creation. Research on games as interactive hedonic systems, however, suggests that players also evaluate games in terms of the experience they expect during play. Building on these perspectives, this study conceptualizes GenAI disclosure as the focal independent variable and proposes two pathways through which disclosure influences players’ purchase intention. First, GenAI disclosure decreases perceived effort, which lowers purchase intention. Second, GenAI disclosure can increase perceived novelty, which raises purchase intention, but this positive pathway depends on the stage of GenAI involvement described by the disclosure. Specifically, this positive effect is stronger under during-interaction involvement than under pre-interaction involvement. We test the model using a scenario-based online experiment in the context of digital games. The results show that GenAI disclosure reduces perceived effort relative to no disclosure, while its positive effect on perceived novelty emerges primarily when GenAI is described as contributing during gameplay rather than before gameplay. Willingness to pay is included as a supplementary outcome and shows directionally similar but weaker patterns. This study extends GenAI disclosure research to digital games and shows that the effect of disclosure depends not only on whether GenAI use is disclosed, but also on the stage of involvement described by that disclosure.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注数字游戏中的生成式AI披露如何影响玩家的购买意愿，并区分了AI介入发生在游戏前还是游戏过程中两种情形。作者通过情境式在线实验发现，披露AI使用会降低玩家对开发者投入程度的感知，从而拉低购买意愿；而披露AI参与游戏过程（而非游戏前）时，能提升感知新颖性，进而提高购买意愿。研究据此指出，披露效应不仅取决于是否披露，还取决于所描述的AI介入阶段，并将生成式AI披露研究拓展到数字游戏情境。

papers.title: Unlocking Breakthrough Innovation: The Impact of Knowledge Co-creation and Contractual Knowledge Protection
papers.authors: Areziguli Wubuli, Qi Huang, Dan-ni Li
papers.journal: Journal of the Association for Information Systems
papers.abstract: There are relatively few existing studies that provide references for Chinese local firms to use collaboration to carry out breakthrough innovation. This study was conducted on 306 respondents from 153 Chinese manufacturing firms, and results indicate that knowledge co-creation mediates the link between resource complementarity and breakthrough innovation. Crucially, the analysis reveals a mediated moderation mechanism: the synergistic interaction between complementarity and contractual knowledge protection is transmitted via knowledge co-creation to drive innovation outcomes. These findings provide insights for firms that want to carry out collaborative breakthrough innovation but are not sure about partner selection and implementation mechanisms in Chinese settings.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注中国本土制造企业如何通过合作实现突破性创新，基于153家企业的问卷数据，考察资源互补性、知识共创与契约性知识保护的作用。结果显示，知识共创在资源互补性与突破性创新之间起中介作用；资源互补性与契约性知识保护的协同交互，也通过知识共创传导至创新结果，构成有中介的调节机制。研究为企业在合作创新中的伙伴选择与实施机制提供了参考，但结论基于企业层面的问卷数据，属于关联性证据。

papers.title: The Impacts of AI Recommendation Systems on User Loyalty in E-Commerce Platforms: Evidence from Gen Z Consumers in Ho Chi Minh City
papers.authors: Thanh Liem Nguyen, Trung Hieu Duong, Linh Thuy Trang Nguyen, Le Van Khanh Nguyen, Hoai An Le, Xuan Huy Bui
papers.journal: Journal of the Association for Information Systems
papers.abstract: This study examines the effects of the AI Recommendation System (ARS) on users’ loyalty on e-commerce platforms in Ho Chi Minh City. Integrating the S-O-R framework and Technology Acceptance Model (TAM), the study evaluates how characteristics of ARS, including personalization, accuracy, and transparency, affect trust and satisfaction. Data from 400 Gen Z consumers were analyzed using the Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM). Results showed ARS significantly boosted trust and satisfaction, serving as key intermediates for long-term loyalty. This finding offers practical implications for businesses to optimize AI strategy and build sustainable customer relationships in the digital era.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以胡志明市的Z世代消费者为对象，结合S-O-R框架与技术接受模型，考察电商平台AI推荐系统的个性化、准确性和透明度如何影响用户忠诚。基于问卷数据的结构方程模型分析显示，推荐系统特征显著提升信任与满意度，二者在形成长期忠诚中起关键中介作用。研究据此提示企业可通过优化AI推荐策略来维系客户关系，但结论基于特定城市与世代群体，推广需谨慎。

papers.title: Unpacking the Experience Economy of Role-Playing Conversational AI: A Grounded Theory Analysis
papers.authors: Ke Xu, Fangzhan Lin, Zhongyun Zhou
papers.journal: Journal of the Association for Information Systems
papers.abstract: The rapid rise of role-playing conversational artificial intelligence (AI) has transformed human-AI interaction from task-oriented exchanges into immersive, scenario-based digital experiences. However, while prior studies predominantly evaluate AI through utilitarian performance or relational support, the holistic experiential structure of these novel interactions remains underexplored. To bridge this gap, this paper draws on the experience economy (4Es) framework to investigate how users experience role-playing conversational AI through the realms of entertainment, education, esthetics, and escapism. Using a grounded theory approach, this study analyzes 6,171 user comments from the Reddit community r/CharacterAI. Findings reveal that user-AI role-playing is fundamentally multidimensional: entertainment and escapism emerge as particularly salient, while educational and esthetic experiences are also clearly present. Ultimately, this study extends the 4Es framework into the context of generative AI, offering a foundational empirical understanding of this emerging form of experiential consumption.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注角色扮演对话式人工智能的整体体验结构，借助体验经济4Es框架，对Reddit社区r/CharacterAI的用户评论进行扎根理论分析。研究发现，用户与AI的角色扮演体验是多维的，娱乐与逃避现实两个维度尤为突出，教育与审美体验也清晰存在。文章据此将4Es框架延伸至生成式AI情境，为理解这种新兴体验式消费提供了初步的实证基础。

papers.title: A Large Language Model-Based Implementation of the Proposition-to-Requirement Mapping Framework for ESG Greenwashing Detection
papers.authors: Qingan Li, Tianxiao Wu, Xiling Cui
papers.journal: Journal of the Association for Information Systems
papers.abstract: This study implements and empirically evaluates the proposition-to-requirement mapping approach proposed in Wu, Li, & Cui (2026). Greenwashing detection in ESG reporting remains difficult because disclosures are narrative, heterogeneous, and often lack transparent evaluation criteria. This study proposes a proposition-level, framework-aligned method for analyzing ESG reports under the HKEX ESG Reporting Guide. The framework converts reports into structured text, decomposes them into atomic propositions, classifies propositions as disclosure, explanation, or residual, and semantically matches them to 192 binary disclosure requirements. Using Tencent’s ESG reports from 2022 to 2024 as a case, the results show that the proposed indicators are directionally consistent with changes in MSCI ESG ratings. The study provides an interpretable and traceable approach to ESG disclosure assessment.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究面向ESG报告中的“漂绿”识别问题，实现并实证评估了一种基于大语言模型的“命题—要求”映射框架。作者将报告转为结构化文本并拆解为原子命题，按披露、解释与残余分类后，与港交所ESG报告指引下的192项二元披露要求进行语义匹配，并以腾讯2022至2024年的ESG报告为案例检验。结果显示，所构建指标的变化方向与MSCI ESG评级变化方向一致，为ESG披露评估提供了一种可解释、可追溯的分析路径；但该结论基于单一案例，尚不能说明因果效果或普遍适用性。

papers.title: Beyond Eye-Tracking: EEG Evidence for Differential Attentional Processing of LED and Projected Sports Venue Signage
papers.authors: Chia-Chan Chang, Simon Chadwick, Jie Liu, Hongying Zhang, Jinming Zong
papers.journal: Journal of the Association for Information Systems
papers.abstract: Sports venue signage is a strategic broadcast asset, yet little is known about whether LED and projected formats are processed differently. In a randomized-order within-subjects study, 63 participants viewed four 60-second football clips presenting Ping An Bank and C’estbon signage in both formats while eye movements and EEG were recorded. LED produced faster initial orienting to the area of interest (AOI), whereas projected signage showed higher absolute occipital alpha power. Total fixation duration did not differ, and the projected condition’s higher aided recognition was not statistically significant. The findings show distinct visual and neural response profiles, indicating that signage format should be evaluated against specific sponsorship and broadcast communication objectives.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注体育场馆LED标牌与投影标牌是否在视觉注意加工上存在差异，采用随机顺序的被试内设计，让参与者观看包含两种格式品牌标牌的足球视频片段，同时记录眼动与脑电。结果显示，LED标牌能更快引导对目标区域的初始定向，而投影标牌伴随更高的枕区绝对alpha功率；总注视时长在两种格式间没有差异，投影条件下更高的辅助再认也未达到统计显著。作者据此指出两种标牌格式对应不同的视觉与神经反应特征，标牌格式的选择应结合具体的赞助与转播传播目标来评估。

papers.title: Trust in AI-Assisted Newsvendor Decisions: Effects of Information Design
papers.authors: Yuxuan Zhang, Haohao Li, Feifan Ren, Yue Li
papers.journal: Journal of the Association for Information Systems
papers.abstract: As artificial-intelligence-assisted tools become prevalent in supply chain inventory management, algorithmic trust critically determines the success of human-AI interaction. Based on the newsvendor decision making, this study primarily considers two key factors—information construal level and presentation format—to investigate how they affect trust in AI recommendation, alongside the moderating role of decision-makers' individual traits. Through an incentivized 2×3 between-subjects experiment, we empirically analyze the level of trust in AI decision-making tools, measured by participants' Mean Absolute Percentage Deviation (MAPD) from the AI-advised values across different groups. Results indicate that text-and-graphic and scenario-based presentation formats significantly reduce decision deviation and enhance AI trust, whereas the construal level shows no significant impact. Furthermore, while decision-making style significantly influences AI tool utilization frequency, it does not affect the actual adoption of AI advice. This study clarifies the mechanisms driving algorithmic trust in newsvendor settings and provides empirical evidence and guidelines for enterprises to optimize the front-end interactive design of AI decision assistants and implement differentiated promotion and literacy training strategies tailored to varying employee traits.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注AI辅助库存决策中信息设计如何影响决策者对算法建议的信任，以报童决策任务为情境，通过激励化的组间实验考察信息建构水平与呈现格式的作用，并检验决策者个体特质的调节效应。结果显示，图文结合与情景化的呈现格式能显著降低决策偏离、提升对AI的信任，而信息建构水平没有显著影响；决策风格会影响AI工具的使用频率，却不影响对AI建议的实际采纳。文章据此讨论了AI决策助手前端交互设计的优化方向，并提示相关结论限于报童任务情境与所考察的信息设计因素。

papers.title: Research on Human-AI Collaboration Based on BERTopic: Exploratory Thematic Mapping and Evolutionary Analysis (2020-2025)
papers.authors: Yang Zhao, Na Li, Shuai Chen
papers.journal: Journal of the Association for Information Systems
papers.abstract: With the increasing integration of artificial intelligence across various societal domains, research on human-AI collaboration has grown rapidly in recent years. This study adopts a thematic mapping approach based on the BERTopic modeling framework to examine the structural organization and evolutionary dynamics of the core human-AI collaboration literature from 2020 to 2025. The analysis identifies nine core themes, including creative collaboration, which are further grouped into four higher-level thematic clusters, such as "Cognitive and Knowledge Co-creation". Longitudinal results show that, although publication output has increased substantially over time, the overall distribution of thematic structures remains relatively stable. This stability suggests a pattern of proportional development across themes, providing a macro-level perspective for understanding the conceptual organization and evolution of the field.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注2020至2025年人机协作研究的主题结构与演化动态，采用基于BERTopic的主题建模方法对相关文献进行探索性主题映射。分析识别出包括创造性协作在内的九个核心主题，并将其归纳为“认知与知识共创”等四个更高层级的主题群。纵向结果显示，尽管发文量随时间明显增长，主题结构的整体分布却保持相对稳定，作者据此认为各主题呈现按比例发展的态势，为理解该领域的概念组织与演化提供了宏观视角。

papers.title: Mapping GenAI-Enabled Technical Features to Player Needs in Digital Games: A Needs-(Dis)Affordances-Features Framework
papers.authors: Yake Yang, Fangzhan Lin, Ke Xu, Zhongyun Zhou
papers.journal: Journal of the Association for Information Systems
papers.abstract: As generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) becomes increasingly embedded in digital products, understanding how users experience GenAI-enabled products has become an important research issue. Prior research on GenAI products has mainly examined relatively static AI-generated outputs, with particular attention to disclosure, algorithmic source, authenticity, and perceived value. However, this literature offers limited insight into digital games, where GenAI may be incorporated not only into pre-generated components such as assets, text, and audio, but also into runtime systems such as adaptive dialogue, characters, and gameplay content. To address this gap, this study develops a Needs-(Dis)Affordances-Features framework for understanding how GenAI-enabled technical features shape players’ psychological need satisfaction and frustration in digital games. Drawing on the needs-affordances-features perspective, disaffordance, and self-determination theory, we conduct a grounded theory analysis of 3,096 reviews from 810 digital games on Steam identified through platform statements indicating GenAI involvement. The findings suggest that player responses are shaped less by AI-related labels or source cues than by the specific technical features through which GenAI is incorporated into the game. GenAI-enabled features such as generated assets, dialogue, and adaptive systems give rise to affordances and disaffordances that support or frustrate autonomy, competence, and relatedness. This study extends research on GenAI products to digital games by showing how feature-level GenAI integration, rather than AI origin alone, shapes player experience.

papers.title: The Paradox of Efficiency: Teacher-Directed AI Misuse and the Burden of Busywork in Higher Education
papers.authors: Zhan Zhan, ABM Munibur Rahman, Weiguo Feng, Jianhui Xiang
papers.journal: Journal of the Association for Information Systems
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into higher education to enhance instructional efficiency and improve learning outcomes. However, its adoption has revealed a paradox: AI-enabled teaching may unintentionally increase student workload without corresponding educational benefits. This study examines teacher-generated “algorithmic busywork,” defined as excessive, low-value assignments produced using Artificial intelligence tools with limited pedagogical design. Using survey data from 206 undergraduate students across multiple universities, we analyze students’ exposure to AI-generated assignments, their perceived educational value, and associated cognitive and emotional responses. The findings indicate that AI misuse in teaching is linked to increased academic stress, reduced engagement, and perceived inefficiencies in learning. Many students report that AI-generated tasks are repetitive, weakly aligned with learning objectives, and detract from more meaningful learning activities.This study contributes to the information systems and digital education literature by shifting attention from student misuse to teacher-directed Artificial intelligence practices. It highlights the need for pedagogical guidelines to ensure that AI-enabled teaching improves, rather than undermines, student outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注高等教育中教师使用人工智能反而可能加重学生负担的悖论，基于对多所大学本科生的问卷调查，考察学生接触教师用AI生成的作业的情况、其对教育价值的感知以及认知与情绪反应。研究发现，这类缺乏教学设计的“算法式忙碌作业”与学业压力上升、学习投入下降和感知到的学习低效相关；不少学生认为这些任务重复、与学习目标契合度弱，并挤占了更有意义的学习活动。文章据此把讨论焦点从学生滥用AI转向教师主导的AI实践，提示需要教学规范来确保AI辅助教学真正改善而非损害学生学习。

papers.title: The Right Amount of “Human Touch”: The Curvilinear Effect of Embodied AI Agent Anthropomorphism on Consumer Usage Intention under Social Intrusiveness
papers.authors: Du Chen, Lin Hui Sun
papers.journal: Journal of the Association for Information Systems
papers.abstract: Anthropomorphic design in embodied AI agents often evokes ambivalent consumer responses, yet it remains a key strategy for enhancing users’ intention to use such agents. Based on three video-based scenario experiments with 438 participants, this study examines how anthropomorphism shapes consumers’ usage intentions. The results confirm an inverted-U-shaped relationship between anthropomorphism of embodied AI agents and usage intention. Further analyses reveal that likability and eeriness jointly mediate this curvilinear relationship: anthropomorphism exerts an inverted U-shaped effect on likability, which in turn positively influences usage intention, whereas anthropomorphism exerts a U-shaped effect on eeriness, which negatively influences usage intention. In addition, social intrusiveness functions as a boundary condition by (1) strengthening the curvilinear relationships between anthropomorphism and both likability and eeriness, and (2) moderating the indirect effects of likability and eeriness. These findings provide empirical support for applying social information processing theory to human–AI interaction and extend uncanny valley theory from emotional responses to usage intention. The study also offers practical implications for deploying embodied AI agents in customer service contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注具身AI代理的拟人化设计如何影响消费者的使用意愿，基于三项视频情境实验展开考察。结果显示，拟人化程度与使用意愿呈倒U形关系：适度拟人化提升喜爱度进而促进使用意愿，而拟人化程度过高则引发诡异感并削弱使用意愿，喜爱度与诡异感共同中介这一曲线关系。社会侵入性作为边界条件，会强化拟人化与喜爱度、诡异感之间的曲线关系，并调节相应的间接效应。研究为社交信息加工理论在人机交互中的应用提供了实证支持，并将恐怖谷理论从情绪反应拓展到使用意愿层面，对客服场景中具身AI代理的部署具有实践参考价值。

papers.title: AI Adoption and Firm Value: A Comparative Study of Chinese FinTech Companies
papers.authors: Yuanting Xia, ABM Munibur Rahman, Ning Zhang
papers.journal: Journal of the Association for Information Systems
papers.abstract: Conventional approaches fail to capture how AI creates value in FinTech. This study develops a multidimensional AI adoption index and examines its relationship with firm value through comparative analysis of Tonghuashun, East Money Information, and Wind Information. Building on a comparative case analysis of three leading FinTech firms, complemented by panel data regression on firm–quarter observations (2018–2024), we find a U–shaped relationship–value emerges only after a threshold of AI integration is reached. Tonghuashun, the highest adopter, achieved 180% market capitalization growth since 2020, reaching RMB 169.94 billion, with monthly active users double its closest competitor. The findings indicate that strategic AI depth drives superior valuation, offering a replicable framework for evaluating AI value creation in emerging markets and extends the application of corporate valuation models to incorporate AI adoption as a measurable driver of firm value.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对传统方法难以刻画金融科技企业中人工智能如何创造价值的问题，构建了多维AI采用指数，并通过对同花顺、东方财富和万得信息的比较案例分析，结合2018至2024年企业—季度面板数据的回归，考察AI采用与企业价值的关系。研究发现二者呈U形关系，即只有AI整合达到一定门槛后价值效应才显现；采用程度最高的同花顺自2020年以来市值大幅增长，月活跃用户数约为最接近竞争对手的两倍。作者据此认为，战略性的AI深度是推动更高估值的关键，并提出一个可用于新兴市场评估AI价值创造的框架，将AI采用纳入企业估值模型作为可测量的价值驱动因素。

papers.title: Theoretical Mechanisms and Framework of Perceived Algorithmic Bias Affecting Human-AI Collaborative Decision-Making Performance
papers.authors: Qiong Jia, Yuxin Zhang
papers.journal: Journal of the Association for Information Systems
papers.abstract: Perceived algorithmic bias is defined as users' comprehensive subjective cognitive judgment, grounded in a cognitive attribution perspective, regarding whether an algorithmic system engages in differential treatment, whether its outcomes exhibit systematic deviations, and whether such differential treatment is justified. This study develops a theoretical model of perceived algorithmic bias and systematically elucidates the construct through three dimensions: perceived differential treatment, perceived outcome skew, and perceived lack of justification. The paper examines the mechanisms through which perceived algorithmic bias influences human-AI collaborative decision-making performance across three levels: cognitive processing, affect and morality, and human-AI interaction. It also analyzes the moderating roles of individual characteristics, algorithmic characteristics, and task characteristics. By systematically reviewing the conceptualizations of algorithmic bias and perceived algorithmic bias and clarifying their effects on and theoretical mechanisms underlying human-AI collaborative decision-making performance, this study offers theoretical implications for advancing research on perceived algorithmic bias. Future research may further develop a measurement scale for perceived algorithmic bias, enrich empirical investigations, test its underlying mechanisms, and explore its impact on human-AI collaborative decision-making performance across diverse application contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 该文从认知归因视角出发，将感知算法偏见界定为使用者对算法是否区别对待、结果是否系统性偏离以及这种区别对待是否合理的综合主观判断，并据此构建了包含感知区别对待、感知结果偏斜和感知缺乏合理性三个维度的理论模型。文章进一步从认知加工、情感与道德、人机交互三个层面梳理感知算法偏见影响人机协同决策表现的机制，并分析个体特征、算法特征与任务特征的调节作用。作为一篇理论综述，该文通过厘清算法偏见与感知算法偏见的概念及其作用路径，为后续开发测量量表、开展实证检验和拓展应用情境研究提供了理论依据。

papers.title: The Impact of GenAI Literacy on Consumer Decision-Making: A Moderated Mediation Model of Information Overload and Consumer Involvement
papers.authors: He-Ran Wen, Yi-Ming Guo, Ze-Long Feng
papers.journal: Journal of the Association for Information Systems
papers.abstract: The rapid proliferation of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) is fundamentally reshaping the landscape of consumer decision-making by providing unprecedented levels of personalized information. However, the inherent complexity and potential for AI hallucinations introduce significant cognitive challenges that may undermine decision quality. Grounded in Information Processing Theory (IPT), this study investigates the mechanism through which GenAI literacy influences consumer decision quality, specifically focusing on the mediating role of perceived information overload and the moderating role of consumer involvement. Through a structured survey of 401 Chinese college students and subsequent structural equation modeling (SEM) analysis, the empirical results demonstrate that GenAI literacy is directly and positively associated with decision quality. Furthermore, perceived information overload serves as a critical mediator, indicating that high levels of GenAI literacy could reduce cognitive friction and prevent decision paralysis. Notably, the continuous latent interaction analysis reveals that consumer involvement significantly moderates the relationship between GenAI literacy and perceived information overload, with the inhibitory effect of literacy being more pronounced in high-involvement scenarios. These findings extend the application of IPT to the era of human-AI symbiosis and offer actionable insights for policymakers and enterprises to optimize the digital consumption ecosystem.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于信息加工理论，考察生成式人工智能素养如何影响消费者的决策质量，并检验感知信息过载的中介作用与消费者涉入度的调节作用。作者对401名中国大学生开展结构化问卷调查，并采用结构方程模型进行分析，发现GenAI素养与决策质量呈正向关联；感知信息过载在其中起中介作用，即较高的GenAI素养可能减少认知摩擦、避免决策瘫痪。持续潜变量交互分析进一步显示，消费者涉入度显著调节GenAI素养与感知信息过载之间的关系，且这种抑制作用在高涉入情境下更为明显。研究据此将信息加工理论延伸至人机共生情境，并讨论了其对数字消费生态的启示。

papers.title: How AI Is Transforming Education: Toward a Symbiotic Relationship among AI, Teachers, and Students
papers.authors: Xu Fang, Zhiyi Liu, Hanshuo Yang, Yongqiang Luo
papers.journal: Journal of the Association for Information Systems
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly reshaping education by reorganizing interactions among teaching, learning, and instructional decision-making. Existing research has largely focused on isolated tools or specific learning outcomes, providing limited insight into how AI operates within integrated educational systems. This study examines an AI-enabled educational environment to explore how interactions among AI systems, teachers, and students relate to changes in instructional organization and student performance. Drawing on multi-source data generated from routine teaching activities, the findings suggest overall improvements in learning outcomes and indicate three interconnected mechanisms: improved instructional efficiency through reduced routine workload, stronger alignment between diagnosis and feedback, and a complementary division of roles between human teachers and AI systems. By linking learning outcomes with underlying instructional processes, the study provides system-level evidence on how integrated AI-enabled environments reshape educational practice and contribute to the emerging symbiotic relationship among AI, teachers, and students.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了人工智能进入教育环境后，AI系统、教师与学生之间的互动如何与教学组织和学生表现的变化相关联，并基于日常教学活动产生的多源数据进行分析。研究发现学习结果总体有所改善，并指出三条相互关联的机制：减少常规工作负担以提升教学效率、加强诊断与反馈之间的衔接，以及人类教师与AI系统之间形成互补的角色分工。作者据此认为，整合式AI教育环境正在重塑教学实践，并推动AI、教师与学生之间形成共生关系；不过相关结论属于系统层面的关联性证据，而非因果效应。

papers.title: How “AI Info” Labels Influence Social Media Posting Behavior? Evidence from Instagram
papers.authors: Pengkun Wu, Yuanxi Liu, Yuanyuan Wu, Yang Liu
papers.journal: Journal of the Association for Information Systems
papers.abstract: AI-generated content (AIGC) has reshaped content creation on social media, prompting platforms to adopt “AI Info” labels as transparency mechanisms. Drawing on signaling theory, this study examines how such labels influence content creators’ posting frequency. Using a propensity score matched difference-in-differences (PSM-DiD) design applied to a panel dataset of 237 Instagram creators observed from January 2023 to December 2025, we find that mandatory AI labeling significantly reduces creators’ weekly posting frequency. This study contributes to AI transparency research by demonstrating unintended behavioral consequences of disclosure policies for content creators, and offers implications for platform governance design.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注社交媒体平台的“AI信息”标签这一透明度机制如何影响内容创作者的发布行为，基于信号理论，使用倾向得分匹配双重差分设计分析Instagram创作者的面板数据。结果显示，强制性的AI标注会显著降低创作者每周的发布频率。作者据此指出，披露政策可能对内容创作者产生非预期的行为后果，并为平台治理设计提供了参考。

papers.title: Anthropomorphism and Relational Ontology of Purchase Intention in Generative AI Use: Insights from Mind Perception Theory and the Computers as Social Actors Paradigm
papers.authors: Jao-Hong Cheng, Li-Ming Wang
papers.journal: Journal of the Association for Information Systems
papers.abstract: A human-centric understanding of purchase intention in generative AI contexts requires attention to how users interpret and experience AI systems under conditions of algorithmic opacity. Rather than treating AI adoption as the outcome of attribute evaluation, we argue that anthropomorphic cues shape how users construe the system itself. When AI is experienced as socially responsive rather than purely instrumental, evaluative emphasis shifts toward trust beliefs and interactional arousal. Drawing on Computers as Social Actors (CASA) and Mind Perception Theory, we theorize that anthropomorphism restructures the experiential architecture through which intention is formed. Using structural equation modeling with data from 526 generative AI users, results show that anthropomorphism influences purchase intention both directly and indirectly through trust and arousal, with relational mechanisms exerting stronger effects. By foregrounding user construal and experiential engagement, this research advances a human-centric framework for understanding AI adoption in opaque, interactive environments.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注生成式人工智能使用中拟人化线索如何影响用户的购买意愿，基于心智感知理论与“计算机作为社会行动者”范式，对526名生成式AI用户的数据进行结构方程建模。结果显示，拟人化既直接作用于购买意愿，也通过信任和唤起间接发挥作用，且关系性机制的效应更强。作者据此提出，在算法不透明的交互环境中，用户对系统的社会性解读比单纯的属性评估更能解释采纳意愿，为以人为中心的AI采用研究提供了框架。

papers.title: The Impact of AI-Generated Content on Brand Image: A Dual Perspective of Algorithm Appreciation and Aversion
papers.authors: Mingxin Sun, Beiping Tan, Congyu Niu, Xinyu Guo
papers.journal: Journal of the Association for Information Systems
papers.abstract: With the rapid advancement of generative artificial intelligence technologies such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, and DALL-E, brands are increasingly leveraging AI to create marketing content. However, systematic research on how AI-generated content affects brand image remains scarce in academia, creating a critical knowledge gap for marketing practitioners. This study addresses this gap by investigating consumer attitudes toward brand use of AI-generated content and the underlying psychological mechanisms. Grounded in Algorithm Aversion theory and AI Technological Image Transfer theory, we examine whether brands should disclose AI involvement in their marketing content and how different AI participation approaches influence brand perception through three experimental studies (N=940). Results show that 100% AI-generated content significantly enhances brand image across all dimensions, with innovativeness showing the largest improvement. AI involvement approach significantly affects brand perception, with 100% AI producing the strongest effect. AI social identity emerges as the key psychological driver, while AI aversion paradoxically benefits 100% AI strategies through an “honesty effect.” This research challenges traditional algorithm aversion assumptions and provides guidance for brand AI marketing strategies.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注品牌使用AI生成营销内容会如何影响消费者对品牌形象的感知，基于算法厌恶与AI技术形象迁移理论，通过三项实验考察AI参与程度与披露方式的作用。结果显示，完全由AI生成的内容在品牌形象各维度上均有提升，其中创新性提升最明显；AI参与方式显著影响品牌感知，完全AI生成的效果最强。AI社会认同是主要心理驱动因素，而算法厌恶反而通过“诚实效应”有利于完全AI策略。研究据此对品牌AI营销策略提出建议，并挑战了传统算法厌恶假设。

papers.title: Color and Spatial Cue Modulation of Emotional Word Processing: Evidence from ERPs
papers.authors: Xiaoyang Luo, Chao LI, Yi Sun
papers.abstract: Emotional word processing is shaped by lexical meaning and concurrent perceptual context. This study investigated when red and green color cues and symbolic upward and downward direction cues modulate the processing of positive and negative Chinese emotional words. Thirty-four native Chinese speakers were recruited, and 27 remained in the final ERP sample after behavioral and EEG-quality exclusions. The experiment used a 2 (color: red vs. green) × 2 (direction: up vs. down) × 2 (word valence: positive vs. negative) within-subject design. Positive words elicited larger P1 amplitudes, and negative words elicited more negative-going N1 and N400 amplitudes. A significant Color × Valence interaction emerged in the late positive complex (LPC) window. The positive-minus-negative LPC difference was descriptively larger under green cues than under red cues, and neither within-color comparison reached significance after Bonferroni correction. Interactions involving spatial direction were not significant across the four components. These findings trace emotional word processing from early valence-sensitive visual attention through semantic processing to late color-dependent evaluation. The temporal pattern supports a context-sensitive account in which perceptual cues, lexical valence, and learned cultural associations contribute to emotional meaning at different processing stages.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察红色与绿色颜色线索及上下方向符号线索如何调节汉语情绪词加工，以脑电成分追踪其时间进程。被试完成颜色、方向与词效价交叉组合的判断任务，结果显示正性词在早期视觉注意阶段诱发更大P1，负性词则诱发更负的N1和N400；颜色与效价的交互仅出现在晚期正成分窗口，且绿线索下正负词差异在描述上大于红线索，但经多重比较校正后同一颜色内的比较均未达显著，方向线索与各成分的交互也不显著。作者据此提出情绪词加工具有情境敏感性，知觉线索、词汇效价与文化习得关联在不同阶段共同参与情绪意义建构，同时提示晚期颜色效应尚属初步证据。

papers.title: Institutional digitalization and digital stress: a four-wave observational study of teacher-reported AI-collaborative teaching in physical education
papers.authors: Xiangyu Wang, Xiangyu Wang, Wang Xiaoyun, Wang Xiaoyun
papers.abstract: Introduction How institutional digitalization relates to teachers’ experience of work and subsequent artificial intelligence (AI)-supported practice remains unclear. Methods Drawing on job demands-resources principles, we examined these relationships in a four-wave observational cohort of 961 physical education teachers from 120 Chinese institutions. We linked an organizational-source digitalization proxy to teacher questionnaires and a study-specific teacher-reported score of AI involvement in teaching tasks. Analyses adjusted for baseline practice and separated between-institution from teacher-relative associations. Results Two of five primary tests met the Holm-adjusted criterion. The stress-related product of between-institution coefficients was negative (−0.099; pointwise 95% confidence interval [−0.184, −0.033]). The positive digitalization–stress association was weaker among teachers with higher digital self-efficacy relative to colleagues (interaction coefficient −0.101; [−0.168, −0.037]) but remained positive at the low, average, and high self-efficacy levels examined. The adjusted digitalization–practice association, appraisal-related coefficient product, and appraisal interaction did not meet the corrected criterion. Discussion The findings connect the organization and experience of work with reported AI practice, emphasizing perceived digital work pressure and relative self-efficacy while complementing accounts centered on technology acceptance.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于工作需求—资源框架，考察机构数字化水平如何与体育教师的工作压力体验及自报的AI协同教学实践相关联。作者对来自120所中国院校的961名体育教师开展了四波观察性追踪，将机构层面的数字化代理指标与教师问卷及自报AI参与度相连接，并在分析中控制基线实践、区分机构间差异与教师相对差异。结果显示，机构间数字化与压力之间的关联在数字自我效能较高的教师中相对同事更弱，但在所考察的各效能水平上仍为正；数字化与实践的关联未达到校正后的显著性标准。研究提示，机构数字化可能通过感知工作压力与相对自我效能影响教师的AI协同教学，相关结论属观察性关联而非因果效应。

papers.title: Authenticity across human and synthetic influencers: a configurational review of source evaluation and social influence
papers.authors: Xiao-Rui Lin, Amily Binti Fikry, Wei-Guo Zhang, Kai Ding
papers.abstract: Introduction Authenticity has become a central concern in social media influencer research, yet its construction is examined differently across human, virtual, and artificial intelligence (AI)-mediated sources. This study examines how authenticity is constructed and evaluated across these influencer contexts. Methods This study conducted a corpus-based review of 1,676 English-language research articles indexed in the Web of Science Core Collection and Scopus between July 2017 and March 2026. BERTopic modeling was employed to identify recurring semantic topics, followed by an abductive, theory-informed synthesis organized around source ontology and the dominant basis of authenticity construction. Temporal changes in relative topic prevalence were examined across the eight complete calendar years from 2018 to 2025. Results The synthesis identified four configurations: relational human authenticity, curated human authenticity, humanized synthetic authenticity, and governed synthetic authenticity. Human-influencer research emphasizes biography, accumulated interaction, commercial congruence, and motive transparency, whereas synthetic-influencer research places greater weight on persona coherence, humanization, identity disclosure, ownership, automation, and accountability. Credibility, trust, parasocial interaction, social presence, and engagement emerge as closely associated evaluative processes. Temporal analysis revealed selective changes in relative topic prevalence, particularly concerning virtual-influencer credibility, humanization, and tourism-related applications, while most topics showed no clear linear trend. Discussion The findings provide a corpus- and method-dependent framework for understanding how authenticity is constructed and evaluated across human and synthetic influencer contexts. The framework highlights distinct evidential foundations underlying authenticity judgments and offers a basis for further research on source evaluation and social influence.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述以语料库为基础，梳理了2017年至2026年间收录的英文网红研究文献，用主题建模识别反复出现的语义主题，再围绕来源本体与真实性建构依据进行归纳综合。分析归纳出四种真实性配置：关系型真人真实性、策展型真人真实性、拟人化合成真实性与受治理的合成真实性。真人网红研究更强调个人经历、互动积累、商业契合与动机透明，合成网红研究则更看重人设一致性、拟人化、身份披露、所有权、自动化与问责；可信度、信任、准社会互动、社会临场感与参与是与之紧密关联的评价过程。时间分析显示，虚拟网红可信度、拟人化及旅游应用等主题的相对占比有所变化，但多数主题未见清晰的线性趋势。作者据此提出一个依赖语料与方法框架的理解路径，用以区分真人与合成网红语境下真实性判断的不同证据基础，并提示该框架的适用范围受语料库和方法限制。

papers.title: Feeling or thinking? User aversion to AI customer service in online education
papers.authors: Yuan He, Lin Huang
papers.abstract: Introduction AI customer service is increasingly integrated into online education, yet users may not always respond favorably to AI-assisted service interactions. Drawing on robotic role theory, this study examines how thinking and feeling AI customer service influence user aversion in online educational service encounters. Methods Three experiments were conducted to examine the effect of AI customer service type on user aversion (Study 1, N = 120), the mediating role of perceived intelligence (Study 2, N = 120), and the moderating role of AI identity disclosure timing (Study 3, N = 120). Across the three between-subjects experiments, thinking AI was operationalized through analytical, information-processing, and task-oriented communication, whereas feeling AI emphasized emotional recognition and relational support. Results The results show that feeling AI generates greater user aversion than thinking AI. Perceived intelligence mediated this effect, such that feeling AI is perceived as less intelligent, which in turn increases user aversion. Further, AI identity disclosure timing moderates the indirect effect through perceived intelligence. Early disclosure of AI identity attenuates the negative effect of feeling AI. Discussion These findings demonstrate that the effectiveness of different AI customer service types depends on the service context and highlight the importance of aligning AI communication with users’ task-oriented service needs.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于机器人角色理论，通过三项实验考察在线教育场景中“思考型”与“情感型”AI客服如何引发用户反感。结果显示，情感型AI比思考型AI引发更强的用户反感，其机制在于情感型AI被感知为智能程度较低，进而加剧反感；AI身份的披露时机则调节这一间接效应，较早披露AI身份可削弱情感型AI的负面影响。作者据此指出，不同AI客服类型的效果取决于服务情境，AI沟通方式应与用户以任务为导向的服务需求相匹配。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence and its influence on student engagement in higher education
papers.authors: Yongsheng Chen, Jing Dong, 冀国娟
papers.abstract: Empirical evidence on how artificial intelligence (AI) relates to student engagement in culturally diverse higher-education settings remains limited. In Chinese university classrooms, where interaction is often teacher-led and asking questions in class can carry a social cost, AI-driven dialogic tools may offer low-pressure opportunities for active participation. This study examined the association between an AI conversational agent (EduBot) and the behavioural, cognitive, emotional and agentic dimensions of engagement among Chinese undergraduates. A mixed-methods quasi-experimental design involved 555 students in four comprehensive (multi-disciplinary, research-intensive) universities, each contributing one introductory course taught in two parallel sections. Within a 15-week semester, intervention sections (n = 278) used EduBot, a Socratic-dialogue agent embedded in the learning management system, for 12 weeks; control sections (n = 277) used teaching-assistant-moderated forums. We measured engagement at three time points with a 21-item four-dimensional engagement scale adapted from an established measure and supplemented it with system logs, 30 student interviews and instructor focus groups. Linear mixed-effects models accounting for the nesting of students within course sections, together with mixed-design ANOVAs, showed Group × Time interactions for behavioural (η 2 p = 0.043, post-test d = 0.71), cognitive (η 2 p = 0.032, d = 0.55), agentic (η 2 p = 0.054, d = 0.57) and emotional engagement (η 2 p = 0.012, d = 0.34), all p ≤ 0.001 after Holm adjustment. Within the intervention group, the number of EduBot sessions predicted post-test engagement after adjustment for baseline scores and covariates. Exploratory moderation analyses indicated larger agentic gains among first-year students and larger cognitive gains among students with lower prior GPA. Thematic analysis identified three hypothesised mechanisms, namely a judgment-free interaction space, scaffolded persistence and temporal flexibility. A Socratic-scaffolded AI agent was associated with higher engagement, most clearly for agentic engagement, which participants described as constrained by classroom norms. The findings support culturally attentive AI design and suggest, tentatively, an equity-enhancing potential. Because the design compared an integrated AI package with usual practice across eight sections, the effects cannot be attributed to single design components.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在中国高校课堂中，嵌入学习管理系统的苏格拉底式对话智能体EduBot与本科生学习投入各维度之间的关联，采用混合方法准实验设计，比较使用EduBot的班级与由助教主持论坛的班级。结果显示，两组在行为、认知、能动和情感投入上均呈现组别与时间的交互，其中能动投入的差异最为明显；访谈将这种关联归因于无评判的互动空间、支架式坚持和时间灵活性。作者据此讨论文化敏感的AI设计可能具有的公平促进潜力，同时强调由于比较的是整合式AI方案与常规做法，效果不能归因于单一设计成分。

papers.title: Intelligent scaffolding for musical practice: a systematic review of AI and digital support for the self-regulated learning cycle
papers.authors: Xiuran Li, Mar Galera-Núñez, Yao Zhang
papers.abstract: Introduction Independent music practice depends on learners’ self-regulated learning (SRL), yet how digital tools and artificial intelligence (AI) support the forethought, performance, and self-reflection phases of the SRL cycle, and when such support may undermine learner autonomy, remains unclear. Methods Following PRISMA 2020, we searched Web of Science, Scopus, ERIC, and PsycINFO through March 2026. Sixteen empirical studies met the inclusion criteria and were appraised with the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool. Because of methodological heterogeneity, we conducted a thematic synthesis rather than a meta-analysis. Results Three categories emerged: traditional digital tools, discriminative AI, and generative AI. Traditional tools supported planning and reflection; discriminative AI enabled real-time error detection; and generative AI may help learners manage task difficulty and translate expert feedback into actionable steps. Study quality was uneven, and several findings came from small-sample or cross-sectional designs, which limits causal inference. Two potential risks, over-scaffolding that may diminish autonomy and visual feedback that may divert attention from sound, were insufficiently studied. Discussion Digital and AI tools appear to scaffold different phases of SRL, but learner autonomy should remain at the core. Fading explicit support and pedagogical guidance may help reduce dependence. Longitudinal studies are required to test these mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述关注数字工具与人工智能如何支持音乐自主练习中自我调节学习的计划、执行与反思三个阶段，以及这种支持何时可能削弱学习者的自主性。作者按PRISMA 2020流程检索多个数据库，纳入十六项实证研究，因方法异质性采用主题综合而非元分析。结果归纳出传统数字工具、判别式AI与生成式AI三类：传统工具主要支持计划与反思，判别式AI侧重实时错误检测，生成式AI可能帮助学习者调节任务难度并把专家反馈转化为可操作步骤。研究质量参差不齐，部分发现来自小样本或横断面设计，因果推断受限；过度支架可能削弱自主性、视觉反馈可能分散对声音的注意这两类风险研究不足。作者据此主张以学习者自主性为核心，通过逐步撤除显性支持并辅以教学引导来减少依赖，相关机制仍需纵向研究检验。

papers.title: Digital attention disruption and academic impact in adolescents: a data-driven network and machine learning analysis
papers.authors: Yan Liu
papers.abstract: Academic impact associated with digital media use is a topic of considerable concern in the fields of adolescent mental health and education; however, the role of attention status in this context remains largely unknown. The present study aimed to systematically investigate the multidimensional association patterns between attention-related characteristics and academic impact among adolescents using data mining approaches. The data were derived from two publicly available cross-sectional survey datasets, and a final sample of 799 adolescents aged 19 years and below was included after age screening. The analytical framework integrated LASSO regression, regularized partial correlation network analysis based on EBICglasso, XGBoost predictive modeling with SHAP interpretation, and latent profile analysis. Results showed that LASSO regression identified stress level (coefficient = 0.384) and social media use duration (coefficient = 0.297) as the strongest predictors of academic impact. Network analysis revealed a three-community structure, corresponding to the “digital distraction load,” “psychological-academic exhaustion,” and “academic engagement” dimensions, with academic impact located at the intersection of the first two communities. The XGBoost model achieved an AUC of 0.842, and SHAP dependence plots further revealed a nonlinear pattern with an inflection point at approximately 3.5 hours for daily social media use duration and a nonlinear effect of stress level. Latent profile analysis identified three subgroups, among which the “high stress-exhaustion” group showed a probability of academic impact as high as 79.4%. These findings indicate that attention-related characteristics can effectively predict academic impact status in adolescents, with stress level, social media use duration, and number of notifications constituting the most influential set of predictors. The results provide data-driven theoretical evidence and practical implications for the early identification and stratified intervention of academic impact in adolescents.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注青少年数字媒体使用中注意状态与学业影响之间的关系，利用两个公开横断面调查数据，对年龄筛选后的青少年样本整合了LASSO回归、正则化偏相关网络、XGBoost预测建模与SHAP解释以及潜在剖面分析。结果发现压力水平和社交媒体使用时长是学业影响的最强预测因素，网络分析呈现数字分心负荷、心理-学业耗竭与学业投入三个社区结构，学业影响位于前两者交汇处；预测模型具有较好的区分能力，社交媒体使用时长与压力水平均呈非线性作用，潜在剖面分析还识别出三个亚组，其中高压力-耗竭组的学业影响概率较高。研究据此认为注意相关特征可用于预测青少年学业影响状况，并为早期识别和分层干预提供数据驱动的依据，但结论基于横断面关联，尚不能说明因果关系。

papers.title: Motor action observation evaluation questionnaire: development and initial validity evidence for the scores in people with and without chronic low back pain
papers.authors: Roy La Touche, Prado Silván‐Ferrero, Encarnación Nouvilas-Pallejà, Alba Paris‐Alemany, Alfonso J. López-Rivero, Miguel Ángel Sorrel
papers.abstract: Introduction Chronic low back pain (CLBP) is highly prevalent and associated with functional limitations. Although action observation is increasingly used as a cognitive–motor rehabilitation strategy, no brief instrument exists to assess how individuals appraise and understand movements during observation. Methods The Questionnaire for the Assessment of Motor Action Observation (CENOAM) was developed using a sequential mixed-methods design. Phase 1 involved item generation based on literature review and qualitative analysis, followed by expert content validation using Aiken’s V . Phase 2 consisted of a cross-sectional study including 280 participants (140 with CLBP and 140 asymptomatic). Dimensionality and psychometric properties of the CENOAM scores were examined using exploratory factor analysis, complementary dimensionality methods, internal consistency ( α , ω ), floor and ceiling effects, concurrent associations, and known-groups comparisons, following COSMIN recommendations. Results The final seven-item instrument showed a parsimonious two-dimensional structure, comprising Familiarity and Competence–Demand, supported by converging evidence across multiple methods. Internal consistency was high for both total and subscale scores, and no floor or ceiling effects were observed. CENOAM scores were positively associated with motor imagery ability, physical activity, and pain self-efficacy, and negatively associated with fear of movement. Participants with CLBP showed significantly lower scores than asymptomatic individuals across all dimensions, with large effect sizes. Conclusion The CENOAM provides a brief and interpretable measure of movement appraisal during action observation. Its scores show initial evidence of validity and may support the individualization of action-observation–based rehabilitation in musculoskeletal conditions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对慢性腰痛人群缺乏评估动作观察过程中动作评价工具的空白，开发了CENOAM问卷并检验其分数效度。作者采用序贯混合方法，先基于文献与质性分析生成条目并经专家内容验证，再对慢性腰痛者与无症状者开展横断面调查，通过探索性因子分析等方法考察其心理测量学性质。结果显示，最终七条目问卷呈 Familiarity 与 Competence–Demand 两维结构，内部一致性高且无地板或天花板效应；分数与运动想象能力、身体活动和疼痛自我效能正相关，与运动恐惧负相关，慢性腰痛者各维度得分均显著低于无症状者。作者据此认为该问卷可简要反映动作观察中的动作评价，为相关康复的个体化提供初步测量依据，但效度证据仍属初步。

papers.title: Dynamic adaptation of attentional control across bilingual interactional contexts
papers.authors: Min Li, Xiangyu Shi, Qinghong Xu, Jie Li
papers.abstract: Background/objectives Bilingual experience is thought to shape cognitive control via adaptive attentional reorganization, yet the neural mechanisms by which different interactional contexts dynamically modulate attentional control remain unclear. This study used EEG to examine how Chinese monolingual, English monolingual, bilingual, and voluntary naming contexts influence attentional control in Chinese–English bilinguals. Methods Thirty-five bilinguals completed picture-naming tasks in different contexts, followed by an antisaccade task with concurrent EEG. We analyzed reaction time, ERPs, frontal and parietal delta/theta power, and frontoparietal functional connectivity (wPLI). Results Bilingual and voluntary naming contexts shortened antisaccade reaction times (all p < 0.01). No significant main effect of context was found on N2 amplitudes ( p = 0.615). Both contexts reduced parietal delta and theta power relative to the English monolingual context (all p < 0.05). Exploratory connectivity analysis initially suggested bilingual-context effects, but this finding did not survive homologous ROI validation. These preliminary sensor-level findings await validation by source-localized EEG or fMRI. Conclusions These findings suggest that bilingual and voluntary naming contexts may facilitate attentional control through adaptive reorganization of the attentional system rather than through enhancing a specific inhibitory process. This pattern is consistent with the adaptationist perspective on bilingual cognition and provides preliminary neural evidence for the language mode theory.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用脑电考察不同语言互动情境如何动态调节中英双语者的注意控制，35名双语者先后在不同命名情境下完成图片命名，再做反向眼跳任务。结果显示，双语情境和自愿命名情境缩短了反向眼跳反应时，并降低了顶区delta与theta功率，而N2波幅未见情境主效应；探索性连接分析虽有提示，但未通过同源感兴趣区验证。作者据此认为，这些情境可能通过注意系统的适应性重组而非增强某一特定抑制过程来促进注意控制，但相关结论仍属初步，有待源定位脑电或功能磁共振验证。

papers.title: Naturalistic language assessment and brain-network biomarkers in post-stroke aphasia for precision neurorehabilitation
papers.authors: Jiayi Xia, Song Pei, Song ZHOU, Yulong Bai
papers.abstract: Advances in naturalistic language assessment, portable neuroimaging, electrophysiology, and brain-network modeling are creating new opportunities to evaluate post-stroke aphasia under conditions closer to real-world communication. Conventional aphasia batteries and isolated linguistic tasks remain essential for diagnosis, severity classification, and treatment planning, but they provide limited information about how language-network activity supports communication in dynamic, naturalistic contexts. This integrative review, informed by a structured literature search and descriptive thematic mapping, synthesizes evidence on connected speech, discourse production, narrative comprehension, interactive communication, and contextual reading after stroke. We examine how multilevel features from these behaviors can be organized into graded, interacting dimensions of lexical-semantic access, phonological encoding, grammatical organization, discourse processing, executive-predictive control, and speech-motor output. We further review multimodal evidence from fNIRS, fMRI, EEG/ERP, lesion-symptom mapping, structural connectivity, and functional connectivity, highlighting residual left-hemisphere language networks, conditional right-hemisphere support, bilateral reorganization, domain-general control systems, and longitudinal recovery. Portable EEG and fNIRS are considered complementary approaches for repeated assessment during less constrained language tasks, with distinct temporal, spatial, and practical trade-offs. Building on this evidence, we propose an operational ecological biomarker framework that links task choice, multilevel feature extraction, multivariate behavioral profiles, neural measures, prespecified clinical questions, and longitudinal outcomes. This framework may support recovery prediction, rehabilitation stratification, neuromodulation target selection, individualized therapy planning, and monitoring of functional communication.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述围绕卒中后失语症的评估与神经康复，梳理了自然情境语言评估与脑网络生物标志物方面的研究证据。作者整合连贯言语、叙事理解、互动交流等行为的多层级特征，并结合fNIRS、fMRI、EEG/ERP及结构与功能连接等多模态证据，归纳出左半球残余语言网络、右半球条件性支持及双侧重组等模式。文章据此提出一个操作性生态生物标志物框架，将任务选择、特征提取、行为画像与神经测量同预设临床问题和纵向结局相衔接，以期为恢复预测、康复分层和个体化治疗提供参考；相关结论来自文献整合而非原始实验。

papers.title: Post-traumatic headache as a window into persistent brain dysfunction after traumatic brain injury: an opinion article
papers.authors: Denise Franco de Almeida Duarte, Jader Vinicius Da Silva Rocha, Fernanda Moura Vargas Dias, Micheline Henrique Araújo da Luz Koerich, Vitória Caroline Reinoso de Almeida, Rodrigo Freire de Almeida, Walter Gomes da Silva Filho, Fernando Zanela da Silva Arêas
papers.abstract: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) remains a major cause of death and disability worldwide, particularly among young adults and individuals of working age (1,2). Advances in prehospital care, neurosurgery, and intensive care have improved survival after TBI, increasing attention to the persistent symptoms and functional limitations that may affect long-term recovery and quality of life (1,2).Post-traumatic headache (PTH) is a secondary headache attributed to traumatic injury to the head, including TBI, and is among the most frequent neurological symptoms reported after TBI (3)(4)(5)(6). In this article, we specifically address PTH occurring in the context of TBI rather than the broader category of headache attributed to head injury without established TBI. Consistent with the International Classification of Headache Disorders, PTH that persists for more than three months is referred to here as persistent PTH (3). Persistent PTH may coexist with fatigue, cognitive complaints, sleep disturbances, anxiety, depression, and limitations in daily activities (4)(5)(6), contributing to the complexity of long-term clinical recovery.Conventional measures of initial TBI severity, including the Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS), pupillary reactivity, and structural imaging findings, remain essential for acute assessment and prognosis.However, the relationship between the extent and characteristics of the initial injury and persistent symptoms is not straightforward, and individuals with apparently similar acute injury characteristics may follow different long-term recovery trajectories (4-6, 11, 12). This variability has increased interest in biological and functional processes that may persist or evolve after the acute injury (7)(8)(9).Against this background, we propose the hypothesis that persistent PTH may serve as a clinical window into persistent brain dysfunction after TBI. This concept does not imply that persistent PTH is itself a biomarker or that it demonstrates the presence of a specific underlying mechanism. Rather, we propose that its persistence may serve as a clinical signal warranting investigation of functional or biological abnormalities that are not fully characterized by conventional structural assessment. This hypothesis is considered across the TBI severity spectrum. However, the evidence discussed in this article derives from heterogeneous populations, including mild TBI and moderate-to-severe TBI, and findings from one severity group should not be assumed to generalize to another. Furthermore, evidence directly obtained from patients with persistent PTH remains more limited than evidence derived from broader TBI populations. Throughout this article, we therefore distinguish PTH-specific findings from mechanisms that remain biologically plausible on the basis of the broader TBI literature.Acute TBI severity remains a major determinant of early clinical outcomes. Measures such as the GCS, pupillary reactivity, and structural imaging findings are strongly associated with mortality and functional disability and remain fundamental for clinical decision-making and prognostic assessment (1,2,10). However, these measures were primarily developed to characterize the initial injury and estimate acute outcomes, and their ability to account for persistent symptoms and heterogeneous longterm recovery trajectories is more limited (11,12).Patients with apparently similar initial injury characteristics may experience markedly different longterm outcomes, including persistent headache, fatigue, cognitive impairment, sleep disturbances, emotional symptoms, and reduced quality of life (11,12). This variability suggests that the extent and characteristics of the initial injury alone do not fully capture the processes associated with long-term recovery.TBI initiates a cascade of biological events that may extend beyond the acute phase (7-9). Among these processes, neuroinflammation has been extensively investigated. Acute activation of microglia and astrocytes contributes to tissue responses following injury, whereas sustained or dysregulated inflammatory activity has been associated with blood-brain barrier alterations, persistent inflammatory signaling, and changes in neuronal function (7)(8)(9)(17)(18)(19). Importantly, evidence of persistent neuroinflammation after TBI derives predominantly from experimental studies and broader TBI populations and should not be interpreted as evidence that neuroinflammation directly causes persistent PTH. Rather, it provides a biologically plausible framework that requires specific validation in patients with persistent PTH.Altered nociceptive processing may represent another relevant mechanism. Central sensitization should be distinguished from nociplastic pain and other forms of altered nociceptive signaling because these concepts are related but not interchangeable (20,21). PTH-specific studies have identified sensory abnormalities, including cephalic allodynia, hyperalgesia, and altered pain modulatory responses, supporting abnormal nociceptive processing in at least a subset of patients with persistent PTH (22). Experimental evidence of hypersensitivity to calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) further supports the involvement of CGRP-related nociceptive pathways (23). However, these findings neither establish central sensitization as a universal mechanism nor demonstrate a single pathophysiological pathway underlying persistent PTH.A complementary perspective is provided by network neuroscience, which conceptualizes neurological dysfunction as potentially arising from disturbances in interactions among distributed brain networks rather than exclusively from focal structural damage (13)(14)(15). TBI studies have demonstrated persistent structural network abnormalities during recovery (24), while PTH-specific neuroimaging studies have identified alterations in resting-state functional connectivity involving pain-processing, painmodulatory, and affective networks (25,26). These findings provide more direct, although still limited, evidence that persistent PTH may be associated with alterations in brain network function.Persistent PTH also frequently co-occurs with fatigue, cognitive impairment, sleep disturbances, emotional symptoms, and reduced quality of life (4)(5)(6). Rather than representing different expressions of a single persistent biological condition, these manifestations may arise from partially overlapping, independent, or mutually reinforcing mechanisms. Their co-occurrence therefore underscores the heterogeneity of post-traumatic recovery and the need to investigate how different biological and functional processes contribute to individual symptom profiles.Within the framework proposed here, persistent PTH is considered a potential clinical window into persistent brain dysfunction rather than a validated biomarker, prognostic indicator, or surrogate measure of an underlying biological process. We use the term clinical window to describe an observable clinical feature whose persistence may signal the need to investigate ongoing functional or biological abnormalities that are not fully captured by conventional structural assessment. Thus, persistent PTH is proposed primarily as a clinical signal for further investigation, not as evidence that a specific pathophysiological process is present.We use the term persistent brain dysfunction as an umbrella concept encompassing ongoing abnormalities in neural function or biological processes after TBI, including altered nociceptive processing, disturbances in brain network function, and potentially persistent inflammatory activity. This definition does not imply a single mechanism, nor does it assume that these abnormalities are present in all individuals with persistent PTH or that persistent PTH is caused by any one of them.The distinction is important because the evidence supporting these potential mechanisms varies substantially. PTH-specific neuroimaging studies have demonstrated alterations in resting-state functional connectivity involving pain-processing and pain-modulatory networks, including periaqueductal gray-related connectivity, with some alterations associated with headache burden or the subsequent development of persistent PTH (25,26). By contrast, evidence for persistent neuroinflammation and several other chronic neurobiological abnormalities derives predominantly from broader TBI populations. These mechanisms should therefore be regarded as biologically plausible contributors requiring direct investigation in persistent PTH rather than as established pathophysiological correlates of the condition.Persistent PTH may also reflect greater overall symptom burden rather than a distinct biological state.Headache commonly co-occurs with sleep disturbance, fatigue, cognitive complaints, anxiety, depression, and other post-traumatic symptoms (4-6), and these factors may independently influence both headache persistence and measures of brain function. Pre-existing headache disorders, injury severity, medication use, cervical or extracranial pain generators, and psychological and behavioral factors may further contribute to clinical heterogeneity. Consequently, the presence or severity of persistent PTH cannot currently be assumed to indicate the presence, type, or magnitude of persistent brain dysfunction.Testing the proposed clinical-window hypothesis will therefore require prospective studies that combine detailed headache phenotyping with objective measures of brain function and biology while accounting for relevant confounding factors. Quantitative electroencephalography, neuroimagingderived connectivity measures, and molecular or inflammatory measures are candidate approaches that could be evaluated in this context (24,27,28,31). Artificial intelligence and machine-learning methods may complement these measures as analytical approaches for identifying multidimensional patterns or patient phenotypes, rather than representing biological or functional measures themselves (29,30).At present, none of these candidate approaches can be considered a validated biomarker of persistent PTH. Their value lies in testing whether persistent PTH is systematically associated with measurable patterns of post-traumatic dysfunction beyond headache severity and overall symptom burden.The hypothesis proposed in this article should be interpreted within several important limitations. First, evidence directly linking persistent PTH to measurable ongoing brain dysfunction remains limited.Although PTH-specific neuroimaging studies have identified alterations in functional connectivity (25,26), much of the evidence supporting persistent neuroinflammation, neurophysiological abnormalities, and other chronic biological processes derives from broader TBI populations. Extrapolation of these findings to persistent PTH therefore requires caution, and associations observed after TBI should not be assumed to represent mechanisms of persistent PTH.Second, persistent PTH is clinically and biologically heterogeneous. Headache phenotype, pre-existing headache disorders, TBI severity, sleep disturbance, fatigue, psychological symptoms, medication use, cervical or extracranial pain generators, and other post-traumatic symptoms may influence both headache persistence and measures of brain function. These factors provide alternative or complementary explanations for associations between persistent PTH and biological or functional abnormalities. Consequently, future studies should determine whether such associations remain after appropriate characterization and adjustment for relevant confounding factors.The proposed clinical-window hypothesis also generates testable predictions. If persistent PTH is associated with ongoing post-traumatic dysfunction beyond overall symptom burden, individuals with persistent PTH should demonstrate reproducible functional or biological abnormalities when compared with appropriately matched TBI survivors without persistent PTH. These associations should remain detectable after accounting for injury severity, pre-existing headache, headache phenotype, psychological symptoms, sleep disturbance, medication use, and other relevant clinical factors.Longitudinal studies should further determine whether changes in headache frequency, intensity, or disability are accompanied by changes in candidate neurophysiological, neuroimaging, or molecular measures.Conversely, failure to identify reproducible associations between persistent PTH and objective measures of post-traumatic dysfunction, particularly after controlling for symptom burden and relevant confounders, would argue against the proposed clinical-window hypothesis or restrict its applicability to specific patient subgroups. This possibility is important because the framework proposed here should be considered a testable hypothesis rather than an assumption that persistent headache necessarily reflects ongoing brain dysfunction.Future research should therefore prioritize prospective longitudinal designs with detailed headache phenotyping and appropriate comparison groups. Studies comparing TBI survivors with persistent PTH, TBI survivors without persistent PTH, and, where appropriate, individuals with primary headache disorders may help determine which findings are related specifically to persistent PTH, to TBI more broadly, or to chronic headache irrespective of trauma. Stratification by mild TBI and moderate-to-severe TBI will also be necessary because mechanisms and recovery trajectories may differ across injury severity.Multimodal studies integrating clinical phenotyping with neuroimaging, quantitative electroencephalography, and molecular measures may help determine whether reproducible patterns of dysfunction can be identified in specific persistent PTH subgroups. Artificial intelligence and machine-learning approaches may support the analysis of these multidimensional datasets and the identification of patient phenotypes, but their role is analytical and depends on the quality and validation of the underlying clinical and biological measures (24,(27)(28)(29)(30)(31). Candidate measures should not be considered biomarkers until their reproducibility, specificity, longitudinal behavior, and clinical relevance have been established in persistent PTH populations.Ultimately, the value of the proposed framework will depend on whether persistent PTH provides clinically meaningful information beyond established measures of injury severity and overall posttraumatic symptom burden. Prospective validation is therefore required before persistent PTH can be used to identify individuals for additional biological assessment, prognostic stratification, or mechanism-based interventions.
