Persistent PTH may provide a clinically accessible signal for investigating ongoing functional or biological abnormalities after TBI, but this relationship remains hypothetical and should not be interpreted as evidence that persistent headache is itself a biomarker of brain dysfunction.Distinguishing PTH-specific findings from abnormalities associated with TBI more broadly, controlling for alternative explanations and confounding factors, and prospectively testing the proposed associations will be essential to determine the validity and clinical relevance of this framework.
keywords: moderate to severe traumatic brain injury

papers.title: Functional brain activity in cancer-related cognitive impairment: a scoping review of EEG studies
papers.authors: Barbara Johanne Thomas Nordhjem, Laura Maria Toftekær Rothschild, Clotilde Rose Honoré, Anders Thyge Steen Larsen, Martin Kaj Fridh, Lisa Lyngsie Hjalgrim
papers.abstract: Cancer-related cognitive impairment (CRCI) is reported across the cancer trajectory, yet its neurobiological basis remains incompletely understood. Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a temporally precise method for assessing brain activity at rest and during cognitive processing, but its application in CRCI research has not been systematically mapped. This scoping review characterized how EEG has been used to study cognitive functioning in people with cancer, including populations studied, EEG paradigms and analytic approaches employed, and cognitive outcomes assessed. Following PRISMA-ScR guidance, we searched MEDLINE, PsycINFO, and Web of Science from inception to February 2025 for studies using EEG to examine cognitive functioning. Sixty articles were included. Most were small and cross-sectional, with publication output increasing markedly after 2015. Task-based event-related potentials, particularly from oddball and attention tasks, were used most frequently, whereas quantitative EEG approaches, including spectral power and connectivity analyses, were less common. In populations with cancers outside the central nervous system (CNS), longer P300 latency and lower amplitude were common, but opposite and null findings also occurred. Evidence from primary CNS and other intracranial tumor populations was sparse. Across cancer contexts, quantitative EEG findings showed limited convergence across articles. Associations between EEG measures and cognitive outcomes were inconsistent and often not tested directly. Overall, EEG provides a complementary approach to investigating cognition in people with cancer, but the evidence remains methodologically heterogeneous. Larger longitudinal studies, more consistent cognitive outcome selection, and closer integration of neural and cognitive measures are needed to establish reproducible findings and evaluate their potential clinical utility. Systematic review registration https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420251084951 .
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了脑电图（EEG）在癌症相关认知障碍研究中的应用，涵盖所研究人群、EEG范式与分析方法及所评估的认知结局。作者按范围综述规范检索并纳入六十项研究，发现多数为小样本横断面设计，任务相关事件相关电位（尤其oddball与注意任务）使用最多，定量EEG分析较少；非中枢神经系统癌症人群中P300潜伏期延长和波幅降低较常见，但也存在相反或无差异结果，中枢神经系统肿瘤证据稀少，EEG指标与认知结局的关联不一致且常未经直接检验。文章据此指出该领域方法学异质性明显，需更大规模纵向研究、统一认知结局并加强神经与认知测量的整合，以形成可重复发现并评估其潜在临床价值。

papers.title: Mapping generative AI in higher education teaching and learning: a scoping review
papers.authors: Michael Pin-Chuan Lin, Daniel Chang, Philip H. Winne, Gervase Michael Bowen, Jeeho Ryoo
papers.journal: International Journal of Educational Technology in Higher Education
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) has rapidly entered higher education, but empirical research on its roles in teaching and learning remains fragmented across instructional activities, outcomes, assessment approaches, and stakeholder perspectives. This scoping review followed PRISMA-ScR guidelines to map 394 empirical studies of GenAI use in higher education published from November 2022 through December 2025. The review examined how GenAI tools were integrated into authentic teaching and learning activities, what outcomes or skills were targeted, how studies assessed those outcomes, and how students and instructors perceived GenAI use. Across the reviewed studies, GenAI was most often used to support existing academic tasks, especially feedback, tutoring, and writing. The most frequently targeted outcomes included engagement, usability and acceptance, critical thinking, disciplinary knowledge, academic performance, writing quality, and AI literacy. Self-regulated learning, ethics, creativity, feedback quality, and equity received less attention. Assessment practices relied mainly on surveys, tests or rubrics, artifact analysis, and interviews, suggesting that much of the evidence base is shaped by short-term and readily implemented methods. Student and instructor perceptions were predominantly mixed, reflecting perceived benefits alongside concerns about pedagogy, integrity, workload, and governance. The review highlights the need for stronger alignment between learning constructs and assessment methods, more process-sensitive evidence, clearer reporting of governance practices, and greater attention to equity in GenAI-supported higher education. Supplementary Information: The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1186/s41239-026-00630-9.

papers.title: Individualized Theta Transcranial Alternating Current Stimulation Modulates Mnemonic Discrimination and ERP Responses to Positive Information in Individuals With Elevated Depressive Symptoms
papers.authors: Xinyu Huang, Min Zhou, Chun Wang, Yuxin Huang, Wenchang Wang, Jianfei Shao, Junyu Mao, Jiaqi Li, Zhang Lei, Rong Ye, Chunyan Zhu, Yanghua Tian, Kongliang He, 余凤琼, Kai Wang
papers.abstract: Individuals with elevated depressive symptoms often show impairments in positive memory processing. This randomized, double-blind study investigated whether individualized theta-frequency transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) using an OFC-oriented montage modulates mnemonic discrimination and ERP responses to positive information. Sixty-one individuals with elevated depressive symptoms received either real or sham stimulation before completing an emotional mnemonic discrimination task. Behavioral results showed that lure discrimination increased following real stimulation but not sham stimulation. EEG results showed that real stimulation modulated ERP responses during positive memory encoding and retrieval, as reflected by increased late positive potential (LPP) amplitudes during encoding and altered early retrieval-related ERP amplitudes. These findings suggest that individualized theta-tACS may influence both mnemonic discrimination performance and neural responses to positive information.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察个体化θ频率经颅交流电刺激能否改善抑郁症状升高个体的积极信息记忆辨别及其脑电反应，采用随机双盲真假刺激对照，让被试在刺激前后完成情绪记忆辨别任务并记录事件相关电位。结果显示，真刺激后被试对诱饵项的辨别表现提高，假刺激组未见此变化；真刺激还改变了积极信息编码和提取阶段的ERP反应，编码期晚正电位波幅增大，提取早期成分波幅也发生改变。作者据此认为，个体化θ-tACS可能同时影响记忆辨别表现和对积极信息的神经加工，但相关结论仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: From digital interaction to social connection: AI virtual humans as interactive learning partners for older adults
papers.authors: WeiCheng Pan, WanQing Zhang, Hong Chen, Qi Guo, Shuyi Wang, Hesen Li
papers.abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes increasingly embedded in educational and social interaction systems, its potential to alleviate digital exclusion and digital loneliness among older adults has attracted growing attention. Across two independent experiments, this study examined the association between AI-assisted interaction and digital loneliness among older adults, as well as the underlying psychological mechanisms. In Experiment 1, 90 older adults participated in a four-week randomized longitudinal experiment. A 2 (group) × 5 (time) mixed-design repeated-measures analysis of variance was conducted to compare changes in digital loneliness between an AI-assisted interaction group and a conventional interaction control group. The results showed that participants in the AI-assisted interaction group exhibited a more pronounced reduction in digital loneliness over the intervention period. Experiment 2 involved an independent sample of 210 participants and used PROCESS analyses to examine further the roles of perceived social support, evaluative emotional fulfillment, and technology acceptance. After controlling for baseline digital loneliness, perceived social support constituted a significant indirect pathway linking AI-assisted interaction to post-intervention digital loneliness, whereas the indirect effect through evaluative emotional fulfillment did not reach statistical significance. Technology acceptance further moderated the association between AI-assisted interaction and perceived social support. Taken together, these findings suggest that the association between AI-assisted interaction and reduced digital loneliness among older adults is primarily related to the perceived social support pathway. In contrast, evidence supporting the mediating role of evaluative emotional fulfillment remains insufficient. This study provides empirical evidence for understanding older adults’ experiences of social connectedness in inclusive AI-enabled environments. It underscores the importance of enhancing both the acceptability of AI-mediated interaction and its capacity to provide social support within educational and digital learning ecosystems.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过两项实验考察AI辅助互动与老年人数字孤独感的关联及其心理机制。实验一采用随机纵向设计，比较AI辅助互动组与常规互动组，发现前者在干预期间数字孤独感下降更明显。实验二进一步检验感知社会支持、评价性情感满足与技术接受度的作用，结果显示感知社会支持构成显著的中介路径，而评价性情感满足的中介效应未达统计显著，技术接受度还调节了AI辅助互动与感知社会支持之间的关系。作者据此认为，AI辅助互动与老年人数字孤独感降低的关联主要与感知社会支持路径有关，而支持评价性情感满足中介作用的证据仍不充分。

papers.title: The Blurring of Reality in the Age of AI: Development of the AI-Induced Reality Perception Confusion Scale and Its Association with Generative AI Literacy and AI Anxiety
papers.authors: BİLAL KAYA, Sezen Ateş Yaman
papers.abstract: This study sought to develop the AI-induced Reality Perception Confusion Scale (AI-RPCS) and investigate the mediating role of AI-induced reality perception confusion in the association between GenAI literacy and AI anxiety. In Study I (N = 355), exploratory factor analysis revealed a single-factor structure, and item response theory indicated that the items displayed high discrimination and suitable difficulty. In Study II (N = 332), confirmatory factor analysis indicated satisfactory model fit indices for the single-factor structure. Significant relationships among the variables supported criterion validity. In Study III (N = 408), structural equation modelling indicated that AI-induced reality perception confusion mediated the association between GenAI literacy and AI anxiety. These results demonstrate the AI-RPCS's initial psychometric validity. Furthermore, this study suggests that GenAI literacy may be associated with lower levels of AI-induced reality perception confusion, which may, in turn, be associated with lower levels of AI anxiety.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究开发了AI诱发现实感知混淆量表（AI-RPCS），并考察这种混淆在生成式AI素养与AI焦虑关联中的中介作用。作者通过三项研究分别进行探索性因素分析、验证性因素分析和结构方程建模，结果显示量表呈单因子结构且心理测量学效度初步良好；AI诱发的现实感知混淆在生成式AI素养与AI焦虑之间起中介作用，即较高的生成式AI素养可能与较低的现实感知混淆相关，进而与较低的AI焦虑相关。这些发现为理解AI素养如何经由现实感知混淆影响AI焦虑提供了量表工具和关联证据，但研究为横断面设计，相关关系不等于因果。

papers.title: Measuring Successful Cooperation in Human-AI Teamwork: Development and Validation of the Perceived Cooperativity and Teaming Perception Scales
papers.authors: Christiane Attig, Christiane B. Wiebel-Herboth, Patricia Wollstadt, Tim Schrills, Mourad Zoubir, Thomas Franke
papers.abstract: As human–AI cooperation becomes increasingly prevalent, reliable instruments for assessing the subjective quality of cooperative human–AI interaction are needed. We introduce two theoretically grounded scales: the Perceived Cooperativity Scale (PCS), grounded in joint activity theory, and the Teaming Perception Scale (TPS), grounded in evolutionary cooperation theory. The PCS captures an agent’s perceived cooperative capability and practice within a single interaction sequence; the TPS captures the emergent sense of teaming arising from mutual contribution and support. Both scales were adapted for human–human cooperation to enable cross-agent comparisons. Across three studies (complete N=409) encompassing a cooperative card game (N1=94), LLM interaction (N2=182), and a decision-support system (N3=133), analyses of dimensionality, reliability, and validity indicated that both scales successfully differentiated between cooperation partners of varying cooperative quality and showed construct validity in line with expectations. The scales provide a basis for empirical investigation and system evaluation across a wide range of human–AI cooperation contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对人机协作中缺乏可靠主观评估工具的问题，开发并验证了感知协作性量表（PCS）与团队感知量表（TPS），前者基于联合活动理论测量个体对单次互动中协作能力与实践的感知，后者基于演化合作理论捕捉由相互贡献与支持形成的团队感，两量表均改编自人人协作版本以支持跨主体比较。作者通过合作卡牌游戏、大语言模型互动和决策支持系统三项研究进行维度、信度与效度分析，结果显示两量表能区分协作质量不同的伙伴，并呈现符合预期的构念效度。这为人机协作的实证研究与系统评估提供了测量基础，但结论限于所检验的互动情境。

papers.title: Social robots in the real world: an analysis of social robot use based on consumer reviews
papers.authors: Katarzyna Kabacińska, Gabriella K. Guerra, Mallorie T. Tam, Julie M. Robillard
papers.abstract: Social robots (SR) are increasingly developed to support users’ mental health needs. Previous research suggests that potential benefits of interacting with SR include reduction in depressive symptoms, loneliness and improved quality of life. Despite the promising impact of short-term robot use, little is known about how SRs are used beyond short interaction in the research environment, and what spontaneous robot adoption looks like. Thus, in this study we set out to address this gap through an analysis of user-generated robot reviews. We analysed online reviews of commercially available SRs to characterise their impact and user experience. We used qualitative content analysis to extract salient themes from 1350 user-generated reviews, supplemented by sentiment analysis of the full sample of 9333 reviews. The content analysis revealed a list of SR use cases, user circumstances and characteristics, the impact of using the robots and ethical challenges experienced by users. The results suggest that self-reported benefits, such as improved mood, reduced depression and loneliness, are maintained through long-term robot use. This study provides a novel qualitative insight into user experiences and SR use in the real world that will inform future robotic development and implementation efforts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注社交机器人在真实生活场景中的使用情况与用户体验，通过对网络用户评论进行定性内容分析和情感分析，考察商用社交机器人的实际影响。结果显示，用户自述的情绪改善、抑郁与孤独感减轻等益处能够在长期使用中维持，评论还涉及多种使用场景、用户处境与特征以及伦理方面的挑战。文章据此指出，这些来自真实使用环境的定性发现可为后续机器人开发与落地提供参考，但结论基于用户自述评论，并非实验验证的因果效果。

papers.title: Beyond accuracy: How humans evaluate legally correct but socially controversial legal advice from machines.
papers.authors: Benjamin Minhao Chen, Zhiyu Li
papers.abstract: AI systems are increasingly used to provide legal advice, raising questions about whether laypeople accept guidance from algorithms-especially when that advice is legally correct but socially controversial.We report a preregistered survey experiment with 3,348 adults in mainland China examining how people evaluate identical legal advice when it is attributed either to an AI system or to a human lawyer and when it is accompanied by reasoning or not.Contrary to expectations of algorithm aversion, attribution to an AI system has no net effect on perceived reasonableness.However, mediation analyses reveal opposing psychological pathways underlying this null result.AI-attributed advice is perceived as more objective, which increases perceived reasonableness, but also as less comprehensive and less attentive to special circumstances, which decreases perceived reasonableness.By contrast, providing legal reasoning substantially increases perceived reasonableness regardless of source, largely by enhancing perceptions of objectivity.Qualitative responses corroborate this tension between objectivity and contextual sensitivity in evaluations of legal advice.Together, these findings suggest that public responses to AI legal advisors are shaped not by rigid attitudes toward automation but by the balancing of competing normative expectations.The results have implications for theories of algorithm aversion and the design of AI recommendation systems in normatively salient domains.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过一项预注册调查实验，考察人们在法律建议被归因于AI系统还是人类律师、以及是否附带推理说明时如何评价同一建议。结果显示，AI归因对感知合理性没有净效应，但存在方向相反的中介路径：AI建议被视为更客观而提升合理性，同时被视为不够全面、较少顾及特殊情形而降低合理性；提供法律推理则不论来源都主要经由提升客观性感知而显著提高合理性。定性回答印证了客观性与情境敏感性之间的张力，表明公众对AI法律顾问的反应并非源于对自动化的 rigid 态度，而是竞争性规范期待的权衡。

papers.title: Task-evoked brain network dynamics underlying executive function in preadolescent children
papers.authors: Alfia Parvez, Shreya Verma, Ruyu Liu, Ginger E. Reeser, Sean Patrick Mullen, Lauren B. Raine, Lisa M. Renzi‐Hammond, Charles H. Hillman, Naiman A. Khan
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: Executive function (EF) has been studied using functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) based functional connectivity (FC); however, electroencephalography (EEG) based dynamic FC interactions supporting EF in children and explaining behavioral performance remain underexplored. We used EEG to examine FC within and between seven core brain networks: Default Mode (DMN), Dorsal Attention (DAN), Ventral Attention (VAN), Somatomotor (SMN), Frontoparietal (FPN), Visual (VIN), and Limbic (LIN), during a modified Eriksen flanker task. We aimed to identify dynamic network configurations linked to EF, specifically selective attention and inhibitory control in preadolescent children (8-10 years). METHODS: Secondary analyses of source-localized EEG data from 84 children (mean age 8.89 ± 0.82 years; 51.2% female) were conducted. A Hidden Markov model extracted spatiotemporal dynamics, quantifying within- and between-network FC correlations. Support vector regression (SVR) with an interpretable kernel identified connectivity patterns predicting behavioral outcomes, including accuracy and reaction time (RT) interference. RESULTS: = 0.26). Behavioral performance indices were most strongly associated with interference within VAN, DMN, SMN, and VIN. Notably, within-VAN FC explained between-subject variability in both Accuracy Interference (ρ = -0.28, p = 0.012) and RT Interference (r = 0.26, p = 0.017). CONCLUSIONS: Dynamic, task-based FC, particularly within-VAN, underpins individual differences in EF among preadolescent children. Stronger within-VAN reconfiguration during high cognitive demand trials supported accuracy but at the cost of slower responses, highlighting a trade-off between stability and efficiency in developing EF.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注青春期前儿童执行功能背后的动态脑网络机制，采用脑电功能连接分析结合隐马尔可夫模型与支持向量回归，考察注意与抑制控制任务中七个核心脑网络的交互模式及其对行为表现的预测作用。结果显示，行为成绩主要与腹侧注意网络、默认模式网络、感觉运动网络和视觉网络内部的干扰相关，其中腹侧注意网络内部连接同时关联正确率干扰与反应时干扰。作者据此认为，高认知需求下腹侧注意网络更强的动态重组有助于准确性但以反应变慢为代价，提示发展中的执行功能存在稳定性与效率之间的权衡。

papers.title: Investigating secondary school students’ shared epistemic agency with GAI in online scientific explanation writing
papers.authors: Hsin‐Yi Chang, Bo-Ren Mau, Jyh-Chong Liang, Chin‐Chung Tsai
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GAI) is increasingly used as a pedagogical assistant in online learning; yet how young students, such as secondary school students, enact epistemic agency (EA) when learning with GAI remains underexplored. In this study, we examined the types and levels of EA demonstrated by secondary school students with scaffolded GAI and investigated the relation among students’ prior academic proficiency, self-efficacy in learning, and EA demonstrated. Participants were 122 seventh graders who engaged in an online bilingual inquiry unit on photosynthesis. The unit supports students in Taiwan in learning science inquiry and English as a foreign language, with GAI prompted and integrated to support students’ scientific explanation writing in English. Data collected and analyzed included students’ prior academic proficiency through assessments, self-efficacy in learning through questionnaires, and student–GAI conversation turns through textual conversation logs. Results identified seven types of student–GAI shared epistemic agency (SEA), with over 80% of students demonstrating such agency at least once. Correlation results indicated that the frequency of EA demonstrated by students was associated with their prior language proficiency. Cluster analysis with the retained four-profile solution further suggested that student–GAI SEA was likely to be activity-specific. The identified SEA categories provide a framework for examining student–GAI SEA, and the instruction design illustrates how GAI can be prompted to preserve opportunities for student contribution. Design implications for supporting students with different needs are discussed.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注中学生在生成式人工智能辅助的在线科学解释写作中如何表现出认识能动性，并考察其先前学业水平、学习自我效能感与能动性表现之间的关系。研究对象为参与光合作用双语探究单元的七年级学生，方法上结合学业测评、问卷和学生与AI的对话记录进行分析。结果识别出七类学生与AI共享认识能动性的表现类型，且多数学生至少出现过一次；能动性表现频率与先前语言水平相关，聚类结果提示这种共享能动性可能具有活动特异性。文章据此提出分析框架，并讨论如何通过提示设计保留学生贡献机会、支持不同需求的学生。

papers.title: Bridging accuracy and interpretability in predictive learning analytics: A human-centered grey-box approach
papers.authors: Ángel Hernández-García, Julián Chaparro-Peláez, Carlos Cuenca-Enrique, Carlos Salcedo-Valverde
papers.abstract: Learning analytics has been increasingly using predictive models to support educational decision-making. However, the trade-off between predictive accuracy and interpretability remains a central challenge that limits how these models can be understood and used by educators. This study examines grey-box approaches to performance prediction by comparing two strategies: a theory-driven approach that groups interaction data into pedagogically meaningful categories, and a data-driven approach based on raw clickstream events followed by post hoc eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) techniques. Using clickstream data from three educational contexts with different scales and instructional formats, we empirically compare the predictive performance, interpretability, and pedagogical relevance of both strategies. The results show that raw-event models achieve higher predictive performance in the large-scale online context with rich interaction data, where XAI methods provide relatively stable and consistent explanatory patterns. In the smaller-scale blended setting, where platform data capture only part of the learning activity, theory-driven aggregation provides a predictive advantage, although results become inconclusive in very small cohorts. The findings indicate that there is no single optimal approach, and that modeling strategies should be selected according to data characteristics, instructional design, and analytic goals. From a human-centered learning analytics perspective, the study highlights the importance of methodological alignment for the meaningful and responsible use of predictive models in education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了预测性学习分析中兼顾准确性与可解释性的两种灰箱建模策略：一种按教学意义对交互数据分组，另一种基于原始点击流事件并辅以事后可解释人工智能技术。作者利用三种不同规模与教学形式的教育情境中的点击流数据，对两种策略的预测表现、可解释性和教学相关性进行实证比较。结果显示，在交互数据丰富的大规模在线情境中，原始事件模型预测表现更好，可解释人工智能方法给出的解释模式也相对稳定一致；而在平台数据仅覆盖部分学习活动的小规模混合情境中，理论驱动的数据聚合反而具有预测优势，但在极小队列中结果不确定。研究据此指出不存在单一最优策略，建模方式应依据数据特征、教学设计与分析目标来选择，并强调方法上的匹配对人本学习分析中负责任地使用预测模型的重要性。

papers.title: Writing Motivation and Self‐Efficacy in AI ‐Chatbot‐Supported EFL Writing: Exploratory Insights Across Proficiency Levels
papers.authors: Thi-Ngoc-Anh Duong, Hsiu‐Ling Chen
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Writing motivation and self‐efficacy are critical factors of success in English as a Foreign Language (EFL) contexts, yet they are frequently undermined by learner anxiety and limited teacher feedback. While artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots offer potential for adaptive writing support, limited research has examined these affective constructs in parallel across learner proficiency levels. Objectives This study investigated changes in intrinsic motivation, extrinsic motivation, and writing self‐efficacy among high school EFL learners at higher‐ and lower‐proficiency levels following chatbot‐supported writing and examined whether these changes differed across proficiency levels. Methods Using an exploratory mixed‐methods design, the study involved 47 Vietnamese high school students divided into higher‐ and lower‐proficiency level groups. Over the 11‐week study, participants completed 8 weeks of AI‐supported writing activities using a chatbot designed in accordance with principles of Self‐Determination Theory, Self‐Regulated Learning Theory and Self‐Efficacy Theory. Changes in intrinsic motivation, extrinsic motivation, and writing self‐efficacy were examined using pre‐ and post‐questionnaires and semi‐structured interviews. Results and Conclusions The quantitative findings revealed that intrinsic motivation, extrinsic motivation, and writing self‐efficacy increased over time in both proficiency groups, with no significant differences in the magnitude of change between higher‐ and lower‐proficiency learners. This suggests that the affective changes observed during AI‐supported writing were not confined to one proficiency group. The qualitative findings indicated that learners linked their positive experiences to reduced anxiety, clearer guidance, and supportive interaction, although the types of support they valued differed by proficiency level. Overall, the findings suggest that when positioned as a supportive writing partner rather than an answer generator, AI chatbot feedback may be associated with positive motivational and self‐efficacy development in mixed‐ability EFL writing classrooms.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察高中英语学习者在聊天机器人辅助写作后内在动机、外在动机与写作自我效能感的变化，并比较高低水平学习者之间是否存在差异。研究采用探索性混合方法，结合前后问卷与半结构化访谈。结果显示，两组学习者的三类情感指标均随时间上升，且变化幅度在水平组间无显著差异，说明这些变化并非局限于某一水平群体；质性结果则表明，学习者将积极体验与焦虑降低、指导更清晰和支持性互动联系起来，但所看重的支持类型因水平而异。作者据此提出，当聊天机器人被定位为支持性写作伙伴而非答案生成器时，其反馈可能与混合能力课堂中的积极动机和自我效能发展相关。

papers.title: Frustrative nonreward engages midfrontal theta power and modulates effort expenditure
papers.authors: Nellia Bellaert, Federico Cassioli, Wan-Ling Tseng, Mandy Rossignol
papers.abstract: Irritability is characterized by a propensity to experience frustration and has been associated with reduced self-reported willingness to expend effort for rewards. Frustration may be relevant to effortful reward pursuit, but its effects on effort expenditure have rarely been experimentally tested in humans. To address this gap, this study introduced a frustration induction in the Effort-Doors task to elicit frustrative nonreward (FNR), a negative emotional state triggered by unexpected reward loss, and examined its effects on physical effort expenditure and feedback-related electroencephalographic (EEG) activity. We also tested whether these effects vary as a function of state and trait measures of motivation and affect. Linear mixed-effects models tested the effects of FNR induction on self-reported, behavioral, and EEG measures in young adults (N = 83) completing the Frustrative Effort-Doors task. Models tested manipulation effects, trial-level post-feedback adjustment, and moderation by state and trait measures. Midfrontal theta power (MFθ) extracted using multivariate spatial filtering was examined as a function of feedback (win vs. FNR), effort (low vs. high), and subsequent behavioral adjustments. The frustration condition was associated with decreased self-reported state motivation and increased frustration, arousal, and response speed. Midfrontal theta power was larger following FNR feedback and increased with state frustration during high-effort trials. Higher state frustration was associated with reduced response vigor during effort execution following FNR feedback. MFθ did not predict trial-to-trial behavioral adjustments. These findings indicate that FNR recruits MFθ, a neural marker of cognitive control, while state frustration modulates physical effort execution following unexpected reward loss.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在Effort-Doors任务中引入挫败诱导，考察意外奖励损失引发的挫败性无奖赏如何影响体力付出及反馈相关脑电活动，并检验状态与特质动机、情绪是否起调节作用。结果发现，挫败条件降低了自评状态动机，同时提高挫败感、唤醒度和反应速度；中额叶theta功率在挫败性无奖赏反馈后更大，并在高付出试次中随状态挫败感升高而增强。状态挫败感越高，参与者在挫败反馈后执行付出时的反应力度越低，而中额叶theta功率并不能预测逐试次的行为调整。作者据此认为，挫败性无奖赏会调动作为认知控制神经标记的中额叶theta，而状态挫败感则调节意外奖励损失后的体力付出执行。

papers.title: Generative artificial intelligence literacy profiles differ in academic self-efficacy and subjective well-being among adolescents
papers.authors: Ja-Yeoung Lee
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) literacy is increasingly important for adolescents, yet variation in literacy across multiple dimensions and its associations with educational and psychological outcomes remain insufficiently understood. This study identified generative AI literacy profiles among Korean adolescents with generative AI experience ( N = 3,959) using K-means cluster analysis based on information evaluation, communication, creative use, and ethical use. Two profiles were identified: Higher AI Literacy and Lower AI Literacy. The profiles differed primarily in their overall literacy levels rather than in qualitatively distinct patterns across the four dimensions. Adolescents in the Higher AI Literacy profile reported greater generative AI education experience and higher academic self-efficacy and subjective well-being than those in the Lower AI Literacy profile. Differences in academic self-efficacy and subjective well-being remained significant after adjustment for gender, school level, academic achievement, and economic status. These findings demonstrate meaningful level-based variation in generative AI literacy among adolescents with generative AI experience and suggest that such variation is associated with educational experience and academic and psychological outcomes. A person-centred perspective may complement variable-centred approaches and inform future research and educational approaches that consider differences in students’ generative AI literacy levels.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注青少年生成式人工智能素养在不同维度上的差异及其与教育和心理结果的关联，以具备生成式AI使用经验的韩国青少年为对象，基于信息评估、沟通、创造性使用和伦理使用四个维度进行聚类分析。结果识别出较高与较低AI素养两类群体，二者的差异主要体现在整体素养水平上，而非四个维度间的质性模式不同；较高素养群体报告了更多生成式AI教育经历，以及更高的学业自我效能感和主观幸福感，且在调整性别、学校阶段、学业成绩和经济状况后，这些差异仍然显著。文章据此指出，青少年的生成式AI素养呈现有意义的水平差异，并与教育经历及学业和心理结果相关，提示可采用以人为中心视角补充以变量为中心的研究取向。

papers.title: How generative AI becomes embedded in design learning: a 14-instructional-day intensive longitudinal study of reciprocal dynamics between AI use and self-efficacy
papers.authors: Yang Li, Yi Yang, Silu Bao
papers.abstract: Generative AI is increasingly embedded in design education, yet little is known about how students’ daily engagement with generative AI is dynamically associated with their learning-related capability beliefs across successive instructional days. Drawing on self-efficacy theory, this study examined the reciprocal next-instructional-day associations between daily generative AI use in design learning and daily design-learning self-efficacy, and further investigated whether baseline hassles were associated with individual differences in these dynamics. A 14-instructional-day diary study was conducted with 260 Chinese undergraduate design students, yielding 3,558 observed person-day assessments out of 3,640 possible assessments. Daily generative AI use and design-learning self-efficacy were assessed throughout the diary period, whereas hassles were measured at baseline. The data were analyzed using bivariate dynamic structural equation modeling within a Bayesian estimation framework. The results showed significant autoregressive effects for daily generative AI use ( β = 0.198, 95% CrI [0.154, 0.237]) and daily design-learning self-efficacy ( β = 0.138, 95% CrI [0.100, 0.175]). At the within-person level, higher-than-usual generative AI use on one instructional day positively predicted design-learning self-efficacy on the subsequent instructional day ( β = 0.043, 95% CrI [0.006, 0.077]), while higher-than-usual design-learning self-efficacy also positively predicted generative AI use on the subsequent instructional day ( β = 0.059, 95% CrI [0.023, 0.095]). At the between-person level, greater baseline hassles were associated with higher average generative AI use ( β = 0.135), lower average design-learning self-efficacy ( β = −0.254), and a stronger cross-lagged association from generative AI use to subsequent self-efficacy ( β = 0.458). Gender did not significantly predict the main random effects. These findings indicate modest reciprocal next-instructional-day associations between generative AI use and design-learning self-efficacy, suggesting that the two may reinforce one another across instructional days. The stronger association from generative AI use to subsequent self-efficacy among students reporting greater baseline hassles further suggests that contextual demands may shape how generative AI becomes integrated into students’ day-to-day design learning.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注设计学习中生成式人工智能使用与设计学习自我效能感在日常教学日之间的动态关联，采用14个教学日的日记法对260名中国设计专业本科生进行追踪，并用双变量动态结构方程模型分析。结果显示，两者均存在显著的自我回归效应；在个体内层面，某教学日高于平常的AI使用正向预测次日的自我效能感，反之亦然，但关联幅度较小，提示二者可能相互强化。基线困扰较高的学生平均AI使用更多、自我效能感更低，且AI使用对次日自我效能感的预测更强，说明情境压力可能影响生成式AI融入日常设计学习的方式。

papers.title: Cognitive transparency and trust calibration in explainable AI systems: a psychological model of human-AI decision reliance
papers.authors: Usman Rehman
papers.abstract: Introduction Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) is widely expected to improve transparency and support appropriate human reliance on AI-assisted decision-making. However, the psychological processes through which explainability relates to reliance remain insufficiently understood, and explainability, transparency, and trust have largely been examined separately. Objectives This study develops and tests a psychological model of cognitive transparency in which AI explainability, algorithmic transparency, and perceived AI accuracy are associated with human reliance on AI through cognitive understanding, cognitive trust, and trust calibration, with AI literacy as a boundary condition. Methods A cross-sectional online survey was completed by 342 AI users in South Korea in May and June 2026. Each participant evaluated one self-selected AI system that they had personally used; all constructs were measured by self-report. The data were analyzed using partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) in SmartPLS 4. Results AI explainability (β = 0.349) and algorithmic transparency (β = 0.297) were positively associated with cognitive understanding. Cognitive understanding (β = 0.388) and, more strongly, perceived AI accuracy (β = 0.492) were associated with cognitive trust. Cognitive trust was associated with trust calibration (β = 0.631), which was associated with human reliance on AI (β = 0.600). All hypothesized indirect effects were significant, and AI literacy strengthened the association between AI explainability and cognitive understanding (β = 0.192). The model explained 36%–54% of the variance in the endogenous constructs and showed medium predictive power. Conclusion The findings are consistent with a sequence in which explainable AI relates to reliance through users’ understanding and trust judgments. Because all constructs were self-reported and measured at a single point in time, the results describe associations among users’ perceptions rather than causal effects, independently verified calibration, or objectively appropriate reliance. The findings suggest that AI developers in domains such as healthcare, education, and finance, where calibrated reliance is critical, should pair user-facing explanations with information about system accuracy and with AI literacy support.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于一项横断面在线调查，考察可解释人工智能、算法透明度与感知准确性如何经由认知理解、认知信任和信任校准，与用户对AI的依赖相关联，并将AI素养作为边界条件。结果显示，可解释性和算法透明度与认知理解正相关，认知理解和感知准确性（关联更强）与认知信任相关，认知信任进而与信任校准及依赖相关，AI素养则增强了可解释性与认知理解之间的关联。作者强调，所有构念均为自我报告且在同一时点测量，因此结果反映的是用户感知间的关联，而非因果效应或客观校准的依赖，并据此建议在医疗、教育、金融等依赖校准至关重要的领域，将面向用户的解释与系统准确性信息及AI素养支持相结合。

papers.title: Academic emotions and perceived learning outcomes in GenAI-supported learning: the serial mediating roles of AI acceptance and learning behaviors
papers.authors: Huaruo Chen, Gefan Wang, Zhentao Peng, Wanru Song, Jie Xu
papers.abstract: Objective With the widespread application of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) in higher education, academic emotions play a vital role in students’ learning processes. This study aims to examine the associations between positive and negative academic emotions and college students’ perceived learning outcomes, and analyze the serial mediating roles of AI acceptance and learning behaviors within GenAI-supported learning environments. Methods A total of 526 college students with GenAI learning experience were recruited via convenience sampling. All participants completed four standardized scales measuring academic emotions, AI acceptance, learning behaviors and perceived learning outcomes. Descriptive statistics, correlation analysis, confirmatory factor analysis and bias-corrected Bootstrap mediation tests were conducted using SPSS 26.0 and AMOS 27.0. Results All variables were significantly correlated ( p < 0.01). Positive academic emotions exerted a significant direct association with perceived learning outcomes ( β = 0.176), whereas the direct association of negative academic emotions was non-significant ( β = −0.098, p = 0.049, 95% CI [−0.205, 0.007]). AI acceptance and learning behaviors had significant independent mediating effects. The serial mediation effect value was 0.020 for positive emotions and −0.037 for negative emotions, with all 95% confidence intervals excluding zero. Indirect pathways dominated the influence of negative academic emotions. Conclusion This study identifies a pattern of associations consistent with the hypothesized emotion-cognition-behavior-outcome pathway in GenAI-supported learning. The findings offer empirical evidence for developing targeted academic-emotion-informed intervention strategies, improving students’ AI acceptance and learning engagement, and promoting the high-quality development of intelligent education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在生成式人工智能支持的学习环境中，大学生正负学业情绪与感知学习结果之间的关联，并检验AI接受度与学习行为在其中的链式中介作用。研究者以便利抽样招募有GenAI学习经验的大学生，采用标准化量表测量四个变量并进行相关分析与中介检验。结果显示，正性学业情绪与感知学习结果存在显著直接关联，负性情绪的直接关联则不显著，其影响主要通过间接路径实现；AI接受度和学习行为均具有显著的独立中介作用，链式中介效应在正负情绪下均成立。作者据此认为，结果呈现出与“情绪—认知—行为—结果”路径一致的关联模式，为针对学业情绪设计干预、提升学生AI接受度与学习投入提供了实证依据。

papers.title: Needs and current status of generative artificial intelligence use among college students: a cross-sectional survey based in China
papers.authors: Rong Zeng, 雷春涛, Qian Jiang, Xueqin Gan, Xiaoguo Zhang, Yu Feng, Qin Xu, Yan Huang, Yang Qian
papers.abstract: Objective This study aimed to investigate the current status of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) usage needs among vocational college students from China, explore their relationships with learning engagement and academic resilience, and identify variables associated with GAI usage demand. Methods Using convenience sampling, 3,876 students from five vocational colleges in Sichuan Province were enrolled. Surveys were conducted using the Generative Artificial Intelligence Application Status and Usage Demand Scale, the Learning Engagement Scale, and the Academic Resilience Scale. Results The average GAI needs score among vocational college students was 58.23 ± 12.77. Correlation analysis revealed positive relationships between GAI needs and both learning engagement and academic resilience ( p < 0.01). Multiple linear regression analysis revealed that gender, academic year, availability of GAI learning devices at home, level of GAI understanding, enrollment in GAI-related courses, frequency of active GAI use, student-reported frequency of teachers’ use of GAI in teaching, learning engagement, and academic resilience were independently associated with GAI usage demand (all p < 0.05). The model explained 24.4% of the variance in GAI usage demand [ R 2 = 0.244, adjusted R 2 = 0.241, F (14, 3,861) = 88.932, p < 0.001]. Conclusion Vocational college students’ GAI usage demand was slightly above the theoretical midpoint of the scale. Greater GAI usage demand was independently associated with male gender, earlier academic year, better availability of GAI learning devices at home, a higher level of GAI understanding, enrollment in GAI-related courses, more frequent active GAI use, more frequent student-reported teachers’ use of GAI in teaching, higher learning engagement, and greater academic resilience. Because of the cross-sectional design, these findings should be interpreted as associations rather than causal relationships.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于中国四川五所高职院校学生的横断面调查，考察高职学生生成式人工智能使用需求现状及其与学习投入、学业韧性的关系。结果显示，学生的生成式人工智能需求略高于量表理论中点，且需求与学习投入、学业韧性均呈正相关；回归分析进一步表明，性别、年级、家中学习设备可及性、对生成式人工智能的了解程度、相关课程修读、主动使用频率、教师教学使用频率、学习投入和学业韧性均与使用需求独立相关。由于采用横断面设计，这些结果只能解释为关联而非因果。

papers.title: Comprehensive artificial intelligence-assisted mental health program for university students in China (CAMPUS): study protocol for a multi-center prospective cohort with planned embedded randomized intervention trials
papers.authors: Guang Yang, Rongxun Liu, Chuansheng Wang, Rongxin Zhu, Shisen Qin, Jinnan Yan, Yan Wang, Hongbo Pei, Lijuan Liang, Yingying Su, Shuai Wang, Weidong Wu, Guangjun Ji, Fei Wang, Wei Yange
papers.abstract: University students face a rising prevalence of depression, anxiety, insomnia, and suicidal ideation that exceeds the capacity of conventional, resource-constrained campus support services. Although artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted screening tools have emerged, many have evaluated selected modalities or isolated prediction tasks, and their integration with prospectively evaluated intervention pathways remains limited. This protocol describes the Comprehensive Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Mental Health Program for University Students in China (CAMPUS), a multi-center research program comprising a five-year prospective cohort, eight planned embedded randomized controlled trials, and exploratory multimodal AI and multi-omics studies across seven Chinese universities. Longitudinal cohort enrolment commenced at Henan Medical University in September 2025 and is planned to expand across seven participating universities. Multidimensional screening integrates psychological self-report (PHQ-9, GAD-7, ISI, BSI-CV, and others), physiological measurements (EEG, MRI, fNIRS, HRV, eye tracking, facial-expression analysis, ERP, voice acoustics), and an exploratory biospecimen component for multi-omics profiling, potentially including genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, metabolomic, and microbiome analyses, subject to the finalization and approval of layer-specific protocols. Students identified through cohort screening as potentially eligible for an intervention trial will undergo trial-specific eligibility assessment. Those who meet the eligibility criteria and provide trial-specific informed consent will be individually randomized in a 1:1 ratio to the intervention or its comparator within one of eight separate two-arm, multi-center, parallel-group randomized controlled trials. A Transformer-based multimodal AI framework with SHAP-based feature attribution will be developed and internally evaluated for questionnaire-defined risk stratification and exploratory treatment-response prediction. The initial Henan Medical University cohort recruitment and university-student mental-health assessment were approved by the Ethics Review Committee of Henan Medical University (XYLL-20250484), and written informed consent is obtained from participants before enrolment. Each additional participating center will obtain local ethics approval before study activation. Findings will be disseminated through peer-reviewed publications, scientific conferences, and policy briefs, providing evidence that may inform the design and prospective evaluation of youth mental-health programs in other university settings. Clinical trial registration The two clinical trials were registered in the Chinese Clinical Trial Registry (ChiCTR). The registration details and URLs are as follows: ChiCTR2500113527: https://www.chictr.org.cn/showproj.html?proj=298271 ; ChiCTR2500113613: https://www.chictr.org.cn/showproj.html?proj=298268 .
papers.summary_zh: 该研究方案提出并描述了面向中国大学生的综合性人工智能辅助心理健康项目（CAMPUS），旨在应对抑郁、焦虑、失眠和自杀意念等心理问题超出校园常规服务能力的情况。项目包含为期五年的多中心前瞻性队列、八项计划嵌入的随机对照试验，以及探索性多模态AI与多组学研究，筛查整合心理自评、生理测量和生物样本分析，并通过基于Transformer的多模态AI框架进行风险分层与治疗反应预测。需要说明的是，本文为研究方案，主要报告项目设计与评估路径，而非已完成的干预效果；其潜在价值在于为高校心理健康项目的设计与前瞻性评估提供证据基础。

papers.title: The study of Chinese EFL teachers' emotions in the digital transformation of education
papers.authors: Feng Wu, Youjie Hua
papers.abstract: Introduction The rapid and continuing development of digital technologies has significantly reshaped the educational landscape, generating diverse emotional experiences among teachers. This study examined the emotional experiences of Chinese EFL teachers and the major antecedents of those emotions. Methods This study employed an explanatory sequential mixed-methods design. First, questionnaire data collected from 296 university EFL teachers identified five primary emotions (love, joy, anger, sadness, and fear). Secondly, semi-structured interviews were conducted with 16 participants to explore the antecedents underlying these emotional experiences. The qualitative findings were subsequently integrated with the quantitative results and presented through a joint display. Results The findings showed that EFL teachers experienced positive emotions more frequently than negative emotions. Of the five primary emotions, joy and love had the highest mean scores, followed by fear, anger, and sadness, respectively. The findings further showed that teachers' emotions were closely associated with their professional goals and students' performance. Several antecedents were found to shape these emotional experiences. The flexibility, interactivity, and innovative opportunities introduced by digital transformation enhanced EFL teachers' sense of love for their work. Likewise, the efficiency and abundance of resources provided by digital tools and platforms contributed to their sense of joy. In contrast, students' misconduct and dishonest behaviors often provoked feelings of anger. Teachers experienced sadness when confronted with students' lack of critical thinking and when they felt inadequately supported in their work. Fear was primarily driven by peer pressure, time constraints, and the threat of being replaced by artificial intelligence. Discussion The study discussed the implications of these findings and proposed recommendations for emotion regulation and emotional support for EFL teachers in China and comparable educational contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注教育数字化转型中中国高校英语教师的情感体验及其主要来源，采用解释性序列混合方法，先以问卷识别教师的主要情绪，再通过访谈探究情绪背后的成因。结果显示，教师体验积极情绪的频率高于消极情绪，其中愉悦与喜爱得分最高，恐惧、愤怒和悲伤依次次之；教师的情绪与其职业目标和学生表现密切相关。数字化带来的灵活性、互动性和创新机会增强了教师对工作的热爱，数字工具与平台的效率和资源丰富了愉悦感，而学生的不当与不诚实行为常引发愤怒，学生缺乏批判性思维和工作支持不足带来悲伤，同伴压力、时间限制和被人工智能取代的威胁则主要驱动恐惧。文章据此讨论了情绪调节与情感支持的建议。

papers.title: Can large language models reproduce humans’ perspective-dependent judgements of gratitude? Evidence from Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Doubao
papers.authors: Wenjun Chen, Yujie Chu, Xiaoming Jiang, Yan Li
papers.abstract: Human social interaction is full of episodes of help, and the person giving it and the person receiving it may not interpret the same episode in the same way. Against a background of reports that large language models match or exceed human performance on social reasoning tasks, this study asks whether they reproduce this asymmetry between the two sides. Forty-eight Chinese university students read 24 everyday helping scenarios, each in four situational versions, from either the beneficiary’s or the benefactor’s side, and rated the helper’s willingness, the recipient’s need, the difficulty of helping, and the recipient’s gratitude. The identical Chinese materials were then given to 12 models, the flagship and the light model of three providers based in English-speaking countries and three based in China, with 30 independent runs per text, followed by two further prompt conditions: the same scenarios in English for the six models of the Chinese providers and a stated identity prepended to the prompt for all 12. Bayesian mixed models showed a dissociation. On what the situation called for, the models mostly matched the humans or exceeded them: the contrast between a pressing need and one already met was 1.325 scale points in the humans and 1.159 to 1.825 across models, above the human value in 11 of 12. On which side the episode was judged from, most fell short: the humans rated gratitude 0.756 points higher from the beneficiary’s side, the models 0.047 to 0.727, with 11 of 12 credibly below the human estimate. Only Doubao-2.1-Pro matched the humans on gratitude, and it departed from them on willingness and difficulty. Capability tier ordered the 12, though the contrast did not exclude zero, while the provider’s country did not order them at all. Among the six models of the Chinese providers, writing the scenarios in English raised the effect in five, though not to the human estimate. Likewise, across all 12, stating an identity raised it in 10, by 0.10 on average against a mean shortfall of 0.44, and 11 of 12 still sat below the human estimate. Our results suggest that large language models, at least those surveyed here, read what a situation calls for at a level comparable to human readers, but that they show markedly less sensitivity to perspective, namely to the asymmetry with which benefactors and beneficiaries evaluate one and the same act of help.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察大语言模型能否复现人类在感恩判断中对受助者与助人者视角的不对称敏感。研究者让中国大学生阅读日常助人情境并从一方视角评分，再将同一材料交给多家国内外模型多次作答。结果显示，模型在判断情境需求强度上大体与人类相当甚至更高，但在视角差异上明显不足：人类从受助者视角给出的感恩评分显著更高，多数模型的这一差距远小于人类，仅个别模型在感恩上与人类持平却在其他维度偏离。作者据此指出，模型更擅长读取情境要求，而对视角不对称的敏感度较低。

papers.title: Stress-related helplessness is independently associated with reward-driven eating in adults with BMI-defined normal weight and obesity
papers.authors: Imke Schamarek, Peter Louis Kovacs, Michael Stümvoll, Matthias Blüher, Anke Tönjes, Kerstin Rohde‐Zimmermann
papers.abstract: Background Accumulating evidence indicates that stress is associated with reward-driven eating, yet the stress dimensions underlying this relationship remain insufficiently understood. Inconsistent findings may partly reflect conceptualizing stress as a unitary construct and insufficient consideration of weight status. This study examined the independent associations of perceived stress dimensions (Helplessness, Self-Efficacy) with hedonic hunger, trait food craving, and uncontrolled eating in adults with BMI-defined normal weight and obesity. Methods Ninety adults were enrolled, 47 with normal weight, 18 with overweight, and 25 with obesity (BMI ≥ 30 kg/m 2 ). Primary inferential analyses included participants with normal weight and obesity ( N = 72); participants with overweight were excluded. Participants completed questionnaires assessing perceived stress (Perceived Stress Scale, PSS), hedonic hunger (Power of Food Scale), trait food craving (Food Craving Questionnaire-Trait reduced), and uncontrolled eating (Three-Factor Eating Questionnaire). PSS Helplessness and Self-Efficacy subscales were derived. Associations were examined using Spearman correlations and multiple linear regression adjusted for age, sex, BMI, and current hunger. Helplessness and Self-Efficacy were entered simultaneously to estimate independent associations with reward-driven eating outcomes. PROCESS moderation analyses tested whether BMI or BMI-defined weight status influenced the association. Results In the primary analysis sample, PSS Total was not independently associated with any reward-driven eating outcome after correction for multiple testing. In contrast, Helplessness was independently associated with greater hedonic hunger, food craving, and uncontrolled eating after FDR correction, whereas Self-Efficacy was not independently associated with any outcome after accounting for Helplessness. In subgroup analyses, associations were descriptively more consistent among participants with obesity than those with normal weight. However, no interaction effect remained significant after correction for multiple testing. Conclusion These findings highlight Helplessness, reflecting, perceived uncontrollability, as the perceived stress dimension most consistently associated with reward-driven eating and underscore the importance of distinguishing between stress dimensions rather than relying solely on overall perceived stress. There was no robust evidence in the present study that BMI or BMI-defined weight status modified these associations. Perceived uncontrollability may represent a potential target for interventions aimed at reducing maladaptive reward-driven eating behavior.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察感知压力的不同维度（无助感与自我效能感）是否与享乐性饥饿、特质性食物渴求和失控进食等奖赏驱动进食行为独立相关，并比较正常体重与肥胖成人的差异。参与者完成压力与进食相关问卷，分析在控制年龄、性别、BMI和当前饥饿后检验各压力维度的独立关联。结果显示，总体感知压力与任何奖赏驱动进食结果均无独立关联，而无助感与更强的享乐性饥饿、食物渴求和失控进食独立相关，自我效能感在纳入无助感后则无独立关联；肥胖组中关联描述性地更一致，但多重校正后未见BMI或体重状态的显著调节。作者据此强调应区分压力维度，而非仅依赖总体压力得分，并提示感知不可控性可能是干预的潜在靶点。

papers.title: Advances in artificial intelligence for brain imaging and computer-aided diagnosis of neurological diseases: a systematic literature review
papers.authors: Batyrkhan Omarov
papers.abstract: Background Brain imaging is central to the structural, functional, metabolic, and neurophysiological characterization of neurological disease, yet interpretation remains constrained by heterogeneity in acquisition, annotation, expertise, and clinical context. Objective This systematic literature review evaluates recent artificial intelligence approaches for brain imaging and computer-aided diagnosis, with emphasis on methods, modalities, neurological diseases, diagnostic tasks, datasets, validation practices, and translational limitations. Methods The review followed PRISMA 2020 and covered peer-reviewed English-language studies published from January 2020 through June 2026. Eight information sources were searched using database-specific terms for artificial intelligence, neuroimaging, neurological disease, and diagnostic analysis. The search identified 1,078 records; 236 duplicates were removed, 842 unique records were screened, 258 full texts were assessed, and 123 studies were included after a record-level eligibility re-audit. Heterogeneous evidence was synthesized narratively and by descriptive mapping rather than meta-analysis. Results MRI was frequently represented in the included studies and auxiliary mapping data; CT was commonly used in acute stroke and intracranial hemorrhage; PET supported selected molecular and differential-diagnosis studies; fMRI and diffusion imaging were used for network and white-matter analysis; and EEG extended the scope to neurophysiological diagnosis. CNN and three-dimensional networks were commonly reported, while attention, Transformer, graph, self-supervised, generative, multimodal, and foundation-model approaches appeared in selected recent studies. Stroke, dementia, and brain tumors were frequently represented, but heterogeneous populations, outcomes, and incomplete validation extraction precluded ranking diseases, modalities, architectures, or validation strategies. Conclusion The evidence suggests movement from task-specific pattern recognition toward multimodal and context-rich decision support in selected settings, but it does not establish uniform methodological superiority or clinical maturity. Dependable translation requires patient-level data governance, transparent reporting, uncertainty estimation, independent multicenter testing, prospective workflow evaluation, and clinically meaningful endpoints.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述按PRISMA 2020流程系统梳理了2020年至2026年间关于人工智能用于脑影像与神经系统疾病计算机辅助诊断的123项研究，重点考察所用方法、影像模态、疾病类型、诊断任务、数据集与验证实践。纳入研究以MRI最为常见，CT多用于急性卒中和颅内出血，PET、fMRI、扩散成像和EEG则分别服务于分子与鉴别诊断、网络与白质分析及神经生理诊断；方法上CNN和三维网络报道较多，注意力、Transformer、图、自监督、生成式、多模态和基础模型出现在部分近期研究中，卒中、痴呆和脑肿瘤较为集中。作者指出，由于人群、结局和验证信息提取不一致，无法对疾病、模态、架构或验证策略排序，证据显示的是在特定场景下从任务特异的模式识别走向多模态、情境更丰富的决策支持，但并未确立普遍的方法优越性或临床成熟度，可靠转化仍需患者层面数据治理、透明报告、不确定性估计、独立多中心测试和前瞻性工作流评估。

papers.title: Federated Spiking GANs with Rényi Differential Privacy for privacy-preserving synthetic EEG generation in brain–computer interfaces
papers.authors: Shouvik Paul, Garima Bajwa
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) data used in brain-computer and brain-machine interfaces (BCI/BMI) contain sensitive, user-specific information, creating privacy risks in consumer applications such as gaming, human augmentation, and virtual reality. Existing methods like encryption and anonymization either fail to protect data during analysis or still expose identifiable attributes. While differential privacy (DP) offers formal protection, it often reduces data utility. The key challenge is to generate synthetic EEG data that protects sensitive attributes while retaining temporal features for downstream use. To address this, we developed a federated spiking generative framework that integrates a spiking neural network (SNN)-based generator, temporally correlated noise, an artificial neural network (ANN)-based discriminator, and Rényi differential privacy (RDP) within a federated learning framework. The SNN-based generator captures temporal characteristics, and the ANN-based discriminator maintains classification accuracy. Federated training prevents centralization of raw client data, while privacy is preserved through controlled perturbation of spike-train and membrane-potential representations, supported by RDP-based privacy accounting. We evaluated our architecture against methods such as RDP-TimeGAN, RDP-CRNN-GAN, RDP-RCGAN, and RDP-Clare-GAN, demonstrating that our approach preserves temporal features and downstream utility while maintaining privacy in synthetic EEG generation. This solution enables privacy-preserving generation of distributed synthetic EEG data for BCI/BMI research and development.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对脑机接口中脑电数据在分析阶段仍可能泄露敏感信息、而差分隐私又常损害数据可用性的问题，提出一种联邦脉冲生成框架，将脉冲神经网络生成器、时间相关噪声、人工神经网络判别器与Rényi差分隐私结合，在联邦学习中生成合成脑电数据。作者将其与多种RDP基线方法比较，结果显示该框架在保护隐私的同时能保留时间特征和下游任务效用。这一结果提示，隐私保护与合成脑电的可用性可以兼顾，但结论限于作者所比较的基线方法和其评估设置。

papers.title: A two-stage RAG-LLM pipeline for roadmapping neuroscience research in operational environments
papers.authors: Cara A. Spencer
papers.abstract: Introduction Neuroscientific research and applications in real world environments are often constrained by limited access, equipment limitations, and high costs. Consequently, robustly selecting constructs to focus effort on is a high-impact task. Method This study introduces a two-stage large language model (LLM) pipeline that generates research roadmaps from existing real-world data to inform research priorities in the field, given the state of the art. Stage 1 uses retrieval-augmented generation on operational logs to identify candidate psychological, social, and neurocognitive constructs and map their co-occurrence. Stage 2 evaluates how well these constructs are represented in the literature across four dimensions that commonly inform prioritization: ecological validity, neural correlates, biosensor protocols, and brain computer interface readiness, producing an evidence gap matrix. Pipeline evaluation combined human review, deterministic computations, and human-LLM alignment analysis. Results Applying the pipeline to Mars Desert Research Station logs, Stage 1 identified 19 constructs. Stage 2 highlighted critical gaps in neuroimaging and measurement protocols, particularly for social domains, thereby identifying potential research priorities and risks. Discussion This methodology offers a generalizable starting point for synthesizing operational logs into actionable research roadmaps, but the evaluation showed it still required human scrutiny.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出并评估了一套两阶段大语言模型流程，用于从真实运行数据中生成研究路线图，以辅助确定神经科学在真实环境中的研究优先级。第一阶段对运行日志做检索增强生成，识别候选心理、社会与神经认知构念并映射其共现关系；第二阶段从生态效度、神经关联、生物传感器协议和脑机接口就绪度四个维度评估这些构念在文献中的呈现程度，形成证据缺口矩阵。将该流程应用于火星沙漠研究站日志时，第一阶段识别出若干构念，第二阶段则突出神经影像与测量协议方面的关键缺口，尤其集中在社会领域，由此提示潜在研究优先级与风险。作者指出，该方法可作为将运行日志综合为可操作研究路线图的通用起点，但评估显示其结果仍需人工审查。

papers.title: Use of Generative AI in Scholarly Research: Challenges and Opportunities
papers.authors: Marco Marabelli, Robert M. Davison, Giovanni Gatti, Ankita Srivastava, Monideepa Tarafdar
papers.journal: Journal of the Association for Information Systems
papers.abstract: The focus of this panel report is to present evidence of a panel discussion that took place in October 2025 on the use of generative artificial intelligence (GAI) in academic research and publishing. The panel included publishers (Elsevier, Emerald, Galiot Press, MIT Press, Nature/Springer, Wiley) and editors-in-chief (representing the Information Systems Journal, Journal of the AIS, Journal of Data Science and ICES Journal of Marine Science). Key outcomes of the panel are the following: (1) publishers and editors have some disagreements regarding GAI use; (2) besides disagreements, all recognize that GAI is here to stay, and therefore, outstanding issues (e.g., training for PhD students and junior faculty and consequences for unallowed uses of GAI) need to be addressed jointly; (3) GAI is in constant flux, and this is a challenge for publisher and journal policies; and (4) it is unclear the extent to which GAI will affect future scholarship outcomes, especially having in mind the potential for scholarly deskilling.

papers.title: ChatGPT’s feedback credibility and students’ perceived learning: the role of agent-related social perceptions
papers.authors: Raúl Pérez‐López, Rubén González-Vallejo, Laura Lucia‐Palacios, Iguácel Melero‐Polo, Andreea Trifu
papers.journal: International Journal of Educational Technology in Higher Education
papers.abstract: Abstract This paper examines whether students’ agent-related social perceptions of ChatGPT are associated with the perceived credibility of its feedback in academic tasks and whether such credibility, in turn, is related to students’ perceived learning. It also investigates whether the relationship between feedback credibility and perceived learning varies according to students’ sensitivity to the quality of their academic work and their sensitivity to grade-based rewards. To address this, we develop a theoretical model grounded in social perception theory and prior research on students’ experiences with AI-based tools. The model is tested using Structural Equation Modelling (SEM) on data collected from 230 students who completed an academic writing task. The findings reveal that students’ agent-related social perceptions—particularly perceived competence and human-like empathy—are positively connected to the credibility students attribute to its feedback. In turn, perceived feedback credibility is interestingly related to students’ perceived learning in the context of academic writing. Furthermore, the positive link between credibility and perceived learning is weaker among students with higher grade-based reward sensitivity. This research contributes to the educational technology literature by advancing understanding of how students evaluate the credibility of ChatGPT-generated feedback and how such evaluations are associated with learning perceptions. It also shows that agent-related social perceptions play a significant role in students’ credibility judgements. Finally, the findings offer practical implications for educators and students seeking to integrate ChatGPT effectively into academic activities.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察学生对ChatGPT的社会感知是否与其对反馈可信度的评价相关，以及这种可信度是否进而与感知学习相关，并检验学业质量敏感性和成绩奖励敏感性对这一关系的调节作用。作者基于社会感知理论构建模型，对完成学术写作任务的230名学生用结构方程模型分析数据。结果显示，学生感知到的能力与类人共情等智能体社会感知正向关联于反馈可信度，反馈可信度又与感知学习相关；而成绩奖励敏感性较高的学生中，可信度与感知学习的正向关联更弱。研究提示智能体社会感知影响学生的可信度判断，相关结论属关联性证据。

papers.title: Latent profiles of academic stress and exercise motivation among college students: A latent profile analysis
papers.authors: Pukui Wang, Zihao Li, Wang Xiangyu, Gao Xiang
papers.abstract: This study aimed to investigate the latent profile structure of academic stress and exercise motivation among Chinese college students and to examine the predictive effects of demographic variables, including gender, body mass index (BMI), grade, and household registration background, on profile membership. From May 14 to June 3, 2025, convenience cluster sampling was employed to recruit 1,346 first- to third-year undergraduate students. The participants completed the Academic Sub-Scale and the Chinese-translated Behavioral Regulation in Exercise Questionnaire-2. Latent profile analysis was performed using Mplus 8.3 to identify distinct combined patterns of academic stress and exercise motivation, and the R3STEP method was applied to test the predictive utility of demographic variables on profile assignment. Four latent profiles were identified as the best-fitting solution. Profile 1, the High stress-low motivation profile (9.0%), was characterized by elevated academic stress and low scores across all exercise motivation dimensions. Profile 2, the High stress-high motivation profile (7.4%), exhibited the highest academic stress and the highest levels of external, introjected, and identified regulation. Profile 3, the Low stress-high autonomy profile (22.1%), demonstrated the lowest academic stress and the highest intrinsic motivation. Profile 4, the Moderate-balanced adaptation profile (61.6%), was marked by moderate scores on all variables and represented the most prevalent pattern. Students with normal weight showed a significantly stronger probability association with the High stress–high motivation profile, the Low stress–high autonomy profile, and the Moderate-balanced adaptation profile compared to their overweight and obese counterparts. Female students and third-year students demonstrated a lower probability of belonging to the High stress–low motivation profile. Rural students exhibited a stronger probability association with the Low stress–high autonomy profile, whereas urban students showed a stronger probability association with the Moderate-balanced adaptation profile. Four heterogeneous combined patterns of academic stress and exercise motivation exist among Chinese college students. Normal weight, female gender, higher grade level, and rural background were positively associated with autonomous exercise motivation and may have a potential protective role in the present sample. These findings provide empirical support for the application of self-determination theory and the strength model of self-control in the context of academic stress and offer targeted references for the implementation of differentiated mental health and physical exercise interventions in higher education settings. However, due to the sampling limitations of this study, caution is warranted when extrapolating the present conclusions to the entire population of Chinese college students.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以中国大学生为对象，采用潜在剖面分析考察学业压力与锻炼动机的组合类型，并检验性别、BMI、年级和户籍背景对剖面归属的预测作用。研究识别出四种异质性组合模式，其中“中等—平衡适应”型最为普遍，另三类分别表现为高压力低动机、高压力高动机和低压力高自主。正常体重、女性、较高年级和农村背景与自主性锻炼动机存在正向关联，可能具有潜在保护作用。作者据此为自我决定理论和自我控制力量模型提供了经验支持，并提示结论受便利整群抽样限制，外推需谨慎。

papers.title: Algorithm or Assembly? An Experimental Study of Recommendations by AI Versus Deliberative Mini-Publics in Democratic Decision-Making
papers.authors: Nuri Kim, Myojung Chung, S. Mo Jones-Jang, Sangwon Lee, Jihyang Choi
papers.abstract: Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) renewed debates about who—or what—can legitimately contribute to democratic processes. While both AI and deliberative mini-publics can supplement citizens’ efforts to form judgments about issues, little is known about how citizens evaluate policy advice from these sources. In an online survey experiment with U.S. adults (N = 502), participants read a mock news story reporting a policy recommendation, attributed either to an AI system or a deliberative citizens’ assembly. Opinion climate was orthogonally varied to assess contextual influences. Results were split: citizens’ assemblies were rated fairer and more satisfying, but AI was perceived to be more useful. Opinion climate cues had no moderating effects. Further analysis indicated that acceptance of AI versus citizens’ assembly recommendations depends on individual factors, such as prior attitudes toward the issue and trust in AI. Findings offer theoretical and practical implications for designing democratic decision support systems.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过一项针对美国成年人的在线调查实验，考察公民如何评价由AI系统与协商式公民大会分别提出的政策建议，并检验意见气候线索是否影响评价。结果显示评价是分裂的：公民大会被认为更公平、更令人满意，而AI建议被认为更有用；意见气候线索没有调节作用。进一步分析表明，对AI建议与公民大会建议的接受度取决于个体因素，如对议题的既有态度和对AI的信任。研究据此讨论了对民主决策支持系统设计与合法性的启示。

papers.title: Why this AI app? The impact of generative artificial intelligence on educators’ choices in educational apps
papers.authors: Emma Liptrot, Adam Kenneth Dubé
papers.abstract: In elementary education, generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is being incorporated into educational applications, despite still-emerging evidence of its effects on children’s learning and development. Educators, who are already overwhelmed with choice in the commercial app space, may increasincly have to decide whether to incorporate GenAI-enabled apps for their classrooms. Thus, the present study investigates how mentioning GenAI in app store descriptions impacts K-6 educators’ selection of educational apps. Over two studies, K-6 educators (each n = 101) from Canada, the US, and the UK viewed and evaluated eight researcher-created educational math apps with and without GenAI. Study 1 tested whether mentioning GenAI in app descriptions affected educators’ app evaluations but found no effect. In Study 2, results from a repeated measures MANOVA revealed that educators rated apps without AI higher than those mentioning GenAI, but there were no significant effects of GenAI on likelihood to download or willingness to pay for apps. A hierarchical cluster analysis identified three distinct groups of educators: 1) selectors (n = 28), who exhibited a preference for downloading, rating, and paying for apps including GenAI; 2) agnostics (n = 59), who exhibit minimal preferences; and 3) avoiders (n = 14), who prefer apps without AI. Most educators were agnostic to the use of GenAI in educational apps, highlighting the need to support educators’ informed decisions about when to adopt GenAI tools and encourage critical evaluation of GenAI’s role in education. More research is needed to understand how educators’ GenAI preferences relate to their attitudes, knowledge, and use of GenAI.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在应用商店描述中提及生成式人工智能（GenAI）是否影响K-6教育者选择教育类应用，通过两项研究让加拿大、美国、英国的教育者观看并评价研究者制作的有无GenAI的数学应用。第一项研究未发现提及GenAI对应用评价有影响；第二项研究发现教育者对不含AI的应用评价更高，但GenAI对下载意愿和付费意愿无显著影响，聚类分析则识别出偏好含GenAI应用的“选择者”、偏好不明显的“中立者”和偏好不含AI应用的“回避者”三类群体。多数教育者对教育应用中的GenAI持中立态度，作者据此指出需要支持教育者就是否采用GenAI工具做出知情决策，并对其在教育中的作用进行批判性评估。

papers.title: Beyond Linear Growth: Adaptive Human Intelligence, Emotional Dynamics, and Willingness to Write in Artificial Intelligence-Mediated Informal Digital Learning of English (AI-IDLE)
papers.authors: Chenghao Wang, Lanfang Sun, Bin Zou, Yunyan Zhang
papers.abstract: The development of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is expanding AI-mediated informal digital learning of English (AI-IDLE) from predominantly receptive and conversational activities to cognitively demanding productive tasks such as academic writing. Yet little is known about how learners’ motivation and technology-related emotions develop over time, or how sustained interaction with GenAI may engage human capacities for evaluation and adaptation. Grounded in Complex Dynamic Systems Theory (CDST), this study investigated the longitudinal development of willingness to write (WTW), technology-related enjoyment (ENY), and technology-related anxiety (ANX) among Chinese undergraduates learning English as a Foreign Language (EFL) in teacher-supported AI-IDLE embedded within an 11-week English for Academic Purposes writing course. Twenty-six participants with complete records across 11 measurement occasions were included in the longitudinal analysis. Trajectory analysis, change-point analysis, and exploratory moving-window correlation analysis were combined with thematic analysis of learners’ reflections. WTW followed a nonlinear trajectory, declining during the middle period before a potential late-stage transition and subsequent increase, whereas ENY remained comparatively stable and ANX generally declined. The relationships of WTW with ENY and ANX also varied over time. Learners’ reflections revealed increasing recognition of human–AI complementarity and more selective, critical, and strategic engagement with GenAI. From a human-intelligence perspective, these patterns illustrate adaptive and metacognitive capacities involved in evaluating AI-generated information, adjusting strategies, and coordinating human and artificial resources. Rather than treating WTW or emotions as measures of intelligence, the findings position AI-IDLE as a context in which such human intellectual capacities may be exercised and expressed.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于复杂动态系统理论，考察中国本科生在教师支持的AI辅助非正式英语数字学习中，写作意愿、技术相关愉悦与技术相关焦虑的纵向变化，并结合轨迹分析、变点分析、移动窗口相关分析与反思主题分析。结果显示，写作意愿呈非线性变化，中期下降后可能出现后期转变并回升；愉悦相对稳定，焦虑总体下降，写作意愿与两种情绪的关系也随时间变化。学习者的反思表明，他们对人机互补的认识增强，对生成式AI的参与更趋选择性、批判性和策略性。作者据此将这些模式理解为评估AI信息、调整策略和协调人机资源的适应性与元认知能力体现，而非把写作意愿或情绪当作智力测量。

papers.title: Empathetic responses by AI legal assistants and user over-disclosure: evidence from an online survey experiment
papers.authors: 思媛 王
papers.abstract: Introduction Generative AI legal assistants rely on users to describe events, evidence, and transaction histories, yet the same accounts may contain private information that is unnecessary for legal guidance. Empathetic language may affect how selectively users decide what to provide. Methods A one-factor between-subjects online survey experiment on Wenjuanxing randomly assigned 360 participants to rational, mildly empathetic, or highly empathetic AI legal responses (n = 120 per condition). Participants completed 1-5 Likert-type measures of parasocial response, privacy boundary judgment, and over-disclosure intention, together with related relational measures, and then answered an open-ended disclosure task. Results The empathy manipulation was successful, F (2,357) = 524.170, p < 0.001, and η 2 = 0.746. Stronger empathetic responses increased parasocial response (η 2 = 0.428), reduced privacy boundary judgment (η 2 = 0.242), and increased over-disclosure intention (η 2 = 0.406). The coded non-essential disclosure score rose from 0.994 in the rational condition to 6.132 in the highly empathetic condition, F (2,357) = 170.795, p < 0.001, and η 2 = 0.489. Necessary case facts remained stable, F (2,357) = 0.245, p = 0.783. Bootstrap analysis yielded an indirect effect through parasocial response of 0.214, 95% CI [0.151, 0.283], and a sequential indirect effect through parasocial response and privacy boundary judgment of 0.063, 95% CI [0.033, 0.098]. Discussion Within this consumer-dispute scenario, stronger empathetic cues reduced users' selectivity about which information was appropriate to provide. Data-minimization prompts and evidence-oriented questioning may help retain limited emotional support without encouraging unnecessary disclosure.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注生成式AI法律助手使用共情化表达时，是否会让用户披露超出法律咨询所需范围的私人信息。作者通过在线问卷实验，将参与者随机分配到理性、轻度共情和高强度共情三种AI回应条件下，测量准社会反应、隐私边界判断与过度披露意愿，并设置开放式披露任务。结果显示，共情表达越强，参与者的准社会反应和过度披露意愿越高，隐私边界判断越低，非必要信息披露也随之增加，而必要案情事实的提供保持稳定；准社会反应及隐私边界判断在其中起间接作用。文章据此提示，在保留有限情感支持的同时，可通过数据最小化提示和证据导向提问来减少不必要的自我披露。

papers.title: Exploration or exploitation? The double-edged effects of AI use modes on radical creativity: evidence from AI-enabled drug discovery
papers.authors: Hao Wang, Zhi Xu, Zhihong Huang, Huaihong Pan, Guanbin Zheng
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has been widely adopted in corporate innovation activities, yet prior research has not reached a consensus on whether it is more conducive to incremental or radical innovation. For radical innovation, which depends on highly novel ideas, realizing the value of AI depends not only on whether AI is adopted but, more importantly, on whether employees can use it creatively to transcend established knowledge boundaries. Drawing on environmental dynamism and the exploration–exploitation perspective, this study develops a theoretical model linking leaders’ perceptions of environmental dynamism, employees’ AI use modes, leader temporal myopia, and employee radical creativity in the context of AI-enabled drug discovery. We distinguish leaders’ perceptions of environmental dynamism into perceived technological dynamism and perceived market dynamism, and employees’ AI use into exploratory and exploitative AI use. The model is tested using partial least squares structural equation modeling and three-wave matched survey data from 368 leader–employee dyads. The results show that leader-perceived technological dynamism is positively associated with employee exploratory AI use, whereas leader-perceived market dynamism is positively associated with employee exploitative AI use. Exploratory AI use is positively associated with employee radical creativity, whereas exploitative AI use is negatively associated with it. Leader temporal myopia weakens the positive conditional indirect relationship of technological dynamism with radical creativity through exploratory AI use and strengthens the negative conditional indirect relationship of market dynamism with radical creativity through exploitative AI use. By adopting a knowledge-activity perspective, this study reveals the differentiated relationships between AI use modes and radical creativity and further explains how perceptions of the external environment, leaders’ temporal orientation, and employees’ AI use behaviors are differentially related. The findings provide a theoretical basis and practical implications for helping firms engaged in AI-enabled drug discovery guide employees toward effective AI use and enhance radical creativity.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注AI使用方式对突破性创造力的双刃影响，以AI赋能药物研发为情境，基于探索—利用视角构建理论模型，并用三波匹配的领导者—员工配对问卷数据检验。结果显示，领导者感知的技术动态性与员工探索式AI使用正相关，感知的市场动态性则与利用式AI使用正相关；探索式AI使用与突破性创造力正相关，利用式AI使用与其负相关。领导者的时间近视削弱了技术动态性经由探索式AI使用影响突破性创造力的正向条件间接关系，并强化了市场动态性经由利用式AI使用影响突破性创造力的负向条件间接关系。研究据此区分了两种AI使用方式与突破性创造力的不同关联，提示外部环境感知与领导者时间取向会调节这一过程。

papers.title: When loneliness amplifies the risk of problematic emotional dependence: perceived anthropomorphism and basic psychological need satisfaction in AI companion use
papers.authors: Ting Liu, Ruey-ming Shih, Tingyun LUO, Shining Jin
papers.abstract: Background Companion-oriented conversational AI can be experienced as socially responsive, yet evidence about problematic reliance requires construct clarity and noncausal interpretation. This study examined whether perceived anthropomorphism was associated with problematic AI-companion dependence directly and indirectly through basic psychological need satisfaction. Methods A cross-sectional online survey was completed by 666 adults in China who reported using a listed AI companion or conversational AI product during the preceding month. The nonclinical outcome was operationalized with six indicators spanning impaired control, distress, continued use, perceived understanding, emotion-regulation reliance, and displacement of offline communication. Measurement evidence was examined using reliability estimates, one-factor confirmatory models, and HTMT. Standardized composite-score regressions used HC3 robust standard errors, and the indirect association was evaluated with 5,000 bootstrap samples.
