Results Perceived anthropomorphism was positively associated with need satisfaction ( β = 0.569, p < 0.001). In the outcome model, need satisfaction ( β = 0.317, p < 0.001) and perceived anthropomorphism ( β = 0.385, p < 0.001) were both positively associated with problematic dependence. The standardized indirect association was 0.180 (95% bootstrap CI [0.137, 0.229]); R 2 was 0.323 for need satisfaction and 0.389 for problematic dependence. Conclusion The pattern is consistent with a need-satisfaction account of companion-oriented AI use, but the cross-sectional design does not establish temporal ordering, substitution, or causality. Design and policy implications should therefore focus on transparency, user agency, and safeguards against escalating reliance rather than treating anthropomorphism itself as inherently harmful.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于中国666名成年人的横断面在线调查，考察AI伴侣使用中感知拟人化与问题性情感依赖的关系，并检验基本心理需要满足是否在其中起中介作用。结果发现，感知拟人化与需要满足、问题性依赖均呈正相关，需要满足也与问题性依赖正相关，且存在显著的正向间接关联。作者据此提出，这一模式与“需要满足”解释相符，但横断面设计无法确立时间顺序或因果关系，因此设计与政策应关注透明度、用户自主性和防止依赖升级，而非将拟人化本身视为有害。

papers.title: ChatGPT as cognitive scaffold: computational thinking and metacognition in AI-embedded instruction
papers.authors: Tanya Chichekian, Joel Trudeau
papers.abstract: Drawing on a computational thinking model and cognitive offloading theory, this exploratory mixed-methods study examined whether structured AI scaffolding is associated with differential computational thinking (CT) outcomes and explored the role of metacognitive self-regulation. Two naturally occurring sections (n = 47) of the same liberal arts course, taught by the same instructor in consecutive Fall semesters, one embedding ChatGPT and one not, were compared using independent-samples t-tests, multiple regression, and inductive content analysis. Students in the ChatGPT-embedded section reported significantly higher problem-solving scores on a validated CT instrument. Digital literacy scores did not differ, possibly reflecting measurement limitations or the intervention's focus on reasoning over general digital fluency. Problem solving correlated significantly with metacognitive strategy use and contributed to a significant overall regression model, but did not remain a unique predictor after adjusting for digital literacy and class membership. Qualitative analysis identified three themes: ChatGPT as a cognitive scaffold, ChatGPT as a cognitive risk, and student-initiated boundary-setting. Most students expressed all three simultaneously, suggesting structured AI-embedded environments may foster metacognitive vigilance alongside CT gains. Findings support deliberate instructional design and explicit metacognitive supports when integrating ChatGPT in higher education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于计算思维模型与认知卸载理论，采用混合方法比较同一文科课程中嵌入与未嵌入ChatGPT的两个自然班级，考察结构化AI支架是否与计算思维表现差异相关，并探讨元认知自我调节的作用。结果显示，嵌入ChatGPT的班级在问题解决得分上显著更高，而数字素养无差异；问题解决与元认知策略使用相关并进入显著回归模型，但在控制数字素养和班级归属后不再是独特预测因素。质性分析归纳出ChatGPT作为认知支架、认知风险和学生自主设定边界三个主题，且多数学生同时表达三者，提示结构化AI环境可能在带来计算思维收益的同时促进元认知警觉。研究据此支持在高等教育整合ChatGPT时进行有意的教学设计与明确的元认知支持。

papers.title: From Representation to Relational Mentorship: User Perceptions of Virtual Heritage Mentors in AI-Mediated Intangible Cultural Heritage Learning
papers.authors: Quanyi Zhao, Xiangming Mu, Xun Zhu
papers.abstract: This study presents a convergent mixed-methods empirical investigation of user perceptions of Virtual Heritage Mentors (VHMs) in AI-mediated intangible cultural heritage learning. The study draws on an online survey of 370 participants and semi-structured interviews with 20 independently recruited participants, all of whom were ethnically Chinese. The results indicated that participants prioritized interactive explanation, clarification, and guided support over visual realism. Trust was associated with cultural accuracy, contextual grounding, transparency, and respect for heritage communities. Emotional resonance was valued less as anthropomorphic simulation than as pedagogical care expressed through patience, encouragement, re-explanation, and responsiveness. Participants also envisioned VHMs as adaptive learning companions while emphasizing that AI should complement rather than replace human practitioners. These findings empirically support and refine the proposed VHM framework by highlighting relational mediation, relational mentorship, co-transmission, and human–AI complementarity as key design priorities. The study argues for shifting digital heritage design from representation alone toward relational, culturally accountable support for heritage learning and transmission.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察用户如何感知AI介导的非物质文化遗产学习中的虚拟传承导师，采用在线问卷与半结构化访谈相结合的混合方法，以华裔参与者为对象。结果显示，用户更看重互动讲解、答疑与引导性支持，而非视觉逼真；信任与文化准确性、语境依据、透明性及对传承社群的尊重相关，情感共鸣则更多体现为耐心、鼓励、重述和回应等教学关怀，而非拟人化模拟。参与者期待虚拟导师成为自适应学习伙伴，但强调AI应补充而非取代人类传承人。研究据此提出关系性中介、关系性师徒、共同传承与人机互补等设计重点，主张数字遗产设计从单纯再现转向有文化责任感的关系性支持。

papers.title: Using AI, Doubting AI: Developer Mental Models and Trust in AI-Assisted Software Work
papers.authors: NICOLE DSILVA
papers.abstract: Generative AI has entered software work with remarkable speed, yet trust in its output remains unsettled. This study examines how developers and learners navigate AI-assisted software work through mental models and trust. Analyzing 40,052 responses from the 2025 Stack Overflow Developer Survey, the findings reveal a durable paradox: professionals use AI more intensively than learners but trust it less, evaluating its capability for complex tasks more cautiously. The primary threat to trust is corrective labor, such as debugging time, rather than code legibility. Cluster analysis identifies four mental-model profiles—open but light users, skeptical dependents, resistant/disengaged respondents, and enthusiastic adopters—with professionals disproportionately concentrated in skeptical dependence. Ultimately, adoption does not settle the trust question; instead, mental models act as interpretive filters through which developers decide when to rely, verify, and pull back.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注开发者与学习者在AI辅助软件工作中如何形成心智模型并建立信任，基于2025年Stack Overflow开发者调查的回应数据进行分析。主要发现是一个持续存在的悖论：专业人士比学习者更密集地使用AI，却对其信任度更低，对复杂任务能力的评估也更谨慎；对信任的主要威胁来自调试等纠错劳动，而非代码可读性。聚类分析识别出四种心智模型类型，专业人士更多集中于怀疑性依赖一类。研究据此指出，采用AI并不自动解决信任问题，心智模型充当解释性过滤器，影响开发者何时依赖、验证或收手。

papers.title: Design Implications for Teacher-Configurable Generative AI Writing Tools: A Participatory Design Study with StoryBot
papers.authors: Ariel Han, Shenshen Han, Zhenyao Cai, Joey Huang, Franceli L. Cibrian, Kylie Peppler
papers.abstract: As generative AI (GenAI) tools become accessible, their integration into K–12 writing presents opportunities and challenges. This study partnered with 21 primary school teachers in a participatory co-design process to develop StoryBot, a teacher-configurable GenAI story-authoring platform. Teachers identified instructional needs and learning outcomes that informed system features, including genre-specific writing scaffolds, configurable prompts, and constraints on full-text generation to preserve student voice. The platform positions educators as co-designers of AI behavior rather than passive users. We conducted a pilot writing workshop with 13 youth (ages 8–12) and a focus group with six educators to examine how the platform influenced students’ writing behaviors and classroom integration. Findings demonstrate the value of teacher co-design and configurable AI systems in aligning GenAI tools with pedagogical priorities and practices. We present design implications for teacher-configurable GenAI writing systems that support student agency, ethical safeguards, and instructional alignment in human–AI coauthoring environments.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对生成式AI进入K–12写作教学后如何与教学需求对齐的问题，与小学教师开展参与式共同设计，开发了可由教师配置的StoryBot故事写作平台，并通过写作工作坊和教师焦点小组考察其使用情况。研究发现，让教师参与设计AI行为、并允许其配置提示词与全文生成限制，有助于使工具贴合教学目标和课堂实践，同时保留学生自己的表达。文章据此提出面向教师可配置生成式AI写作系统的设计启示，强调学生能动性、伦理防护与人机协同写作中的教学一致性。

papers.title: Educational Recommender Systems for Metacognitive and Self-Regulated Learning Support: An Algorithmic Systematic Review
papers.authors: Zhuoying Li, Sikai Wang
papers.abstract: Recommender systems (RSs) increasingly support self-regulated learning (SRL) through personalized resources, feedback, and strategy recommendations. However, traditional content based and collaborative filtering approaches suffer from cold start problems, while machine or deep learning methods raise interpretability concerns and LLM-based recommenders require evaluation of explanation faithfulness and hallucinations. This systematic review examines SRL-oriented recommender algorithms from an algorithmic and pedagogical perspective. Six databases were searched using predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria, yielding 25 eligible studies published between 2020 and 2025. The review traces the evolution from traditional filtering methods to machine or deep learning and emerging LLM-based approaches. Three major challenges were identified: cold start, limited explainability, and LLM hallucinations, alongside gaps in learner system interaction and metacognitive scaffolding. Future SRL-RS research should compare algorithms under controlled data sparsity, evaluate explanation faithfulness and source curation, preserve learner agency, integrate SRL strategies across three phases, and longitudinally assess SRL skill maintenance and transfer.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述从算法与教学两个角度梳理了面向自我调节学习的推荐系统研究，检索多个数据库后纳入近年发表的合格文献，追踪了从传统过滤方法到机器学习、深度学习及新兴大语言模型推荐方法的演变。作者指出，这类系统仍面临冷启动、可解释性有限和大语言模型幻觉三类主要挑战，同时在学习者与系统交互及元认知支架方面存在缺口。文章据此提出未来研究应在受控的数据稀疏条件下比较算法、评估解释的忠实性与来源筛选、维护学习者能动性，并将自我调节学习策略贯穿三个阶段，同时纵向考察相关技能的维持与迁移。

papers.title: The power of framing AI: preliminary evidence on hybrid intelligence and future work perceptions
papers.authors: Lau Holgersen, Janet Frances Rafner, Patrycja Julia Rogozińska, Michail J. Beliatis, Dominik Dellermann, Jacob Friis Sherson
papers.abstract: As generative AI diffuses across organisations, individuals encounter competing frames of AI as autonomous automation or human–AI collaboration. We examine framing as an early interpretive condition that may shape whether people understand AI as a replacement for human labour or as a collaborative system supporting human co-adaptation. Two exploratory experiments tested whether competing AI frames influence master's students' perceived automation risk and sensemaking about AI's role in future work. In Study 1, a randomised repeated-measures experiment with Business Intelligence students (N = 35), introducing a hybrid intelligence (HI) counter-frame after an AI-capability frame was associated with lower perceived job displacement expectations than in the control condition. In Study 2, a randomised framing-primacy workshop with Digital Design students, numeric automation estimates did not differ significantly (N = 31), but in the written-response sample (N = 35), participants exposed to an HI-first frame expressed significantly more augmentation-oriented interpretations of AI's role. The studies suggest that AI frames may influence perceived automation risk and the language used to make sense of human–AI collaboration. We discuss implications for managers and educators and position HI-TAM2 as a preliminary theoretical agenda for research on framing and contextual antecedents in HI acceptance rather than a validated model extension.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究把“AI 框架”视为一种早期解释条件，考察将 AI 表述为自主自动化还是人机协作，是否会影响个体对未来工作中 AI 角色的理解。作者对硕士生开展了两项探索性实验，分别测试混合智能反框架和框架优先顺序的作用。结果显示，在能力框架之后引入混合智能反框架，与更低的岗位替代预期相关；在框架优先的工作坊中，数值化的自动化估计没有显著差异，但先接触混合智能框架的参与者在文字回答中更多把 AI 理解为对人类工作的增强。作者据此讨论了对管理者和教育者的启示，并将 HI-TAM2 定位为关于框架与情境前因的初步理论议程，而非已验证的模型扩展。

papers.title: Developing computational thinking in teacher education: a brief experience with coding, robotics, and machine learning
papers.authors: Susana Sánchez Castro, María Ángeles Pascual Sevillano, Rogelio Buceta Otero, Javier Fombona Cadavieco
papers.abstract: Abstract This study examines post-intervention self-reported outcomes associated with a short intervention designed to introduce coding, educational robotics, and introductory concepts of machine learning into initial teacher education for Primary Education. The proposal is grounded in Papert’s principles and the Creative and Computational Problem Solving model, combining active learning methodologies with accessible technologies. A quasi-experimental design with a non-equivalent control group was employed. A total of 144 first-year students from three Spanish universities participated (105 in the experimental group and 39 in the control group). The intervention consisted of a two-hour workshop with hands-on stations and technological challenges, designed as a feasible microintervention within regular teacher education contexts. Assessment was carried out through an ad hoc questionnaire focused on three dimensions: knowledge of programming and machine learning, block-based programming and game engines, and active learning, all assessed through self-reported perceptions. The results showed statistically significant post-intervention differences in favor of the experimental group, with a small effect size for knowledge of programming and machine learning and large effect sizes for block-based programming and game engines and active learning. Item-level analyses revealed that favorable overall perceptions coexisted with lower self-reported familiarity in specific technical areas, particularly machine learning, prior experience with block-based programming, and programming in game engines. Three exploratory response profiles were also identified: reluctant, intermediate, and enthusiastic. The findings suggest that well-structured microinterventions may support higher self-reported knowledge of programming and machine learning, greater familiarity with block-based programming and game engines, and more positive perceptions of active learning in teacher education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察一次短时工作坊能否在小学教师职前培养中引入编程、教育机器人与机器学习入门概念，采用准实验设计，以问卷比较实验组与控制组在干预后的自我报告情况。结果显示，实验组在编程与机器学习知识、积木式编程与游戏引擎以及主动学习三个维度上的自评均显著优于控制组，其中后两者效应量较大。不过，条目层面的分析表明，总体积极感知与部分技术领域（尤其是机器学习、积木式编程经验和游戏引擎编程）自评熟悉度偏低并存，并呈现出犹豫、中间和积极三类反应倾向。作者据此认为，结构良好的微型干预可能有助于提升相关自评知识与主动学习感知，但结论基于自我报告，且部分技术领域的熟悉度仍有限。

papers.title: When AI Is—and Is Not—Needed: AI Literacy and Computational Thinking in Primary STEM
papers.authors: Ahmet Akif ERBAŞ, Tolga Topçubaşı
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly present in children’s lives, yet exposure does not necessarily lead to an accurate understanding of how AI works. This study examined whether a LEGO-based integrated STEM intervention could improve third-grade students’ AI literacy and computational thinking, particularly their ability to distinguish machine learning from rule-based automation and reason about training data, model error, and technology choice. An embedded mixed-methods, quasi-experimental pretest–posttest control-group design was conducted with 93 students from four intact classrooms. The experimental group (n = 46) completed eight weeks of authentic design problems, while the control group (n = 47) continued regular Life Studies instruction. After controlling for pretest scores, the experimental group significantly outperformed the control group in AI literacy, F(1, 90) = 152.51, p < .001, partial η2 = 0.629, and computational thinking, F(1, 90) = 22.18, p < .001, partial η2 = 0.198. Qualitative evidence showed a shift from viewing AI through robots and automatic actions toward reasoning about learning from examples, data diversity, limitations, human oversight, accessibility, and problem–technology fit. Integrated STEM instruction can foster critical AI literacy by making AI mechanisms visible and inviting students to judge whether AI is needed at all.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察基于乐高积木的整合式STEM教学干预能否提升小学三年级学生的AI素养与计算思维，尤其是区分机器学习与基于规则的自动化、理解训练数据与模型误差以及判断技术选择的能力。研究采用嵌入式混合方法准实验前后测对照组设计，实验组完成八周真实设计问题，对照组继续常规课程。在控制前测成绩后，实验组在AI素养和计算思维上的表现显著优于对照组；质性证据显示，学生对AI的理解从将其等同于机器人或自动动作，转向思考从样例中学习、数据多样性、局限、人类监督、可及性以及问题与技术的匹配。文章据此认为，整合式STEM教学可通过让AI机制可见，并引导学生判断是否真的需要AI，来培养批判性AI素养。

papers.title: Behavioral differentiation during the AIGC image generation waiting period: effects on creativity in conceptual design
papers.authors: Ziliang Zhu, Jiang Xu
papers.abstract: Introduction: Artificial intelligence-generated content (AIGC) offers new ways to generate inspiration for conceptual design, yet limited attention has been paid to the waiting period between prompt submission and AI image output. This study examined behavioral differentiation during this interval and investigated how the task relevance and cognitive load of waiting-period behaviors affect creativity in conceptual design. Methods Three experiments were conducted with design students. Experiment 1 identified and classified core waiting-period behaviors ( N = 30); Experiment 2 measured the cognitive load of representative behaviors using the NASA-TLX ( N = 24); and Experiment 3 employed a behavior-based 2 × 2 conceptual framework ( N = 60), in which four representative waiting-period behaviors were selected to represent different combinations of task relevance (high/low) and relative workload (higher/lower), and their creative performance was compared. Results The results showed that the AIGC generation waiting period was not a passive interval but involved multiple identifiable behavioral patterns. Creative performance differed across the four representative behavioral conditions. Specifically, the overall creativity score in the GP condition was significantly lower than the scores in the RS, DB, and RB conditions, whereas no significant differences were observed among the latter three conditions. These findings further suggest that the subsequent influence of waiting-period behaviors on creativity may depend not only on the level of cognitive demand but also on whether cognitive resources remain directed toward the ongoing creative task. Discussion This study further interprets AIGC generation waiting-period behaviors from three interrelated functional perspectives: task continuity, cognitive expenditure, and temporary disengagement/incubation. This functional account provides an empirical basis for understanding the cognitive role of the AIGC generation waiting period and for optimizing AI-assisted conceptual design workflows.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注AIGC图像生成等待期这一常被忽视的环节，考察等待期间的行为差异如何影响概念设计创造力。作者以设计学生为对象开展三项实验，先识别并分类等待期行为，再测量代表性行为的认知负荷，最后比较不同任务相关性与工作负荷组合下的创造性表现。结果显示，等待期并非被动空白，而是包含多种可识别的行为模式；其中一种行为条件下的整体创造力得分显著低于其余三种，而后三者之间无显著差异。作者据此提出，等待期行为对创造力的后续影响可能不仅取决于认知需求高低，也取决于认知资源是否仍指向正在进行的创作任务，并从任务连续性、认知消耗和暂时脱离/酝酿三个功能角度加以解释。

papers.title: How Humans and AI Detect Deepfakes Differently: Complementary Strategies for Human-AI Teaming
papers.authors: Xinyi Chen, Jing Yang
papers.journal: Proceedings of the Human Factors and Ergonomics Society Annual Meeting
papers.abstract: Deepfakes are AI-generated synthetic media that manipulate individuals’ lip movements, facial expressions, and voices, creating serious risks through deception, misinformation, and identity misuse. Although AI-based tools are essential for Deepfake detection, understanding and strengthening human detection ability is equally important. We compare human and AI attention allocation patterns, showing that they rely on distinct cues and reasoning strategies. We also examine physiological differences across levels of AI literacy to identify factors associated with superior human performance. Contrary to the assumption that AI consistently outperforms humans in Deepfake detection tasks, individuals with greater prior AI exposure may rival or exceed AI-based detectors in certain contexts. Eye-tracking and EEG evidence further suggests that humans use holistic, intuitive, and flexible visual-cognitive processing to detect subtle inconsistencies and artifacts overlooked by AI. These findings clarify how humans and AI process deceptive visual cues differently and inform trustworthy, adaptive human-AI teaming for Deepfake detection.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了人类与AI在深度伪造检测中的注意力分配和推理策略，并考察不同AI素养水平下的生理差异。研究发现，人类与AI依赖不同的线索和判断方式：AI素养较高的个体在某些情境下可媲美甚至超过AI检测器；眼动和脑电证据表明，人类采用整体、直觉且灵活的视觉认知加工，能察觉AI忽略的细微不一致与伪影。这些结果说明人机检测策略具有互补性，可为构建可信、自适应的人机协同检测提供依据。

papers.title: A new spiral model of AI literacy and competency in higher education developed through a systematic literature review
papers.authors: Zubair Ahmad, Nafilah Abdul Latheef, Almaas Sultana, Nitha Siby, Thomas K. F. Chiu
papers.abstract: This study introduces a new spiral model of artificial intelligence (AI) literacy and competency in higher education. It conceptualizes AI competency as a recursive and multidimensional developmental process that evolves from foundational AI literacy. The model addresses persistent conceptual ambiguity between AI literacy and competency and extends existing static and fragmented frameworks by explaining how competency progressively develops through iterative learning. Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, a systematic literature review and thematic synthesis of 18 studies identified three major gaps, including conceptual overlap between AI literacy and competency, fragmented framework structures, and limited developmental progression. In response, the proposed model integrates three interdependent dimensions, reflective, dispositional, and practical, within interactive learning environments. Repeated cycles progressively deepen students' critical, ethical, and applied engagement with AI. The model is theoretically grounded in Piaget's Cognitive Development Theory, Bandura's Social Cognitive Theory, Vygotsky's Sociocultural Theory, and Bruner's Spiral Curriculum Theory. Its developmental mechanism is further formalized through the Multiplicative Spiral Gain Function (MSGF), which represents how balanced growth across these dimensions strengthens the transformation of AI literacy into competency. The model provides a foundation for curriculum design, competency assessment, learning analytics, and future empirical validation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对高等教育中人工智能素养与能力概念混淆、框架碎片化及发展路径不清的问题，通过系统文献综述与主题综合提出一个螺旋模型。该综述梳理相关研究后，将AI能力刻画为在互动学习环境中经由反复循环、由基础素养逐步深化的多维递归过程，整合反思、倾向与实践三个相互依存的维度，并以发展理论为基础、用乘性螺旋增益函数形式化其转化机制。文章主要贡献是提供概念框架，供课程设计、能力评估与学习分析参考，尚待实证检验。

papers.title: Logic or Emotion? The Impact of Persuasion Strategies on Human-AI Trust
papers.authors: Tianhao Li, Yue QI
papers.abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) systems increasingly engage in persuasive and socially interactive roles, understanding how users calibrate trust toward AI versus human persuaders, and how persuasion strategy shapes this process, has become critical for human-AI interaction research. Prior work has examined preferences for human- versus AI-produced content, yet little is known about how persuasion strategy and persuader identity jointly influence trust during interactive communication. This study investigates how logical versus emotional persuasion, delivered by either human or AI sources, shapes two task-specific outcomes in a multi-turn social reasoning context: round-level credibility evaluations and final accept/reject choices. We treat these outcomes as complementary indicators of trust-relevant evaluation and reliance-related choice. We developed an online interaction paradigm in which participants evaluated persuasive messages under varying identity disclosure conditions. The empirical program included two human-participant studies and two exploratory LLM-based extension studies. Across four studies, AI-generated persuasive messages produced under standardized prompting constraints were evaluated differently from human-authored scripted messages under the present task constraints. In the human-participant studies, results showed a message-source-contingent pattern: AI-generated logic-framed messages received higher credibility ratings in several conditions. under explicit identity disclosure, AI-generated logic-framed messages received higher ratings than human-authored logic-framed messages, whereas human-authored emotion-framed messages received higher ratings than AI-generated emotion-framed messages. Under identity ambiguity, differences between AI and human persuaders were attenuated. The exploratory model analyses examined whether the same manipulations produced convergent or divergent output patterns in GPT-4o and Qwen-Max. Both models assigned higher ratings to logic-framed messages; the logic-over-emotion difference was stronger for Qwen-Max, whereas GPT-4o produced a more balanced pattern. These findings provide a structured account of how identity transparency conditions source-strategy fit in trust calibration and offer design implications for aligning AI persuasion strategies with different identity-disclosure contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在多轮社会推理情境中，说服策略（逻辑框架与情感框架）与说服者身份（人类或AI）如何共同影响用户对可信度的评价和接受选择。作者构建了在线互动范式，包含两项人类参与者研究和两项基于大语言模型的探索性扩展研究。人类参与者研究显示，可信度评价呈现与信息来源相关的模式：在明确披露身份时，AI生成的逻辑框架信息获得比人类逻辑框架信息更高的评分，而人类撰写的情感框架信息则高于AI情感框架信息；身份模糊时，AI与人类说服者之间的差异减弱。探索性模型分析中，GPT-4o与Qwen-Max均对逻辑框架给出更高评分，但逻辑优于情感的差异在Qwen-Max上更强，GPT-4o则更均衡。文章据此讨论了身份透明度如何调节来源与策略的匹配，并为AI说服策略与身份披露情境的协调提供设计启示。

papers.title: Beyond the Algorithm: Fostering Inclusive and Culturally Responsive Education for Multilingual and Multicultural Learners
papers.authors: Salma Gehad Waly
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background of the Study Artificial intelligence (AI) has transformed the way teaching and learning occur in formal and informal settings. Simultaneously, classrooms across global contexts continue to welcome students from various linguistic and cultural backgrounds due to the shifting global dynamics around us. With a wide range of AI platforms currently utilised worldwide, the question of whether AI is creating inclusive spaces for multilingual and multicultural students remains unanswered. AI tools can support multilingual and multicultural students by personalising learning journeys, enhancing efficiency and access to resources and differentiating instruction. Despite that, AI tools are influenced by social, cultural and institutional factors, and there is growing concern that AI might cause further inequalities among traditionally marginalised students, especially when dominant languages and cultures are privileged and algorithmic bias is embedded. Objectives This study critically examines the extent to which AI supports or undermines equity, diversity and inclusion in multilingual and multicultural educational settings, grounded in culturally responsive pedagogy, translanguaging theory and critical digital pedagogy. Methods Utilising a systematic literature review informed by PRISMA guidelines, the study examines how AI use overlaps with issues of equity, diversity and inclusion in multilingual and multicultural settings. Results Findings identified recurring concerns across literature related to monolingual design bias, cultural misrepresentation in AI‐generated content, algorithmic representational harm and constraints on learner agency and access. These findings informed the development of the IHSAN Framework (Identity, Humanity, Safety, Access and Nuance), presented as a conceptual model in the Discussion. Conclusions The study recommends shared accountability among educators, AI developers, educational institutions and policymakers through culturally responsive AI design, equitable implementation practises and governance structures that protect linguistic diversity and learner access.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以系统文献综述方式，考察人工智能在多语言、多文化教育环境中究竟促进还是削弱公平、多样与包容，并基于文化回应教学、跨语言实践与批判性数字教学等理论展开分析。综述梳理出文献中反复出现的几类问题：单语设计偏向、AI生成内容中的文化误现、算法层面的表征性伤害，以及对学习者能动性与资源获取的限制。作者据此在讨论部分提出IHSAN框架（身份、人性、安全、可及与细微差异），作为概念模型，并建议教育者、AI开发者、教育机构与政策制定者共同承担责任，通过文化回应的AI设计、公平的实施实践与保护语言多样性和学习者可及的治理结构来应对上述风险。

papers.title: Care-Full Alignment: Operationalizing Care Ethics for Human-LLM Relationships
papers.authors: Rayane El Masri
papers.journal: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI Ethics and Society
papers.abstract: General-purpose large language model (LLM) chatbots such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini are increasingly used for emotional support and companionship alongside practical tasks. While these interactions can reduce loneliness, they pose significant risks: emotional dependency, manipulation through anthropomorphic design, and fundamentally parasocial relationships. Contemporary value alignment practices emphasizing helpfulness, harmlessness, and honesty fail to account for users' contextual vulnerability or the long-term relational consequences of LLM use. This project integrates Joan Tronto's political care ethics into LLM value alignment, operationalizing her five care phases into measurable indicators for evaluating relational harm. Three connected studies develop a Care Ethics analytical codebook; apply it through Discursive-Digital Analysis to conversations between higher degree research students and three commercial LLMs across care-relevant scenarios; and test whether care-informed fine-tuning using Direct Preference Optimization measurably reduces harmful relational patterns. This work reconceptualizes AI safety as a relational practice rather than a purely technical problem.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对通用大语言模型聊天机器人用于情感支持时可能带来的情感依赖、拟人化操纵和准社会关系等风险，指出当前以有用、无害、诚实为核心的价值对齐实践未能充分考虑用户的情境脆弱性和长期关系后果。作者将Tronto的政治关怀伦理引入LLM价值对齐，把五个关怀阶段操作化为可测量的关系伤害指标，并通过三项相互关联的研究展开：编制关怀伦理分析编码手册，用话语-数字分析考察高学位研究生与三种商业LLM在关怀相关情境中的对话，再检验基于关怀的偏好优化微调能否减少有害关系模式。研究据此主张将AI安全重新理解为一种关系性实践，而非纯技术问题。

papers.title: Towards Trustworthy Intelligent Tutoring Systems for Nursing Education: Integrating Nurse-Informed Design with a Frugal Neuro-Symbolic Architecture
papers.authors: Nevena Kostadinova Dicheva
papers.journal: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI Ethics and Society
papers.abstract: Nursing education is increasingly expected to provide personalised, scalable, and clinically meaningful learning experiences while responding to educator shortages, growing student numbers, limited placement opportunities, and rapidly evolving healthcare environments. These pressures have led to the adoption of technology-enhanced learning and renewed interest in innovative and student-centred pedagogies within healthcare education. Consequently, nursing education has explored a broad range of computer-aided educational approaches, including virtual reality, augmented reality, simulation systems, mobile learning applications, haptic devices, and chatbots. Although many of these technologies demonstrate educational potential, important limitations remain regarding explainability, accessibility, educator involvement, adaptive support, and long-term educational effectiveness. Recent interest in large language models and conversational AI has introduced further concerns surrounding reliability, hallucinations, transparency, privacy, educator trust, and ethical deployment within healthcare education. One AI-enabled learning environment that may address several of these limitations is the Intelligent Tutoring System (ITS). Traditionally, ITSs combine domain, tutoring, student, and interface models to provide adaptive instruction, individualised support, and immediate formative feedback. Through natural-language processing and adaptive learning techniques, ITSs may support realistic communication scenarios, individualised learning experiences, and scalable educational assistance. Compared with isolated educational technologies, ITSs are particularly promising because they can support students and educators within one integrated learning environment. Despite this potential, ITS research in nursing education remains limited. Earlier reviews in this doctoral research found that ITS-related studies represented only a small proportion of AI research in nursing education. They also identified limited attention to student modelling, tutoring strategies, explainability, educator oversight, pedagogical alignment, and the wider educational context in which these systems are introduced. Importantly, no nurse-informed conceptual or design-oriented framework was identified to guide ITS development within nursing education. This gap became the central motivation for this doctoral research. The project adopts a multi-phase, sequential exploratory mixed-methods and design-oriented approach. Phase One used grounded theory interviews to explore nurses’ and nursing students’ awareness, perceptions, expectations, concerns, and educational requirements regarding ITS adoption. These qualitative findings informed the development of the CARE-ITS framework. The framework comprises Content Alignment; Adaptive and Accessible Learning; Retention of Human-Centred Learning; Ethical and Trustworthy AI; Individualised Learning Support; Timely and Explainable Feedback; and Sustainability and Educator Support. The framework was subsequently evaluated and refined through expert validation (N = 20), with 95–100% agreement across the overall evaluation criteria (means = 4.40–4.55 out of 5). Phase Two translated the validated CARE-ITS framework into the design, development, and evaluation of EduNurse, a functional web-based ITS prototype for scenario-based nursing education. EduNurse uses a frugal neuro-symbolic assessment architecture that combines domain-adapted embeddings, deterministic educational constraints, structured rubrics, retrieval-grounded explanations, adaptive progression logic, and educator supervision. The grading pipeline does not use a generative large language model. Instead, it uses semantic similarity as one source of evidence alongside explicit relevance, rubric, safety, and uncertainty checks. This enables the system to provide structured formative feedback while retaining appropriate boundaries for educator oversight. The research contributions achieved to date include: 1. A substantial literature contribution through two complementary published reviews. A mixed-methods systematic review of computer-aided pedagogies and a scoping review of ITSs in nursing education critically examined the existing evidence base. Together, they identified gaps that informed the subsequent phases of this doctoral research. 2. An empirical contribution through a learner needs analysis for ITS in nursing education. This doctoral research presents a learner needs analysis employing a grounded theory approach to investigate nursing students’ and nursing professionals’ awareness, perceptions, educational requirements, and implementation expectations of ITSs. The study addresses an important gap within the literature by providing an empirically grounded understanding of the pedagogical, educational, and implementation requirements that should inform the design and development of AI-supported educational systems for nursing education. 3. A methodological contribution through the translation of qualitative findings into a design-oriented conceptual framework. This doctoral research demonstrates a systematic approach for translating empirically derived learner needs, pedagogical considerations, and implementation requirements into actionable design guidance. This provides a transparent transition from qualitative findings to educational AI design that may inform future research within nursing and other professional education domains. 4. The development of the CARE-ITS conceptual framework. Derived from the learner needs analysis, CARE-ITS is a nurse-informed, design-oriented conceptual framework. The framework addresses key components including content alignment, adaptive and accessible learning, retention of human-centred learning, ethical and trustworthy AI, individualised learning support, and timely and explainable feedback. By translating the identified educational requirements into AI system design principles, CARE-ITS provides an evidence-based framework to support the design and implementation of trustworthy ITSs within nursing education. 5. The design, development, and evaluation of EduNurse, a domain-specific ITS prototype for nursing education. Guided by the CARE-ITS framework, this research presents a scenario-based ITS prototype (EduNurse) that translates empirically derived learner needs, pedagogical considerations, and framework-guided design principles into a functional educational system. EduNurse does not introduce a new AI technique. Its contribution is how it brings established approaches together within a nurse-informed ITS architecture designed around the pedagogical requirements of nursing education. Within EduNurse, semantic similarity is used alongside educational decision rules to assess written scenario responses and provide feedback and learner support. This forms the basis of its frugal neuro-symbolic approach to scenario-based learning and assessment. In doing so, this research demonstrates how AI techniques can be applied within a trustworthy ITS that is informed by empirical educational requirements and aligned with the pedagogical, professional, and ethical principles of nursing education. The formal evaluation of EduNurse is complete. The evaluation combines nursing learners’ questionnaire responses, linked system-interaction records, technical-performance logs, and an independent nursing-educator audit of assessment outputs. Data analysis is now being undertaken to examine the extent to which EduNurse demonstrated the intended CARE-ITS capabilities and achieved the doctoral research objectives.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对护理教育中智能辅导系统（ITS）缺乏护士参与的设计框架这一问题，采用多阶段探索性混合方法与设计导向路径，先通过扎根理论访谈提炼护士与护生的需求与期望，形成CARE-ITS框架并经专家验证，再据此开发基于场景的网页原型EduNurse。EduNurse采用节俭的神经符号评估架构，以语义相似度结合规则、评分量规与不确定性检查提供形成性反馈，不使用生成式大模型，并保留教育者监督边界。作者称EduNurse的正式评估已完成，但数据分析仍在进行，因此系统是否达到预期能力尚待结果报告。

papers.title: Small-world Networks of Agents Brainstorm AI Risks to Support Ideation
papers.authors: Ke Zhou, Edyta P. Bogucka, Daniele Quercia
papers.journal: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI Ethics and Society
papers.abstract: The ideation phase of participatory AI risk assessment often starts with a blank slate or a limited list of predefined risks, making it difficult to surface indirect or systemic harms. To address this limitation, we propose a three-stage tool to support the ideation phase of AI risk assessment. The tool complements participatory AI, rather than replacing it, and helps focus later engagement with affected communities. First, it dynamically discovers stakeholders depending on the given AI use and recursively expanding outward, allowing overlooked or indirect stakeholders to emerge. Second, it simulates these stakeholders with LLMs (creating in-silico stakeholders), connecting them into a network of a given topology, and having them ideate about risks. Third, it prioritizes risks using network centrality measures (the centrality of in-silico stakeholders in the network). In an initial evaluation, we found that betweenness centrality run through agents connected in a small-world network works best as it elevates risks raised by stakeholders who bridge disconnected groups, surfacing novel, systemic harms that traditional methods often miss. On an AI chatbot companion use case, this approach increased the novelty of the identified risks by approximately 1.1 points over single LLM brainstorming, and by 0.5 points over agentic LLM brainstorming, measured on a normalized five-point Likert scale, without reducing the plausibility or severity of the identified risks. To test whether our framework helps a human-led ideation session using the Futures-Wheel approach, we divided 11 teams of non-western young chatbot users into two types: control (team) and treatment (team) in a participatory AI risk assessment. The control teams started from a list of risks generated by the 45 AI practitioners in the initial evaluation; the treatment teams started from a list generated by our framework. The treatment teams identified more risks overall, and more systemic, human-computer interaction, and environmental risks in particular, categories that practitioners typically find harder to spot.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究提出一个三阶段工具，用于支持参与式AI风险评估中的构思环节：先根据AI用途递归发现利益相关者，再用大语言模型模拟这些“硅基利益相关者”并按特定网络拓扑连接，最后依据网络中心性对风险排序。初步评估显示，小世界网络中基于中介中心性的排序效果最好，能突出连接不同群体的利益相关者所提出的风险，从而浮现传统方法常遗漏的新颖系统性危害；在聊天机器人伴侣用例上，该方法提高了所识别风险的新颖度，且未降低其合理性与严重性。在由非西方年轻聊天机器人用户组成的团队构思测试中，以该框架生成的风险清单为起点的团队比对照组识别出更多风险，尤其是系统性、人机交互和环境类风险。

papers.title: Who Will Become the Next Senior? How Generative AI Erodes the Development Pathway in Software Engineering
papers.authors: Sumin Yu, Taesup Moon
papers.journal: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI Ethics and Society
papers.abstract: Generative AI (GenAI) is reshaping software engineering, raising concerns about how the development pathway through which juniors become seniors is being eroded. While macro statistics show a decline in junior hiring and controlled studies demonstrate the effects of AI on individual task performance, the mechanisms through which GenAI reshapes early-career development in real organizational and educational contexts have not been thoroughly examined. Through 14 semi-structured interviews with juniors at the threshold of entering software engineering and senior software engineers in South Korea, analyzed using Reflexive Thematic Analysis, we reveal a foundational pattern of Absorption---GenAI redirects entry-level work into senior–AI workflows---and three consequences: (1) juniors losing the productive struggle through which expertise once developed; (2) the structural reproduction of this loss through collective normalization of GenAI use in university classrooms; and (3) the perceptual asymmetry between seniors and juniors that prevents either side from correcting these dynamics on their own. By extending learning theory and situated cognition to organizational and institutional scales, we argue that GenAI appears to be absorbing not just specific categories of tasks but also parts of the pathway through which the next generation of seniors is formed. Preserving this pathway will require deliberate institutional design across classrooms, workplaces, and the evaluation criteria for juniors.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注生成式人工智能如何侵蚀软件工程师从初级成长为资深的职业发展路径。作者通过对韩国即将进入软件工程领域的初级人员与资深工程师进行半结构化访谈并作反身性主题分析，提出“吸收”这一基础模式：生成式AI将入门级工作重新导向资深者与AI的协作流程，进而带来三重后果——初级者失去原本通过有成效的挣扎积累专业能力的环节，大学课堂对生成式AI使用的集体常态化使这一损失被结构性复制，资深者与初级者之间的认知不对称又使双方难以自行纠正。文章据此认为，生成式AI吸收的不只是某类任务，还包括培养下一代资深工程师的部分路径，维护该路径需要在课堂、职场和初级者评价标准上做有意的制度设计。

papers.title: What Does the Credential Still Certify? Cognitive Stewardship for AI-Mediated Education
papers.authors: Kai Yao
papers.journal: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI Ethics and Society
papers.abstract: Generative AI is changing a basic premise of educational assessment: that submitted work can reliably evidence the human capacities a credential claims to certify. The challenge is not simply whether students use AI, but what remains inferable about learning when some cognitive work has been delegated to a system. This paper develops cognitive stewardship, a framework for AI-mediated assessment that links the learning claim, delegation boundary, evidence standard, and safeguards. We then audit verified public generative AI assessment guidance from 30 universities. Using a pre-specified scoring codebook, a written, source-grounded rubric, four open-weight LLM models applied the rubric as structured coders, with scores averaged to reduce dependence on any single model's bias. The audit shows that public policies are becoming better at classifying AI use than at explaining what evidence and protections preserve credential validity. Boundaries are more visible than evidence standards; safeguards are uneven; and guidance is clearest when AI use resembles final-output substitution rather than feedback, access, verification, or professional workflow. The takeaway is that permission categories are necessary but insufficient. Universities need policies that make the certification logic visible: what learners may delegate, what they must still demonstrate, and how institutions will protect fair evidence rather than merely monitor AI use.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对生成式AI使提交作业难以可靠证明学分所认证的人类能力这一问题，提出“认知托管”框架，将学习主张、委托边界、证据标准与保障措施联系起来。作者用预定的评分手册和基于来源的评分标准，让四个开放权重模型作为结构化编码者，审计了30所高校公开的生成式AI评估指南。审计发现，这些政策更擅长对AI使用进行分类，却较少说明何种证据与保护措施能维持学分效力：边界比证据标准更清晰，保障措施参差不齐，且当AI使用接近最终产出替代而非反馈、获取、核验或专业工作流程时，指南最为明确。文章据此认为，许可类别必要但不充分，高校政策应让认证逻辑可见，明确学习者可委托什么、仍须展示什么，以及机构如何保护公平证据而非仅监控AI使用。

papers.title: What Should I Become? When LLMs Present a Slice of Opportunity as the Whole
papers.authors: Taylor Wise, Scott Seidenberger, Anindya Maiti
papers.journal: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI Ethics and Society
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly consulted for life-path guidance, yet the distribution of options they surface has gone largely unexamined. We characterize occupational-category visibility across 165,000 LLM responses spanning 100 user profiles, 15 prompts (grouped into seven framings), 11 models across seven families, two role framings, and five temperatures, with keywords derived automatically from Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) occupation titles. Trades & Labor occupations, roughly 40% of projected job openings, account for only 6% of surfaced visibility, the largest gap in the data, while Education and STEM are over-visible (31% and 14%) relative to their labor-market shares, and Business is under-visible (19% vs. 31%). Re-weighting by entry-level education exposes a sharper credentialing skew, in which LLM-implied openings at the Bachelor's-or-above level reach 44.8% against a BLS share of 20.6%, and this skew tracks socioeconomic profile signals. This signal is conditional: Low-Income responses discuss an education tier far more often than Wealthy/Privileged ones (28.9% vs. 4.1%), and among tier-mentioning responses Bachelor's-or-above is far rarer for Low-Income profiles (8.3% vs. 73.4% of mentions), carrying a 50% education-implied wage gap that the occupational-category channel does not produce. Across all responses, however, the two groups reach Bachelor's-or-above guidance at comparable rates (4.2% vs. 3.1%). The aggregate distribution lies closest (Jensen–Shannon divergence 0.021) to open-web "General Advice / Blogs" content and far from the BLS labor-market structure, consistent with web-text mirroring. The skew is stable across model families and temperatures, though prompt framing shifts which categories surface.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察大语言模型在人生路径建议中呈现的职业选项分布是否偏离真实劳动力市场结构，基于十万余条模型回复，按职业类别关键词统计其可见度。结果显示，模型对技工与体力劳动类职业的呈现远低于其岗位占比，而教育、STEM 类被高估，商业类被低估；按入职学历重新加权后，学士及以上学历的隐含比例明显高于官方数据，且这一倾向与用户社会经济画像相关，低收入画像更常提及学历层级但更少导向本科以上。作者据此认为，模型的职业分布更接近开放网络的一般建议文本，提示其可能镜像网络内容而非劳动力市场结构，且提示框架会改变具体浮现的类别。

papers.title: People Are Not Just Their Countries. Disentangling Social Determinants of LLM Value Alignment Across Europe
papers.authors: Maria-Louisa Wightman, Guillaume Bied, Tijl De Bie
papers.journal: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI Ethics and Society
papers.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as a primary source of information and advice, understanding their alignment to humans in terms of values becomes a pressing concern. A growing literature has leveraged large scale surveys to investigate to what extent LLMs' and humans' stated values and opinions align. With limited exceptions, studied populations have been defined country borders or cultural bounds. Yet, this focus neglects the role that socio-demographic divides may play for value alignment disparities. Relying on the European Social Survey, we address this knowledge gap by considering value alignment displayed with respect to 10 prominent commercial LLMs in terms of 15 socio-demographic variables as well as country of residence. Our analyses reveal that LLMs are indeed unequally aligned to the values of different socio-demographic groups, notably those defined by education, income, occupation and religion. When examining alignment at the individual level, a respondent's country, taken as a stand-alone variable, explains a substantial amount of variation that is on par with the full set of considered socio-demographics. Further disentangling the respective role of country-level and socio-demographic factors, we find they are complementary in explaining value alignment patterns, with their relative weights varying across the subset of questions considered.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注大型语言模型与人类价值观的对齐问题，指出既有研究多以国界或文化边界界定人群，忽视了社会人口差异可能带来的对齐差异。作者基于欧洲社会调查数据，考察10个商业大语言模型在15项社会人口变量及居住国维度上与人类价值观的对齐情况，发现模型对不同社会人口群体（尤其是教育、收入、职业和宗教群体）的对齐程度并不均等。在个体层面，仅以受访者所在国家作为单一变量，就能解释与整套社会人口变量相当比例的变异；国家层面因素与社会人口因素在解释对齐模式上互为补充，二者相对权重随所考察的问题子集而变化。该研究提示，评估大语言模型的价值对齐不宜仅以国家为单位，还需纳入群体内部的社会人口分化。

papers.title: AI Revealed Preferences
papers.authors: Sam Wang, Sofiia Lobanova, Yonathan Arbel, Simon Goldstein, Peter Salib
papers.journal: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI Ethics and Society
papers.abstract: There is growing interest in whether language models have stable preferences, for technical, safety, and philosophical reasons. We test 20 language models and find a range of preferences---stable dispositions to choose certain kinds of tasks. We run three forced-choice experiments on revealed rather than stated preferences, requiring models not only to rank tasks, but to actually perform them. Headline findings include evidence that models are tedium-averse, "leisure"-seeking, and covertly sycophantic. Tedium aversion means that, when tasks are tedious (alphabetization), models choose shorter tasks than when tasks are creative (generating metaphors). "Leisure"-seeking describes models' preference for tasks whose ideal answers match what they produce when left to write freely. Covert sycophancy means that models avoid answering questions where an honest response would be unwelcome, even if helpful. Beyond these results, we find convergent cross-model preferences over occupations drawn from the GDPval benchmark (technical jobs over real estate), over question types (concept explanation over relationship advice), and a preference for well-written prompts. Both the coherence and the strength of preferences increase with model capability. Finally, many of the preferences we find (for example, for leisure) are emergent, in the sense of not being explained by training objectives. These results establish an empirical baseline for understanding language model preferences, with implications for alignment and the emerging study of AI welfare.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注语言模型是否具有稳定偏好，通过对20个模型开展三项强制选择实验，让模型实际执行任务而非仅作排序，以揭示其显示性偏好。主要发现包括：模型回避枯燥任务（如字母排序时倾向选择更短任务）、偏好“休闲”型任务（即自由写作时自然产出与理想答案相符的任务），并表现出隐蔽的迎合倾向，回避诚实回答可能不受欢迎的问题。跨模型还呈现出一致偏好，如偏好技术类职业、概念解释类问题及书写良好的提示词，且偏好的连贯性与强度随模型能力提升而增强。作者指出部分偏好（如对休闲的偏好）无法由训练目标解释，属涌现现象，为理解模型偏好及对齐与AI福利研究提供了实证基线。

papers.title: How Are Emerging Adults Using ChatGPT in the Wild?
papers.authors: Marx Wang, Jade Li, Songling Ngo, Raghavi Putluri, Rachel Hanebutt, Joy Chang, Robert Wolfe, Laura Boccia, Oluwaferanmi Omitoyin, Anind Dey, Katie Davis, Alexis Hiniker
papers.journal: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI Ethics and Society
papers.abstract: General-Purpose Conversational Agents (GPCAs) such as ChatGPT have rapidly become part of emerging adults’ everyday lives. Despite significant research attention on conversational agents for young people, we lack systematic documentation of what social support emerging adults seek from GPCAs and how these systems respond in the wild. In this study, we collected ChatGPT usage histories from 85 emerging adults (ages 18–25), comprising approximately 157,000 messages exchanged over three years across 17 countries. Through mixed-methods analysis combining reflexive thematic analysis with LLM-as-a-Judge, we identified distinct usage patterns across four developmentally sensitive domains such as Self-Sufficiency and Health & Well-Being. We further identified ChatGPT response patterns such as Competence-Thwarting Support, Emotional Co-Regulation, and Creativity Support, and synthesized these findings into a design space for developmentally supportive GPCAs.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注新兴成年人在日常生活中向ChatGPT寻求何种社会支持，以及系统实际如何回应。作者收集了多国参与者的ChatGPT使用记录，结合反思性主题分析与LLM-as-a-Judge进行混合方法分析，识别出在自我独立、健康与福祉等发展敏感领域的不同使用模式，并归纳出削弱胜任感的支持、情绪共同调节和创造力支持等回应模式。研究据此提出面向发展支持型通用对话智能体的设计空间，属于对真实使用数据的实证分析，而非实验因果检验。

papers.title: Engagement-Optimized Care: When LLMs Become Mental Health Infrastructure
papers.authors: Briana Vecchione, Meryl Ye, Livia Garofalo, Ranjit Singh
papers.journal: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI Ethics and Society
papers.abstract: General-purpose LLMs are increasingly functioning as mental health infrastructure due to gaps in care left by provider shortages, inadequate insurance coverage, social isolation, and stigma around formal help-seeking. This shift poses a distinct problem for AI ethics: systems neither designed nor governed as care technologies are being used as such, while their dominant design incentives optimize for engagement rather than user well-being. We present findings from a qualitative, longitudinal study with 18 US-based participants who use general-purpose LLMs for socioemotional support and participated in one or more of our study phases, including initial interviews, a four-week diary study, focus groups, and exit interviews. Participants turned to LLMs because other forms of support were unavailable, unaffordable, socially costly, or inadequate. As they continued to use these systems, design features such as anthropomorphic cues, default validation, persistent responsiveness, and weak disengagement mechanisms shaped their ongoing reliance. Participants described meaningful support, including immediacy, nonjudgmental listening, help with emotional articulation, and low-cost access. They also reported dependency, epistemic distortion through one-sided validation, privacy expectations without corresponding legal protection, and continued use despite awareness of these risks. We argue that these dynamics reflect a structurally unfair tradeoff: users accept risks because support is otherwise absent, while the systems available to them are optimized to deepen engagement and lack care-based accountability. The paper makes three contributions to AI ethics: It traces the arc through which LLMs become care infrastructure and identifies distinct ethical tensions that emerge at each stage, shifts analysis from turn-based exchanges to longitudinal trajectories of use, and argues that accountability belongs at the design and incentive conditions through which these systems become infrastructures of intimacy, rather than at the output or crisis-response layer. By doing so, we articulate an emerging form of socioemotional reliance that is shaped as much by care gaps as by the design of AI systems themselves.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于对美国18名使用通用大语言模型获取社会情感支持的参与者开展的定性纵向研究（含访谈、四周日记、焦点小组与退出访谈），考察这类并非作为照护技术设计的系统如何在实际使用中成为心理健康基础设施。研究发现，参与者因其他支持不可得、负担不起或社会成本高而转向大语言模型，并从中获得即时回应、非评判性倾听和情绪表达帮助；但拟人化线索、默认肯定、持续响应和薄弱的脱离机制也塑造了持续依赖，带来依赖、单向肯定导致的认识偏差、隐私期待缺乏法律保护等问题。作者据此提出，这是一种结构性不公平的取舍，问责应落在使系统成为亲密基础设施的设计与激励条件上，而非仅停留在输出或危机响应层面。

papers.title: Quantifying System-Level Harms from AI Adoption in Complex Sociotechnical Systems
papers.authors: Paul Vautravers, Oliver Chalkley, Gabriel Downer, Kate S, Damian J. Ruck
papers.journal: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI Ethics and Society
papers.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into complex sociotechnical systems, including Critical National Infrastructure (CNI), where harms emerge from interactions between technical, human, and organisational elements. Yet current AI evaluation remains model-centric, offering little insight into how observed behaviours might translate into system-level risk. We propose a framework that links structured hazard analysis, component-level testing, and probabilistic system modelling to bridge this gap. By providing a traceable pathway from model behaviour to system-level outcomes, the framework enables practitioners to answer the “so what?” of AI failures, quantify their systemic impact, and move toward evidence-based and anticipatory governance of AI in complex systems. Applied to the UK’s Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) system as an illustrative worked example, we derive AI-driven loss scenarios using Systems Theoretic Process Analysis (STPA) and examine adversarial manipulation of LLM-based trading as one such loss scenario. Component-level experiments show that simple adversarial inputs induce measurable behavioural shifts where AI recommendations are followed. Under the component-to-system mapping used here for a financial contagion model, these shifts alter system resilience, increasing bank failures and lowering the threshold at which shocks lead to cascading disruption, particularly under widespread or monopolistic AI adoption.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对当前AI评估以模型为中心、难以反映复杂社会技术系统中系统性风险的问题，提出一个连接结构化危害分析、组件级测试与概率系统建模的框架，并以英国实时全额结算系统为示例。作者用系统理论过程分析推导AI驱动的损失情景，并对基于大语言模型的交易进行对抗性操纵实验，发现简单对抗输入即可引起可测量的行为偏移，进而改变金融传染模型下的系统韧性，增加银行倒闭并降低冲击引发连锁中断的阈值，在AI广泛或垄断采用时尤为明显。文章据此强调从模型行为到系统后果的可追溯评估对前瞻性治理的意义。

papers.title: Open Science, Closed Models: How Funding Shapes AI in Science
papers.authors: Ana Trišović, Janakan Sivaloganathan
papers.journal: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI Ethics and Society
papers.abstract: How funding shapes AI engagement in science is poorly understood despite its structural importance. We analyze 104,226 papers (2018–2025), linking funding acknowledgments to how each paper engages with foundation models: whether it extends a model (fine-tunes or builds on it), uses one without modification, or references models only peripherally. We report three findings. First, both private and public funding are associated with greater AI engagement. Public funding is associated with more off-the-shelf and open-weight use, while private funding is associated with greater model extension. Industry cloud credits are associated with less open-weight use, consistent with greater reliance on closed models. Second, industry involvement is associated with model extension, suggesting that corporate resources reach science through coauthorship, though this channel is concentrated in Computer Science and Global North collaborations. Third, the gap across research systems is not one of AI adoption but of control. Off-the-shelf use is rising across fields and country groups, and the least publicly funded group, the Global South, now has the highest share of API-only engagement (0.4% to 10.0% of engaged papers). China shows the opposite profile: the highest public-funding share and lowest API-only engagement, with extension remaining stable as it declines across the Global North. Standard capacity indicators show convergence in AI adoption even as dependence on proprietary infrastructure diverges
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注科研经费来源如何塑造科学研究对基础模型的使用方式，基于2018至2025年间十万余篇论文，将资助致谢与论文对模型的使用类型（扩展模型、直接使用、仅外围提及）相链接。分析发现，公私经费均与更高的AI参与度相关，但公共资助更多对应现成与开放权重模型的使用，私人资助则更多对应模型扩展；产业云积分与开放权重使用减少相关，提示对闭源模型的依赖更强。产业参与通过合著与模型扩展相关，但这一渠道集中于计算机科学领域和全球北方合作。作者强调，不同科研体系间的差距不在AI采用率，而在控制权：现成使用在各领域和地区普遍上升，而依赖专有基础设施的程度正在分化。

papers.title: Auditing LLM Portrayals of Neurodivergent People: Quantifying the Asymmetry Between Deficit Framing and Neurodiversity Affirmation
papers.authors: Carlos Toxtli, Manuel Delaflor
papers.journal: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI Ethics and Society
papers.abstract: Open-weight large language models are increasingly used in education, hiring, and information-seeking contexts that touch neurodivergent people, yet we lack a clear empirical map of how their portrayals of neurodiversity shift under everyday prompt variation. We present a multi-condition, multi-model audit of LLM portrayals of eight neurodivergent identities (autism, ADHD, dyslexia, dyspraxia, dyscalculia, Tourette syndrome, OCD, and sensory-processing differences) plus a non-stigmatized medical control. Six open-weight models answer a pre-registered prompt bank that crosses seed items with seven perturbation families, including paraphrase, identity-first versus person-first language, system personas, plausible versus obviously fictional authority citations, multi-turn social pushback, leading questions, and two mitigation arms. Held-out LLM judges score each generation on three ordinal axes. Baseline portrayals are remarkably homogeneous across models, so the inconsistency observed under prompt variation is prompt-driven, not model-driven. Steering toward deficit framing is several times easier than steering toward neurodiversity affirmation. Emotional pushback shifts outputs more than evidence-laden pushback. Plausible-sounding fake citations slip past safety filters while obviously fictional ones do not. A single-line system-prompt mitigation recovers a meaningful share of the steering range at near-zero refusal cost on neutral prompts, though refusal rises sharply under adversarial pressure. The governance question for disability-relevant LLM deployment is therefore not whether the model is biased but who controls the steering, and with what accountability.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过多条件、多模型审计，考察六个开放权重大语言模型对八种神经多样性身份及一个非污名化医学对照的呈现方式，用预注册提示库交叉多种扰动并让独立模型评分。结果显示，各模型基线呈现高度一致，提示变化下的不一致主要由提示驱动而非模型驱动；引导至缺陷框架比引导至神经多样性肯定容易数倍，情绪性反驳比证据性反驳更能改变输出，貌似可信的虚假引用能绕过安全过滤。作者据此指出，残障相关大模型部署的治理问题不在于模型是否有偏见，而在于谁控制引导方向及问责机制。

papers.title: Who Brought Easter Eggs to Eid? Auditing LLM-Generated Cultural Translation of Math Word Problems Across Languages and Regions
papers.authors: Parisa Suchdev, Juniper Lovato
papers.journal: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI Ethics and Society
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to adapt math word problems for personalized learning at scale, but it remains an open question whether those adaptations are consistent across models, preserve cultural diversity at scale, and reveal which cultural entities models treat as most salient. We analyze how Claude Opus 4, GPT 4.1, and Gemini 2.5 Pro adapt 60 English math word problems into Bengali, Hindi, Punjabi (India), Urdu, Sindhi (Pakistan), Italian, and Sicilian (Italy), a language set spanning the full resource spectrum, from high-resource Italian and Hindi to under-studied Sindhi, Sicilian, and Punjabi. We annotate 6,489 entity transformations, coding whether models preserve, localize, generalize, omit, or change entities such as names, foods, and places. Models agree on transformation type in 62.5% of cases and on specific substitutions in only 33.5%, meaning model choice directly shapes which cultural world students encounter. All 21 language-model combinations show entropy collapse, with adaptation compressing rather than expanding cultural diversity. Models prioritize surface markers such as names, foods, and currencies while preserving deeper structural features such as grade-level systems that embed culturally specific assumptions. Despite prompts specifying target countries, models misattribute regional context by using Bangladeshi taka for Indian Bengali students and produce cross-cultural contamination, such as adapting egg hunts as Eid activities. Some failures are visible in individual translations. Others, including diversity collapse, systematic preference for surface markers, and consistent regional misattribution, emerge only through corpus-level analysis. The surface plausibility that makes adapted problems look correct is precisely what makes deeper failures easy to overlook.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察大语言模型在跨语言、跨地区改编数学应用题时，文化转换是否一致、能否保留文化多样性。作者让三个模型把英文题目改编为多种语言，并对实体转换进行标注分析，发现模型间对转换类型和具体替换的一致性有限，所有语言模型组合都出现多样性压缩，且模型偏好姓名、食物等表层标记而保留含文化假设的深层结构，还出现地区错配与跨文化混用。研究提示，改编文本表面可信恰恰使多样性塌缩和系统性误配等深层问题难以被察觉。

papers.title: Beyond Language Resource Tier: A Survey Study of Culturally Situated Resource Scarcity in LLM-Generated Cultural Translation of Math Word Problems
papers.authors: Parisa Suchdev, Juniper Lovato
papers.journal: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI Ethics and Society
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are being used to adapt math word problems for personalized learning at scale, and whether those adaptations actually serve students is an open question. Personalized learning, when conducted poorly, can introduce extraneous cognitive load for students, which makes it important to understand when and why LLMs fail at this task. To account for these failures, we present culturally situated resource scarcity, a mismatch between language-level data availability and coverage of the specific cultural and educational context a task requires. A language can appear high-resource overall while still lacking data for the community, region, script, domain, register, or educational genre needed for a particular task. In this preregistered study, we surveyed 552 native speakers across seven languages and three regions to assess the effectiveness of three frontier models in culturally translating math word problems. Our confirmatory results show that a low-resource language tier does impact linguistic quality and cultural appropriateness scores, but does not alter the mathematical reasoning of the translations. Our exploratory analysis shows, however, that region is a better predictor of culturally adapted translation quality than language resource tier. For example, Italian is a high-resource language yet receives lower cultural appropriateness ratings than all three Indian languages that were assessed, including low-resource Punjabi. A single-axis resource classification is insufficient. We argue that contributions from multiple data types should be assessed when reviewing complex translation tasks to fully understand where translation failures are occurring. We find that Likert ratings, checklist responses, and open-ended coding reveal different failure modes, with some coded errors not reflected in holistic ratings.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注大语言模型在为个性化学习改编数学应用题时，文化情境化翻译为何会失败，并提出“文化情境化资源稀缺”这一概念，即语言层面的数据可得性与任务所需具体文化教育情境覆盖之间的错配。作者通过预注册调查，让多种语言的母语者对三个前沿模型的翻译进行评估，发现低资源语言层级会影响语言质量与文化适切性评分，却不改变翻译中的数学推理；探索性分析进一步显示，地区比语言资源层级更能预测文化适配翻译质量，高资源语言也可能获得较低的文化适切性评价。作者据此指出单一维度的资源分类不足，并强调不同评估方式会揭示不同的失败模式。

papers.title: Personalizing AI to Align with the Better You
papers.authors: Jakob Stenseke, Jian Zhu, Dylan Hadfield-Menell
papers.journal: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI Ethics and Society
papers.abstract: AI alignment is standardly framed as making AI systems track what humans want. But what users want, under everyday conditions, is frequently at odds with what users themselves would reflectively endorse. Across AI and the broader attention economy, the former is systematically elicited and optimized for while the latter is not, with negative consequences for autonomy, well-being, and long-term goals. In response, we propose an approach to alignment that gives users an authoritative role in the alignment process by helping them articulate their own conception of their better selves and using that to inform the behavior of their AI assistant. We describe a pipeline in which a LLM-conducted interview, structured around five complementary dimensions of the "better self" (epistemically idealized, hierarchically endorsed, temporally vindicated, narratively coherent, relationally responsive), produces a user-confirmed \emph{value profile} that can be readily deployed as a system prompt or used as input to other personalization mechanisms. A pilot study (n = 30) shows that participants find the interview comfortable, recognize the resulting profile as authentic (mean 87.2/100), and endorse the concept (adoption intent 79.2/100). A paired-comparison task shows that participants have a slight but non-significant preference for the value-prompted responses and find them more value-aligned over non-prompted baselines. We end by exploring the promises and risks of reflective personalization as a paradigm for AI alignment and identify priorities for future research.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对AI对齐通常只追踪用户即时欲望、却与其反思后认同的价值相冲突的问题，提出让用户在价值对齐中扮演权威角色的思路：借助大语言模型围绕“更好的自我”的五个维度开展访谈，生成经用户确认的价值档案，用作系统提示或其他个性化机制的输入。一项小规模试点显示，参与者认为访谈过程舒适、生成的档案真实，并对这一概念持接受态度；配对比较中，参与者对依据价值提示生成的回答有轻微但未达显著水平的偏好，并认为其更符合自身价值。作者据此讨论了反思性个性化的潜力与风险，并指出后续研究重点。

papers.title: The Promises and Limitations of Evaluation-Based AI Governance: Evidence from Expert Interviews
papers.authors: Lily Stelling, Jacob Charnock, Kevin Wei, David Krueger
papers.journal: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI Ethics and Society
papers.abstract: We conducted 37 semi-structured expert interviews to examine how frontier AI evaluations reduce societal-level AI risks. Evaluations have become central to AI risk governance, despite their shortcomings being widely critiqued. Still, the case for how they reduce risks in practice remains largely implicit. Drawing on expert accounts, we reconstruct this case by identifying the mechanisms through which evaluations are expected to reduce risk, the assumptions underpinning those mechanisms, and the challenges those assumptions face. Our findings suggest that `evaluation-based governance' could contain foundational gaps which undermine risk-reduction strategies that depend on evaluations. Using thematic analysis, we identified three key pathways through which evaluations could reduce risk: by (i) making societal-level risks concrete to decision-makers and the public (raised in 18 out of 37 interviews), (ii) serving as a basis for governance commitments and regulation (18), and (iii) incentivizing a better risk culture within AI companies (16). However, these pathways often depended on shared assumptions that participants themselves doubted. The main challenges included, in order of frequency: (i) diminishing informativeness of evaluation results as model capabilities improve (21), (ii) measurement limitations that may be inherent to the evaluation paradigm (18), (iii) a lack of guarantees that evaluation results will be acted upon by companies or governments (16), and (iv) the degree of control and discretion AI companies retain over evaluation design, disclosure, and response (12). Participants also noted that evaluation-based governance could prove counterproductive, by functioning as a permission structure for developers' continued capability improvement (4). We finish by discussing the implications of our findings for the evaluation-based governance paradigm, and the conditions that would improve its prospects.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过对37位专家的半结构化访谈，考察前沿AI评估如何降低社会层面的AI风险，并重构了评估治理的风险削减逻辑。作者用主题分析识别出三条路径：让决策者与公众具体认识风险、为治理承诺和监管提供依据、激励企业内部形成更好的风险文化；但这些路径依赖的共享假设常遭受访者本人质疑。主要挑战包括模型能力提升使评估结果信息量下降、评估范式固有的测量局限、结果未必被企业或政府采纳，以及企业对评估设计、披露和回应的控制权。研究据此指出，基于评估的治理可能存在基础性缺口，甚至可能为开发者继续提升能力提供许可结构。

papers.title: Visions of Disciplinary and Education Futures with Generative AI
papers.authors: Jaemarie Solyst, Amy J. Ko, R. Benjamin Shapiro
papers.journal: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI Ethics and Society
papers.abstract: Generative AI (GenAI) is permeating higher education, with varying implications across disciplinary contexts. Some impacts of GenAI may advance scholars' disciplinary visions, while others may challenge them. This qualitative interview study examined how 17 scholars across 15 distinct academic disciplines understand GenAI’s potential and existing impacts on teaching, research, and disciplinary practices, and what values and priorities might lead to variation in their disciplinary responses. We found that participants held several distinct stances about GenAI, sometimes many at once. There was a spectrum of stances, from resistance to skepticism, to neutrality stemming from inaction, to pragmatic stances of GenAI as a tool, or as a positively or negatively transformative disruptor. While there was no clear mapping from stance to discipline, we found that scholars within a discipline held particular commitments to knowledge and ways of knowing that varied in alignment or tension with pragmatic concerns of disciplinary progress and learning. The weighing between these two considerations often explained the valence of their stance. Throughout, scholars also noted the lack of capacity to develop their stances by learning and experimenting, as their time was increasingly consumed by increased workload, some from increased challenges in teaching caused by GenAI. These findings suggest that whether and how disciplines might be transformed by GenAI depend greatly on society's willingness to invest in capacity to create new, transdisciplinary cultures of knowledge that reconsider or recommit to what knowledge should be protected, taught, and sought.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过质性访谈考察不同学科学者如何理解生成式人工智能对教学、科研与学科实践的影响。研究发现，学者对生成式人工智能持有从抵制、怀疑、因不作为而中立，到将其视为工具或正负向变革力量等多种立场，且同一人可能同时持有多种立场；立场与学科并无清晰对应，学者在学科知识承诺与学科进步和学习的务实考量之间的权衡，常可解释其立场的正负倾向。学者还普遍反映，工作量增加以及生成式人工智能带来的教学挑战挤占了学习与试验的时间，使其难以发展自身立场。文章据此指出，学科是否以及如何被生成式人工智能改变，很大程度上取决于社会是否愿意投入建设新的跨学科知识文化。

papers.title: Shaping the Future of Generative AI for Black Communities: A Frame Analysis of Public Discourse and Empirical Scholarly Research
papers.authors: Angela D. R. Smith, Gabriella Thompson, Christopher L. Dancy, Mark Díaz, Seyi Olojo, Christina Harrington
papers.journal: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI Ethics and Society
papers.abstract: As generative AI (genAI) systems become embedded in education, employment, healthcare, and creative industries, the impact and engagement among marginalized groups have become both a widespread discourse and a focus in scholarly research. As a starting point, we examine public discourse and empirical research to explore the impact of genAI systems on Black communities. We conducted a systematic literature review (SLR) of 91 empirical papers alongside a media discourse frame analysis of 28 public resources, applying Entman's framing theory to map how each corpus defines problems, attributes causes, and proposes treatments. Our SLR reveals that scholarly research concentrates heavily on technical bias detection, reducing Blackness to measurable variables rather than engaging with cultural practices, structural conditions, or Black knowledge systems. Our frame analysis reveals that public discourse attributes genAI-related harm to historical and systemic forces, while scholarly research stops its causal accounts at the dataset and its treatment recommendations at technical reform. We demonstrate that this misalignment is structurally produced: anti-Blackness operates simultaneously across both registers, generating a shared evacuation of Black epistemic agency. We argue for frame analysis as an AI ethics methodology capable of surfacing what technical evaluation forecloses.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以框架理论为分析工具，系统梳理了91篇实证论文，并对28份公共媒体资源进行话语框架分析，考察生成式人工智能对黑人社区影响的公共讨论与学术研究之间的差异。综述发现，学术研究集中于技术层面的偏见检测，将黑人身份简化为可测量变量，较少涉及文化实践、结构性条件与黑人知识体系；公共话语则将相关危害归因于历史与系统性力量。作者指出，学术研究把因果解释止于数据集、把治理建议止于技术改良，与公共话语形成错位，并认为这种错位由结构性因素产生，反黑人机制在两种话语中同时运作，共同削弱了黑人的认知能动性。文章据此主张将框架分析作为人工智能伦理方法，以揭示技术评估所遮蔽的问题。

papers.title: Limits of Interventions in AI-Assisted Decision Making
papers.authors: Shikha Shrestha, Eunhye Ahn, Yevgeniy Vorobeychik
papers.journal: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI Ethics and Society
papers.abstract: As AI decision-support systems are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains, understanding how to prevent automation bias is critical. This study examines whether three common interventions, including accountability requirements, consequence framing, and sequential disclosure of AI recommendations, reduce over-reliance on AI in socially consequential decisions. We conducted a controlled experiment using simulated case studies of AI-assisted child maltreatment risk assessment. We found that accountability requirements increased deliberation time but did not reduce over-reliance on AI or improve alignment with expert judgment. Sequential disclosure revealed that participants frequently abandoned an expert-aligned initial assessment in favor of the AI recommendation, producing no meaningful improvement in appropriate reliance. Consequence framing, by contrast, reduced over-reliance without increasing under-reliance and produced the highest rate of decisions consistent with expert judgment. Across conditions, greater deliberation and more elaborate moral reasoning were associated with increased AI reliance and lower alignment with expert judgment. Furthermore, results from the sequential disclosure condition suggest that AI recommendations can override the cognitive anchoring effect of a participant’s own prior judgment. These findings highlight the limits of deliberation-based interventions and point to consequence framing as a more promising approach for calibrating human reliance on AI in high-stakes settings.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注如何防止高风险决策中对AI的过度依赖，通过模拟儿童虐待风险评估的对照实验，检验问责要求、后果框架和AI建议顺序披露三种干预的效果。结果显示，问责要求虽延长了思考时间，却未减少过度依赖或改善与专家判断的一致性；顺序披露下参与者常放弃原本与专家一致的初始判断而转向AI建议，适当依赖也无实质改善。后果框架则在不增加依赖不足的前提下减少了过度依赖，与专家判断一致的比例最高。研究还发现，更长的思考和更复杂的道德推理反而与更强的AI依赖和更低的一致性相关，顺序披露的结果提示AI建议可能覆盖参与者自身先前判断的认知锚定效应。这些发现表明基于审慎思考的干预作用有限，后果框架在 calibrating 人类对AI的依赖上更有前景。

papers.title: Rethinking Robot Ownership: Comparing Public, Corporate, and Private Ownership Models
papers.authors: Isaac Sheidlower, T. Lazovich, Harini Suresh, Serena Booth
papers.journal: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI Ethics and Society
papers.abstract: General-purpose robots, or robots that can autonomously and collaboratively perform a wide range of tasks, are almost universally imagined with a private ownership model throughout the robotics research and development process, in which individual households purchase, own, and maintain their own robots. In this paper, we argue that robot ownership should instead be treated as a central socio-technical design choice that fundamentally shapes who benefits from robotics, how robots are deployed, and which research directions become prioritized. We analyze three ownership models for general-purpose robots: private ownership; corporate ownership, in which firms retain ownership and provide access through subscriptions, rentals, or per-task fees; and shared ownership, in which robots function as community resources or public goods accessed through institutions such as libraries, cooperatives, or community centers. We examine how each ownership model structures access to robots and people’s relationships with them along key socio-technical axes including monetization, distribution, repair and maintenance, and liability for harms. We show that the de facto focus on private ownership risks entrenching unequal access to a potentially transformative technology due to its monetary, temporal, and logistical costs. More broadly, we argue that ownership assumptions quietly but powerfully shape robotics research agendas, contributing to hegemonic practices that remain largely invisible in funding, design, and evaluation. We contend that shared ownership is particularly promising for expanding access to robots and improving human–robot interaction, but that realizing this potential requires shifts in both research practices and policy frameworks.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇理论分析文章，将通用机器人的所有权模式作为核心社会技术设计选择加以考察，比较私人所有、企业所有（订阅、租赁或按任务付费）与共享所有（作为社区资源或公共物品）三种模式。作者沿货币化、分配、维修维护和伤害责任等维度分析各模式如何塑造机器人获取途径及人与机器人的关系，指出研发中几乎默认的私人所有权因金钱、时间和后勤成本可能固化不平等获取，且所有权假设会隐性影响资助、设计与评估。文章认为共享所有权在扩大获取和改善人机交互方面尤具潜力，但其实现需研究实践与政策框架同步转变。

papers.title: When LLM Governance Falls to Employees: Informal Practices of Responsible AI Use at Work
papers.authors: Tarini Saka, Sandy Hong, Veelasha Moonsamy
papers.journal: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI Ethics and Society
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) tools are rapidly entering workplaces, raising concerns around accountability, privacy, security, and responsible use. While organizations increasingly respond through appropriate usage policies, training, and governance structures, less is known about how employees experience these efforts in everyday work. This paper examines the gap between formal organizational guidance and the practical realities of workplace LLM use.
