papers.abstract: Anthropomorphic robots are increasingly prominent technologies, yet how variations in robot gaze are associated with human perception and visual engagement remain poorly understood. We examined this with a multi-method design spanning three complementary levels: subjective ratings assessed whether an uncanny-valley pattern was present across the tested gaze combinations, individual-difference measures tested moderation effects by personality and attitudes, and eye movements characterized how the robot's face is visually explored. We presented a virtual robot across nine gaze conditions, systematically varying direct-to-averted gaze ratios and durations within a storytelling scenario. Participants ( N = 61) rated each robot's anthropomorphism, likability, and perceived empathy while their eye movements were recorded, and their personality traits and attitudes toward robots were assessed. Results showed that (1) the relationship between perceived anthropomorphism and likability followed an uncanny-valley pattern (a significant cubic relationship), whereas perceived empathy increased monotonically with anthropomorphism; (2) exploratory analyses showed that extraversion and negative attitudes toward robots moderated the relationship between anthropomorphism and likability, while neuroticism moderated the relationship between anthropomorphism and perceived empathy; (3) Eye Movement analysis with Hidden Markov Models (EMHMM) identified two viewing patterns (analytic and holistic) and participants higher in openness viewed the highest-rated robot gaze more analytically and the uncanny robot gaze more holistically. These findings indicate that an uncanny valley pattern was observed across the tested gaze-timing combinations and that individual differences may be associated with variation in robot evaluations and visual attention patterns.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察虚拟机器人在讲故事场景中不同注视时机组合（直视与移开视线的比例和时长）与人类感知及视觉参与的关系，结合主观评分、个体差异测量和眼动记录三种手段。结果显示，感知拟人度与喜爱度之间呈三次方关系，符合恐怖谷模式，而感知共情随拟人度单调上升；外向性和对机器人的负面态度调节拟人度与喜爱度的关系，神经质调节拟人度与共情的关系。眼动分析识别出分析型与整体型两种观看模式，开放性较高者对评分最高的注视更偏分析型、对恐怖谷注视更偏整体型。作者据此指出，在所测试的注视时机组合中观察到恐怖谷模式，个体差异可能与机器人评价和视觉注意的差异相关。

papers.title: The invisible signature: Top-down bias in aesthetic evaluation of visual and textual AI-generated art
papers.authors: Cinzia Di Dio, Federico Manzi, Giulia Peretti, Federico Longoni, Vittorio Gallese M. D, Davide Massaro, Gabriella Gilli, Antonella Marchetti
papers.abstract: The rapid evolution of generative AI has blurred the boundaries between human and machine art making, raising questions about how authorship information shapes the evaluation of creative products. This study extends previous research by examining how attributed authorship influences the evaluation of genuinely AI-generated art by directly comparing expressive modalities, namely prose (ChatGPT) and images (DALL·E), while also accounting for participant- and stimulus-related characteristics. Participants (N = 121 Italian adults) first evaluated stimuli under a blind baseline condition and then a different, balanced set accompanied by an explicit human- or AI-attribution label. Mixed repeated-measures GLMs examined whether evaluations changed from baseline to disclosure as a function of attributed authorship; educational level and perceived complexity were then entered stepwise as covariates to assess whether the observed pattern was sensitive to participant- and stimulus-related variability, respectively. Across models, evaluations decreased following AI attribution, whereas they remained stable following human attribution. Before covariate adjustment, the baseline-to-disclosure decrease was stronger for texts than for images and varied across evaluative dimensions, with the largest decreases observed for subjective and objective aesthetic judgments, a smaller near-threshold change for emotion, and comparatively stable originality. After educational level and perceived complexity were taken into account, modality- and dimension-related differences were no longer evident in the final model, suggesting that these effects were partly intertwined with characteristics of the participants and stimuli. By contrast, the differential response to attributed authorship persisted after adjustment. These findings confirm that source attribution exerts a robust top-down influence on the appraisal of AI-generated creative products, while differences across expressive modalities and evaluative dimensions provide a more fine-grained account of how this influence is expressed within aesthetic evaluation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察作者归属信息如何影响人们对真正由AI生成作品的审美评价，并直接比较文本（ChatGPT）与图像（DALL·E）两种表达模态。参与者先在无标签基线下评价刺激，再在标明人类或AI归属的条件下评价另一组平衡刺激，分析评价变化是否随归属来源而不同。结果显示，标注为AI归属后评价整体下降，而人类归属下保持稳定；这一差异在控制教育水平和感知复杂度后依然存在，说明来源归属对AI生成创意产品的评价具有稳健的自上而下影响。文本与图像、不同评价维度间的差异在纳入协变量后不再明显，提示其部分与参与者和刺激特征相关。

papers.title: Constructing Selves in AI ‐Mediated Apprenticeship Learning: Students of Colour's Narratives of Agency, Recognition and Negotiation
papers.authors: Eugene Kwasi Gyekye
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming computer‐assisted learning, yet little is known about how students of colour engage with AI within authentic educational settings. Existing research has focused primarily on academic integrity, efficiency and technological adoption, with comparatively less attention to students' own experiences of AI‐mediated learning. Objectives This study examined how students of colour in online apprenticeship programs constructed narratives of agency, recognition and negotiation while engaging with generative AI and what these experiences reveal about AI‐mediated learning within apprenticeship education. Methods A qualitative narrative inquiry was conducted over 9 months with five secondary school apprentices participating in online placements across healthcare, government, finance, technology and public service. Data comprised repeated narrative interviews, classroom observations, digital artifacts and field notes, which were analyzed using manual narrative coding. Results Three interconnected patterns emerged. First, students exercised agency by strategically using, refusing, verifying, revising and disclosing AI in ways that maintained authorship and credibility. Second, participants viewed AI as procedurally fair while also recognizing that generic responses often overlooked their cultural and linguistic identities. Third, students negotiated tensions between AI‐generated outputs and institutional expectations through continual verification and adaptation, while proposing design features that would better support transparency, learning and equitable participation. Conclusions The findings suggest that effective AI‐mediated learning extends beyond technical proficiency to include learners' capacity to exercise agency, establish legitimate authorship and experience meaningful recognition within educational contexts. The study introduces Institutional AI Literacy and Recognition Bandwidth as interpretive concepts for understanding how students of colour navigate AI within apprenticeship learning and highlights the importance of designing AI systems that support transparent, equitable and culturally responsive learning experiences.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注有色人种学生在生成式人工智能介导的学徒学习中如何建构能动性、被认可与协商的叙事，采用为期数月的质性叙事探究，对五名参加线上实习的中学生进行多次叙事访谈并结合课堂观察、数字作品与田野笔记分析。研究发现三类相互关联的模式：学生通过策略性地使用、拒绝、核实、修改和披露AI来维护作者身份与可信度；他们一方面认为AI在程序上是公平的，另一方面也指出通用化回应常忽视其文化与语言身份；学生通过持续核实与调整来协商AI产出与机构期望之间的张力，并提出改善透明度、学习与公平参与的设计建议。文章据此提出“机构性AI素养”与“认可带宽”两个解释性概念，强调有效的AI介导学习不仅涉及技术熟练度，还包括学习者行使能动性、确立正当作者身份并获得有意义认可的能力。

papers.title: Rethinking Giftedness in the Age of Generative AI: A Relational Epistemic Agency Model for Advanced Learners
papers.authors: Çiğdem Nilüfer Umar
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence can enhance the quality and visibility of advanced learners’ work while making it harder to determine what the resulting performance reveals about their independent competence. This theoretical paper develops the Relational Epistemic Agency Model for Advanced Learners (REAM-AL) through a structured database search and an integrative synthesis of scholarship on talent development, extended and distributed cognition, cognitive offloading, metacognition, epistemic agency, intellectual ownership, transfer, and assessment validity. The model organizes five focal constructs across four analytical layers: developmental epistemic readiness, cognitive task distribution, epistemic decision distribution, intellectual ownership, and the relationship among supported performance, independent competence, and transfer. Their configuration may produce relational cognitive extension, in which AI broadens thinking while epistemic authority remains with the learner, or developmental substitution, in which the system performs operations the learner is expected to develop. REAM-AL treats these as interaction patterns rather than fixed student categories. It offers a framework for task design and assessment that distinguishes joint human–AI performance from independently sustained and transferable competence. The proposed constructs and relationships remain theoretical and require direct testing with advanced children and adolescents across varied tasks, developmental periods, and AI conditions.
papers.summary_zh: 该理论文章针对生成式人工智能在提升资优学习者作品质量的同时、使其独立能力更难被辨识这一问题，通过结构化数据库检索与多领域文献整合，提出面向高阶学习者的关系性认知能动性模型（REAM-AL）。模型围绕发展性认知准备、认知任务分配、认知决策分配、知识所有权，以及支持性表现与独立能力及迁移之间的关系展开，指出这些构念的不同配置可能形成关系性认知扩展（AI拓展思维而认知权威仍属学习者）或发展性替代（系统代行学习者本应发展的操作），并将二者视为互动模式而非固定的学生类别。文章据此提出区分人机联合表现与可独立维持、可迁移能力的任务设计与评估框架，同时说明相关构念与关系仍属理论层面，尚需在资优儿童与青少年中直接检验。

papers.title: Achievement emotions in AI-assisted learning, academic self-efficacy, and learning engagement and AI dependence among university students in statistics-related programs: a moderated mediation study
papers.authors: Huijuan Qin, Kun Liu
papers.abstract: Background Generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools have become part of everyday coursework for university students, yet the emotional and motivational conditions under which these tools support or undermine learning remain poorly understood. Drawing on the control-value theory of achievement emotions, this study examined whether academic self-efficacy mediates the links of positive achievement emotions in AI-assisted learning with learning engagement and AI dependence, and whether AI literacy moderates the first stage of these pathways. Methods A cross-sectional survey was conducted with 700 undergraduate students (386 female; M_age = 19.81 years, SD = 1.27) majoring in applied statistics and related programs at three universities in Shijiazhuang, China. Participants completed measures of positive and negative achievement emotions, academic self-efficacy, learning engagement, AI dependence, and AI literacy. Confirmatory factor analysis preceded a first-stage moderated mediation analysis with bias-corrected bootstrap confidence intervals (5,000 resamples), controlling for negative emotions, gender, and year of study. Results The six-factor measurement model fitted the data well, χ 2 (50) = 55.62, p = 0.271, CFI = 0.998, RMSEA = 0.013, SRMR = 0.017. Positive achievement emotions predicted higher self-efficacy ( β = 0.374), which in turn predicted stronger engagement ( β = 0.395) and lower AI dependence ( β = −0.176), all p < 0.001, with AI literacy entered in every equation. AI literacy moderated the emotion-efficacy association ( β = 0.152, p < 0.001): the conditional indirect association with engagement rose from 0.088 to 0.208 across ±1 SD of AI literacy, and that with AI dependence fell from −0.039 to −0.093. The direct association with AI dependence was positive ( β = 0.447, p < 0.001), and the conditional total association remained positive (0.355 to 0.408). Both indexes of moderated mediation were significant. Conclusion Positive emotional experiences in AI-assisted coursework show beneficial and costly associations simultaneously, and self-efficacy statistically accounts for opposing parts of each. The total association with dependence remained positive at all literacy levels, so the results describe inconsistent mediation rather than protection. AI literacy marks where the emotion-engagement pathway is strongest.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于控制—价值理论，以石家庄三所高校应用统计学相关专业的本科生为对象，通过横断面问卷考察AI辅助学习中的积极成就情绪如何经学业自我效能感与学习投入及AI依赖相关联，并检验AI素养是否调节这一路径的首段。结果显示，积极情绪与较高的自我效能感相关，后者又与更强的学习投入和更低的AI依赖相关；AI素养增强了情绪与自我效能感的关联，使经自我效能感通向学习投入的间接关联随素养提高而增强，通向AI依赖的负向间接关联也随之增强。但积极情绪与AI依赖的直接关联及总关联均为正，故整体呈现不一致中介而非保护作用，说明积极情绪体验同时伴随有益与代价，且结论受横断面设计与专业样本限制。

papers.title: GenAI-supported project-based product design learning: differential changes in multidimensional learning outcomes
papers.authors: Yizhou Chen, Yingqi Zhao, Kenny S L Cheah, Nur Yuhanis Mohd Nasir
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is increasingly used in design education, yet evidence remains limited on whether its educational value derives from tool access itself or from how human–AI interaction is structured within project work. This quasi-experimental pre-test–post-test study compared a 4-week GenAI-Integrated Project-Based Learning Module (GIPLM) with traditional project-based learning (PjBL) in an undergraduate product design course ( N = 60). Rather than treating GenAI as a stand-alone content-generation tool, GIPLM embedded GenAI as process scaffolding across four stages: product and requirement analysis, user research and knowledge structuring, ideation with multimodal visualization and 3D prototyping, and feedback, validation, and reflective presentation. Learning outcomes were assessed across cognitive, affective, and psychomotor-related domains, together with course performance. According to a mixed-design ANOVA, the GenAI-supported group was associated with significantly greater gains than the control group in cognitive understanding, problem-solving and creativity, fundamental tool operation, advanced design application, and final academic performance. Because advanced design application differed at baseline, ANCOVA was additionally conducted; the post-test group effect remained significant after controlling for pre-test scores, F (1, 57) = 20.519, p < 0.001, partial η 2 = 0.265. Engagement and participation and ethical and user-centered responsibility improved over time but showed no significant Time × Group interactions. These findings suggest that the observed advantages are more consistent with structured, workflow-embedded GenAI scaffolding than with AI access alone, with stronger short-term effects on cognitive, procedural, and performance outcomes than on affective development.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注生成式人工智能在设计教育中的价值究竟来自工具本身，还是来自人机互动在项目工作中的组织方式，并以本科产品设计课程为对象，采用准实验前后测设计比较了嵌入四阶段流程的GenAI项目式学习模块与传统项目式学习。结果显示，GenAI支持组在认知理解、问题解决与创造力、基础工具操作、进阶设计应用及最终学业表现上的提升均大于对照组，进阶设计应用在控制前测后组间差异仍显著；参与投入以及伦理与以用户为中心的责任感随时间改善，但组间变化无显著差异。作者据此认为，所观察到的优势更符合将GenAI作为结构化流程支架嵌入工作流的解释，而非仅提供AI使用机会，且短期效果在认知、程序性与表现性结果上强于情感发展。

papers.title: Psychological associations between perceived generative AI-supported learning and creative design performance in vocational design education: a within-course correlational study
papers.authors: Xu Xiaoping, Wang Chenhui, 傅双燕, Jiawei Tong, Dian Jin
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is increasingly used in design courses, but evidence remains limited on how students’ appraisal of such support co-varies with domain cognition, creative confidence, engagement, and independently assessed creative work. This within-course correlational study examined within-course change and theory-specified contemporaneous associations in a 72-h Furniture Appreciation and Selection course involving 150 vocational design students in China. Sustainable design cognition and creative self-efficacy were measured before and after the course; perceived GenAI-supported learning and learning engagement were measured after it; and final creative design performance was rated independently by three experts. Paired-samples t tests described within-course change. Item-level CFA preceded the score-level association analyses, while standardized composite-score ordinary least squares models and 10,000-resample percentile bootstrap confidence intervals summarized theory-specified post-course associations and coefficient products. Sustainable design cognition increased from 3.326 to 3.792, t (149) = 10.362, p < 0.001, d z = 0.846, and creative self-efficacy increased from 3.509 to 3.877, t (149) = 7.424, p < 0.001, d z = 0.606; these values indicate change during the course as a whole rather than a GenAI-specific intervention effect. Among the direct post-course associations, learning engagement showed the largest coefficient with expert-rated creative design performance (β = 0.515, p < 0.001; f 2 = 0.361). The theory-specified coefficient products were 0.076 for SDC-CSE-LE, 0.204 for CSE-LE-CP, and 0.0080 for AISL-SDC-CSE-LE-CP. The last interval narrowly excluded zero [0.0002, 0.0234], but the product was statistically detectable and negligible in magnitude. Because the study followed one cohort without a comparison condition and most model variables were measured at the same post-course occasion, the findings support within-course change and contemporaneous association, not causal or temporally ordered effects.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察职业设计课程中，学生对生成式人工智能支持学习的感知如何与可持续设计认知、创造自我效能、学习投入及专家评定的创意设计表现相关联。研究以某职业院校设计课程的学生为对象，采用课程内相关设计，在课程前后测量认知与自我效能，课程后测量感知与投入，并由专家独立评定作品。结果显示，课程期间可持续设计认知与创造自我效能均有所提升，但这反映的是整门课程的变化，而非生成式人工智能干预的效果；课程后各关联中，学习投入与专家评定表现的联系最强，其余理论设定的系数乘积虽有个别区间勉强不包含零，但量级可忽略。作者据此强调，这些发现只支持课程内变化和同时性关联，不能作因果或时间顺序解释。

papers.title: Can users trust AI doctors? Unpacking the dual credibility pathways linking AI chatbot use to AI health advice adherence intention
papers.authors: Zhanyou Wang, Jingru Wang, Dongmei Han, Liang Ma, Feifei Hao
papers.abstract: With the rapid integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into healthcare, AI doctor chatbots have emerged as increasingly prevalent tools for health information acquisition and health management. However, existing research has paid insufficient attention to how AI doctor utilization is associated with AI healthcare users' credibility judgments and subsequent AI health advice adherence intention. To address this research gap, this study examines the relationship between AI doctor utilization and AI health advice adherence intention, with a particular focus on the mediating roles of perceived honesty and ability credibility, as well as the moderating role of anxiety sensitivity. A questionnaire survey was conducted among participants from various regions of China, and 224 valid responses were retained after data cleaning. SmartPLS 4.0 was used for data analysis. The results show that AI doctor utilization is significantly and positively associated with both perceived honesty and ability credibility, which, in turn, are positively associated with AI health advice adherence intention. Additionally, perceived honesty and ability credibility play mediating roles in the relationship between AI doctor utilization and AI health advice adherence intention. Regarding the moderating effect, anxiety sensitivity negatively moderates the relationship between perceived honesty and AI health advice adherence intention, while positively moderating the relationship between ability credibility and AI health advice adherence intention. These findings provide nuanced insights for designing anxiety-sensitive AI healthcare services by tailoring credibility cues to users' psychological characteristics and promoting appropriate reliance on AI-generated health advice.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注使用AI医生聊天机器人如何关联用户对AI健康建议的依从意愿，并考察感知诚实与能力可信度的双重中介作用及焦虑敏感性的调节作用。作者通过问卷收集中国多地用户数据，用结构方程建模分析后发现，AI医生使用与两类可信度感知均正相关，二者又分别与依从意愿正相关并起中介作用。焦虑敏感性会削弱感知诚实与依从意愿的关联，却增强能力可信度与依从意愿的关联，提示AI医疗服务可按用户心理特征调整可信度线索。

papers.title: When AI translations fall flat: embodied simulation and effort in cross-language reading
papers.authors: Zeli Liu
papers.abstract: Common machine translation evaluation metrics, such as the Bilingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU) and Crosslingual Optimized Metric for Evaluation of Translation (COMET) are reliable measures of propositional fidelity and surface fluency but systematically ignore the embodied texture of reading, leaving unexplained why high-scoring AI translations still feel flat to readers despite formal accuracy. The Embodied Translation Quality Assessment (E-TQA) framework was developed based on embodied cognition theory to operationalize three key dimensions of cross-language comprehension: sensorimotor simulation, affective-cultural resonance, and processing friction. To validate this framework, a counterbalanced Latin-square design was employed with 192 English-major participants. Six literary and culturally loaded excerpts were each presented in three rigorously matched conditions. Published professional human translations, and translations from DeepSeek and ChatGPT, with all versions controlled for BLEU (±1.2 points) and COMET (±0.04 points) to isolate embodied variation from semantic equivalence. Participants completed the Self-Assessment Manikin and E-TQA scales after each excerpt, and data were analyzed via linear mixed-effects models, reporting partial η 2 as effect size. Human texts were consistently rated higher than both AI conditions in sensorimotor imagery, affective resonance, valence, and arousal, whereas AI texts were rated much higher in phenomenological flatness and cognitive effort. All critical indices showed medium to large effect sizes (η p 2 = 0.15–0.35) and were consistent across educational levels and text genres. These results offer evidence for a dissociation of propositional accuracy and embodied richness, showing that the E-TQA framework accounts for unique variance in reader experience beyond that explained by standard computational metrics. The work advances translation quality assessment by centering embodied cognition, provides a psychometrically sound complement to existing tools, and motivates future multimodal investigations of cross-language processing mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对机器翻译评估指标只衡量语义忠实与表层流畅、却无法解释高分AI译文为何读来平淡的问题，提出基于具身认知的E-TQA框架，从感觉运动模拟、情感文化共鸣与加工摩擦三个维度考察跨语言阅读体验。研究以英语专业参与者为对象，采用拉丁方平衡设计，将人工译文与DeepSeek、ChatGPT译文在BLEU和COMET上严格匹配后进行比较，通过量表评定并用线性混合效应模型分析。结果显示，人工译文在感觉运动意象、情感共鸣、效价与唤醒上均高于两种AI译文，而AI译文在现象学平淡感和认知努力上评分更高，效应量中等至较大且在不同教育水平与文本类型间保持一致。作者据此指出命题准确性与具身丰富性存在分离，E-TQA能解释标准计算指标之外的读者体验差异。

papers.title: Toward a cognitive framework of expert singing-voice evaluation in bel canto pedagogy: a longitudinal exploratory study
papers.authors: Kyoko Ikeda, Michiko Yamaguchi, 朱実 小畑, Tomohiro Tani, Yasuki Yamashita, Taisei Terauchi, 隆 永井, Yuko Mesuda, Mizue Kayama
papers.abstract: Classical singing pedagogy relies on expert judgments that integrate auditory-perceptual cues, embodied pedagogical knowledge, and specialized evaluative language. This exploratory, longitudinal study proposes a cognitive framework, centered on Polanyi's concept of tacit knowledge, for describing how experienced bel canto pedagogues perceive singing-voice development from a brief excerpt. Twenty female soprano students (7 music-education, 13 vocal-performance majors) sang the word 'tanto' from Caro mio ben at university entry (Z1) and after 2 years of instruction (Z2). Four professional singers and voice pedagogues, blind to institutional affiliation, rated perceived development on a 0-2 scale and selected evaluative terms from a 27-item Italian pedagogical vocabulary; median ratings, rather than the mean of an even number of raters, served as the primary outcome. Acoustic analysis proceeded in two exploratory, descriptive stages. First, the singer's-formant ratio (SFR) and a Q-value index were compared with a pedagogical reference recording (M2025) using path-length-normalized dynamic time warping. Movement toward M2025 did not correspond consistently with expert ratings: several students whose SFR/Q-value profiles moved toward M2025 received low or zero median ratings (e.g., E06, E07, V07), whereas six students whose profiles moved away from M2025 on both indices received high median ratings of 1.5-2 (E02, E05, V01, V02, V03, V06). Second, changes in alpha ratio, H1-H2, spectral centroid, smoothed cepstral peak prominence (CPPS), and singing power ratio (SPR) were examined descriptively alongside participants' evaluative terms, without regression or machine-learning modeling, given the small, non-random sample. Case-level analysis indicates that experts attended to qualitatively different cues depending on what they heard in a given voice-e.g., basic, mouth-opening- and resonance-related terms (S07, R02) versus depth- and vibrato-related terms (R10, S09)-independent of institutional cohort. We propose a Polanyi-centered interpretive framework in which candidate acoustic correlates, the 27 evaluative terms (understood, after Vygotsky, as mediating cultural-linguistic tools), and Dreyfus-and-Dreyfus-informed developmental sensitivity jointly, but only partially, illuminate the focal judgment that pedagogically meaningful development has occurred. The framework is hypothesis-generating rather than confirmatory; no predictive or inferential claims are made about the acoustic determinants of expert judgment.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于波兰尼的默会知识概念提出一个认知框架，用以描述资深美声教学专家如何从简短演唱片段判断声音发展。研究对20名女高音学生入学时和接受两年教学后的演唱进行纵向分析，由4位专业歌者与声乐教师盲评发展程度并选择评价术语，同时开展探索性声学描述分析。结果显示，声学指标向教学参考录音靠近并不一致地对应专家评分，部分靠近者获低分，而部分远离者在两项指标上均远离却获高分；个案分析还表明专家会依据所听到的声音关注不同线索，且与院校背景无关。作者据此提出，候选声学相关物、评价术语和发展敏感性只能部分解释专家的核心判断，该框架用于生成假设而非验证因果。

papers.title: Social cognitive communication mechanism of digital participation in Chinese traditional music in the context of cultural identity and intangible cultural heritage
papers.authors: Tingting Kuai, Jing Qian, Wei Xu
papers.abstract: Digital platforms have reshaped how traditional Chinese music circulates, yet the psychological mechanism linking user participation to cultural identification remains undertheorized. Drawing together social cognitive theory, contemporary cultural psychology, and communication theory, this study develops a four-layer architecture (input, participation, cognitive, and identity) coupled with a staged process model spanning information encoding, symbolic decoding, cognitive reconstruction, and identity internalization. A hybrid specification formalizes the mechanism, pairing structural equation modeling with attention-weighted neural aggregation; both components are estimated and validated on the same data. Empirical testing draws on 2,346 behavioral records from music, short-form video, and social media platforms, paired with 1,128 survey responses from users engaged with the guqin, Kunqu, pipa, and regional opera repertoires. Item loadings, heterotrait-monotrait ratios, collinearity diagnostics, and a common-method check document measurement quality. Results indicate that digital participation (DP) shapes cultural identity (CI) mainly through social cognitive communication (SCC), with the co-creation and dissemination strata showing indirect effects that are more than three times those of passive exposure. As the direct participation-identity path remains significant, the pattern is one of partial rather than full mediation. Cultural identity also looks more like a hinge than a terminal state: a chained specification linking identification to downstream cognitive engagement returns a reliable indirect path, which is consistent with the recursive reading the framework proposes but, on single-wave evidence, cannot establish it. Community climate exerts the strongest moderating influence, exceeding both platform affordance and content polish. Since the design is cross-sectional, all of these patterns are read as associations rather than as causal effects; even so, they suggest that audience cultivation and co-creation tooling deserve at least as much investment as interface refinement in the digitization of traditional music.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对数字平台中传统音乐参与如何转化为文化认同这一问题，整合社会认知理论、文化心理学与传播理论，提出四层架构与分阶段过程模型，并用结构方程模型与注意力加权神经聚合对同一批平台行为记录和问卷数据进行分析。结果显示，数字参与主要通过社会认知传播影响文化认同，共创与传播层面的间接效应明显强于被动接触，且直接路径仍显著，属于部分中介；文化认同更像连接后续认知投入的枢纽而非终点。社区氛围的调节作用最强，超过平台可供性与内容精致度。由于采用横断面设计，上述模式只能视为关联而非因果。

papers.title: Teachers’ self-regulated learning profiles in artificial intelligence contexts: implications for differentiated professional development
papers.authors: Yuhao Su, Mustafa Alpsülün, Müge VURAN, Hasan Celal Balıkçı, M. Barut
papers.abstract: Introduction: The rapid integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into education requires teachers to develop new competencies and manage their own learning. While research has examined teachers' AI attitudes, acceptance, and literacy, less is known about how they regulate their learning in AI contexts. This study examined teachers' self-regulated learning (SRL) profiles and their associations with demographic characteristics and AI-related experience. Methods: In a descriptive survey, 213 in-service teachers completed the Artificial Intelligence Self-Regulated Learning Scale for Teachers (AI-SRLS). Two-Step Cluster Analysis was conducted using five dimensions: task planning, self-monitoring, help seeking, institutional support, and self-evaluation. Results: Two profiles emerged: High Strategic Learners, who scored consistently higher across all five dimensions, and Limited Strategy Users, who reported comparatively lower strategy use. Profile membership was significantly associated with prior AI experience and AI-related training. Gender, age, and professional experience did not significantly differentiate the profiles. Discussion: Teachers' AI-related SRL strategies co-occur in distinct profiles, supporting a differentiated approach to professional development. Teachers with limited strategy use may benefit from structured guidance, scaffolded AI learning opportunities, and stronger institutional support, while highly strategic learners may benefit from more autonomous and advanced learning opportunities.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注教师在人工智能情境下的自我调节学习，采用描述性问卷调查，让在职教师填写《教师人工智能自我调节学习量表》，并基于任务规划、自我监控、求助、机构支持和自我评价五个维度进行聚类分析。结果识别出两类画像：高策略学习者在五个维度上得分普遍较高，有限策略使用者则报告较低的策略运用；画像归属与先前的人工智能经验和相关培训有关，而性别、年龄和教龄未表现出显著区分。作者据此认为，教师的AI相关自我调节策略会以不同画像组合出现，这支持差异化专业发展路径：策略使用有限的教师可能需要结构化指导、支架式学习机会和更强的机构支持，高策略学习者则可能更适合自主性更强、进阶的学习机会。

papers.title: Textbook, multimedia, and generative AI in elementary English learning: usage patterns and family-reported evaluations
papers.authors: Lu Sun, XiaCheng Song, Jing Jin, Min Dai, Huafeng Qu, Xiqiong Yi, Huirong Huang
papers.abstract: Introduction This study examined how often elementary-school learners used textbooks, multimedia resources, and generative AI tools and how these modalities were evaluated by family respondents. Methods A non-probability, teacher-mediated online survey yielded 987 consented responses from multiple sites in mainland China. Respondents rated usage frequency and 15 evaluation items crossing five dimensions with three modalities. Results Textbooks were used most frequently and received the most favorable ratings. After applying a single-step multivariate-t adjustment to each family of three within-dimension contrasts, multimedia and AI differed reliably only for enjoyment in the full sample. The original three-modality confirmatory model had poor absolute fit (RMSEA = 0.151). A crossed dimension-by-modality model improved fit (RMSEA = 0.067) but produced a negative residual variance and was therefore inadmissible; latent achievement regression was not retained. In the primary proportional-odds model using observed modality scores and categorical controls, textbook evaluation was positively associated with family-reported achievement band ( b = 0.343, OR = 1.409, p < 0.001), whereas multimedia ( p = 0.085) and AI ( p = 0.808) were not. Discussion These cross-sectional associations describe this teacher-mediated convenience sample and do not establish modality effects on achievement.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注小学英语学习中教材、多媒体资源和生成式AI工具的使用频率及家庭评价，采用教师中介的非概率在线调查，由家庭受访者对三种媒介的使用频率和多个评价维度进行评分。结果显示，教材使用最频繁且评价最积极；在控制相关变量后，教材评价与家庭报告的成绩等级呈正相关，而多媒体和AI评价与成绩等级的关联不显著。作者强调这些仅为横断面关联，不能据此推断媒介对成绩的因果影响，且样本为便利样本，结论推广需谨慎。

papers.title: Deep brain stimulation and spinal cord stimulation for chronic disorders of consciousness: a decade of clinical evidence, mechanistic insights, and critical appraisal
papers.authors: Dongsheng Liu, Kai Yang, Jianlei An, Sipeng Zhu, Yitong Jia, Yichen Zhou, Yong Wang, Weihua Cheng, Kaihan Jiang, Yi Yang, Shaoya Yin, Lei Liu
papers.abstract: Deep brain stimulation (DBS) and spinal cord stimulation (SCS) have been investigated for over four decades as neuromodulatory treatments for chronic disorders of consciousness (DOC), including the vegetative state/unresponsive wakefulness syndrome (VS/UWS) and the minimally conscious state (MCS), for which no disease-modifying pharmacological therapy exists. This narrative review synthesizes literature published between 2016 and 2026 on the neurobiological rationale, clinical evidence, neurophysiological biomarkers, and safety of DBS and SCS for chronic DOC. The 'mesocircuit hypothesis', supported by human intraoperative electrophysiology and nonhuman primate causal manipulation, provides a coherent rationale for central thalamic and centromedian-parafascicular targeting. Across case series, cohort studies, and individual patient data meta-analyses, both DBS and SCS produce clinically meaningful improvement in a minority of patients, consistently more often in MCS (63-74% response) than in VS/UWS (26-30% response), with younger age and shorter injury-to-treatment interval predicting better outcomes. However, the two largest individual patient data meta-analyses of DBS concur that current evidence is insufficient to conclude that stimulation alters the natural history of neurological recovery beyond what would be expected from patient selection and spontaneous recovery, and adverse event rates (8.1% for SCS, 18.2% for DBS) indicate non-trivial surgical risk in this vulnerable population. Neurophysiological and neuroimaging biomarkers derived from EEG, functional near-infrared spectroscopy, functional MRI, and FDG-PET show promise for objective outcome prediction but await prospective validation. We conclude that DBS and SCS remain experimental, mechanistically motivated but not yet definitively proven therapies for chronic DOC, and that adequately powered randomized controlled trials, biomarker-guided patient selection, and dedicated ethical frameworks are needed before either modality can be recommended outside of research settings.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述梳理了2016至2026年间关于深部脑刺激（DBS）和脊髓刺激（SCS）治疗慢性意识障碍的神经生物学依据、临床证据、生物标志物与安全性。基于中脑环路假说，DBS和SCS在少数患者中产生有临床意义的改善，且最小意识状态患者的应答率高于植物状态/无反应觉醒综合征，较年轻和损伤至治疗间隔较短者预后更好。但两项最大的个体患者数据荟萃分析认为，现有证据不足以判定刺激改变了神经恢复的自然史，且不良事件率提示存在不可忽视的手术风险。脑电、功能近红外、功能磁共振和FDG-PET等标志物有望用于客观预后预测，尚待前瞻性验证。作者据此认为两种方法仍属实验性治疗，需开展足够把握度的随机对照试验、标志物指导的患者筛选及伦理框架。

papers.title: Graded multisensory neurofeedback via the iNems system for comprehensive upper limb recovery after stroke: a multiple baseline study
papers.authors: Takayuki Kodama, Ken Kitai, Yasuhisa Mizomoto, Kaichi Nishigaya, Shoutarou Hashimoto, Riona Hiraga, Satomi Shimizu, Miki Kawabata, Yuumi Hirabayashi, Keita Ikesue, Hazime Kako, Syouta Yasui, Hiroki Ito, Kazuhei Nishimoto, Osamu Katayama, Hideaki Yamaguchi, Hikaru Nagano, Mari Inoue, Shin Murata, Kiichiro Morita
papers.abstract: Introduction: Post-stroke upper-limb recovery remains challenging, especially in the presence of sensory impairments. Conventional brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) are constrained by binary feedback, single-modality stimulation, and exclusion of patients with sensory deficits. We developed the Imagery Neurofeedback-based Multi-sensory System (iNems), a neurofeedback system that provides graded multisensory (visual and electrical) feedback based on ERD magnitude. This study validated iNems' efficacy in motor function, self-reported numbness, and cognitive functions using a multiple-baseline design (MBD). Methods: Four participants with post-stroke upper-limb motor and sensory impairments underwent a multiple baseline design. The baseline phase (phase A) used random feedback; the intervention (phase B) used adaptive iNems. iNems quantified motor intention via sensorimotor EEG event-related desynchronization (ERD) and delivered graded visual and electrical feedback. Primary outcomes were the Fugl-Meyer Assessment-Upper Extremity (FMA-UE) and Box and Block Test (BBT). Secondary outcomes included body cognition, numbness, and neurophysiological (ERD/ERS) changes. Results: All participants demonstrated significant improvement during the intervention. FMA-UE increased by 6-16 points. The BBT showed large effects (integrated Tau-U = 0.75). Body cognition improved significantly in both sense of agency (Tau-U = 0.80) and ownership (Tau-U = 0.89). Numbness was reduced in affected cases (Tau-U = -0.85). Neurophysiological changes correlated with functional gains, with some patterns suggesting increased neural efficiency. Conclusion: This first MBD-validated demonstration shows that graded, multisensory graded neurofeedback based on ERD magnitude can improve motor, self-reported numbness, and cognitive domains after stroke. These findings support adaptive closed-loop therapy as a promising, multifaceted rehabilitation strategy.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对卒中后上肢运动与感觉障碍患者，开发了基于感觉运动脑电事件相关去同步化幅度提供分级视觉与电刺激反馈的iNems神经反馈系统，并采用多基线设计在四名参与者中检验其效果。结果显示，干预阶段所有参与者的上肢运动功能均有改善，箱块测试呈现较大效应，身体认知中的能动感与拥有感显著提升，部分病例麻木感减轻，神经生理变化与功能增益相关，部分模式提示神经效率提高。作者据此认为，基于ERD幅度的分级多感官闭环神经反馈有望成为兼顾运动、感觉与认知的多维康复策略，但结论受多基线小样本设计限制。

papers.title: Reward positivity and affective functioning in early childhood: evidence from temporospatial principal components analysis
papers.authors: Yu Sun Chung, Armen Bagdasarov, Michael Santo Gaffrey
papers.abstract: Reward-related Positivity (RewP) indexes neural sensitivity to reward feedback and has been widely studied in adolescents and adults. However, little is known about how individual differences in RewP are associated with emotional functioning during early childhood, a critical period for affective development. Interpretation of feedback-related ERPs in children is further complicated by temporally overlapping components. This study examined whether a principal component analysis (PCA)-derived RewP is associated with affective functioning in children aged 4-7 years. Electroencephalography was recorded from 140 children during an age-appropriate reward task. Temporospatial PCA was performed on the full EEG sample ( n = 140), and primary regression analyses were conducted in the subset with complete covariate data ( n = 48). Temporospatial PCA was applied to isolate a RewP component differentiating gain from loss feedback. Positive and negative affect were assessed using the child version of the Positive and Negative Affect Schedule. Regression analyses examined whether PCA-derived RewP- and gain-related P200 amplitudes were associated with affective functioning while controlling for age, sex, ethnicity, income-to-need ratio, child depressive symptoms, and parental depressive symptoms. At the group level, boys showed greater PCA-derived gain-related P200 amplitudes than girls. At the individual level, higher child positive affect was associated with larger PCA-derived RewP amplitudes in the primary covariate-adjusted regression model. In sensitivity analyses conducted in the larger sample without the income-to-needs covariate, negative affect, rather than positive affect, was significantly associated with PCA-derived RewP amplitude. These findings provide novel evidence that RewP may serve as an early neural marker of affective functioning. By extending RewP research to an understudied developmental period and emphasizing normative emotional functioning, this study advances understanding of early reward processing and highlights the utility of PCA for isolating meaningful ERP components in children.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了4至7岁儿童中，经时空主成分分析提取的奖励正波（RewP）是否与情感功能相关。研究者记录儿童完成适龄奖励任务时的脑电，用主成分分析分离出区分获益与损失反馈的RewP成分，并结合积极消极情感量表评估情感功能。结果显示，在控制年龄、性别及家庭经济等协变量后，儿童积极情感越高，RewP波幅越大；而在未纳入收入需求比的敏感性分析中，与RewP相关的是消极情感而非积极情感。作者据此提出RewP可能作为早期情感功能的神经标记，并强调主成分分析有助于在儿童中分离有意义的脑电成分，但相关结论受协变量设定影响。

papers.title: Finding Love in the Black Box: Algorithm Awareness on Dating Apps
papers.authors: Doris Bukman, Liesel L. Sharabi, Elisabeth Timmermans
papers.abstract: Most dating apps use algorithms to match users to one another, but are not fully transparent about how their recommender systems work. In turn, users have varying degrees of awareness of matching algorithms. Unfortunately, little is known about how awareness of algorithmic functioning relates to online dating. This research examined the relationship between algorithm awareness, trust in algorithms, and satisfaction with the quality of matches. A survey was conducted among 500 users of the Dutch dating app Breeze, presented to respondents within the app itself. Relationships were estimated with structural equation modeling. Higher algorithm awareness was associated with more trust in algorithms, which positively related to satisfaction with the quality of matches. This mediated association between awareness and satisfaction with matches suggested that awareness of matching algorithms is associated with better outcomes of dating app use. This research contributes to the limited literature on human-algorithm interaction on dating apps. Overall, the results suggest that algorithm awareness may be a relevant part of the online dating experience.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注约会应用用户对匹配算法运作方式的了解程度如何与在线约会体验相关，以荷兰约会应用Breeze的用户为对象，通过应用内问卷收集数据，并用结构方程模型估计变量间关系。结果显示，算法意识较高与对算法的信任较强相关，而信任又正向关联用户对匹配质量的满意度；算法意识与匹配满意度之间的关联经由信任中介。作者据此认为，对匹配算法的了解可能与更好的约会应用使用结果相关，并提示算法意识可能是在线约会体验中一个值得关注的组成部分。由于研究采用调查设计，上述关系应理解为关联而非因果。

papers.title: The gentle grip of beauty: Neural bases of motor inhibition during aesthetic appreciation
papers.authors: PAOLO BARBIERI, Jacopo Frascaroli, Greta Varesio, Francesca Piovesan, Ludovico Bechis, Pietro Sarasso, Irene Ronga
papers.abstract: A century-old tradition characterizes aesthetic experiences as intense contemplative moments in which we suspend practical concerns and devote our full attention to the object at hand. In line with this tradition, recent theories suggest that aesthetic experiences involve heightened sensory processing accompanied by a suppression of motor activity. Yet, while the link between aesthetic appreciation and perceptual enhancement has received considerable attention, the role of motor inhibition remains largely unexplored. The present study addressed this gap by investigating whether the aesthetic appreciation of images can modulate behavioral and electrophysiological markers of motor inhibition. In Experiment 1, significantly slower reaction times following the observation of preferred images were found. In Experiment 2, EEG responses associated with motor preparation and execution were significantly reduced in trials involving preferred compared with non-preferred images. Time-frequency analysis revealed significantly decreased alpha power (associated with attentional engagement toward visual perception) and increased beta power (associated with inhibited motor preparation) for preferred than non-preferred images. Overall, our results provide new evidence for the existence of a relationship between aesthetic appreciation and motor inhibition and position aesthetic experience as a valuable case study for exploring the adaptive coordination of sensory and motor systems in response to environmental demands.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察审美欣赏是否伴随运动抑制，结合行为反应时与脑电指标，让参与者观看偏好与非偏好图片。结果发现，观看偏好图片后反应时显著变慢，与运动准备和执行相关的脑电响应也明显减弱；时频分析显示偏好图片下alpha功率下降、beta功率上升，分别对应视觉注意投入增强与运动准备受抑。作者据此认为审美欣赏与运动抑制之间存在关联，并将审美体验视为探究感知与运动系统如何随环境需求协调适应的一个切入点。

papers.title: Different forms of interaction with generative AI in higher education: a latent profile analysis
papers.authors: Marcos Pascual‐Soler, Luca Delbello, Alejandro de Vega de Unceta, María Dolores Frías Navarro
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming how students interact with digital systems in learning contexts, although students differ substantially in how and why they use these technologies. Grounded in Self-Determination Theory and adopting a person-centered approach, this study examined latent profiles of students’ interaction with generative AI based on autonomous motivation, amotivation, AI self-efficacy, and academic self-concept, and their associations with behavioral and attitudinal variables. A sample of 422 undergraduate students completed the study measures. Latent profile analysis identified four distinct user profiles: moderate functional users, self-determined and competent users, low-motivation users, and active competent users. Multinomial logistic regression indicated that AI user identity consistently differentiated the more adaptive profiles, whereas perceiving AI as a form of academic plagiarism was associated with the low-motivation profile. Positive expectations regarding the professional impact of AI were also associated with the self-determined and competent profile. Overall, the findings suggest that students’ relationships with generative AI reflect heterogeneous configurations of motivational regulation, perceived competence, and academic self-perceptions, associated with differences in AI-related identity, ethical beliefs, and professional expectations. These results highlight the importance of motivational heterogeneity in students’ use of generative AI.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于自我决定理论，采用以人为中心的方法，考察大学生使用生成式人工智能时在自主动机、无动机、AI自我效能和学业自我概念上的潜在剖面类型，并分析这些类型与行为及态度变量的关联。对422名本科生的潜在剖面分析识别出四种使用者类型：中等功能性使用者、自主动机且胜任的使用者、低动机使用者和积极胜任的使用者。多项逻辑回归显示，AI使用者身份认同能稳定区分更具适应性的剖面，而将AI视为学术抄袭则与低动机剖面相关，对AI职业影响的积极预期与自主动机且胜任的剖面相关。研究提示学生与生成式AI的关系反映动机调节、能力感知和学业自我认知的异质组合，并关联其AI身份认同、伦理信念与职业预期的差异。

papers.title: Examining measurement properties of AI literacy instruments in the era of generative artificial intelligence: a review study
papers.authors: Zhenghong Du, Tianle Dong, Bing Wei
papers.abstract: As generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) becomes embedded in interactive learning environments, measurement of AI literacy is central to instructional design and policy. Valid and reliable instruments are essential for capturing what AI literacy entails in the GenAI era, yet existing reviews have not systematically evaluated the quality of evidence for their measurement properties. This review applied the COSMIN methodology to assess the methodological quality and measurement properties of AI literacy instruments developed in the GenAI context. A search across five databases yielded 37 eligible empirical studies covering four populations, including students, teachers, employees, and the general public. Instrument development was concentrated in East Asian and Western regions and predominantly targeted university students. Self-report scales outnumbered performance-based assessments, with Likert-type formats dominating. The included instruments drew on a range of theoretical sources, with earlier AI literacy concepts often reframed, reorganized, or extended to fit different contexts and emerging assessment needs. Structural validity and internal consistency were the best-supported measurement properties, whereas evidence for several other applicable properties was limited or uncertain. Based on these findings, this review provides guidance for instrument selection according to assessment purpose while considering population and context.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述关注生成式人工智能时代AI素养测量工具的证据质量问题，采用COSMIN方法系统评估相关工具的方法学质量与测量属性。作者检索五个数据库后纳入37项实证研究，覆盖学生、教师、员工和公众四类人群，发现工具开发集中于东亚和西方地区且以大学生为主要对象，自评量表多于表现性测评，李克特式格式占主导。结构效度和内部一致性是证据支持最好的测量属性，其他若干适用属性的证据则有限或不确定。文章据此为按评估目的选择工具提供参考，并提示需考虑人群与情境。

papers.title: Teaching English language learners to prompt effectively: examining effects on prompt literacy, AI self-efficacy, and self-directed English learning readiness
papers.authors: Rahavi Murugesan, P Madhumathi
papers.abstract: Prompt literacy, Artificial Intelligence (AI) self-efficacy and self-directed learning (SDL) are increasingly recognized as essential skills and competencies for learners in the AI era, regardless of discipline. However, developing these key competencies in AI-assisted language learning contexts has received limited scholarly attention. This study examined whether structured instruction in prompt literacy could enhance learners’ prompt literacy, AI self-efficacy (AISE), and self-directed English learning readiness (SDELR) in GenAI-assisted learning contexts. 82 undergraduate English as a Second Language (ESL) learners were randomly assigned to a control group (CG), which received AI-assisted language instruction and an experimental group (EG) that additionally incorporated structured prompt literacy instruction. The results revealed that structured prompt literacy instruction significantly enhanced students’ prompt literacy and AISE. However, there were no marked differences between the two groups in SDELR. The study highlights the value of prompt literacy instruction in AI-based language learning contexts to promote equitable development of digital competencies essential for the AI era alongside language instruction. The findings have important implications for language learners, language educators, teacher educators and researchers.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察结构化提示词素养教学能否在生成式AI辅助的英语学习情境中提升学习者的提示词素养、AI自我效能感与自主英语学习准备度。研究将82名本科英语二语学习者随机分为对照组与实验组，对照组接受AI辅助语言教学，实验组额外加入结构化提示词素养教学。结果显示，该教学显著提升了学生的提示词素养和AI自我效能感，但两组在自主英语学习准备度上没有明显差异。作者据此强调提示词素养教学在AI辅助语言学习中的价值，认为其有助于在语言教学之外促进学习者数字素养的均衡发展，同时提示该教学对自主学习准备度的作用有限。

papers.title: How Agent-Driven Creative Trace Mining Reshapes Design Behavior in a Deployment Study of Intent-Aligned Multimodal Design
papers.authors: Seung Won Lee, Jiin Choi, Yejin Yun, Semin Jin, Yugyeong Jang, Geunmin Hwang, Sang Woon Park, Seonghoon Ban, Kyung Hoon Hyun
papers.abstract: Designers continuously capture inspirations across media, yet these creative traces remain underutilized in computational design support. We present DesignJournal, an agent-driven system that mines multimodal creative traces and transforms them into intent-aligned image generation. The system consolidates artifacts into a unified workspace and employs an agentic pipeline for structured grouping, belief-guided prompt refinement, and iterative intent updates. We developed a framework that classifies sequential design actions, deriving a hierarchical action taxonomy from interaction logs. We used it to examine how agent affordances reshape design behavior. A 10-day deployment study with eight professional designers compared baseline and agent-supported conditions across 5838 classified actions. Agent support significantly reduced the frequency of spatial repositioning actions, particularly small-distance movements, while sequential transition structures shifted from extended repositioning chains toward relational encoding sequences. Awareness of agent interpretation shaped upstream recording behavior, and agent-mediated collaboration extended designers’ creative reach beyond independent exploration.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对多模态创意痕迹在计算设计支持中利用不足的问题，提出并部署了智能体驱动的 DesignJournal 系统，将分散的创意素材整合为意图对齐的图像生成，并基于交互日志构建动作分类框架，以考察智能体可供性如何重塑设计行为。为期十天的专业设计师部署研究对比了基线条件与智能体支持条件，发现智能体支持显著减少了空间重定位动作，尤其是小距离移动，同时动作序列结构从较长的重定位链转向关系编码序列。研究还表明，设计师对智能体解读的感知会影响其上游记录行为，且智能体介导的协作将创意探索拓展到独立探索之外。这些结果提示，智能体介入不仅改变操作层面的动作分布，也可能通过意图对齐与解读反馈重塑设计过程。

papers.title: Activating Social Responses in Human–AI Interaction: The Effects of Reciprocal Self-Disclosure and Social Role Framing
papers.authors: Xuejiao Chen, Shuining Wang, Chen Chen, Yiming Zhao, Guoming Yu
papers.abstract: As chatbots become increasingly embedded in everyday communication, understanding when they elicit social responses is important. We conducted an experiment in which 169 participants interacted with LLM-based chatbots in a 2 (reciprocal self-disclosure: yes vs. no) × 3 (social role: mentor, companion, or assistant) between-subjects design. Self-esteem was measured before the interaction as an individual-difference factor. Factorial analyses showed that reciprocal self-disclosure increased users’ disclosure but did not significantly increase trust or perceived support; enjoyment was lower in the reciprocal-disclosure condition. Social role interacted with self-esteem in predicting self-disclosure quality, with favorable responses to the mentor role among participants with higher self-esteem. These findings suggest that chatbot social cues elicit different behavioral and evaluative responses and that role framing should account for user characteristics. The study offers a conditional account of social responding in human–AI interaction and implications for chatbot design in relational contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过让参与者与基于大语言模型的聊天机器人互动，考察互惠性自我披露和社交角色设定如何影响用户的社会性反应，并将自尊作为个体差异因素纳入分析。结果显示，互惠性自我披露提高了用户的披露程度，但并未显著提升信任或感知支持，反而降低了愉悦感；社交角色与自尊共同预测自我披露质量，自尊较高的参与者对导师角色反应更积极。作者据此指出，聊天机器人的社交线索会引发不同层面的行为与评价反应，角色设定设计需考虑用户特征，并对人机互动中的社会性回应给出了有条件限制的解释。

papers.title: Different lenses on human-AI collaboration: towards a comprehensive view on hybrid intelligence in education
papers.authors: Anne Horvers, Inge Molenaar, Karcie Snoeijen, Oana Costache, Joep van der Graaf, Anne‐Wil Kramer, Susanne M. M. de Mooij, Paraskevi Topali, Zowi Vermeire, Peter J. C. Sleegers
papers.abstract: This paper aims to deepen our understanding of hybrid intelligence in education by investigating human-AI collaboration in four real-world educational use cases. We argue against the simple view of automation and augmentation as distinct processes and foreground the automation-augmentation paradox. This paradox proposes a comprehensive view of automation and augmentation as co-occurrent processes that drive task allocation between humans and AI. We use this paradox as an analytical lens to examine patterns of task changes in human-AI collaboration across four educational use cases. This study approaches teacher-AI collaboration as emerging from task-level changes when AI tools are implemented in educational settings, and these task-level changes are conceptualised as replacement, complementation, and transformation. Across cases, the analysis suggests that automation and augmentation are distributed across different stages in the instructional process. Replacement was primarily situated in bounded analytical subtasks, whereas complementation emerged when teachers interpret, validate and enact AI-generated output. Transformation was most visible in the planning and reflection phases. The cases illustrate how AI may redistribute tasks between teachers and AI systems without displacing teachers’ pedagogical judgement. These findings suggest that the automation-augmentation paradox can serve as a useful analytical lens for analysing meaningful patterns of human-AI collaboration.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以四个真实教育用例为对象，借助“自动化—增强悖论”这一分析视角，考察教师与AI协作中任务层面的变化，并将这些变化区分为替代、互补与转化。分析显示，自动化与增强分布在教学过程的不同阶段：替代主要出现在边界清晰的分析性子任务中，互补发生在教师解释、验证并落实AI生成内容时，转化则在规划与反思阶段最为明显。文章据此认为，AI可能重新分配教师与AI系统之间的任务，但并未取代教师的教学判断，该悖论可作为分析人机协作模式的有用框架。

papers.title: Beyond think-aloud: Toward a representational–recursive agenda for multimodal process-tracing research in learning and instruction
papers.authors: Anthony John Onwuegbuzie
papers.abstract: Background Think-aloud traditionally has been conceptualized as a means of accessing cognitive processes through verbal report. The nine studies in this special issue reveal a broader methodological transition in which verbal protocols increasingly are combined with eye tracking, retrospective cueing, classroom observation, qualitative and quantitative coding, process mining, and epistemic network analysis. Purpose This meta-commentary synthesizes the nine studies together with Hu and Gao's commentary on culturally aware think-aloud research and considers what they collectively imply for the future of process-tracing research in learning and instruction. Results The special issue demonstrates that contemporary process tracing is becoming multimodal, transformational, and implicitly mixed methodological. However, greater methodological sophistication also creates new inferential problems: different traces represent different aspects of cognition; transformations can alter what is represented; integration often remains implicit; ecological validity is relational rather than merely situational; and verbalization itself is culturally situated. Building on these observations, I propose a representational–recursive perspective in which process-tracing research is organized around the design, transformation, integration, and recursive interrogation of multiple representations. I extend this framework further to cultural legitimation, representational equity, and human–AI inquiry. Conclusions The future of think-aloud research lies not in replacing verbal protocols, but in repositioning them within theoretically coherent multimodal systems. Progress will depend on making representational choices explicit, integrating evidence recursively, evaluating meta-inferences across traces, embedding cultural and equity considerations throughout the research process, and using artificial intelligence transparently and accountably.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇针对特刊九项研究的元评论，梳理了学习与教学领域过程追踪研究从单纯依赖出声思维向多模态方法转变的趋势。作者指出，这些研究将言语报告与眼动追踪、回溯提示、课堂观察、过程挖掘及认知网络分析等结合，使过程追踪呈现多模态、转换性和隐性混合方法的特征；但方法精细化也带来新的推断难题，如不同痕迹对应认知的不同侧面、转换可能改变所表征的内容、整合常不明确、生态效度是关系性的、言语化本身受文化情境影响。据此作者提出表征—递归视角，主张围绕多重表征的设计、转换、整合与递归审视来组织研究，并延伸至文化合法性、表征公平与人机探究，强调出声思维研究的未来在于将其重新置于理论一致的多模态系统中。

papers.title: From emotional inhibition to memory suppression: Acute exercise modulates electrophysiological dynamics associated with inhibitory control during suppression of negative memories
papers.authors: Yifan Zhang, Haiting Zhu
papers.abstract: Failures in inhibitory control over negative emotional memories can lead to intrusive recollections that interfere with cognitive functioning and well-being. The present study examined whether acute exercise modulates the electrophysiological dynamics underlying inhibitory control during the suppression of negative emotional memories. Seventy healthy participants were randomly assigned to an acute exercise group or a seated-rest control group. The exercise group completed 30 min of moderate-intensity exercise, whereas the control group remained seated at rest. Participants completed the emotional Think/No-Think paradigm both before and after the intervention, while electroencephalography (EEG) was recorded. Event-related potentials (ERPs), time-frequency analyses, and multivariate pattern analysis (MVPA) were used to characterize neural processes associated with inhibitory control. Results showed that acute exercise selectively modulated late-stage neural activity during negative memory suppression, particularly within the 2400-3000 ms time window. This modulation was most evident over central site and left parietal site, and was accompanied by changes in alpha- and beta-band power at the left parieto-occipital junction. Overall, these findings suggest that acute exercise modulates late-stage neural dynamics during the suppression of negative memories. The observed neural changes were accompanied by a reduction in intrusion frequency during suppression attempts, consistent with the possibility that acute exercise facilitates late-stage sustained inhibition.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察急性运动能否调节抑制负性情绪记忆时的抑制控制电生理动态，将健康参与者随机分入中等强度运动组或静坐休息对照组，并在干预前后结合情绪性Think/No-Think范式记录脑电，用事件相关电位、时频分析和多变量模式分析刻画相关神经过程。结果显示，急性运动选择性地调节了负性记忆抑制晚期的神经活动，尤其在中央区和左顶区较为明显，并伴随左侧顶枕区alpha和beta频段功率的变化；这些神经变化同时伴随抑制尝试中侵入频率的下降，与急性运动促进晚期持续抑制的可能性相符。结论提示运动的影响集中在抑制加工的晚期阶段，而非整个抑制过程。

papers.title: Trust, ethical exposure, and AI adoption intention among accounting professionals: Incremental explanatory evidence beyond UTAUT
papers.authors: Mahfoudh Hussein Mgammal
papers.abstract: Research on artificial intelligence (AI) adoption in accounting and auditing increasingly considers trust, ethics, and organizational conditions, but less often asks whether such appraisals add explanatory value after a conventional technology-acceptance baseline is already entered. This study conducts a composite-score nested-model comparison using 362 accounting professionals in Saudi Arabia, of whom 285 (78.7%) are external auditors. The UTAUT-aligned baseline contains performance expectancy (ETB), effort expectancy (EOP), social influence (PSE), and facilitating conditions (ERC); the added block contains perceived trust in AI (CTR) and ethical exposure appraisal (EEA). The baseline explains 25.2% of adoption-intention variance and the extended model explains 45.0% (ΔR 2 = .198; HC3 Wald χ 2 (2) =76.68, p < .001; f 2 = .36; 95% CI for ΔR 2 [.126, .283] from a 5,000-resample bootstrap). The increment remains positive after removal of the EEA item overlapping with willingness to use AI, alternative ETB/EOP baselines, demographic and occupational controls, conservative repeated-pattern rules, both chronological waves, and external-auditor subgroup analysis. CTR is positively associated with adoption intention, whereas EEA is also positive, contrary to its negative directional hypotheses; these individual coefficients are treated as secondary descriptive associations. Measurement evidence limits stronger interpretation: ETB and EOP are nearly indistinguishable (HTMT = .977), ordinal dimensionality analyses recover fewer dimensions than specified, and reliability deteriorates sharply in the later recruitment wave. The conclusion supported by the available evidence is therefore sample-bounded and model-comparative: the added score block contributes incremental in-sample explanatory information, but the study does not validate a new latent extension of UTAUT, establish stable mechanisms or causality, or measure actual AI use or audit quality.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以沙特阿拉伯362名会计从业者为对象，采用复合得分嵌套模型比较，考察在UTAUT基线之外加入对AI的信任与伦理暴露评估能否提升对AI采用意愿的解释力。结果显示，基线解释25.2%的变异，扩展模型提升至45.0%，增量在多种稳健性检验和外部审计师子组中仍为正；信任与伦理暴露评估均与采用意愿正相关，后者方向与假设相反，但作者仅将其视为次要描述性关联。由于测量效度存在局限，作者强调结论限于样本内和模型比较，未验证UTAUT的新潜变量扩展，也未确立机制、因果或实际使用。

papers.title: Recall of overlearned speech in noise: Developmental ERP findings and an episodic buffer frame for culturally situated brain activity
papers.authors: Amedeo D’Angiulli, Matthew Sheculski, Aaron Morrow
papers.abstract: How does extensively practiced speech memory remain dependent on momentary sensory input, and how does this interaction shape brain activity during development? This perspective integrates exploratory behavioral and event-related potential (ERP) findings from a culturally situated spoken-sequence recognition paradigm with a working memory episodic-buffer account. We reanalyzed data from children and young adults who had memorized Quranic passages despite limited Arabic comprehension. Participants heard incomplete passages with or without static noise and selected the missing final word from phonologically plausible alternatives. Noise reduced recognition accuracy, and children generally responded more slowly. Descriptive ERP patterns revealed larger, more spatially distributed responses in children, spanning early auditory processing, mid-latency positivity, and later negative activity. We propose that recognition requires temporary binding of acoustic input, serial and rhythmic expectations, visual response cues, and consolidated sequence knowledge within an episodic buffer under executive control. Noise may impair perceptual fidelity and matching between transient input and stored representations. Developmental ERP differences may reflect representational coordination rather than neural efficiency. These preliminary findings motivate testable predictions concerning cross-modal congruence, familiarity, comprehension, and independently measured expertise. Culturally embedded learning practices provide informative contexts for examining interactions among working memory, long-term knowledge, and developing neural systems supporting cognition.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注大量练习过的语音记忆为何仍依赖当下听觉输入，以及这种交互在发展中的脑活动上如何体现。作者将一项文化情境下口语序列识别范式的探索性行为与事件相关电位（ERP）结果，与工作记忆的情景缓冲模型相整合，重新分析了已熟记经文但阿拉伯语理解有限的儿童和年轻人的数据。结果显示，噪声降低识别正确率，儿童总体反应更慢；ERP 描述性模式上，儿童反应更大且空间分布更广，涉及早期听觉加工、中潜伏期正波和较晚的负波。作者据此提出，识别需要在执行控制下于情景缓冲中临时绑定声学输入、序列与节奏预期、视觉反应线索及巩固的序列知识，噪声可能损害知觉保真度及瞬时输入与存储表征的匹配，发展差异或反映表征协调而非神经效率。上述为初步发现，尚待进一步检验。

papers.title: Technology-Supported Interventions and Learners’ Metacognition: A Three-Level Meta-Analysis
papers.authors: Yijia Yuan, Yiran Du
papers.abstract: Abstract Despite the growing use of educational technologies, including AI and generative AI, how these technologies support learners’ metacognition remains insufficiently understood. The present study synthesised 33 studies using a three-level meta-analysis. Technology-supported interventions were associated with higher metacognitive outcomes on average, Hedges’ g = 0.653, 95% CI [0.520, 0.786], although heterogeneity was substantial. Technology type did not significantly moderate effects. Exploratory analyses showed descriptively larger estimates for interventions with technology-use guidance, immediate feedback, and system-directed learner control, but none remained significant after BH-FDR adjustment (adjusted p = .095 for each). Because these features overlapped, the patterns are hypothesis-generating rather than evidence of independent moderator effects. Interventions most frequently supported evaluation/reflection, monitoring, and strategic control, whereas planning was less consistently represented. Importantly, 77 of 94 effects (81.9%) concerned metacognitive regulation, and 90 (95.7%) relied on self-report measures, indicating that the pooled association primarily reflects self-reported metacognitive regulation. Overall, the findings suggest that technology-supported interventions can support metacognitive outcomes, while these effects should be interpreted in light of the specific regulatory processes targeted and how metacognitive outcomes are measured.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注教育技术（包括人工智能与生成式人工智能）如何支持学习者的元认知，采用三水平元分析对33项研究进行了综合。结果显示，技术支持干预与元认知结果的平均关联为中等偏正向，但异质性较大；技术类型未起显著调节作用。使用引导、即时反馈和系统主导的学习者控制等特征在探索性分析中描述性效应较大，但经多重比较校正后均不显著，且这些特征相互重叠，因此只能视为有待检验的假设。作者指出，多数效应涉及元认知调节且依赖自我报告测量，故汇总关联主要反映自我报告的元认知调节，结论需结合所针对的调节过程与测量方式谨慎解读。

papers.title: Collaborating in the age of GenAI: a mixed-methods study of model preferences
papers.authors: Maria A. Perifanou, Anastasios A. Economides

papers.title: AI interventions as hypothesis cues: rethinking overreliance in human-AI decision-making
papers.authors: Mai Phuong Pham, David Anthony Illingworth, Rickey P. Thomas
papers.abstract: The proliferation of human-AI systems has intensified concerns about the misuse of AI technologies (Parasuraman and Riley, 1997;Amershi et al., 2019). A growing literature has examined cases of misuse with a keen interest in miscalibrated use, specifically overreliance. Currently, numerous interventional methods have emerged to mitigate the improper integration of AI recommendations in decision-making processes. These interventions have had mixed results, as some appear to exacerbate the issue by implying AI technologies are better calibrated to an operator's task than they truly are. We argue that such results may be a consequence of hyper-fixation on behavioral outcomes and tool escalation, while failing to advance theoretical accounts for how AI outputs are integrated into cognitive processes.Here, we use explainable AI (XAI) as an example intervention for illustrating the influence of AI interventions on overreliance. Specifically, we propose that AI interventions prematurely cue and privilege one interpretation of the decision space before competing alternatives have been sufficiently activated.In this view, what is typically characterized as blind acceptance of an AI recommendation may instead reflect an inadequately populated comparison set, in which plausible alternatives were never retrieved, maintained, or activated strongly enough to compete with the AI-supported interpretation. Thus, the acceptance of AI recommendations may reflect a constrained decision-making process rather than poorly calibrated trust.Figure 1 illustrates the proposed XAI-as-hypothesis-cue framework, in which AI recommendations and explanations influence trust and reliance by shaping the hypotheses available for comparison. Task cues and AI outputs activate candidate hypotheses, while explanations can either strengthen the AI-supported interpretation (focal hypothesis) or activate plausible alternatives. These effects depend on cognitive and task constraints. When multiple alternatives remain active, operators are more likely to engage in diagnostic search and exhibit calibrated reliance. When the AI-supported hypothesis becomes dominant, search is more likely to become confirmatory, increasing the risk of overreliance.Many accounts frame overreliance as a problem of excessive trust, insufficient monitoring, or opacity in AI output (Endsley and Kiris, 1995;Hoff and Bashir, 2015). XAI addresses this problem by making model recommendations more interpretable, with the expectation that operators can better evaluate why an output was produced (Lee and Moray, 1992;Ribeiro et al., 2016). This approach can be effective in relatively simple or well-structured tasks, especially when AI recommendations are accurate and explanations clarify task-relevant cues (Bansal et al., 2021). However, calibrating reliance becomes more difficult in complex or uncertain decision environments, where model outputs may reflect epistemic uncertainty, aleatory uncertainty, or hallucinations (Parmar et al., 2021;Ashktorab et al., 2025).Consistent with this limitation, richer explanations can increase trust and overreliance even when incorrect (Bussone et al., 2015;Bansal et al., 2021). By compressing task cues and model reasoning into digestible chunks, explanations may encourage model-consistent search (Payne et al., 1993;Pirolli and Card, 1999).Under time pressure or cognitive load, this can anchor operators to the model's characterization of the problem, impair error detection, and increase acceptance without improving complementary performance (Poursabzi-Sangdeh et al., 2021;Bansal et al., 2021).Process-level interventions, such as cognitive forcing, provide further evidence that the sequence of reasoning matters. Requiring operators to form an independent judgment before viewing AI advice can reduce overreliance (Buc ¸inca et al., 2021). Yet, such interventions are often interpreted as improving posthoc evaluation of AI advice through greater effort or more cautious trust calibration. This interpretation leaves open another possibility that delaying AI input may preserve the opportunity to retrieve and consider competing hypotheses before an AI-supported interpretation becomes focal.From a memory-theoretic perspective, judgment and decision-making behaviors are grounded in the hypotheses retrieved from and maintained within memory systems. Available task information acts as a set of retrieval cues that activate candidate hypotheses (Thomas et al., 2008). These processes are constrained by information search costs, restricted by cognitive load (Sprenger et al., 2011), working memory capacity (Dougherty and Hunter, 2003), time pressure (Dougherty and Hunter, 2003), and other resources (Böckenholt and Weber, 1993;Weber et al., 1993;Thomas et al., 2014;Illingworth and Thomas, 2022;Payne et al., 1993;Pirolli and Card, 1999). Specifically, under time pressure or cognitive load, people can maintain only a limited set of active alternatives (Dougherty and Hunter, 2003). Early cues shape which hypotheses are retrieved, maintained, used to form confidence, and used to guide further search (Dougherty et al., 2010;Illingworth and Thomas, 2022;Lange et al., 2013).Research in diagnostic reasoning suggests that the precursors of overreliance emerge well before belief evaluation, at the point of hypothesis generation. Work on the temporal dynamics of hypothesis generation has shown that early cues, data serial order, and the first hypotheses generated can exert a primacy-like influence on subsequent diagnostic reasoning (Böckenholt and Weber, 1993;Lange et al., 2012). Initial hypotheses shape which evidence is sought, how subsequent information is interpreted, and whether the decision-maker ultimately arrives at the correct diagnosis (Böckenholt and Weber, 1993;Illingworth and Thomas, 2022). Related work on counterfactual forecasting suggests that better decisions may require increasing the number and diversity of generated hypotheses, not only improving explanations (Illingworth et al., 2023). Model-blindness findings similarly show that cueing effects are conditional when feedback and explanations reveal model limitations, providing operators with opportunities to recalibrate which model's output they treat as diagnostic, preventing the model's recommendations from dominating the hypothesis space (Parmar et al., 2023). Together, these findings motivate the idea that the set of alternatives available for comparison may be determinative of whether the subsequent AI output is appropriately evaluated.The hypothesis-cue account overlaps with, but is not reducible to, neighboring concepts of AI overreliance.Automation-bias and authority accounts emphasize excessive deference to automated recommendations (Skitka et al., 1999;Hoff and Bashir, 2015;Lee and Moray, 1992); anchoring invokes the heuristic mechanism of insufficient adjustment from the initially presented conclusions (Epley and Gilovich, 2006); effort-reduction accounts emphasize the switch to less demanding strategies (Payne et al., 1993;Buc ¸inca et al., 2021); and confirmation bias accounts emphasize the preferential testing of an already focal belief (Klayman and Ha, 1987). Our distinct claim concerns a change in the alternatives available for evaluation at an earlier stage where AI output can alter the number, diversity, accessibility, and activation strength of the hypotheses in the operator's active comparison set (Dougherty and Hunter, 2003;Thomas et al., 2008;Illingworth and Thomas, 2022). Accordingly, two operators may report equal trust in an AI system, but rely on it differently because different alternatives are available for comparison. Thus, the framework predicts that the timing and content of explanations will affect alternative generation and information search even after perceived trust, authority, and effort are controlled.The findings reviewed in the previous section point to a broader account of overreliance in which XAI interventions shape not only how operators evaluate a recommendation but also how recommendations are integrated into reasoning processes and influence the construction of the alternative hypothesis set. We next consider how this process varies with the presence, content, and timing of an AI explanation.AI output without explanation. Our claim is not that AI interventions inevitably narrow the hypothesis space. Even an AI output without an explanation attached can cue one hypothesis by making it focal (Skitka et al., 1999;Epley and Gilovich, 2006). Because a stripped-down recommendation often provides little supporting structure, its effect will likely depend on perceived model competence and whether alternative hypotheses are already active (Hoff and Bashir, 2015). Even so, early presentation can give an AI-prompted hypothesis temporal and retrieval advantages that shape the interpretation of later evidence (Böckenholt and Weber, 1993).AI output with a supportive explanation. Adding a supportive explanation can do more than increase credibility. By supplying model-consistent cues and compressing the model's reasoning into a fluent rationale, the explanation may elaborate the recommended hypothesis, increase its accessibility, and reinforce model-consistent search or undermine the perceived usefulness of disconfirmatory search (Bansal et al., 2019;Dougherty et al., 2010;Payne et al., 1993;Pirolli and Card, 1999). Subsequent reasoning may appear careful even though it occurs within an impoverished comparison set. That is, operators may inspect evidence and articulate a coherent rationale without retrieving viable alternatives. The explanation can then guide confirmatory rather than discriminating search (Klayman and Ha, 1987;Illingworth and Thomas, 2022), increasing reliance without improving complementary performance (Poursabzi-Sangdeh et al., 2021;Bansal et al., 2021).AI output with a contrastive or uncertainty-focused explanation. An explanation that identifies plausible alternatives, specifies why the recommendation was favored over them, or indicates what evidence would discriminate among them can broaden the active comparison set (Miller, 2019;Illingworth et al., 2023).These explanations should have qualitatively different effects because expanding the hypothesis space can support calibration and orient information search toward evidence to discriminate among alternatives.However, explanations that display uncertainty alone may calibrate perceived reliability (e.g., through a confidence percentage display) without helping operators determine what alternative to consider. Therefore, the effectiveness of such interventions may depend on how well the uncertainty signal is calibrated to the model's actual reliability (Lemus et al., 2023). Accordingly, uncertainty should be linked to model error, misspecifications, missing information, and competing hypotheses if it is to influence hypothesis generation and evaluation rather than trust alone (Zhang et al., 2020;Parmar and Thomas, 2020;Parmar et al., 2023).Intervention before versus after independent judgment. Sequencing should determine whether the intervention helps construct the initial hypothesis set or is evaluated against alternatives already generated.When presented before independent judgment, a supportive intervention may give one hypothesis both primacy and greater elaboration. Presented after an initial judgment or explicit alternative-generation step, the same explanation is more likely to encounter an already populated comparison set. Cognitive forcing may therefore reduce overreliance not simply by lowering trust or increasing effort, but by preserving an opportunity to retrieve alternatives before AI guidance becomes dominant (Buc ¸inca et al., 2021). Thus, the framework predicts an interaction where early supportive explanations should narrow consideration of alternative hypotheses most strongly, whereas contrastive explanations and delayed presentation should promote alternative hypothesis generation and diagnostic comparisons.The practical implication of the proposed frameowrk is straightforward in that operators should form an independent judgment and generate at least one plausible alternative before viewing an AI recommendation or its explanation. Operators should be prompted to ask what evidence would distinguish the AI-supported hypothesis from its strongest competitor and what observation would indicate that the AI is in error. When feasible, recording an initial assessment before consulting AI can separate hypothesis generation from AI evaluation. The purpose is not to discourage trust, but to ensure that reliance follows comparison among plausible alternatives rather than the fluency of a single AI-supported interpretation (Klayman and Ha, 1987;Illingworth and Thomas, 2022).For designers, the framework shifts intervention downstream. Systems should delay recommendations when early outputs are likely to dominate, prompt operators to generate alternatives, present explanations that compare hypotheses, and identify potentially discriminating evidence, rather than merely justify the model's answer.
