Interfaces can highlight missing evidence and diagnostic task information to discriminate among competing hypotheses, as well as alert operators when they fall prey to confirmation bias (when their search is focused on a single option). In this role, AI facilitates the mapping of the decision space before promoting a preferred conclusion. Moreover, probabilistic support may externalize uncertainty, although its value will likely depend on whether it expands what operators attend and consider rather than simply making recommendations appear more precise and trustworthy.For researchers, we believe that they should consider that reliance, trust, and accuracy are insufficient outcome measures. Studies should also address the number and diversity of hypotheses generated, their rank or relative activation, the information operators select, and whether search is confirmatory or diagnostic (Dougherty and Hunter, 2003;Thomas et al., 2008;Illingworth and Thomas, 2022). The presence of the recommendation, the type of explanation, and the timing should be manipulated separately to determine whether an intervention changes trust, the set of active hypotheses, or both. A key prediction is that reliance can change without a corresponding change in reported trust when AI output alters the alternatives available for comparison. Thus, the central design challenge is therefore not only to make AI recommendations comprehensible, but to prevent a single AI-consistent interpretation from becoming the only option seriously considered by the operators. Explanations should be most useful when they support comparison, review model limitations, and preserve access to viable alternatives before commitment.

papers.title: The layer of lesson preparation delegated to AI predicts classroom discourse quality: a four-wave video study of 90 junior secondary mathematics teachers
papers.authors: Hongyu Chen, Na Wang, 陈冲, Dirong Zhang, Xin Dang
papers.abstract: Research on teachers and generative artificial intelligence has largely measured how much they use these tools, leaving open which cognitive operations they hand over. We asked whether the layer of processing delegated during lesson preparation predicts what happens in the classroom. Ninety junior secondary mathematics teachers in 18 public schools in eastern China were followed across four waves of video-recorded lessons over one school year, yielding 897 coded lessons, 4,640 unplanned student contributions, 1,518 preparation sessions, and 556 stimulated-recall interviews. For each lesson, the final plan was compared against the interaction logs segment by segment, producing two ratios that index offloading by provenance: generative-layer offloading, the share of questioning and variation segments originating in model output, and formulation-layer offloading, the share of context and wording segments. Three-level models decomposing within- and between-teacher variation showed that the two layers behaved differently. Within teachers, generative-layer offloading was associated with less higher-order questioning, less substantive uptake of student talk, weaker maintenance of high cognitive demand, and lower recognition and substantive use of unplanned student contributions, with standardized coefficients between 0.08 and 0.18. Formulation-layer offloading was unrelated to four of those indicators, positively associated with the length and variety of designed variation sequences, and positively associated with recognition of unplanned contributions, the single indicator on which the two layers cross in opposite directions. Total preparation time with AI predicted discourse outcomes on its own and lost that value for the lesson-level indicators once layer composition was entered. An embedded micro-randomized comparison, in which teachers drafted their own questioning and variation sequence before consulting the model, lowered generative-layer offloading and raised substantive uptake. Professional attention to student thinking, coded from stimulated-recall interviews conducted after the lesson by a separate team, followed the same within-teacher pattern and carried the association with the substantive use of unplanned contributions. However, the retrospective measurement leaves its direction open. Teachers' post-preparation confidence rose with generative-layer offloading by 0.23 standard deviations per within-teacher standard deviation. It carried no positive information about the lesson that followed, a confidence-performance dissociation. What predicted classroom discourse was which layer was delegated, not how much.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究追问教师在备课中把哪一层认知加工交给生成式AI，而非使用多少AI，并考察这种委托层次能否预测课堂话语质量。研究追踪中国东部初中数学教师一个学年的录像课，将最终教案与交互日志逐段比对，区分生成层委托（提问与变式片段源自模型输出）和表述层委托（情境与措辞片段）。多层模型显示，教师内部生成层委托比例越高，高阶提问、对学生发言的实质回应、高认知需求的维持以及对非预设学生贡献的识别与使用越弱；表述层委托则与其中多数指标无关，且与设计变式序列的长度和多样性、对非预设贡献的识别正相关，是两层方向相反的唯一指标。嵌入的微随机比较提示，教师先自行起草再咨询模型可降低生成层委托并提升实质回应；课后信心随生成层委托上升，却与后续课堂表现无关。作者据此强调，预测课堂话语的是委托了哪一层，而非委托了多少。

papers.title: Generative AI acceptance in study-travel contexts: an integrative model of affective and utilitarian pathways with mediation and grade-level moderation
papers.authors: Yuan Li, Dexin Li
papers.abstract: Background: Generative artificial intelligence is progressively reshaping study-travel-a curriculum-embedded educational practice. Yet, the psychological processes governing upper-primary and middle-school students' adoption of such technology in this context remain underexplored. Prior technology acceptance inquiries have predominantly centered on adult populations, leaving adolescent cognitive-developmental contingencies unaddressed. Objective: This investigation aimed to elucidate the differential roles of affective versus utilitarian drivers in shaping study-travel participants' anticipated intentions to adopt GenAI, and to determine whether these pathways differ by grade level. Method: We constructed an integrative model grounded in the extended Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT2), supplemented by Piaget's developmental framework. The model incorporated perceived enjoyment as a mediator and perceived risk as a direct negative antecedent, with grade level specified as a moderator of selected pathways. Survey data from 741 students in grades 4-9, drawn from twelve schools across six Chinese cities, were analyzed using structural equation modeling, multi-group comparisons, and cluster-robust standard errors to account for the nested sampling structure. Measurement invariance across grade groups was established prior to structural comparisons. Results: < 0.001), with primary students exhibiting approximately twice the inhibitory magnitude of middle-school counterparts. Grade significantly moderated the performance expectancy-intention relationship, and provided borderline evidence for moderation of the risk-intention relationship, indicating systematic grade-related differences in how these pathways operate. Conclusion: These findings advance technology acceptance theory by introducing grade-related contingency and establishing an "affective-efficacy" dual-channel model. Practical implications for designing grade-differentiated educational AI products are discussed.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注小学高年级与初中学生在研学旅行情境中采用生成式人工智能的心理机制，基于扩展UTAUT2并引入感知愉悦与感知风险，对多城市学生问卷数据做结构方程建模与跨年级比较。结果显示，情感与功利路径共同影响使用意向，且部分路径随年级不同而系统变化，提示相关机制存在发展性差异。文章据此提出“情感—效能”双通道解释，并讨论按年级差异化设计教育AI产品的启示；结论属调查关联，不宜解读为因果效果。

papers.title: Generative AI-assisted learning and perceived academic performance in higher education: the indirect role of self-efficacy and the moderating role of AI literacy
papers.authors: Shen Xiaotong, Geumchul Um
papers.abstract: Introduction: Generative AI is increasingly used to support learning in higher education, yet the association between generative AI-assisted learning use and students' perceived academic performance, as well as the conditions under which this association varies, remains unclear. Drawing on social cognitive theory and AI literacy research, this study tested whether generative AI-assisted learning use was indirectly associated with perceived academic performance through self-efficacy and whether AI literacy conditioned the association between generative AI-assisted learning use and self-efficacy. Methods: Cross-sectional questionnaire data were collected from 376 undergraduates at universities in China. An item-level latent interaction structural equation was estimated using a matched-pair product-indicator approach. Results: = 0.068, 95% bias-corrected bootstrap confidence interval [0.012, 0.123]), indicating that the association between generative AI-assisted learning use and self-efficacy was stronger at higher levels of AI literacy. The conditional indirect association was not statistically significant at low AI literacy but was positive and statistically significant at the mean and high levels. The index of moderated mediation was 0.011 (95% bias-corrected bootstrap confidence interval [0.002, 0.026]), indicating that the indirect association varied across levels of AI literacy. Discussion: These findings describe a theory-consistent conditional pattern of cross-sectional associations but do not establish temporal or causal ordering.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于社会认知理论与AI素养研究，考察生成式人工智能辅助学习的使用与大学生感知学业表现之间的关联，并检验自我效能感的中介作用及AI素养的调节作用。研究以中国高校本科生为对象，采用横断面问卷数据，通过潜交互结构方程模型进行分析。结果显示，生成式AI辅助学习使用与自我效能感之间的正向关联在AI素养较高时更强；自我效能感的中介关联在低AI素养水平下不显著，在均值和高水平下则显著为正，且调节中介指数表明该间接关联随AI素养水平而变化。作者强调，这些结果仅描述横断面关联的条件性模式，不能确立时间顺序或因果关系。

papers.title: AI-contextualized self-efficacy and exercise engagement among vocational college students in China: a cross-sectional serial mediation analysis of exercise self-efficacy and exercise outcome expectations
papers.authors: Guoliang Hou, Lintong Gan
papers.abstract: Background It remains unclear whether artificial intelligence-contextualized self-efficacy, reflecting general efficacy beliefs about coping with difficulties and achieving goals with artificial intelligence support, is associated with exercise engagement. This study examined this association and specific and serial statistical indirect effects involving exercise self-efficacy and exercise outcome expectations. Methods A cross-sectional questionnaire survey was conducted among 2,279 students recruited by convenience sampling from one vocational college in China. Participants completed self-report measures of artificial intelligence-contextualized self-efficacy, exercise self-efficacy, exercise outcome expectations, and exercise engagement. Confirmatory factor analysis examined the measurement model. PROCESS Models 4 (preliminary) and 6 (primary) evaluated indirect effects using 5,000 bootstrap resamples and percentile 95% confidence intervals. Supplementary latent-variable structural equation models examined the theory-specified mediator ordering and its reversal. All regression and structural models adjusted for gender, age, and grade. Results In the main PROCESS analyses, artificial intelligence-contextualized self-efficacy was positively associated with exercise engagement in the total-association model ( β = 0.427, p < 0.001). After including exercise self-efficacy and exercise outcome expectations, the direct association remained significant ( β = 0.246, p < 0.001). The specific indirect effects through exercise self-efficacy ( B = 0.047, 95% confidence interval [0.0352, 0.0598]) and exercise outcome expectations ( B = 0.048, 95% confidence interval [0.0378, 0.0586]) were significant. The serial indirect effect through exercise self-efficacy and exercise outcome expectations in the theory-specified order was also significant ( B = 0.016, 95% confidence interval [0.0116, 0.0198]). Supplementary models yielded identical fit for the two mediator orderings. Conclusion In this convenience sample, artificial intelligence-contextualized self-efficacy was associated with self-reported exercise engagement, with statistical indirect effects involving exercise self-efficacy and exercise outcome expectations. These minimally adjusted cross-sectional findings do not establish temporal ordering, causal mechanisms, or effects of actual artificial intelligence use.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注人工智能情境化自我效能是否与高职学生的锻炼参与相关，并检验锻炼自我效能与锻炼结果预期在其中的中介作用。研究采用横断面问卷，对一所高职院校学生进行便利抽样调查，通过结构方程与自助法分析间接效应。结果显示，人工智能情境化自我效能与自报锻炼参与呈正相关，且锻炼自我效能和锻炼结果预期各自及按理论顺序串联的间接效应均显著；补充模型对两种中介顺序拟合相同。作者强调，这些仅作基本调整的横断面关联不能确立时间顺序、因果机制或实际人工智能使用的影响。

papers.title: Multimodal data processing for affective perception in AI-supported developmental bibliotherapy: a mixed-methods feasibility study in university libraries
papers.authors: Chenyang Zhou, Wei Kang
papers.abstract: Introduction: Multimodal data processing is increasingly important for understanding human affective experience in naturalistic settings. In this study, "multimodal" refers to the integration of heterogeneous human-centered evidence streams rather than synchronized perceptual or physiological sensing. We evaluated a low-threshold university-library support model integrating developmental bibliotherapy salons with AI chatbot-supported emotional expression. Methods: A convergent mixed-methods feasibility and acceptability design was conducted at a Chinese university. Of 180 baseline respondents, 45 voluntarily registered for a three-week intervention and 38 completed all sessions and post-intervention assessments; 68 non-participating students with complete baseline and follow-up assessments served as a descriptive comparison group. Evidence sources included psychological self-report data, participation records, AI-use feedback, participant evaluations, and semi-structured interviews with nine intervention participants. Quantitative indicators assessed recruitment, retention, acceptability, and exploratory SCL-90 change, while thematic analysis examined participants' affective experiences and perceived mechanisms. Results: All available intervention places were filled within two days, retention reached 84.4%, and 94.7% of completers reported moderate or considerable benefit. The intervention-group mean SCL-90 change was -0.12 points, with an approximate 95% confidence interval of [-0.23, -0.01]. Because allocation was voluntary and non-randomized, no causal group-by-time intervention effect is claimed. Qualitative findings suggested that bibliotherapy salons supported interpersonal resonance, cognitive reframing, and shared reflection, whereas the AI chatbot provided a private and non-judgmental channel for emotional disclosure. Discussion: AI-supported developmental bibliotherapy appears feasible and acceptable as a low-threshold university-library wellbeing service. The findings support feasibility, acceptability, and perceived mechanisms only; they do not establish treatment efficacy, clinical effectiveness, or a neuroscience mechanism. More broadly, the study illustrates how heterogeneous psychological, behavioral, and experiential evidence can be integrated in a naturalistic educational setting.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了在大学图书馆场景中，将发展性阅读疗法沙龙与AI聊天机器人支持的情感表达相结合的低门槛心理支持模式是否可行、可接受。研究采用混合方法，整合心理自评、参与记录、AI使用反馈、参与者评价和访谈等异质证据，并设置非随机参与的描述性对照组。结果显示招募迅速、保留率较高，多数完成者自评有中等或较大获益，干预组SCL-90均值呈小幅下降，但因自愿参与、非随机分配，作者明确不主张因果性干预效果。质性分析提示沙龙促进人际共鸣与认知重评，聊天机器人提供私密、无评判的情绪表达渠道；结论限于可行性与可接受性，未确立疗效。

papers.title: Translating AI and peer feedback in sustainability-oriented STEM teacher education: pre-service mathematics teachers’ uptake, revision, and modeling task-design quality
papers.authors: Sejun Oh
papers.abstract: Introduction: As generative AI becomes increasingly available in teacher education, a central question is how pre-service teachers interpret, evaluate, and translate different feedback sources into coherent design decisions. This study examined how 22 South Korean pre-service mathematics teachers used AI and peer feedback while revising sustainability-oriented mathematical modeling tasks on school cafeteria food waste, a context aligned with Sustainable Development Goal 12. Methods: Using an exploratory, comparative mixed-methods sequence-comparison design embedded in an authentic teacher-education course, participants received two rounds of feedback in different sequences: AI followed by peer feedback or peer feedback followed by AI. Framed within cognitive, affective, and behavioral dimensions of feedback engagement, the analysis combined double-coded ratings of initial and final task designs, feedback-response records, revision-depth coding, validation-focused revision indicators, and post-activity reflections. Results: Participants rarely copied feedback passively: 20 selectively accepted feedback in at least one round, and 17 made at least one structural or reconceptual revision. Five participants showed a positive composite gain in rated task-design quality. Participants valued AI feedback for its specificity, new perspectives, and speed, and more often made validation-focused revisions after it, whereas they valued peer feedback for mutual communication, classroom realism, and student perspective. Descriptive comparisons showed different engagement trajectories across the sequence conditions alongside similar composite-quality changes. Discussion: Feedback translation provides an analytic perspective on the divergence between revision activity and artifact quality. Within this course context, the findings show how feedback evaluation, revision decisions, and artifact quality can diverge and suggest that teacher educators should scaffold evaluative judgment, source comparison, and post-revision coherence checking.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察职前数学教师在修订面向可持续发展的数学建模任务时，如何理解、评估并转化AI反馈与同伴反馈，采用探索性混合方法比较两种反馈顺序下参与者的采纳与修订过程。结果显示，参与者很少被动照搬反馈，多数会有选择地接受并作出结构性修订，但修订活跃程度与任务设计质量的提升并不一致，仅少数人出现综合质量增益。参与者看重AI反馈的具体性、新视角与速度，也更常据此做验证性修订，而重视同伴反馈的沟通、课堂真实感与学生视角。文章据此提出“反馈转化”视角，提示教师教育需支持评价判断、来源比较与修订后一致性检查。

papers.title: Pedagogical GenAI use and self-reported creative cognition in art education: a three-wave time-lagged correlational study among design students
papers.authors: Jingyi Zhang, Da Xing
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is increasingly used in design education, yet the psychological pathways associated with students' self-reported creative cognition remain unclear. In this three-wave time-lagged correlational study, 389 design students at a South Korean university reported pedagogical GenAI use at Wave 1, creative self-efficacy and AI-related learning anxiety at Wave 2, and creative engagement and self-reported creative cognition at Wave 3. Pedagogical GenAI use referred to coursework-related use for ideation, style exploration, revision, comparison of alternatives, and feedback seeking. Covariance-based structural equation modeling showed good fit [comparative fit index (CFI) = 0.983, root mean square error of approximation (RMSEA) = 0.026]. Higher GenAI use was associated with higher self-efficacy (β = 0.489) and lower anxiety (β = -0.191). The total modeled association with self-reported creative cognition was β = 0.456 [95% CI [0.314, 0.604]]; its indirect components constituted approximately 59%. The GenAI-origin serial indirect association through self-efficacy and engagement was β = 0.122, whereas the corresponding anxiety-engagement association was β = 0.015. Separately, self-efficacy was indirectly associated with creative cognition through engagement (β = 0.249); this quantity does not include the preceding GenAI-use path. Because the study was observational and engagement and cognition were measured concurrently at Wave 3, the findings do not identify causal mediation. They are consistent with an appraisal-to-engagement account in which competence beliefs have a larger modeled role than anxiety reduction.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察设计教育中教学性生成式AI使用与学生自评创造性认知之间的心理路径，采用三波时间滞后相关设计，让设计专业学生在不同时间点分别报告AI使用、创意自我效能与AI相关学习焦虑，以及创意投入和创造性认知。结构方程模型显示，较高的GenAI使用与较高的自我效能和较低的焦虑相关，并与自评创造性认知呈正向关联，其中约六成通过间接路径实现；经自我效能与投入的序列间接关联明显大于经焦虑与投入的关联。作者据此提出一种“评价到投入”的解释，认为能力信念的建模作用大于焦虑缓解，同时因研究为观察性且投入与认知同期测量，不能据此认定因果中介。

papers.title: Experiential avoidance and smartphone addiction in adolescents: a study using multi-model machine learning and mediation analysis
papers.authors: Xinyao Zhang, Weixin Zhang
papers.abstract: Background: Smartphone addiction is closely associated with adolescents' mental health and educational outcomes. Current research lacks comprehensive machine learning studies for predicting smartphone addiction factors, and studies examining relationships between various factors including mediation effects are also insufficient. Methods: A cross-sectional survey was conducted among 3,405 adolescents in China (1,853 boys, 54.4%; 1,552 girls, 45.6%; mean age = 14.50 years, SD = 1.18). Eight machine learning algorithms (Linear Regression, Ridge Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, Support Vector Regression, Bayesian Ridge Regression) were employed with SHAP analysis for interpretability. Predictive variables included demographic characteristics, social support, experiential avoidance, self-efficacy, and emotional symptoms. Baron and Kenny's method was used for mediation effect analysis. Results: = 0.478, RMSE = 8.66). SHAP analysis identified experiential avoidance as the strongest predictor (SHAP value = 5.472), followed by depressive symptoms (1.723), BMI category (1.438), age (1.394), and anxiety symptoms (1.337). Mediation analysis revealed that social support's negative association with smartphone addiction (total effect = -0.231) was almost indirect (-0.252), with experiential avoidance mediating the majority of the total effect. The final model explained 49.4% of variance in smartphone addiction. Conclusion: Experiential avoidance is a strong correlate of adolescent smartphone addiction and plays a mediating role in the association between social support and smartphone addiction. This finding is consistent with the "reality deficit-virtual compensation" theoretical framework. Additionally, depressive symptoms, BMI category, age, and anxiety symptoms were also independently associated with smartphone addiction.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于中国青少年的横断面调查数据，采用多种机器学习模型结合SHAP分析，考察哪些因素与青少年智能手机成瘾相关，并通过中介分析检验因素间的作用路径。结果显示，经验性回避是最强的预测因素，抑郁症状、BMI分类、年龄和焦虑症状也各自与手机成瘾相关；社会支持与手机成瘾的负向关联几乎全部为间接效应，其中经验性回避承担了大部分中介作用。作者据此认为，经验性回避既是青少年手机成瘾的重要相关因素，也在社会支持与手机成瘾的关联中起中介作用，这一结果与“现实缺失—虚拟补偿”的理论框架相符。需注意，上述发现来自横断面数据，关联和中介结果不宜直接解释为因果效应。

papers.title: Behavioural expression of ictal embarrassment: a stereo-EEG case report
papers.authors: Anna Scarabello, Veronica Pelliccia, Francesca Bisulli, M. Revay, Francesca Gozzo, A. Mingarelli, Chiara Peretto, R. Mai, C. Pizzanelli, F. Pizzo, Fabrice Bartoloméi, L. Tassi
papers.abstract: Embarrassment is a rare ictal manifestation whose neurophysiological basis remains poorly understood. We describe the case of a 40-year-old woman with drug-resistant focal epilepsy characterized by an unusual ictal semiology combining an intense positive emotional experience with behavioral manifestations of embarrassment. Stereo-EEG demonstrated seizure onset within the middle frontal gyrus bank of the superior frontal sulcus (F2sb), with rapid propagation to the dorsal anterior cingulate cortex (dACC) and superior anterior insula (sAI). Electrical stimulation of the F2sb reliably reproduced the habitual electroclinical seizure. While identical stimulation parameters elicited the subjective and autonomic manifestations in both supine and upright postures, the complete behavioral repertoire of embarrassment emerged only when stimulation was delivered in the standing position. Exploratory functional connectivity analyses revealed that overt embarrassment was associated with reduced node strength within a network encompassing the dACC, sAI, mesial prefrontal cortex (mPFC), and dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC). More restricted network changes were associated with only mild sensations, whereas asymptomatic stimulation produced a distinct and partly reversed connectivity pattern. This case suggests that the behavioral expression of ictal embarrassment arises from the transient reconfiguration of a frontal-cingulo-insular network and is critically shaped by bodily context.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究报告一例耐药性局灶性癫痫患者的罕见发作表现：强烈正性情绪体验与尴尬行为并存，作者结合立体脑电记录与电刺激，定位到上额沟内中额回（F2sb）起源并快速扩散至背侧前扣带皮层和上前岛叶。相同刺激参数下，主观与自主反应在卧位和立位均出现，但完整的尴尬行为仅在站立时诱发，提示身体情境对行为表达起关键作用。探索性功能连接分析显示，外显尴尬伴随额-扣带-岛叶网络节点强度降低，而轻度感受与无症状刺激对应不同的连接改变模式。作者据此提出，发作性尴尬的行为表达源于该网络的短暂重构，并受身体状态调节；作为单例报告，结论仍需更多病例验证。

papers.title: The domain-specific bias in creativity evaluation: human evaluators favor human-created art, but prefer AI outputs for divergent thinking
papers.authors: Yanming Hou, Yingying Zhang, Bin Wang, Yuxi Zhu, Xiaofei Wu
papers.abstract: Abstract How do humans perceive and evaluate creativity when it is attributed to artificial intelligence (AI)? This research examined how labeling a source as “AI” versus “human” systematically biases creativity evaluations across different domains. In experiment 1 (painting and poetry), outputs labeled as human-created were rated as more creative than identical AI-labeled outputs in artistic creation. Experiment 2, which manipulated the attribution of co-created works, revealed that the “human ideation with AI assistance” label enhanced perceived originality in poetry, whereas those attributed primarily to humans remained dominant in evaluations of painting. Experiment 3 utilized a divergent thinking task (Alternative Uses Test), found a reversal: the same output received higher creativity ratings when bearing an AI label. The findings reveal a domain-specific pattern in attitudes toward AI creativity: viewing collaboration positively yet maintaining a persistent bias in valuing AI’s creative contributions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察人们在不同领域评价创造力时，是否会因作品被标注为“AI”或“人类”来源而产生系统性偏差，并通过三项实验分别操纵绘画、诗歌、共创作品和发散思维任务的来源标签。结果显示，在艺术创作中，标注为人类创作的作品被评为更有创造力；在共创情境下，“人类构思、AI辅助”的标签能提升诗歌的原创性感知，而绘画评价仍以人类主导为主；但在发散思维任务中，同一产出标注为AI时反而获得更高创造力评分。作者据此指出，人们对AI创造力的态度存在领域特异性：既对协作持积极看法，又在艺术等领域持续看重人类贡献。

papers.title: Neural Representations of Perceptual Reorganization in the Musical Scale Illusion
papers.authors: Ahyeon Choi, Jusung Ham, Kyogu Lee, Inyong Choi
papers.abstract: The auditory system organizes complex acoustic input into coherent perceptual streams, yet how neural responses relate to physical stimulus structure and reported perception when the two diverge remains unclear. We investigated perceptual reorganization using the scale illusion, in which interleaved tone sequences presented separately to the two ears are typically heard as continuous melodic streams.Thirty participants listened to illusory, zigzag, and continuous sequences during EEG recording and reported whether each sequence sounded continuous or zigzag. Temporal response function models characterized neural encoding and reconstruction of amplitude-envelope (envelope) and pitch-change magnitude features. We tested whether neural responses during illusory listening corresponded more closely to reference patterns associated with the physical zigzag structure or reported continuous organization. Illusory sequences were predominantly categorized as Continuous and elicited longer RTs than non-illusory sequences. Encoding models revealed delayed pitch-change magnitude responses in the illusory condition, whereas envelope latencies remained comparatively stable. For pitch-change magnitude, reconstruction correlations computed over the full sequence exceeded chance levels estimated separately for each reference, with higher correlations for the continuous reference. Envelope correlations exceeded neither chance level, despite a small relative preference for the zigzag reference. These findings show that neural response timing and relative correspondence with the tested reference patterns depend on the modeled feature during the scale illusion. The reconstruction result concerns correlations across complete sequences and does not establish continuous tracking of the perceived melody.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用脑电图考察音阶错觉中听觉序列的神经表征，让参与者聆听错觉、锯齿和连续序列并报告其听感，同时用时间响应函数模型刻画神经活动对包络与音高变化幅度特征的编码和重建。结果显示，错觉序列多被报告为连续，且反应时更长；音高变化幅度的神经响应在错觉条件下出现延迟，而包络潜伏期相对稳定。重建相关性上，音高变化幅度与连续参考的对应高于锯齿参考，包络则未超过各自随机水平。作者据此指出，神经响应时序及与参考模式的相对对应取决于所建模的特征，且该重建结果仅涉及整段序列的相关，不能证明对感知旋律的连续追踪。

papers.title: The User Agency Trap in Media Literacy Chatbots: Interactive Evaluation Format, Imperfection Disclosure, and Visual Misinformation Discernment
papers.authors: Jiyoung Lee, Suhyun Kim, Hakjun Lee, Jiwon Hwang
papers.abstract: Although media literacy interventions are increasingly used to counter misinformation, many remain text-centered and non-interactive, limiting engagement during real-time evaluation. This limitation is particularly consequential for visual misinformation, where realistic synthetic images can encourage intuitive judgments. This study examines how two chatbot design features—interactive evaluation format and chatbot (im)perfection disclosure—shape perceived user and AI agency and, in turn, truth discernment. In an online experiment (N = 348), participants evaluated visual misinformation in a chatbot-supported task varying these two features. Interactive evaluation increased perceived user agency but decreased perceived AI agency, whereas imperfection disclosure modestly increased user agency without affecting AI agency. Critically, interactive evaluation indirectly reduced truth discernment through increased perceived user agency. These findings reveal a potential user agency trap: chatbot interactivity can make users feel more empowered while paradoxically undermining their ability to discern visual misinformation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注媒体素养聊天机器人的交互设计如何影响用户对视觉虚假信息的辨别，通过在线实验让参与者借助聊天机器人完成评估任务，并操纵交互评估形式与机器人不完美披露两个设计特征。结果显示，交互式评估提升了用户感知的自主性却降低了感知的AI自主性，而不完美披露仅小幅提升用户自主性、对AI自主性无影响；更关键的是，交互式评估经由用户感知自主性的提升间接削弱了真伪辨别。作者据此提出“用户自主性陷阱”：聊天机器人的交互性可能让用户感到更有掌控，却反而损害其识别视觉虚假信息的能力。

papers.title: No added benefit of VR and neurofeedback-enhanced VR for trait mindfulness in long-term mindfulness training
papers.authors: Yuqin Liu, Weitao Zhang, Yilin Wang, Chen Wu, Sha Zhao, Gang Pan, 胡宇正
papers.abstract: Immersive virtual reality (VR) and neurofeedback (NF) are increasingly promoted to enhance mindfulness meditation, yet it remains unknown whether these externally engaging technologies confer lasting benefits for trait mindfulness over sustained practice. This longitudinal randomized controlled trial compared three conditions over a 4-week program (eight sessions) with a three-month follow-up: screen-based audio-guided mindfulness (Non-VR), mindfulness in an immersive VR environment (VR), and mindfulness in VR with real-time EEG neurofeedback (VR-NF). Ninety-four meditation-naïve participants completed the study. Trait mindfulness (Five Facet Mindfulness Questionnaire, FFMQ) was assessed at six time points, EEG signal was recorded during all sessions, and subjective presence (Igroup Presence Questionnaire, IPQ) in VR was measured. Linear mixed models and Bayesian analysis revealed comparable FFMQ increases across all three groups, indicating that VR and VR-NF did not confer added behavioral benefit for trait mindfulness development. Higher IPQ presence scores showed a modest negative correlation with long-term FFMQ gains at three-month follow-up. Exploratory EEG analyses described a numerically steeper theta trajectory in the Non-VR group relative to the VR and VR-NF groups, whereas alpha trajectories were comparable across groups. However, because the two EEG systems were not equivalent across conditions and recordings were obtained from frontopolar sites, these patterns are descriptive only and cannot be interpreted as evidence of group differences. Taken together, these findings suggest that VR and VR-NF did not confer added benefit for trait mindfulness in long-term mindfulness training.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察沉浸式虚拟现实（VR）与脑电神经反馈（NF）能否在持续冥想练习中为特质正念带来额外收益，采用纵向随机对照试验，将无冥想经验的参与者分为屏幕音频引导、VR冥想和VR加实时神经反馈三组，进行为期四周的八次训练并随访三个月。结果显示，三组的正念问卷得分提升幅度相当，说明VR和神经反馈并未带来额外的行为层面益处；VR中更高的临场感与三个月随访时的正念增益呈弱负相关。探索性脑电分析仅作描述，因设备与记录位点限制不能解释为组间差异，作者据此认为这些技术未增强长期正念训练的效果。

papers.title: Human–AI interaction in cybersecurity: An SOR model approach to users' intention to adopt AI-based authentication systems
papers.authors: Md. Solaiman Chowdhury, Shafiyatur Maria, Md. Rabiul Awal, Raiyan Jannat Sohana
papers.abstract: Cyber-attack poses potential threats and challenges for both individuals and organizations. Although strong security systems can protect against the destructive outcomes of cybercrime victimization, this is comparatively feasible in the current era of Artificial Intelligence. Therefore, the current study aims to unlock users’ intention to adopt AI-based authentication systems (AAI), prioritizing the role of attitude toward AI (AT) as a key direct predictor, while investigating prior cybercrime victimization experience (CVE), perceived severity (PS), and fear of cybercrime victimization (FCV) as antecedent psychological factors determining users’ adoption-related perceptions. Employing a cross-sectional research design, the current study uses convenience sampling with a quantitative method to examine the inner, outer, and structural models. PLS-SEM was applied to conduct both descriptive and inferential statistics by using a total of 453 screened responses. The findings explore that users’ AT, compared to CVE, FCV, and PS, has the strongest impact on users’ AAI. The outcomes also indicate that CVE, FCV, and PS have a positive association with AAI, but all the paths are statistically insignificant. Moreover, FCV has a positive and statistically significant relationship with users’ PS, while CVE has a positive interaction with FCV. By integrating the SOR model into AI-based technology adoption for cybersecurity, this empirical study offers a robust understanding of how AT shapes individuals’ AAI through human-AI interaction. This study uniquely identifies users’ AAI as a key factor in promoting cybersecurity, whereas previous studies emphasized traditional authentication systems.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于SOR模型，考察用户对AI身份认证系统的采纳意愿，重点关注对AI的态度以及既往网络犯罪受害经历、感知严重性和受害恐惧等心理因素的作用。作者采用横断面问卷与偏最小二乘结构方程模型分析数据，发现对AI的态度是采纳意愿最强的预测因素，而受害经历、恐惧和感知严重性与采纳意愿虽呈正向关联但均不显著；受害恐惧与感知严重性之间、受害经历与受害恐惧之间存在显著正向关系。文章据此讨论了在人机交互中态度因素对AI安全技术采纳的关键作用，并提示其余心理因素的关联尚不确定。

papers.title: Exploring AI literacy in elementary classrooms: students’ perspectives on generative AI, fairness, and ethical use
papers.authors: Panagiotis Kosmas, Andria Agesilaou

papers.title: Generative AI in the Global South: a PLS-SEM analysis of student perceptions and intentions
papers.authors: Anthony Aapia Korku Dzidzornu, Xukan Xu

papers.title: Problematic reliance on generative AI among university students: an I-PACE-informed PLS-SEM and fsQCA study
papers.authors: Guoqing Liu, Caisang Hou
papers.abstract: Generative AI has become increasingly embedded in university students' academic learning, offering immediate feedback, content generation, and problem-solving support. Alongside these benefits, repeated reliance has raised concerns about problematic dependence on AI-mediated academic support. Drawing on an I-PACE-informed framework, this cross-sectional study examined psychological and academic factors associated with learning-related problematic reliance on generative AI, defined as a non-clinical, self-reported pattern rather than a clinical diagnosis. Data were obtained from a non-probability online sample of 242 university students who had used generative AI for learning-related purposes. Partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) was used to examine associations among positive affect, generative-AI use self-efficacy, need for cognition, perceived usefulness, cognitive absorption, AI-based mood regulation, academic stress, and problematic reliance on generative AI. Fuzzy-set qualitative comparative analysis (fsQCA) was further used to identify configurations associated with high problematic-reliance membership and its set-theoretic complement. The PLS-SEM results showed that perceived usefulness, cognitive absorption, and academic stress were positively associated with problematic reliance on generative AI, whereas positive affect and AI-based mood regulation did not show significant direct associations. The fsQCA results indicated that no single condition was necessary for high problematic-reliance membership; instead, both outcome sets were associated with multiple configurations. The findings support a cautious distinction between problematic reliance, ordinary generative AI use, and technology acceptance, and they suggest potential implications for AI literacy and academic support in higher education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于I-PACE框架，考察大学生学习中使用生成式AI时问题性依赖的相关心理与学业因素，采用横断面问卷，对使用过生成式AI学习的大学生进行PLS-SEM与fsQCA分析。结构方程结果显示，感知有用性、认知沉浸和学业压力与问题性依赖呈正相关，而积极情感与AI情绪调节无显著直接关联；fsQCA则表明没有单一条件是高问题性依赖的必要条件，高、低依赖结果均由多种条件组合构成。作者据此强调应区分问题性依赖、一般性AI使用与技术接受，并为高校AI素养教育和学业支持提供参考。

papers.title: The relationship between challenge-hindrance stressors and AI dependence among art students: the mediating roles of creative self-efficacy and positive experiences
papers.authors: Huali FAN, Yuan Wang, Shengwu Pan, Shuai Shao
papers.abstract: Background Despite growing concerns about art students’ over-reliance on generative AI tools, existing research has largely treated academic stress as a uniform construct, overlooking the possibility that different types of stressors may drive AI dependence through distinct psychological pathways. Methods Based on the Interaction of Person-Affect-Cognition-Execution (I-PACE) model, this study examines the relationships between Challenge-Hindrance stressors (CHS) and AI dependence among art students. It explores the mediating roles of creative self-efficacy and positive experiences. A questionnaire survey was conducted among 580 art students using the Challenge-Hindrance Stress Scale, the Creative Self-Efficacy Scale, the Positive Experiences Scale, and the AI Dependence Scale. Results Path analysis revealed that both challenge stressors ( β = 0.245, p < 0.001) and hindrance stressors ( β = 0.322, p < 0.001) were positively associated with AI dependence; challenge stressors were negatively associated with creative self-efficacy ( β = −0.155, p = 0.003) and positively associated with positive experiences ( β = 0.268, p < 0.001); the negative association between hindrance stressors and creative self-efficacy was significant ( β = −0.107, p = 0.043). Mediation analysis indicated that creative self-efficacy played a significant mediating role only in the path involving challenge stressors (indirect effect = 0.023, 95% CI [0.007, 0.044]) and was not significant in the path involving hindrance stressors; positive experiences significantly served as a mediator in the relationships between both challenge stressors (indirect effect = 0.042, 95% CI [0.020, 0.068]) and hindrance stressors (indirect effect = 0.019, 95% CI [0.003, 0.039]) on AI dependence. The chain mediation effects did not reach significance in either path. Conclusion The study found asymmetry in the dual pathways by which Challenge and Hindrance stressors relate to AI dependence. These findings extend the I-PACE model to the issue of AI dependence in arts education and provide empirical evidence and intervention insights for targeted prevention of problematic AI use.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于I-PACE模型，以问卷方式考察艺术类学生的挑战性—阻碍性压力源与AI依赖之间的关系，并检验创意自我效能感和积极体验的中介作用。路径分析显示，两类压力源均与AI依赖呈正相关，但中介路径并不对称：创意自我效能感仅在挑战性压力源与AI依赖之间起显著中介作用，在阻碍性压力源路径上不显著；积极体验则在两条路径上均起显著中介作用，链式中介均未达到显著。作者据此指出两类压力源关联AI依赖的心理路径存在差异，并将I-PACE模型延伸至艺术教育中的AI依赖问题，为针对性预防提供实证线索；由于研究为横断面问卷设计，相关结果不宜解读为因果效应。

papers.title: Exploring antecedents and consequences of value co-creation of women entrepreneurs: a conceptual framework and research agenda
papers.authors: Bello Hassan, Bahtiar Mohamad
papers.abstract: This study examines the antecedents and outcomes of value co-creation among women entrepreneurs, emphasizing the importance of addressing the unique challenges they encounter in entrepreneurial activities. While prior studies have investigated women's entrepreneurial motivations and barriers, the concept of value co-creation in this context remains insufficiently explored, thereby limiting theoretical development in the field. This conceptual paper develops a model derived from an extensive, critical, and multidisciplinary literature review. The review synthesizes insights from entrepreneurship, management, and network theory to explain how individual dynamic capabilities, opportunity recognition, entrepreneurial orientation, and entrepreneurial networks collectively foster value co-creation among women entrepreneurs. The study identifies four key antecedents of value co-creation: individual dynamic capabilities, opportunity recognition, entrepreneurial orientation, and entrepreneurial networks. It also proposes that value co-creation positively influences business performance. The study introduces an integrative conceptual framework and formulates five testable hypotheses to guide future empirical research. The paper provides theoretical and practical insights for policymakers and entrepreneurship support organizations to enhance women's entrepreneurial success through value co-creation strategies.
papers.summary_zh: 该概念性论文关注女性创业者价值共创的前因与结果，指出既有研究多聚焦创业动机与障碍，对价值共创探讨不足。作者基于创业、管理与网络理论的多学科文献批判性综述，构建整合框架，提出个体动态能力、机会识别、创业导向与创业网络是价值共创的四项关键前因，并推测价值共创正向影响企业绩效，据此形成五项可检验假设。文章属理论建构，未开展实证检验，其框架与假设有待后续研究验证，也为政策制定者和创业支持机构通过价值共创策略提升女性创业成效提供参考。

papers.title: Designing generative AI–powered reflective learning dashboards for enhancing self-regulated learning in higher education
papers.authors: Thacha Lawanna
papers.abstract: A reflective learning dashboard powered by generative artificial intelligence (AI) was developed to enhance self-regulated learning, student engagement, academic performance and learner perceptions in higher education. Grounded in learning analytics and generative feedback pedagogy, the system integrates behavioural data with AI-generated reflective dialogue to support continuous metacognitive development. Using a quasi-experimental design, 180 undergraduate students participated in a 12-week intervention comparing traditional instructor feedback with AI-generated reflective feedback. Quantitative results revealed significant improvements in self-regulated learning behaviours, time on task, login frequency and academic performance (p < .001), indicating strong effects on both cognitive and behavioural dimensions of learning. In addition, students reported high levels of perceived usefulness, trust, personalisation and positive attitudes towards AI-generated feedback, supported by qualitative insights highlighting increased motivation and learner agency. The findings demonstrate that combining generative AI with learning analytics transforms feedback into a dynamic, dialogic process that enhances reflective thinking and adaptive learning. This study contributes a scalable, human-centred and ethically grounded model for improving both learning outcomes and learner experience in digital education environments. Implications for practice or policy: University administrators should implement transparent AI dashboards ensuring ethics, privacy and accountability. Educators can enhance reflective learning by integrating adaptive AI feedback that supports metacognitive development. Policymakers should promote AI literacy and self-regulated learning within higher education frameworks. Technology developers need to design user-centred and interpretable AI systems aligned with pedagogical objectives. Higher education leaders should foster AI-supported reflection, professional development and evidence-based innovation for sustainable transformation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究开发了一个由生成式人工智能驱动的反思性学习仪表盘，旨在提升高等教育中的自我调节学习、学生参与度、学业表现与学习者感知。研究采用准实验设计，让本科生在12周内分别接受传统教师反馈与AI生成的反思性反馈，结果显示AI反馈组在自我调节学习行为、任务投入时间和学业表现上有显著提升，学生也报告了较高的感知有用性、信任感和个性化体验，并表现出更强的学习动机与自主性。文章据此讨论了将生成式AI与学习分析结合、把反馈转化为动态对话过程的设计思路，并提示相关结论来自特定干预情境。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence self-efficacy among iranian medical sciences students: academic, behavioral, and socioeconomic correlates
papers.authors: Neda Gilani, Ahmad Pourabbas, Rouhollah Haghshenas, Gholamali Dehghani
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into healthcare and medical education. This study assessed AI self-efficacy and its associated factors among medical sciences students with prior self-reported AI use. Methods In this cross-sectional study, 550 students from Tabriz University of Medical Sciences, Iran, were recruited using convenience sampling through an online questionnaire distributed via university social media channels and student networks. The questionnaire covered demographic, academic, socioeconomic, and digital media use characteristics, as well as the Persian version of the Artificial Intelligence Self-Efficacy Scale (AISES). Prior self-reported AI use was assessed using a Likert-scale item; students selecting “not at all” were excluded. Univariable and multivariable linear regression analyses were used to examine factors associated with AI self-efficacy. Results The mean AISES score was 69.80 ± 13.34 on a standardized 0–100 scale. Educational level was associated with AI self-efficacy, with bachelor’s (β = 15.34, 95% CI: 8.05–22.64), master’s/PhD (β = 12.63, 95% CI: 6.88–18.48), and professional-doctorate students (β = 18.63, 95% CI: 13.71–23.55) having higher scores than residents. Higher GPA (β = 3.62, 95% CI: 2.44–4.80) and employment (β = 5.25, 95% CI: 1.03–9.49) were also associated with higher AI self-efficacy. Compared with < 1 h/day, educational digital-media use of ≥ 3 h/day was associated with higher AI self-efficacy, whereas recreational use of ≥ 3 h/day was associated with lower scores. Age and gender were not independently associated with AI self-efficacy. Conclusions AI self-efficacy was associated with academic, socioeconomic, behavioral, and educational characteristics among medical sciences students. These cross-sectional associations do not establish causality; longitudinal studies are needed to clarify temporal direction.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了伊朗医学科学学生的人工智能自我效能感及其相关因素，采用横断面设计和便利抽样，通过在线问卷收集了已自我报告使用过AI的学生的学业、社会经济与数字媒体使用信息，并用回归分析检验关联。结果显示，教育阶段、较高绩点和就业状况与较高的AI自我效能感相关，教育性数字媒体使用时间较长者得分较高，而娱乐性使用时间较长者得分较低，年龄和性别则无独立关联。作者强调这些均为横断面关联，不能推断因果，需纵向研究厘清时间方向。

papers.title: Lifestyles, psychological well-being, and mental health: A cross-sectional study in a higher education sample
papers.authors: Inês Conceição, Raquel Simões de Almeida, Raquel Simões de Almeida
papers.abstract: Abstract Background The transition to higher education represents a critical developmental stage during which lifestyle behaviours and psychosocial factors interact to influence well-being and mental health. Understanding these dynamics is essential to prevent adverse health outcomes and support academic success. This study aimed to (i) describe lifestyle patterns among Portuguese higher education students, (ii) examine their associations with well-being and mental health, and (iii) assess the influence of sociodemographic and contextual variables. Methods A cross-sectional study was conducted with 1,159 students from the Polytechnic of Porto, Portugal. Participants completed the FANTASTICO Lifestyle Questionnaire, the Depression, Anxiety and Stress Scale (DASS-21), and the CORE-18 to assess lifestyle behaviours and mental health indicators. Descriptive analyses were performed, and one-way ANOVA and independent Student’s t-tests were used to compare lifestyle and psychological variables across sociodemographic groups. Pearson’s correlation coefficients were calculated to examine associations with age, body mass index (BMI), and self-rated health. A multiple linear regression model using a stepwise method identified explanatory variables of lifestyle scores. Results The mean age of the sample was 21.51 (± 2.65) years; most participants were women (69.70%) and lived with their families (71.00%). Students reported overall favourable lifestyle profiles and relatively low psychological distress. However, mild symptoms of depression, anxiety, and stress were present, approaching the threshold for moderate severity. Higher self-rated health, absence of depressive symptoms, lower stress levels, lower BMI, female gender, younger age, and enrolment in the School of Health Sciences were significantly associated with healthier lifestyle scores. Fourth-year students also reported better lifestyle and mental health indicators than those in earlier years. An unexpected positive association emerged between the CORE-18 problems/symptoms subscale and lifestyle scores, possibly reflecting compensatory health behaviours among students more aware of psychological symptoms. Conclusions These findings highlight the complex interplay between psychological well-being, lifestyle, and sociodemographic factors in higher education students. Future research should include more diverse samples, consider additional factors such as social support, economic pressures, and physical context, and adopt longitudinal designs with objective measures to better capture the relationships between lifestyle and mental health.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以葡萄牙高等教育学生为对象，采用横断面设计，通过生活方式问卷与心理健康量表考察生活方式、心理幸福感与心理健康之间的关系。结果显示，学生整体生活方式较为健康、心理困扰相对较低，但仍存在接近中度阈值的轻度抑郁、焦虑和压力症状；自评健康较高、无抑郁症状、压力较低、BMI较低、女性、较年轻及就读健康科学学院者，其生活方式得分更健康，四年级学生的生活方式与心理健康指标也优于低年级。作者据此强调心理幸福感、生活方式与社会人口因素之间的复杂互动，并指出意外出现的心理症状与生活方式正相关可能反映补偿性健康行为，结论受横断面设计与样本局限。

papers.title: Comparing chatbot and peer interaction among trilingual students: effects on self-regulated learning, critical thinking, task engagement and reading comprehension
papers.authors: Huiling Ma
papers.abstract: This study examined the differential effects of chatbot-mediated interaction and peer interaction on trilingual students’ English reading comprehension, self-regulated learning, critical thinking, and task engagement. Using a mixed-methods design, the study combined pre- and post-intervention quantitative measures with semi-structured interviews conducted throughout the intervention. Quantitative findings revealed that both instructional conditions significantly improved reading comprehension, with no significant between-group difference after controlling for baseline performance. After controlling for baseline performance, the peer interaction group demonstrated significantly higher task engagement than the chatbot-mediated group. The chatbot-mediated group demonstrated significant within-group improvement in self-regulated learning; however, no significant between-group difference was observed. Critical thinking scores increased modestly in both groups, but the within-group changes were not statistically significant, and no significant between-group difference was found. Qualitative analysis identified distinct interactional affordances and constraints. Peer interaction was associated with collaborative engagement, exposure to diverse perspectives, and shared meaning-making, whereas chatbot-mediated interaction provided relatively low-pressure practice, individualized feedback, and opportunities for learner regulation, while presenting challenges related to emotional responsiveness and discourse coherence. Overall, chatbot-mediated and peer interaction were associated with distinct learning experiences and outcomes during reading tasks. The findings highlight their potentially complementary pedagogical roles in trilingual English reading contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较聊天机器人与同伴互动对三语学生英语阅读理解、自我调节学习、批判性思维和任务投入的影响，采用混合方法，结合前后测与访谈。结果显示，两种条件下阅读理解均显著提升，控制基线后组间无显著差异；同伴互动组的任务投入显著高于聊天机器人组；聊天机器人组自我调节学习组内显著改善，但组间无显著差异；批判性思维两组仅小幅上升，组内变化不显著，组间也无差异。质性分析表明，同伴互动带来协作参与和多元视角，聊天机器人互动则提供低压力练习、个性化反馈和调节机会，但在情感回应与话语连贯性上存在挑战。作者据此认为两者在阅读任务中可能具有互补的教学角色。

papers.title: Living with Risk: Folk Theories of AI Hallucinations Among Young Chinese Users
papers.authors: Huili Liu, Ying Zhang
papers.abstract: As generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) becomes increasingly integrated into everyday life, AI hallucinations have emerged as a significant challenge in human-AI interaction. Drawing on the perspective of algorithmic folk theories, this study combines textual analysis and in-depth interviews with both ordinary users and technical users to examine how they understand and respond to AI hallucinations. Users identify AI hallucinations by scrutinizing the AI’s reasoning process, making intuitive judgments, and conducting cross-validation, while their attitudes toward hallucinations vary. Users develop four types of algorithmic folk theories: the Human-AI Interaction Misalignment Theory, the Technical Limitations Theory, the Data Source Distortion Theory, and the Generative Rule Constraint Theory. They rise to four corresponding coping strategies: reducing communication errors, reconfiguring human-AI task allocation, intervening in data input while verifying outputs, and reducing AI’s processing load. This study further indicates how technological identity and sociotechnical contexts jointly shape algorithmic folk theories.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注生成式人工智能产生幻觉时，用户如何理解并应对这一现象，采用文本分析与深度访谈考察普通用户和技术用户。研究发现，用户通过审视推理过程、直觉判断和交叉验证来识别幻觉，并形成人机交互错位、技术局限、数据来源失真和生成规则约束四类民间理论，相应采取减少沟通误差、重配人机任务、干预输入并核验输出、降低AI处理负荷等策略。文章进一步指出，技术身份与社会技术情境共同塑造这些民间理论，说明用户对幻觉的应对并非单纯技术问题，而与其对AI运作方式的理解密切相关。

papers.title: When artificial intelligence apologizes: Dynamic trust updating and the role of personality.
papers.authors: Jit Wei Aaron Ang, Chenye Zhong, Syaheed B. Jabar, Georgios Christopoulos
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems are susceptible to error, and many are designed to apologize.Yet, it remains unclear which apologies restore user trust, a question requiring repeated interactions with an AI agent and models capturing how trust evolves across encounters.Drawing on models of apology from human-human interaction research, we examined whether apology components that repair interpersonal trust function similarly in AI.Participants (N = 245) solved five business problems with a chatbot preprogrammed to err in two tasks at fixed intervals.They were randomly assigned to one of seven conditions: error with no apology or error followed by one of six apology strategies (Expression of Regret, Explanation, Acknowledgment of Responsibility, Declaration of Repentance, Offer of Repair, Request for Forgiveness).Using a dynamic trust-updating model, we estimated how trust shifted after each trial, following errors versus correct performance.Trust trajectories differed significantly by apology condition.Relative to no apology, only Expression of Regret buffered the typical immediate decline in trust following the errorapology-correction sequence.None of the apology conditions further enhanced trust recovery once the system resumed correct performance.Larger apology-related reductions in trust loss occurred among participants with more relational, relative to functional, postinteraction evaluation profiles.In separate bivariate analyses, all five Big Five traits were associated with baseline trust.When considered jointly, only Agreeableness and Openness remained associated with baseline trust, and Openness was also linked to dynamic trust updating.These findings suggest that apology-based trust repair in AI is selective and context-dependent.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察聊天机器人在出错后采用不同道歉策略能否修复用户信任，以及人格特质在其中的作用。参与者与预先设定在固定任务中出错的聊天机器人反复互动，并被随机分配到无道歉或六种道歉策略之一的条件，作者用动态信任更新模型估计每次互动后信任的变化。结果显示，道歉对信任修复的作用具有选择性：相比不道歉，只有表达遗憾缓冲了出错后信任的即时下降，而系统恢复正确表现后，没有任何道歉条件进一步促进信任回升；道歉减少信任损失的程度在更偏关系型评价的参与者中更大。人格方面，外向性等五因素分别与基线信任相关，但联合考虑时仅宜人性与开放性仍与基线信任相关，开放性还关联信任的动态更新。作者据此认为，AI 的道歉式信任修复是选择性的且依赖情境。

papers.title: Real-time fMRI neurofeedback of left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex to enhance emotional cognitive control: A randomized controlled trial
papers.authors: Timothy J. McDermott, Aki Tsuchiyagaito, Sam Ramirez, Mallory J. Cannon, Elisabeth Akeman, James Touthang, Namik Kirlić, Masaya Misaki, Martin P. Paulus, Robin L. Aupperle
papers.abstract: Real-time fMRI neurofeedback (rt-fMRI-nf) is an endogenous neuromodulation approach whereby individuals are taught to self-regulate their own neural activity in the moment. Cognitive control in emotional contexts is related to risk for or protection against mental health disorders, such as depression, anxiety, or posttraumatic stress disorder. The left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC) has been shown to be centrally important in facilitating emotional cognitive control (ECC). Using a double-blind randomized controlled trial design, the present study tested a novel rt-fMRI-nf protocol to increase left dlPFC activity during ECC and improve ECC measured by self-report and behavioral task performance. Seventy healthy adult participants were enrolled and randomized to either active (n = 37; left dlPFC) or sham [n = 33; left postcentral gyrus (PCG)] neurofeedback. Linear mixed effects models tested for effects of time (practice/run 1/run 2/run 3/transfer), feedback target (active/sham), and their interaction on left dlPFC activity, left PCG activity, and ECC measures (self-report and behavior). Results showed a significant time-by-feedback interaction on left dlPFC activity (p = .031). This interaction was such that active feedback led to greater left dlPFC activity in run 1 (p = .030; d = .66) and run 2 (p = .042; d = .62), but not for run 3 nor the transfer run (when no feedback was provided). There were no significant effects of feedback on ECC measures. These findings demonstrate that rt-fMRI-nf had an initial but not a sustained effect on left dlPFC activity, providing evidence of neural target engagement. However, the lack of a sustained effect on neural activity nor any observed effects on ECC highlight the complexity of identifying the optimal design and dosing for novel rt-fMRI-nf protocols.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究采用双盲随机对照设计，考察实时fMRI神经反馈能否提升健康成人在情绪认知控制任务中左侧背外侧前额叶的活动，并改善其自评与行为表现。结果发现，主动反馈组在最初两次训练中左侧背外侧前额叶活动高于对照组，但这一差异在后续训练及无反馈的迁移阶段未能维持；情绪认知控制的各项测量也未受反馈影响。作者据此认为，该方案实现了初步的神经靶点激活，却缺乏持续效应，凸显了此类神经反馈协议在设计与剂量优化上的难度。

papers.title: Do anthropomorphic descriptions of AI influence trust, distrust, and reliance? – Two pre-registered framing experiments
papers.authors: Philip Porwol, Tobias M. Peters, Ingrid Scharlau
papers.abstract: Anthropomorphizing artificial “intelligence” (AI) – that is, attributing human characteristics to it – is prevalent in the AI field. Using human-like voices or appearances is a prominent example. Similarly, the language used to describe AI applications is anthropomorphic. “AI” is “fed” with data, it “learns”, “acts”, and “decides”. However, little is known about the effects of using such anthropomorphisms when describing AI systems. Previous research has shown that anthropomorphic appearance and design increase trust among people utilizing AI applications. To test whether this translates to anthropomorphism used in descriptions of AI, we conducted two pre-registered experiments comparing two conditions in which an AI application is either linguistically anthropomorphized or described non-anthropomorphically. In the first large-scale online experiment ( N = 1072), participants read a fictitious newspaper article about the usage of an AI system in radiology. In the second laboratory experiment ( N = 55), participants completed a classification task using AI. Using a response-elicitation approach, participants had to judge their trust and distrust towards the AI system, and reliance was additionally compared in the second experiment. We found no significant differences in trust, distrust, or reliance between anthropomorphic and technical conditions. Subgroup analyses accounting for domain expertise and general attitudes towards AI systems yielded similar null results. These results suggest that anthropomorphic descriptions alone are insufficient to shift trust-related concepts (trust, distrust, and reliance). Further, the results indicate boundaries for anthropomorphic framing effects in general and, specifically, for trust.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过两项预注册实验，考察用拟人化语言描述AI系统是否会改变人们的信任、不信任与依赖。第一项为大规模在线实验，参与者阅读关于AI用于放射科的虚构报道；第二项为实验室实验，参与者使用AI完成分类任务，并额外测量依赖。结果显示，拟人化描述与技术性描述在信任、不信任和依赖上均无显著差异，按领域专业知识和一般AI态度分组的分析也得到类似零结果。作者据此认为，仅靠拟人化描述不足以改变信任相关概念，提示拟人化框架效应在信任层面存在边界。

papers.title: A multimodal e-learning platform integrating artificial intelligence, game-based learning, and augmented reality to enhance reading comprehension in secondary language learning
papers.authors: Esti Swatika Sari, Ella Wulandari, Ratna Wardani, Bima Mhd Ghaluh

papers.title: Against mandatory prompt disclosure in AI-assisted scholarship
papers.authors: Brian David Earp, Udo Schüklenk, Julian Savulescu, Sebastian Porsdam Mann
papers.abstract: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) are becoming routine as tools for drafting, editing, and revising scholarly manuscripts, raising difficult questions about how much transparency is needed to assess research integrity, authorship claims, and accountability. In response, some authors have proposed that researchers who use LLMs in manuscript preparation should be required to submit the prompts they used, together with the generated outputs, as supplemental material. We support detailed disclosure when it is needed to assess the scientific validity or reproducibility of a study, for example where LLMs are used in data analysis, coding, literature synthesis, or the production of figures. We argue, however, against Mandatory Full Inclusion (MFI) of prompts and outputs for ordinary writing assistance. Such a policy would, we suggest, be difficult to enforce, easy for dishonest users to evade, burdensome for careful users to follow, and poorly suited to the capacities of editors and peer reviewers. It would also risk discouraging beneficial uses of LLMs, penalizing careful multi-model consultation, distorting how researchers interact with AI systems, and disadvantaging scholars who already face undue or unnecessary barriers in academic publishing, including scholars at under-resourced institutions. More generally, an MFI policy would impose a level of surveillance on AI-assisted writing that has no clear analog in ordinary human collaboration. We propose instead a proportionate prompt-and-output disclosure framework: targeted disclosure where reproducibility or validity requires it; voluntary documentation where authors wish to demonstrate their contribution; and continued reliance on authorship attestation, contributor statements, and misconduct procedures where warranted. This approach better aligns transparency with the risks posed by LLM use in scholarly writing, while also minimizing surveillance-related harms and inefficiencies.
papers.summary_zh: 该文是一篇立场论证文章，讨论是否应强制研究者披露使用大语言模型辅助撰写稿件时的提示词与生成内容。作者主张，在数据分析、编程、文献综合或制图等影响研究有效性或可复现性的环节应详细披露，但反对对普通写作辅助实行提示词与输出的强制全文收录，认为这类政策难以执行、易被规避、增加合规负担，并可能抑制有益使用、惩罚谨慎的多模型咨询、扭曲研究者与 AI 的互动方式，且对资源匮乏机构的学者尤为不利。作者据此提出按风险分级披露的框架：必要处定向披露，作者自愿记录贡献，并继续依靠署名声明与不端行为程序。

papers.title: Multidimensional engagement effects of generative AI adoption among minority ethnic international students in UK higher education
papers.authors: Olatunji David Adekoya, Hakeem Adeniyi Ajonbadi, Chima Mordi
papers.abstract: Abstract Generative artificial intelligence (GAI) has become a prevalent tool in higher education, yet little is known about how its use affects the learning experiences of minority‐ethnic international students (MEIS). Drawing on an extended Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT) and a four‐strand engagement model, this quantitative study surveyed 273 MEIS across UK business schools and analysed the data with Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modelling (PLS‐SEM). The findings suggest that performance expectancy, effort expectancy and social influence predicted intention, and facilitating conditions and intention were also positively associated with self‐reported GAI use frequency. GAI frequency positively predicted cognitive, behavioural, emotional and, most strongly, agentic engagement. Multigroup analysis revealed that female students showed stronger effects of effort expectancy, performance expectancy, social influence and facilitating conditions on intention than males; low‐experience students were more sensitive to effort expectancy than high‐experience peers; and postgraduate students exhibited stronger facilitating conditions, performance expectancy and social influence effects than undergraduates. The study highlights both theoretical and practical implications by linking GAI adoption with multidimensional student engagement, with the strongest association observed for agentic engagement, and calls for equity‐focused policy, curriculum interventions and institutional support targeted at individual access gaps among MEIS. Practitioner notes What is already known about this topic? Generative AI (GAI) technologies are increasingly used by students in higher education for learning support. The Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT) has been widely applied to examine technology adoption in educational contexts. What this paper adds? It extends UTAUT to an under‐researched population (MEIS), who often face heightened academic, technological and cultural challenges in UK higher education. GAI use by MEIS is strongly associated with cognitive, behavioural, emotional and especially agentic engagement. Implications for practice and/or policy Institutions should consider embedding GAI literacy and access support into orientation and academic skills programmes for MEIS. Educators who integrate GAI into teaching may consider structured questioning, verification and reflection activities while evaluating rather than assuming their effects on engagement. Policymakers should develop equity‐oriented strategies that support the digital and cultural integration of disadvantaged student groups.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注生成式人工智能的使用如何影响英国高校中少数族裔国际学生的学习投入，基于扩展的UTAUT模型与四维投入模型，对商学院学生进行问卷调查并用结构方程模型分析。结果显示，绩效期望、努力期望和社会影响预测使用意向，便利条件与意向同自报使用频率正相关，而使用频率正向预测认知、行为、情感和能动性投入，其中与能动性投入的关联最强。多群组分析还表明，这些前因与意向的关系在性别、使用经验和学位层次间存在差异。作者据此讨论了面向该群体的公平政策、课程干预与机构支持，并提示相关结论为关联性而非因果。

papers.title: Trustworthy healthcare AI for wellbeing: how AI characteristics and information sensitivity shape privacy disclosure
papers.authors: Jungwon Kim, Yongjun Sung
papers.abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes increasingly integrated into healthcare, understanding how AI characteristics and data sensitivity influence users’ disclosure behaviour is critical for designing trustworthy and emotionally safe AI systems. This study investigates how two types of AI trust cues (i.e. technical vs. psychological securities) and the type of personal information requested (i.e. demographic vs. digital footprint) interact to shape perceived trust, disclosure intention, and actual disclosure behaviour in the course of AI interaction. We conducted a 2 × 2 between-subjects online experiment with 146 participants using a Wizard-of-Oz healthcare chatbot. Results showed a significant interaction effect on disclosure intention. Participants showed higher intention to disclose demographic information to psychologically secure AI, while technical security framing increased disclosure intention for digital footprint information. Trust significantly mediated these effects. Although AI characteristics did not affect the amount of disclosed data, psychological security led to significantly deeper, more emotionally intimate disclosures. These findings extend trust and privacy research by revealing that AI trust cues operate differently depending on information sensitivity. The interaction demonstrates that effective trust-building strategies must be tailored to the specific disclosure context.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察医疗AI的信任线索（技术性安全与心理性安全）与所请求个人信息类型（人口统计信息与数字足迹）如何共同影响用户的信任、披露意愿和实际披露行为，采用2×2组间在线实验，借助Wizard-of-Oz医疗聊天机器人开展。结果显示，两类线索与信息类型存在交互：心理性安全框架下用户更愿意披露人口统计信息，技术性安全框架下则更愿意披露数字足迹信息，信任在其中起中介作用。AI特征虽未改变披露数据的数量，但心理性安全使披露更深、更具情感亲密性。作者据此指出，信任建立策略需依披露情境定制。

papers.title: Brains on copy-paste mode? A mixed-methods study on the relationship between generative artificial intelligence use and students’ critical thinking skills
papers.authors: Héctor Galindo‐Domínguez, Lucía Campo, Nahia Delgado, María Victoria Urruzola
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The rapid integration of generative artificial intelligence tools, such as ChatGPT, into higher education has raised important questions about their relationship with students' critical thinking (CT) skills. This study explored these associations among 398 undergraduate students using a mixed-methods design. Quantitatively, participants completed validated measures of critical thinking and a survey assessing frequency of AI use in academic contexts. Correlation analyses indicated a significant negative association between AI use and Analyzing/Organizing skills. Moderation analyses revealed that academic achievement moderated this relationship for Analyzing/Organizing and Evaluating, with higher achievers showing a stronger negative association. No significant effects emerged for gender and age on the remaining CT dimensions. Likewise, qualitative analyses of 200 open-ended responses identified three user profiles: (1) instrumental/uncritical, comprising younger low-achieving male students emphasizing AI speed and utility while reporting reduced verification effort; (2) stable/complementary, comprising older high-achieving students perceiving little change in their evaluative practices; and (3) ambivalent/skeptical-trusting, comprising women with medium achievement, divided between increased skepticism and greater reliance on AI outputs. Supplementary analyses linking Analyzing/Organizing and Evaluating scores to these profiles showed that lower development of both skills consistently aligned with the instrumental/uncritical profile. The interpretive consistency between both analytical strands suggests that the relationship between generative AI use and CT skills is nuanced and profile-dependent, limited in scope to specific dimensions and student groups rather than reflecting a broad negative impact, while highlighting the risks of uncritical reliance and the potential of AI as a complementary academic tool when used reflectively.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究采用混合方法，考察398名本科生使用生成式人工智能与批判性思维技能之间的关系。相关分析显示，AI使用频率与分析/组织技能呈显著负相关，学业成绩对分析/组织和评估两个维度具有调节作用，高成绩者的负向关联更强；性别和年龄对剩余维度无显著影响。对开放式回答的质性分析识别出工具性/不批判、稳定/互补和矛盾/怀疑-信任三类使用者画像，较低的分析/组织与评估技能水平一致对应工具性/不批判画像。两条分析线索相互印证，表明这种关系因画像而异，且仅局限于特定技能维度和学生群体，并非普遍的负面影响。

papers.title: A pragmatic approach to a computational model of human intention applied to human-robot interaction
papers.authors: J. E. Domínguez-Vidal

papers.title: AI vs. human authorship in paintings: Differential impacts on consumers' perceived value
papers.authors: Dan Zhang, Peiyao Chen, Yixuan Wu, Xiaolin Li, Yutong Wang
papers.abstract: The proliferation of artificial intelligence (AI) art generators has introduced algorithmically created paintings into mainstream consumer markets, yet consumers consistently assign lower value to AI-generated works than to human-created equivalents. This paper proposes perceived creative authenticity---consumers' subjective perception that an artwork reflects a genuine creative process characterized by human-centered values of originality, craftsmanship, and uniqueness---as a theoretically distinct mechanism explaining this value differential. Conceptually differentiated from perceived creativity, which concerns the novelty of the artistic output, perceived creative authenticity addresses the genuineness of the creator-work relationship. Drawing on authenticity theory and Psychological Ownership Theory, we develop a moderated mediation framework hypothesizing that (H1) human authorship elicits higher perceived value than AI authorship, (H2) perceived creative authenticity mediates this effect, while the indirect effects through perceived creativity, perceived effort, and anthropocentric creativity beliefs are not significant, establishing perceived creative authenticity as the primary explanatory mechanism within the tested model, and (H3) non-fungible token (NFT) authentication attenuates the mediated pathway by providing verifiable creative provenance. Across five studies, results support this framework: Study 1 conceptually replicates the human-AI value gap among Chinese consumers; Studies 2a—2c demonstrate the mediating role of perceived creative authenticity: Study 2a establishes the basic mediation pathway; Study 2b shows through parallel mediation that perceived creative authenticity uniquely mediates the effect while perceived creativity, perceived effort, and anthropocentric creativity beliefs do not exhibit significant indirect effects; and Study 2c provides causal evidence through a moderation-of-process design; and Study 3 shows that NFT authentication narrows the authenticity gap between human and AI art. These findings advance the literature on human-computer interaction by identifying process-based authenticity judgments as a key psychological mechanism shaping consumer responses to algorithmic creative products, with implications for artists and platforms navigating digital art markets.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对消费者对AI生成绘画估值低于人类作品的现象，提出“感知创作真实性”这一机制，即消费者对作品是否体现以人为中心的原创性、技艺与独特性的主观判断，并借助真实性理论与心理所有权理论构建有调节的中介框架。作者通过五项研究检验该框架，发现人类作者身份带来的感知价值优势由感知创作真实性中介，而感知创造力、感知努力和人类中心主义创造力信念的间接效应不显著；NFT认证可提供可验证的创作来源，从而缩小人类与AI艺术之间的真实性差距。文章据此将基于过程的真实性判断视为影响消费者回应算法创作产品的关键心理机制，并讨论其对数字艺术市场中艺术家与平台的含义。

papers.title: Prolonged participation AI-based mindfulness school programme in primary education: Implications for AI practices, schools and developers
papers.authors: Şükran Uçuş
papers.abstract: Background Research on Artificial Intelligence (AI) -supported mindfulness programs in primary education remains limited, particularly in rural contexts where implementation conditions differ from urban settings. Aim This study examines the effects of an AI-supported mindfulness intervention on rural primary school students' behavioral and socio-emotional outcomes, and on teachers' self-regulation and creativity, measured at pretest (T1), posttest (T2), and follow-up (T3). Method The study used a quasi-experimental design with a control group across selected classrooms in four rural schools. The sample comprised an intervention group ( N = 91) and a control group ( N = 54), with 16 teachers participating in the intervention group. The intervention ran for ten weekly sessions across the fall and spring semesters. AI tools (ChatGPT and Gemini) supported teacher candidates in lesson planning and in the inquiry phase that followed each mindfulness practice. Implementation fidelity, assessed through mentor cross-rating, was 88.6% ( SD = 9.7), with Cohen's κ = .86 in a sub-sample. Results Split-plot ANOVAs showed significant Time × Group interactions favouring the intervention group on life skills (LSAS, η 2 p = .242), behavioural difficulties (SDQ total, η 2 p = .378), and teacher-student relationship quality (STRS total, η 2 p = .025). In the Strengths and Difficulties Questionnaire (SDQ), all five subscales were significant. The Closeness subscale drove the STRS effect; Conflict did not change. Nested analyses confirmed consistent effects across grade levels. Teachers showed gains on all nine TSRS subscales, and on the Social Value subscale of the TCS. Conclusion The intervention was associated with improvements in students' life skills, behavioral functioning, and teacher-student closeness, as well as gains in teachers' self-regulation. The findings inform AI-supported mindfulness practice in rural primary education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了在乡村小学开展人工智能支持的长期正念项目对学生行为与社会情绪结果以及教师自我调节和创造力的影响，采用带对照组的准实验设计，在四个乡村学校的选定班级中于前测、后测和追踪三个时间点进行测量。结果显示，干预组在生活技能、行为困难以及师生关系质量上均出现有利于自身的显著时间与组别交互作用，其中师生关系的变化主要由亲密性维度驱动，冲突维度未见变化；教师则在自我调节的多个维度上有所提升。作者据此讨论了相关发现对乡村小学人工智能支持的正念实践、学校实施以及开发者设计的启示，但研究为关联性证据，尚不能确立因果关系。

papers.title: More than a loading bar: Conversational silence and anthropomorphic latency cues in mental health chatbots
papers.authors: Shiyi Wang, Han Zhang
papers.abstract: Mental health chatbots increasingly rely on conversational interaction to support users' emotional well-being, yet little is known about how users interpret temporary silence while waiting for system responses. Existing research on social presence and anthropomorphic interaction has primarily focused on conversational content after a response is generated, whereas the waiting phase remains underexplored. Drawing on social presence theory, this study conceptualizes anthropomorphic latency cues as socially meaningful signals that may shape users’ emotional and interactional experiences during temporary conversational silence. Two studies were conducted. Study 1 developed and semantically validated three categories of anthropomorphic latency cues (empathic, effortful, and playful). Study 2 employed a within-subjects laboratory experiment with university students, comparing five latency-cue conditions (text, progress bar, empathic, effortful, and playful) using subjective evaluations, eye-tracking measures, and semi-structured interviews. The results showed that anthropomorphic latency cues were associated with lower anxiety and greater pleasure in several condition-level comparisons relative to non-anthropomorphic feedback. Perceived interaction continuity was significantly associated with reduced anxiety and enhanced pleasure. Within the anthropomorphic conditions, mediation analyses revealed significant indirect associations among perceived anthropomorphism, social presence, and emotional and interactional outcomes. Eye-tracking results indicated longer fixation durations on anthropomorphic latency cues during temporary silence. Qualitative findings further suggested that participants often interpreted latency cues as signals of attentiveness, responsiveness, and interaction continuity rather than merely as technical loading indicators. Overall, temporary conversational silence may function as a socially meaningful phase of AI-mediated interaction rather than a purely technical delay. The study extends social presence research into temporally silent phases of conversational AI interaction and provides preliminary design implications for chatbot-based support systems.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注心理健康聊天机器人在等待回复的沉默阶段，用户如何理解拟人化的延迟线索。作者先开发并验证了共情、努力和俏皮三类延迟线索，再通过实验室实验结合主观评价、眼动追踪和访谈进行比较。结果显示，相比非拟人化反馈，拟人化延迟线索在部分条件下与更低的焦虑和更高的愉悦感相关，感知互动连续性与焦虑降低和愉悦提升相关；眼动结果也显示用户对拟人化线索注视更久。访谈表明，用户常把延迟线索理解为关注、回应和互动连续性的信号，而非单纯的技术加载提示。研究据此提出，对话中的暂时沉默可能是具有社会意义的互动阶段，而不仅是技术延迟。

papers.title: Effects of AI Interventions Across Cognitive, Social-emotional, and Academic Outcomes: a Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials with Nonlinear Dose–response Evidence
papers.authors: Ren Xiaotian, Xinying Li, Luying Gao, Qiuying Wei, Haoning Liu, Xiao Yu

papers.title: More than we can make: generative AI, artistic forms, and artistic becoming
papers.authors: Amit Raphael Zoran
papers.abstract: Abstract Debates surrounding generative AI and creativity have largely focused on artifacts: who or what produced a given image or text, whether machine outputs qualify as art, and how authorship and value should be understood. Drawing on aesthetics, craft theory, anthropology, human–computer interaction, hybrid craft, digital fabrication, and rematerialization, this article argues that art has historically involved two intertwined dimensions. Artistic forms stabilize and transmit meaning through artifacts, whereas artistic becoming refers to the developmental and transformative processes through which new possibilities of perception, interpretation, and experience emerge, in makers, in recipients, and in cultures.
