The article’s central claim is a decoupling thesis: for most of history these dimensions were contingently coupled, since producing sophisticated forms required the maker’s becoming, and generative AI loosens this coupling by enabling such forms to emerge without the specific developmental pathways that traditionally conditioned them. Rather than signaling the disappearance of creativity, the decoupling relocates to new sites and makes visible dimensions of artistic practice that the demands of production long obscured. The article situates generative AI within a longer history of hybridization and distributed creativity, develops the decoupling thesis across these three levels, and defends a normative orientation: under conditions of symbolic abundance, the creative practices most worth pursuing are those that route generative fluency back into embodied, situated experience.
papers.summary_zh: 该文围绕生成式AI与创造力的争论，指出既有讨论多聚焦于作品归属与价值，而忽视了艺术的双重维度：通过作品稳定并传递意义的“艺术形式”，以及发生在创作者、接受者与文化中的感知与体验转化过程即“艺术成为”。作者基于美学、手工艺理论、人类学与人机交互等文献提出“解耦”论点：历史上形式生产与创作者成长路径偶然绑定，生成式AI则使精致形式可在缺少相应发展过程的情况下出现。文章认为这并非创造力消失，而是其转移至新场所，并主张在符号丰裕条件下，值得追求的创作实践应把生成流畅性重新引回具身、情境化的经验。该文为理论论述，未开展实证研究。

papers.title: Tricky trade-offs on a transparency spectrum: how the Financial Times approaches transparency about AI use in news
papers.authors: Liz Lohn, Felix M. Simon
papers.abstract: Abstract As news organisations adopt artificial intelligence (AI), they face growing pressure to be transparent about when and how it is used—yet practical approaches remain uneven. This paper examines AI transparency through an in-depth case study of the Financial Times (FT). Drawing on 13 semi-structured interviews with 12 senior managers across editorial, product, data science, and communications, together with internal documents, we show that the FT approaches transparency as a hybrid of policy, process, and practice, framed by a desire to safeguard both internal and external trust. Transparency is calibrated to context: internally, AI use is signposted in tools and reinforced through training and personal accountability; externally, the prominence of disclosure scales with system autonomy and editorial oversight, with stronger labelling for no-human-in-the-loop features than for AI-assisted, journalist-edited outputs. We identify nine factors that shape audience-facing disclosure—legal/provider requirements, industry benchmarking, nature of the task, human oversight, system novelty, audience expectations, perceived risk, commercial sensitivities, and design constraints—and five crosscutting challenges, including site-wide consistency (especially on mobile) and potential “transparency backfire.” Conceptually, our analysis links AI transparency to isomorphic pressures and to intersecting institutional logics. We argue that AI transparency in news is best understood as a spectrum, evolving with technological advancements, commercial, professional and ethical considerations and shifting audience attitudes.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以《金融时报》为深度案例，通过访谈编辑、产品、数据科学与传播部门的管理者并结合内部文件，考察新闻机构如何就人工智能使用向受众保持透明。研究发现，该报把透明度视为政策、流程与实践的混合体，对外披露的显著程度随系统自主性和人工编辑监督而变化，对无人在环的功能标注更强；同时识别出影响披露的九类因素和五项跨领域挑战，包括移动端一致性及可能的“透明度反噬”。作者据此提出，新闻业的人工智能透明度应被理解为随技术、商业、专业伦理与受众态度演变的谱系。

papers.title: The 3×2A framework: a profile-based interpretive approach to human–AI coevolution and adaptive governance
papers.authors: Valeriu Ungureanu

papers.title: GenAI Literacy and Students’ Exploitative and Exploratory Innovation: The Moderating Role of Critical Thinking
papers.authors: Yali Tang, Liang Wu
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) literacy, encompassing the knowledge, skills, and attitudes for effective use, is becoming essential in education. However, its distinct associations with exploitative versus exploratory innovation and the role of critical thinking remain unclear. Grounded in social cognitive theory, this study surveyed 228 students to examine these relationships. GenAI literacy was positively associated with exploitative innovation and showed a U-shaped association with exploratory innovation, in which benefits emerged only after a literacy threshold; the U-shaped association was robust to correction for multiple comparisons. Critical thinking negatively moderated the association between GenAI literacy and exploitative innovation, and this interaction was robust to correction for multiple comparisons; the hypothesized moderation of the U-shaped exploratory association, in contrast, did not reach the 0.05 level and did not receive empirical support. The findings extend theory by differentiating how GenAI literacy relates to distinct innovation types and offer practical guidance—drawn from the supported associations and from theoretical reasoning—for fostering balanced human–AI collaboration. Because participation was voluntary, the self-selected sample may have overestimated the reported associations, and all results should be interpreted with this caveat in mind.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于社会认知理论，以问卷调查方式考察了学生的生成式人工智能素养与利用式创新、探索式创新之间的关系，并检验批判性思维的调节作用。结果显示，生成式人工智能素养与利用式创新正相关，与探索式创新则呈U形关联，即素养达到一定水平后探索式创新的收益才显现；批判性思维负向调节素养与利用式创新的关联，而对U形探索式关联的调节未获支持。作者据此区分了素养与两类创新的不同关系，并提示自愿参与带来的自选择样本可能高估关联，结论需谨慎解读。

papers.title: Beyond Overlap: Development and Validation of the Inclusion of AI in Self (IAIS) Scale and Its Moderating Role in the Relationship Between AI Identity and AI Threat
papers.authors: Jiali He, 이한미, Xiang Yao
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming increasingly integrated into people’s self-concepts, yet a psychometrically robust multi-item pictorial instrument for assessing the inclusion of AI in self (IAIS) is lacking. Drawing on self-expansion theory and the AI-mediated communication (AI-MC) model, we developed and validated the IAIS scale. The IAIS comprises four pictorial items capturing overlap, distance, centrality, and size, designed as indicators of a single dimension. In Study 1, Chinese university students (N = 195, 56.9% male) were recruited through campus online platforms using convenience sampling. We conducted exploratory and confirmatory factor analyses (EFA/CFA), examined reliability and convergent, discriminant, and criterion-related validity (the last via Steiger’s Z tests), and assessed gender invariance with multigroup CFA. In Study 2, the scale was cross-validated in a sample of Chinese employees (N = 513, 38.4% male) recruited through the Credamo online research platform. In Study 3, a mixed student–employee sample (N = 240, 43.3% male) completed a two-wave longitudinal survey with a 15-day interval. The moderating role of IAIS in the relationship between AI identity and AI threat was tested with PROCESS Model 1 (5000 bootstrap resamples). Results supported a replicable single-factor structure, good reliability, and convergent, discriminant, and criterion-related validity. IAIS significantly moderated the association between AI identity and AI threat. We conclude that IAIS is a psychometrically sound instrument for assessing the inclusion of AI in self, and that the negative association between AI identity and AI threat is stronger among individuals who include AI more deeply in the self.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对人工智能日益融入个体自我概念、却缺乏可靠多题项图示测量工具的问题，开发并验证了“AI纳入自我”（IAIS）量表，并在中国大学生和在职员工样本中通过因素分析、效度检验及两波纵向调查考察其心理测量学性质与调节作用。结果显示，IAIS具有可复现的单因子结构、良好的信度以及聚合、区分和效标效度，并在AI认同与AI威胁的关联中起显著调节作用：在更深地将AI纳入自我的个体中，AI认同与AI威胁之间的负向关联更强。作者据此认为IAIS是评估AI纳入自我的心理测量学可靠工具，同时提示这一调节关系属于关联性发现，其因果方向尚待进一步检验。

papers.title: Self-reported learning-oriented GenAI use under perceived teacher-referenced normative tension in Chinese higher education
papers.authors: Zhenzhen Yang, Yong Yang, WEI LIU
papers.abstract: Objective The educational implications of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) depend not only on whether students use these tools, but also on how they orient their use when acceptable-use expectations remain unsettled. This study examined whether perceived teacher-referenced GenAI normative tension (PNT) was associated with self-reported learning-oriented GenAI use (LOU) and whether LOU remained distinguishable from related academic experiences and learning tendencies in Chinese higher education. Methods Cross-sectional survey data were collected from 1,004 students at three public universities. Covariance-based structural equation modelling was used to evaluate the proposed five-factor measurement representation and a theory-constrained six-path associational model. Internal split-sample measurement analyses, alternative measurement models, covariate-adjusted models, an ordinal-estimator sensitivity analysis, institution sensitivity analyses, a reverse focal specification, and exploratory structural extensions were also conducted. Results The proposed five-factor measurement representation showed close fit and was reproduced in a held-out subsample. The focal PNT–LOU association was positive and statistically significant, while the remaining structural paths positioned LOU within a broader network of related academic experiences and learning tendencies. PNT was positively associated with self-reported LOU (β = 0.568, p < 0.001), and the model explained 32.2% of the variance in LOU. The focal association remained positive after adjustment for GenAI guidance clarity (β = 0.478, p < 0.001), demographic and institutional covariates (β = 0.570, p < 0.001), and use of an ordinal estimator. An observationally equivalent reverse specification produced the same global fit, indicating that temporal direction could not be identified. Exploratory extensions further indicated that the six-path specification did not exhaust the observed covariance structure, particularly for ACS. Conclusion Perceived difficulty locating one’s GenAI practices relative to teacher-referenced expectations and self-reported learning-oriented GenAI use can coexist rather than functioning as opposite ends of a single continuum. However, the cross-sectional, same-source design does not establish that normative tension improves learning-oriented behaviour. Reverse direction, shared unmeasured characteristics, common-method inflation, social desirability, and legitimacy-oriented self-presentation remain plausible explanations.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在中国高校中，学生感知到的、以教师为参照的生成式人工智能规范张力是否与其自报的学习导向使用相关，并检验这种使用能否与相关学业体验和学习倾向区分开来。作者对三所公立大学的学生开展横断面问卷调查，采用协方差结构方程模型评估五因子测量结构及六路径关联模型。结果显示，规范张力与自报学习导向使用呈正相关，且该关联在纳入多种协变量和敏感性分析后仍成立；但反向设定拟合相同，说明无法确定时间方向。作者据此指出，二者可以共存而非同一连续体的两端，但横断面同源设计不足以证明规范张力会促进学习导向行为。

papers.title: Short-term responses across two sequential plant-based activity sessions: an exploratory fixed-order pilot study
papers.authors: Li-Li Chang, Yun-Hsien Ku, Chuen-Yu Chuang, Yu-Sen Chang
papers.abstract: Background Structured plant-based activities combine natural materials, purposeful manual work, sensory engagement, and social interaction, but direct comparisons of practical formats in community adults remain limited. We characterized short-term responses during two sequential sessions and compared within-session changes. Methods Twenty-five adults participated in a single-group, fixed-order pilot study. Session 1 involved horticultural crafting; 1 week later, Session 2 involved balm crafting followed by horticultural crafting. Twenty-three attended both sessions. DASS-21 and STAI-S were principal outcomes; horticultural wellbeing, HRV, and forehead single-channel EEG were exploratory. Within-session changes and complete-case between-session differences were estimated with 95% CIs. Post hoc TOST examined exploratory equivalence bounds. Results Both sessions were followed by favorable short-term psychological changes. DASS-21 scores decreased by 8.57 points in Session 1 [95% CI (5.41, 11.72), n = 23] and 5.53 in Session 2 [(2.65, 8.41), n = 17]. STAI-S scores decreased by 7.30 points in Session 1 [(5.23, 9.37), n = 25] and 6.86 in Session 2 [(4.07, 9.66), n = 22]; all four Holm-adjusted p values were <0.001. Complete-case comparisons showed no statistically detectable between-session difference in DASS-21 improvement [3.12 points, 95% CI (−1.51, 7.75)] or STAI-S improvement [0.34 points, (−3.15, 3.83)]. STAI-S changes met the exploratory TOST criterion only at the broad ±0.50 standardized bound. Horticultural wellbeing improved in both sessions; SDNN and RMSSD increased, whereas EEG findings did not remain significant after multiplicity correction. Conclusion Both sessions were associated with favorable short-term psychological changes, particularly reduced distress and state anxiety. These findings support the feasibility and potential value of brief, hands-on plant-based activities in community settings and provide estimates for larger randomized, counterbalanced trials. Given the fixed order and absence of a control group, the findings are preliminary rather than definitive causal or modality-specific evidence.
papers.summary_zh: 该探索性固定顺序先导研究以25名社区成年人为对象，比较两次连续植物基手工活动（园艺手工、香膏制作加园艺手工）期间的短期心理反应。两次活动后，抑郁焦虑压力量表得分和状态焦虑量表得分均下降，且改善幅度在两次活动间未显示统计学可检测的差异；园艺幸福感在两次活动中均提升，心率变异性指标上升，而脑电结果经多重校正后不再显著。作者据此认为，简短动手的植物基活动在社区场景中具有可行性和潜在价值，但因固定顺序且缺少对照组，结果仅为初步证据，不能作为因果或特定活动形式的结论。

papers.title: Generative AI in creative education: baseline-linked evidence on learning processes, artistic performance, and authorship
papers.authors: Ningtao Shen, Lai Soon Lee, Aneng He
papers.abstract: Introduction: Generative artificial intelligence is increasingly shaping creative learning in higher education art courses, yet its educational value remains contested when creative support, output generation, authorship, and skill development become intertwined. This study investigates AI-supported creative learning in an undergraduate art course. Methods: The study used linked data from 133 students, including prior course performance, final creative-performance assessment, and post-project questionnaire responses. AI use was operationalized through two dimensions: assistive use for ideation, refinement, process management, and technique learning, and content-generative use involving AI contributions to creative output. The analysis combined baseline-adjusted outcome models, performance-change models, propensity-score adjustment, AI-use intensity comparisons, and robustness checks across alternative AI-use definitions. Results: The findings show a clear process-outcome decoupling pattern. AI use was associated with stronger perceived support and skill transfer, while final artistic performance and baseline-to-final performance change showed no corresponding improvement. Content-generative AI use was associated with lower evaluated authorship, suggesting that AI-shaped artifacts may reduce the visibility of students' creative decision-making in final outcomes. Discussion: The study contributes a differentiated account of AI in creative education and argues that responsible AI integration should focus on how students use, document, justify, and reflect on AI within the creative process.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察生成式人工智能在高校艺术课程创作学习中的作用，基于学生先前课程成绩、最终创作表现评估与项目后问卷的关联数据，区分辅助性使用（构思、修改、流程管理与技法学习）和内容生成性使用两个维度。结果显示明显的“过程—结果脱节”：AI 使用与更强的感知支持和技能迁移相关，但最终艺术表现及从基线到最终的变化并无相应提升；内容生成性使用还与更低的学生作者性评价相关，提示 AI 参与生成的作品可能削弱学生创作决策在最终成果中的可见度。作者据此主张，负责任的 AI 融合应关注学生如何在创作过程中使用、记录、论证并反思 AI。

papers.title: Contemporary AI attitude scale research: a systematic mapping review and bibliometric analysis
papers.authors: Yusuf Ziya Olpak
papers.abstract: Introduction: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) has been accompanied by growing efforts to measure individuals' attitudes toward these technologies. However, existing AI attitude scales vary considerably in their theoretical foundations, dimensional structures, target populations, and application contexts, raising questions about the extent to which they represent equivalent conceptualizations of the construct. Methods: This systematic mapping review examined contemporary AI attitude scale research and mapped its thematic, intellectual, methodological, and conceptual structure. A predefined Web of Science Core Collection search identified 298 eligible AI-related psychometric scale studies published between 2022 and June 2026; within this corpus, AI attitude was the most frequently represented construct, with 51 studies forming the final analytic sample. The review integrated descriptive and conceptual synthesis with bibliometric mapping analyses, including author keyword and abstract-term co-occurrence, co-citation, and bibliographic coupling. Results: The findings showed that scale development and psychometric evaluation constitute prominent methodological themes in the literature. Co-citation analysis linked the broader technology-acceptance tradition with AI-specific approaches to attitude measurement, while bibliographic coupling revealed four interconnected contemporary research fronts involving scale refinement and contextual extension, education and generative AI, population- and domain-specific measurement, and cross-cultural validation around established scale families. Despite these overlapping knowledge bases, substantial conceptual heterogeneity was evident across instruments, including unidimensional, positive-negative, cognitive-affective-behavioral, functional, ethical, and domain-specific multidimensional conceptualizations. Discussion: Overall, the findings indicate that bibliographic and methodological commonality has not produced conceptual uniformity in AI attitude measurement. Future research should therefore prioritize explicit construct definition, conceptual fit between instruments and research purposes, measurement invariance, cross-cultural validation, and cumulative evaluation of established measures rather than assuming equivalence across scales carrying the same construct label.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了当代人工智能态度量表研究，通过文献计量与概念综合，考察其主题、知识基础、方法及概念结构。分析显示，量表开发与心理测量学评估是主要方法主题，共被引分析将技术接受传统与AI特定态度测量联系起来，文献耦合则揭示出量表改进与情境拓展、教育与生成式AI、特定人群与领域测量、以及围绕成熟量表家族的跨文化验证四个相互关联的研究前沿。尽管知识基础存在重叠，各工具在概念化上差异显著，涵盖单维、正负二分、认知—情感—行为、功能性、伦理及领域特定多维等多种取向。作者据此指出，文献与方法上的共性并未带来AI态度测量的概念统一，未来研究应优先明确构念定义、确保工具与研究目的的概念匹配、检验测量不变性与跨文化效度，并对已有量表进行累积性评估，而非假定同名构念的量表彼此等价。

papers.title: Body image and maladaptive eating behaviors in Chinese early adolescents: a latent profile analysis
papers.authors: Chungan ZHANG, Yichu Han, Shuhua Cheng, Yuqian Qi
papers.abstract: Background Body image undergoes significant changes during early adolescence, yet empirical evidence on how the combination of negative and positive body image in this stage relates to maladaptive eating behaviors remains limited. To address this, employing a person-centered approach, this study aimed to identify distinct profiles of body image and to explore the relationships between profile membership, gender, body mass index (BMI), socioeconomic status (SES), and maladaptive eating behaviors among Chinese early adolescents. Methods Using indicators from three dimensions of positive body image (i.e., body self-appreciation, body other-appreciation, resilience against negative appearance feedback) and negative body image (i.e., body dissatisfaction), latent profile analysis (LPA) was conducted with a sample of 1,248 junior high school students (aged 12–15 years, M = 13.42, SD = 1.03; 50.4% boys) from Heilongjiang Province, China. Results Three distinct body image profiles were identified: the Positive Body Image Group (66.59%), the Body Other-Appreciation Dominant Group (23.88%), and the Moderate Body Image Group (9.54%). Gender and BMI significantly predicted profile membership, whereas SES did not. Regarding maladaptive eating behaviors, both the Body Other-Appreciation Dominant Group and the Moderate Body Image Group reported significantly higher levels of restrained eating than the Positive Body Image Group. The Moderate Body Image Group also reported significantly higher levels of emotional eating compared with the Positive Body Image Group. No significant differences were found in external eating among the three profiles. Conclusion Early adolescents' body image profiles exhibit significant heterogeneity, with distinct patterns of association with maladaptive eating behaviors across profiles. Accordingly, interventions should consider gender and body mass index and be tailored to the characteristics of each profile to improve body image and eating behaviors.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注中国早期青少年身体意象的异质性及其与不良进食行为的关系，采用潜在剖面分析，以积极身体意象三个维度和身体不满为指标对初中生进行分类。结果识别出积极身体意象组、身体他人欣赏主导组和中等身体意象组三类，性别与BMI可预测剖面归属，而社会经济地位不能。身体他人欣赏主导组和中等身体意象组的限制性进食均高于积极身体意象组，中等身体意象组的情感性进食也更高，三组在外源性进食上无显著差异。作者据此提示干预应结合性别与BMI并针对不同剖面特征设计。

papers.title: An explainable machine learning model based on multidimensional task-state electroencephalography for identifying attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder comorbid developmental dyslexia
papers.authors: Keduo Huang, Pengxiang Zuo, Xuemei Luo, Chun Ji, Fang Yang, Yuhao Huang, Xiaole Wang
papers.abstract: Background: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and developmental dyslexia (DD) are highly comorbid, yet objective differentiation from individual disorders remains challenging due to the lack of neurophysiological biomarkers. This study aimed to develop an interpretable machine learning model leveraging multidimensional task-state EEG features to distinguish ADHD-DD comorbidity from ADHD and typical development (TD). Methods: Ninety children (27 ADHD-DD, 40 ADHD, 23 TD) underwent EEG during a VSWM task. Five feature categories were extracted: event-related potentials, time-frequency characteristics, functional connectivity, graph-theoretic metrics, and nonlinear dynamics. Three feature-processing strategies and nine classifiers were compared within a nested cross-validation framework. Feature contribution was quantified by coefficient back-projection of the optimal PCA-LR mode. Sensitivity and permutation analyses were performed. Results: The PCA-LR model achieved a balanced accuracy of 80.5%, a Macro-F1 of 0.799, and a Macro-AUC of 0.912. Class-wise AUCs were 0.905 for ADHD-DD, 0.904 for ADHD, and 0.927 for TD. Left temporal α-band functional connectivity was a shared high-contribution feature in both disorder groups. ADHD-DD was distinguished by widely distributed cross-regional connectivity spanning θ and α bands and by P200 amplitude. ADHD was characterized primarily by α-band network metrics and α-ERD, whereas TD relied mainly on θ and α bands functional connectivity and graph-theoretic metrics. Conclusion: Our findings suggest that multidimensional task-state EEG features may help differentiate children with ADHD-DD comorbidity from those with ADHD or typical development. They also indicate that machine-learning approaches may be useful for identifying neurodevelopmental comorbid conditions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）与发育性阅读障碍（DD）共病难以客观区分的问题，利用儿童在视空间工作记忆任务中的多维脑电特征构建可解释机器学习模型，以区分ADHD-DD共病、单纯ADHD与典型发育儿童。结果显示，最优模型在分类上取得较好的平衡准确率与类别区分能力，共病组主要依赖跨区域θ与α频段连接及P200波幅，单纯ADHD组以α频段网络指标和α事件相关去同步为主，典型发育组则更多依赖θ与α频段功能连接及图论指标。作者据此认为，多维任务态脑电特征或有助于识别这类神经发育共病，机器学习方法在该场景中具有潜在价值，但结论仍属模型区分层面的证据。

papers.title: EEG-based mental workload recognition during multi-tasking scenarios: the role of resting-state normalization and brain region of EEG features
papers.authors: Yuchen Ji, Zongqi Liang, Jiaqi Huang, Da Tao
papers.abstract: EEG-based mental workload (MWL) recognition is challenged by inter-individual variability and limited model interpretability. This study investigated MWL recognition in long-term multi-tasking scenarios using resting-state EEG normalisation and regional feature analysis. Participants performed multi-tasking operations at three difficulty levels, while resting-state and task-state EEG, behavioural performance, and NASA-TLX ratings were collected. The best whole-brain model achieved 93.78% ± 0.45% accuracy under standard normalisation, while the parietal configuration retained substantial recognition capability with fewer electrodes. Resting-state normalisation changed EEG feature-importance patterns, but its effects on classification were classifier-dependent rather than uniformly beneficial. SHAP analysis identified prominent frontal and parietal contributions. The findings support interpretable and lightweight EEG-based MWL monitoring in complex operational environments.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对脑电（EEG）心理负荷识别中的个体差异与模型可解释性问题，让参与者在三种难度下完成多任务操作，并采集静息态与任务态脑电、行为表现及主观负荷评分。结果显示，全脑模型在标准归一化下取得较高识别准确率，顶叶配置以更少电极仍保留较强识别能力；静息态归一化会改变特征重要性模式，但其分类效果因分类器而异，并非普遍有益。SHAP分析显示额叶与顶叶贡献突出，作者据此认为该结果支持在复杂操作环境中开展可解释、轻量化的脑电心理负荷监测。

papers.title: Altered neural prioritization of auditory information during cross-modal attention in children with ADHD
papers.authors: Letian Yang, Chen Dang, Weizhen Yin, Xinru Xu, Xuye Yuan, Han Yang, Shanping Zhang, Shuai Jiang, Yuanjie Guo, Yao Wang, Chanjuan Yang, Yanlin Zhou, LI Dongwei, Yan Song, Cai-Ping Dang
papers.abstract: Efficient auditory attention requires prioritizing target over nontarget information. Although attention deficits are a core feature of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), the neural mechanisms underlying auditory prioritization during cross-modal attention remain unclear. We examined neural differentiation between target and nontarget auditory information in children with ADHD. Ninety-five school-aged children (mean age = 10.81 years), including 46 children with ADHD and 49 typically developing (TD) children, performed a visually cued auditory spatial attention task during electroencephalography (EEG) recording. Auditory selective attention was assessed using the N2-anterior-contralateral (N2ac) component and multivariate pattern analysis (MVPA). TD children showed enhanced MVPA decoding of target locations and reduced decoding of nontarget locations. Greater target-nontarget neural differentiation was associated with larger N2ac amplitudes. In contrast, children with ADHD showed reduced target lateralization, smaller N2ac amplitudes, weaker target decoding, and enhanced decoding of nontarget locations, resulting in diminished neural differentiation between relevant and irrelevant auditory information. Reduced target-related lateralization was associated with greater response-time variability, whereas reduced target decoding accuracy was linked to more severe hyperactivity-impulsivity symptoms. Together, these findings indicate that children with ADHD show altered neural prioritization of auditory information within a visually cued attention context. Altered neural prioritization was associated with behavioral variability and symptom severity, providing new insights into the neurocognitive mechanisms underlying attentional dysfunction in ADHD.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）儿童在跨通道注意中如何对听觉信息进行神经层面的优先化，采用脑电记录结合视觉线索听觉空间注意任务，比较ADHD儿童与典型发展儿童的靶刺激与非靶刺激神经分化。结果显示，典型发展儿童对靶位置的解码更强、对非靶位置的解码较弱，靶与非靶的神经分化更明显；ADHD儿童则靶侧化减弱、N2ac波幅更小、靶解码更弱而非靶解码增强，整体神经分化降低。靶相关侧化减弱与反应时变异性增大相关，靶解码准确率降低与多动冲动症状更严重相关，提示这种优先化改变与行为波动和症状严重程度存在关联。

papers.title: Neurophysiological affective reactivity classification and its stability in individuals with cannabis use disorder
papers.authors: Brandon S. Schermitzler, Thomas J. Preston, Mallory J. Cannon, Julia Y. Gorday, Sophia Solan, Scott J. Moeller, Richard J. Macatee

papers.title: Generative AI ‐Supported Creative Writing Among Primary School Students: A Study of Creative Writing Performance, Writing Self‐Efficacy, and Flow State
papers.authors: Xin Liu, Yi Wen, Xiaozhe Yang, Yihe Gao
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background The integration of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) into creative writing is a growing trend. However, few studies have examined primary school students' interactions with GenAI alongside their writing experiences and resulting writing products. Objectives This study compared creative writing performance, writing self‐efficacy, and flow state across GenAI‐supported, peer‐collaborative and individual writing conditions. It also descriptively examined patterns of student–AI interaction during the writing activity. Methods An experiment involved 78 primary school students in China assigned to three conditions: GenAI‐supported writing ( n = 20), peer collaboration ( n = 38; 19 pairs), and individual writing ( n = 20). Results and Conclusions Students in the GenAI‐supported writing group obtained higher creative writing performance scores than those in the peer‐collaborative and individual writing groups. Interaction analysis showed that students mainly used GenAI to generate and elaborate ideas. Among episodes with observable uptake, adapted or selective incorporation was more common than direct incorporation, and no complete GenAI response was reproduced verbatim. In addition, students in the GenAI‐supported writing group also reported higher writing self‐efficacy than those in the individual writing group, although the difference from the peer‐collaborative writing group was not significant. However, they reported the lowest flow state. Writing self‐efficacy was positively associated with creative writing performance, whereas no significant association between flow state and creative writing performance was observed in this sample. These findings suggest that GenAI may serve as a resource for developing ideas in primary school creative writing.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究比较了小学生在生成式人工智能支持、同伴协作与独立写作三种条件下的创意写作表现、写作自我效能与心流状态，并描述性地考察了学生与AI的互动方式。结果显示，GenAI支持组学生的创意写作得分高于同伴协作组和独立写作组，写作自我效能也高于独立写作组，但与同伴协作组差异不显著；不过该组报告的心流状态最低。互动分析表明，学生主要用GenAI生成和拓展想法，在有可观察采纳的片段中，改编或选择性采纳比直接采纳更常见，未出现完整照搬AI回应的情况。写作自我效能与创意写作表现呈正相关，而心流状态与创意写作表现在本样本中未见显著关联。作者据此认为，GenAI或可作为小学生创意写作中发展想法的资源。

papers.title: Object speed and distractor number affect performance but not attentional allocation in multiple object tracking
papers.authors: Nika Adamian, F. Akalan, S. K.Andersen
papers.abstract: Keeping track of multiple moving objects across dynamic real-world scenarios such as driving, team sports, or crowded social environments is a fundamental challenge for visual attention. We have previously demonstrated that as the number of tracked objects increases, the strength of attentional facilitation allocated to each individual object decreases, limiting tracking success. It is also well established that beyond the number of tracked objects, faster-moving objects and objects embedded amongst higher numbers of distractors are more difficult to track. Are these effects on tracking difficulty also mediated by less effective allocation of attention to tracked targets as in the case of tracking more targets? If so, one should expect the strength of attentional modulation to drop systematically with increasing speed and total number of moving stimuli. In two experiments (total n = 70), participants were instructed to track moving targets amongst identical distractors while we manipulated object speed (Experiment 1) and number (Experiment 2). As expected, tracking performance declined with both manipulations. However, steady-state visual evoked potentials (SSVEPs) recorded during successful tracking revealed that attentional enhancement of tracked targets compared with distractors did not drop with increasing speed or object number. In summary, bottom-up changes in the stimulus display and top-down attentional manipulations affect tracking performance in independent ways, with the balance between strength of attentional allocation and bottom-up demands of the task determining successful tracking. The allocation of attention itself seems to be determined exclusively by top-down goals rather than being reactive to bottom-up display characteristics. SIGNIFICANCE STATEMENT: Keeping track of multiple moving objects is fundamental to navigating dynamic real-world scenarios. This ability is accomplished through multifocal attentional selection, which weakens as the number of tracked targets increases. This study asks whether other stimulus manipulations increase tracking difficulty by diluting attentional allocation. Using steady-state visual evoked potentials to measure selective attention during tracking, we demonstrate that both increases in speed and distractor number impair performance, but they do not affect attentional enhancement of targets relative to distractors. This suggests that top-down attentional control operates independently from bottom-up demands.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察物体运动速度和干扰项数量是否通过削弱对追踪目标的注意分配来增加多目标追踪难度，采用两项实验并结合稳态视觉诱发电位（SSVEP）测量追踪过程中的选择性注意。结果显示，速度提高和干扰项增多都会降低追踪成绩，但对目标的注意增强相对于干扰项并未随速度或物体数量增加而系统性下降。作者据此认为，自下而上的刺激变化与自上而下的注意控制以相对独立的方式影响追踪表现，注意分配本身似乎主要由自上而下的目标决定，而非对刺激特征的被动反应。

papers.title: Metacognition in AI-Supported Second Language Learning: A Systematic Review of Constructs, Measures, and Evidence (2016–2026)
papers.authors: Hong Yi, Qiang Chen, Zhuo Wang
papers.abstract: Metacognition has informed research on second and foreign language (L2) learning for three decades, while AI tools have supported such learning for nearly as long. Yet, no review has examined how the field conceptualises and measures metacognition under AI mediation. This systematic review identified 60 eligible studies published between 2016 and May 2026. Each study was coded on fourteen dimensions anchored in established taxonomies and appraised with the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool. Only four eligible studies fall within the pre-ChatGPT portion of the review window, from January 2016 to November 2022; 56 were published during the subsequent three and a half years. Three findings emerge. First, measurement is narrowly concentrated: 98% of the 56 post-ChatGPT studies measured self-reported metacognitive regulation, and 66% relied on self-report alone. Only one study in the full corpus measured metacognitive accuracy. Five post-ChatGPT studies combined an AI-absent comparison with process-level data, and only one of these also measured judgement accuracy. Second, 41% of post-ChatGPT studies used tools that combined two or more functional orientations within a single interface, a configuration not represented by the field’s inherited four-category taxonomy of AI applications. Third, none of the 18 contrast-based studies assigned the regulatory operation to the system in place of the learner. In every design that specified the division of labour, the learner retained that operation; three designs did not specify it. The condition most in need of testing therefore remains untested. Reported findings skew positive, but correlational and qualitative designs account for a disproportionate share of that evidence. The review concludes with a research agenda centred on calibration and process data.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了2016年至2026年间AI辅助二语学习中元认知的概念化与测量方式，共纳入60项研究，并依据既定分类框架进行编码与质量评估。主要发现有三：测量高度集中于自我报告的元认知调节，几乎无人测量元认知准确性，过程数据与无AI对照的设计很少；多数后ChatGPT研究使用的工具在同一界面中融合了多种功能取向，超出了既有四类AI应用分类；在明确分工的对比研究中，调节操作始终由学习者而非系统承担，最需要检验的“系统替代学习者调节”条件仍未被测试。作者指出，现有证据偏正面但相关与质性设计占比过高，并据此提出以校准和过程数据为核心的研究议程。

papers.title: Examining Computer-Science Students’ Metacognitive Beliefs and Reported Practices in Verifying AI-Generated Code: A Concurrent Mixed-Methods Study
papers.authors: Shanshan Li, Jingqi Tang, Zhen Qiang, Zhuo Wang
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) accelerates programming, but its educational value depends on whether students check generated code before accepting it. This concurrent mixed-methods study examined which beliefs accompany such checking among computer-science students at one Chinese university. Survey responses from 294 students were analyzed with an exploratory structural equation model treating three practices as separate outcomes: checking code line by line before use, practicing without AI, and declining in advance to delegate. Robustness checks included ordinal estimation, acquiescence modeling, split-half replication, and multiverse analysis; eleven students were interviewed. Verification-dispensability belief, endorsing reasons for treating further checking as unnecessary, was the only construct negatively associated with all three practices in every robustness check. Other beliefs were narrower or inert: perceived AI literacy accompanied line-by-line checking alone, generic metacognitive self-regulation none. Delegation breadth, the number of activities handed to GenAI, was unrelated to all three: volume of delegation said little about checking. Interviews exposed a mismatch between self-reported categories and actual workflows: students allocated checking by task purpose, accepted process-level understanding, and delegated verification to other AI models, a practice unmeasured by the survey. The data are cross-sectional and self-reported, so these are associations requiring behavioral and longitudinal confirmation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察计算机科学学生在接受AI生成代码前进行核查时伴随哪些信念，以一所中国高校学生为对象，采用混合方法，将问卷分析与访谈结合。结果显示，认为“无需再核查”的信念是唯一在各项稳健性检验中均与三种核查实践负相关的因素；其他信念关联较窄或无关，委托给AI的活动数量也与核查无关。访谈还发现学生按任务目的分配核查、接受过程性理解，甚至把核查转交给其他AI模型，与问卷分类存在错位。由于数据为横断面自报，结论仅为关联，尚需行为与纵向研究确认。

papers.title: AI technostress and professional identity among Chinese university teachers: the mediating role of teaching self-efficacy and the moderating role of perceived organizational support
papers.authors: Youming Yang
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) has entered university teaching faster than the evidence needed to guide its use, and teachers carry much of the resulting strain. This study examined whether AI technostress is associated with the professional identity of university teachers through teaching self-efficacy, and whether perceived organizational support buffers this pathway. A cross-sectional questionnaire survey was conducted with a convenience sample of 486 full-time teachers from five public universities in Guangxi, China, all of whom had used at least one generative AI tool in their teaching or course preparation. Respondents completed Chinese adaptations of established measures of AI technostress, teaching self-efficacy, professional identity, and perceived organizational support. The measurement properties of the adapted scales were verified with confirmatory factor analysis and competing-model comparisons, and the hypotheses were tested with a moderated mediation path analysis based on 5,000 bootstrap resamples. AI technostress was negatively associated with professional identity, and teaching self-efficacy partially accounted for this association. Perceived organizational support moderated the first link of the pathway: the negative association between AI technostress and teaching self-efficacy was weaker among teachers who perceived stronger institutional backing, and the indirect association with professional identity was correspondingly smaller. These findings suggest that teachers' professional identity is vulnerable to technology-related strain and that institutional support may attenuate this vulnerability. Universities that invest in efficacy-oriented professional development and visible organizational support are better positioned to help teachers sustain their professional identity as generative AI becomes embedded in teaching.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察大学教师的AI技术压力是否通过教学自我效能感与其职业认同相关，以及组织支持感知是否缓冲这一路径。作者对广西五所公立大学曾使用生成式AI工具的教师进行横断面问卷调查，并采用验证性因素分析与调节中介路径分析检验假设。结果显示，AI技术压力与职业认同呈负相关，教学自我效能感部分解释这一关联；组织支持感知调节路径首段，即感知到更强机构支持的教师，其AI技术压力与教学自我效能感的负向关联更弱，进而与职业认同的间接关联也更小。作者据此认为教师职业认同易受技术压力影响，而机构支持可能减弱这种脆弱性，并提示相关结论受横断面设计与便利抽样限制。

papers.title: AI feedback-seeking and learning engagement in art education: psychological antecedents and reflective mechanisms
papers.authors: Tianbi Hu, Guangyao Li
papers.abstract: Introduction: Generative artificial intelligence provides students with a feedback source that differs from traditional teacher and peer interaction, yet limited research has explained why students actively seek feedback from AI or how such feedback-seeking is associated with subsequent learning engagement. Drawing on transactional stress and coping theory and social cognitive theory, this study examined the psychological antecedents and reflective mechanisms of AI feedback-seeking in art education. Methods: Two complementary studies were conducted. Study 1 utilized survey data from 315 higher education students with recent experience in art learning and generative AI use to investigate whether a fear of negative evaluation was associated with AI feedback-seeking through interpersonal help-seeking avoidance. Study 2 involved 172 students who completed a standardized AI-supported art-creation task. It examined whether AI feedback-seeking was associated with task behavioral engagement through reflective learning and whether openness strengthened this indirect relationship. The proposed relationships were tested using partial least squares structural equation modeling. Results: In Study 1, fear of negative evaluation was positively associated with interpersonal help-seeking avoidance, which in turn was associated with greater AI feedback-seeking. The indirect association between fear of negative evaluation and AI feedback-seeking through interpersonal help-seeking avoidance was significant, whereas the direct association was not. In Study 2, AI feedback-seeking was positively associated with reflective learning, which was further associated with task behavioral engagement. Reflective learning significantly mediated the association between AI feedback-seeking and task behavioral engagement. Openness strengthened both the association between AI feedback-seeking and reflective learning and the corresponding indirect association with task behavioral engagement. Discussion: The findings indicate that avoiding interpersonal help does not necessarily reflect withdrawal from feedback. Under evaluation concerns, students may instead select AI as a feedback source involving less interpersonal exposure. However, seeking AI feedback is not uniformly associated with stronger learning engagement; its relevance depends on whether students reflect on the information obtained and remain receptive to alternative perspectives. The study positions AI feedback-seeking as both a coping-oriented form of feedback-source selection and a learner-initiated resource for reflective engagement in art education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于交易性压力与应对理论及社会认知理论，考察艺术教育中大学生寻求AI反馈的心理前因及其与学习投入的关联，采用问卷调查与标准化AI辅助艺术创作任务两项子研究，并用偏最小二乘结构方程模型检验关系。研究发现，对负面评价的恐惧与人际求助回避正相关，后者又与更多AI反馈寻求相关，且人际求助回避在其中起显著中介作用，而直接关联不显著；AI反馈寻求与反思性学习正相关，反思性学习进一步与任务行为投入相关并起中介作用，开放性则增强了这一间接关系。作者据此指出，回避人际求助未必意味着回避反馈，学生可能因评价顾虑而转向人际暴露更少的AI；但寻求AI反馈并不必然带来更高学习投入，其作用取决于学生是否对所得信息进行反思并保持对替代视角的开放，因而将AI反馈寻求同时视为应对性的反馈来源选择和学习者主动发起的反思性参与资源。

papers.title: Does learning burnout link physical exercise and problematic short-video use? Evidence from a three-wave random-intercept cross-lagged panel model and supplementary machine-learning analysis among Chinese high school students
papers.authors: Tian Yin, Yanfeng Peng, Longjiang Chen, Zetian Wang, Xu Liu, Changcheng Xie, Zeng Gao
papers.abstract: Background Problematic short-video use has become a growing behavioral health concern among adolescents, yet its longitudinal links with physical exercise and learning burnout remain insufficiently understood. This study examined the within-person bidirectional associations among physical exercise, learning burnout, and problematic short-video use, tested whether learning burnout served as a longitudinal pathway linking physical exercise to later problematic short-video use, and explored the predictive value of these variables for subsequent problematic short-video use. Methods A three-wave longitudinal survey with 6-month intervals was conducted among 1,327 students aged 16–18 years from five high schools in Yunnan Province, China. Physical exercise, learning burnout, and problematic short-video use were assessed using the Physical Activity Rating Scale-3 (PARS-3), the Adolescent Student Burnout Inventory, and the Short-Video Addiction Scale. Random-intercept cross-lagged panel modeling was used to separate stable between-person differences from within-person fluctuations while controlling for demographic and educational covariates. The longitudinal indirect association was estimated using 5,000 bias-corrected bootstrap samples. Supplementary ridge regression and extreme gradient boosting models, using nested cross-validation and a holdout test set, examined the incremental predictive value of physical exercise and learning burnout for later problematic short-video use. Results At the between-person level, higher long-term physical exercise was associated with lower learning burnout and problematic short-video use, whereas higher learning burnout was associated with higher problematic short-video use. At the within-person level, higher-than-usual physical exercise predicted lower subsequent learning burnout and problematic short-video use. Learning burnout and problematic short-video use showed positive reciprocal associations over time, and both predicted lower subsequent physical exercise. The longitudinal indirect association from physical exercise to later problematic short-video use through learning burnout was statistically significant but small. In supplementary machine-learning analyses, the best holdout R 2 was 0.311, but adding physical exercise and learning burnout did not improve prediction beyond prior problematic short-video use. SHAP results from the extended XGBoost model were therefore interpreted as exploratory feature attributions. Conclusion Physical exercise, learning burnout, and problematic short-video use showed interconnected longitudinal associations among Chinese high school students. Learning burnout may represent one small longitudinal indirect pathway linking physical exercise to later problematic short-video use, while recent problematic short-video use provides the most informative signal for future risk. These findings may inform the development and evaluation of school-based health-promotion strategies that support physical exercise, address learning burnout, and respond to recent problematic-use symptoms.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察中国高中生中体育锻炼、学习倦怠与问题性短视频使用之间的纵向关联，采用三波追踪调查和随机截距交叉滞后面板模型，并辅以机器学习分析。个体内层面结果显示，高于平常的体育锻炼可预测随后较低的学习倦怠和问题性短视频使用，而学习倦怠与问题性短视频使用存在正向相互关联，且二者均预测后续体育锻炼减少；学习倦怠作为体育锻炼影响后续问题性短视频使用的中介路径虽显著但效应较小。补充机器学习分析表明，在既往问题性短视频使用之外加入体育锻炼和学习倦怠并未提升预测效果，提示近期使用症状才是未来风险最有信息量的信号。

papers.title: Generative artificial intelligence in jazz improvisation: an Actor-Network Theory perspective
papers.authors: Chenge Gao
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GAI) plays an increasingly significant role in the artistic creation process. In the domain of highly interactive human-machine composition, GAI is no longer a passive tool but exhibits a certain degree of agency. Based on Actor-Network Theory (ANT), a social science theoretical framework proposed by French sociologist Bruno Latour and other scholars, GAI can be viewed as a non-human subject endowed with the status of an actor. In jazz improvisation, a representative creative activity, the agency of GAI is manifested in the generation of its specific musical works, presenting a contrast to human creation. Furthermore, this process reveals the leading and constraining factors in the actions of GAI, as well as the potential pathways and mutual interactions of its future co-creative development with humans.
papers.summary_zh: 该文以行动者网络理论为框架，将生成式人工智能视为具备行动者地位的非人主体，考察其在爵士即兴这一高度互动的人机共创活动中的能动性表现。作者通过分析生成式人工智能所生成的具体音乐作品，将其与人类创作形成对照，进而揭示该技术在创作行动中的主导因素与约束条件，并讨论其未来与人类协同创作的潜在路径及相互互动关系。文章属于理论分析，未报告人类参与者实验或系统性能数据，相关判断建立在概念框架与作品对照之上。

papers.title: Exploring learner–parent–AI interaction patterns in an AI-supported EFL learning game during informal learning: insights from sequence and epistemic network analyses
papers.authors: Simin Xu, Chung Kwan Lo
papers.abstract: Abstract The rapid advancement of digital technologies (e.g., generative artificial intelligence [AI] and digital games) has enhanced informal learning of English as a foreign language (EFL). However, few studies have explored AI-mediated informal learning in primary EFL education settings. The objectives of this study are to explore learner–parent–AI interactions in an AI-supported EFL learning game and to make recommendations regarding AI-mediated informal learning of English. We developed an AI-supported EFL learning game and invited 50 participants (25 pairs of young learners and parents) to engage with the game for informal learning during the summer holiday. Data were collected from (1) video recordings of gameplay, (2) learner–AI dialogues, (3) learners’ pre- and post-tests, and (4) semi-structured interviews with the participants and were analysed using sequence analysis, epistemic network analysis (ENA), the Wilcoxon signed-rank test, Quade’s non-parametric ANCOVA, multiple regression analysis, and qualitative analysis, respectively. Two distinct learner–parent–AI interaction profiles were identified. The Wilcoxon signed-rank test indicated significant increases in scores from pre-test to post-test within both profiles. However, learners’ post-test scores did not differ significantly across the learner profiles after controlling for their pre-test scores. The regression analysis results indicated that learners’ pre-test scores, their engagement in knowledge-learning tasks, and parental cognitive engagement strategies were positively associated with learners’ post-test scores. By contrast, learner–AI interaction types showed no significant association with learners’ post-test scores. Hence, this study informs the future development of AI-supported EFL learning games (e.g., incorporating knowledge-learning tasks and adaptive scaffolding). This study also highlights the potential role of parental cognitive engagement strategies and contributes to an enhanced design framework for AI-supported EFL learning games in informal learning contexts.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注小学英语作为外语的非正式学习中，学习者、家长与AI在AI支持的学习游戏里如何互动，并据此提出设计建议。作者开发了一款AI支持的英语学习游戏，邀请25对小学生与家长在暑假使用，结合游戏录像、学习者与AI对话、前后测和访谈，用序列分析、认知网络分析及统计与质性方法考察互动模式。研究识别出两类学习者—家长—AI互动特征，两类学习者的后测成绩均较前测显著提高，但控制前测后两类学习者的后测成绩无显著差异；前测成绩、知识学习任务的投入以及家长的认知参与策略与后测成绩正相关，而学习者与AI的互动类型与后测成绩无显著关联。文章据此建议在AI支持的英语学习游戏中融入知识学习任务与自适应支架，并强调家长认知参与策略的潜在作用。

papers.title: Distinct Visual Pathways of Threat Retrieval in Fear‐Conditioned Faces
papers.authors: Enya M. Weidner, Marlene Götze, Adrian Taday, Johanna Maria Kissler
papers.abstract: Many have demonstrated rapid (< 100 ms) visuo-cortical differentiation of threat-associated faces. This may go back to low-spatial frequency (LSF) visual information originating from magnocellular pathways. Yet it remains unknown whether potentially magnocellular fear signals extend beyond evolutionarily prepared emotional faces. If so, spatial frequency characteristics should modulate visual processing of faces with newly acquired threat-relevance. Furthermore, it is unclear whether sub-bands of the visual spectrum are associated with autonomic arousal. Using a differential fear-conditioning paradigm (n = 68), this study tested whether early visual attentional capture, indicated by the P1 event-related potential component, face encoding, indicated by the N1 component, and autonomic arousal, indicated by skin conductance responses (SCR), prioritizes LSF information of threat-associated faces with neutral expressions during fear retrieval. Additionally, correlations tested whether the same subcortical system underlies the P1 and SCR. Stimulus ratings and N1 amplitudes confirmed successful fear acquisition. During fear retrieval, the P1 showed a selective left-hemispheric enhancement in response to LSF threat-faces. By contrast, the N1 was sensitive to spatial frequency but not fear-relevance. CS-differentiation in the SCR was not modulated by spatial frequency but longer CS presentations resulting in larger fear differentiation. Amplitudes of P1 and SCR were positively correlated only for safety faces. Data support the notion that magnocellular-cortical pathways adapt quickly to novel threat-associations and facilitate rapid threat retrieval in early visual attention, but not face encoding, even for perceptually neutral faces. At least in the present paradigm, subcortical fear pathways do not associate with anticipatory arousal in SCR.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察新获得威胁关联的中性面孔在恐惧提取时，其视觉加工是否优先依赖低空间频率信息，以及这种优先性与自主神经唤醒是否关联。作者采用差异恐惧条件化范式，记录P1、N1事件相关电位与皮肤电反应，发现P1对低空间频率威胁面孔出现左半球选择性增强，而N1只受空间频率影响、不受恐惧关联调节；皮肤电的威胁区分不受空间频率调制，且P1与皮肤电仅在安全面孔上正相关。结果提示，大细胞—皮层通路能快速适应新威胁关联，促进早期视觉注意中的威胁提取，但不涉及面孔编码，也未支持皮层下恐惧通路与预期性自主唤醒相联系。

papers.title: Inducing Interpersonal Closeness: Effects on Inter‐Brain Synchrony and Collaborative Performance
papers.authors: Laura Fornari, Tieme W. P. Janssen, Ido Davidesco, Lydia Krabbendam M. A, Nienke van Atteveldt
papers.abstract: Feeling close to another person is widely assumed to facilitate collaboration. However, causal evidence that interpersonal closeness improves collaborative behavior remains limited, and it is unclear whether any such influence is accompanied by increased synchrony at the neural level. Previous studies comparing inter-brain synchrony (IBS) and collaborative performance across relationship types (e.g., friends vs. strangers) have reported better collaboration and higher IBS in closer relationships, but these effects are confounded by familiarity and shared interaction history. To address these limitations, we experimentally manipulated interpersonal closeness in 123 dyads of strangers (N = 246) to test its causal influence on IBS and collaborative performance. Dyads were randomly assigned to one of three conditions: No Interaction, Small Talk, or a closeness-generating conversation. After the manipulation, dyads completed a collaborative task while undergoing mobile EEG hyperscanning. The manipulation was effective: perceived closeness increased significantly between the No-Interaction, Small-Talk, and closeness-generating conversation conditions. However, induced closeness did not affect collaborative performance or IBS during collaboration. These findings suggest that the better collaboration and higher IBS often reported for pre-existing relationships in previous studies may originate from factors beyond momentary feelings of closeness, such as familiarity derived from prior interaction. Interestingly, across all dyads, we observed a negative association between central delta IBS and collaborative performance, with IBS explaining unique variance beyond self-reported measures. This negative link is consistent with the idea that, in this context, IBS reflects speech-tracking and increased cognitive demands during coordination, rather than coordination efficiency.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过实验操纵陌生人之间的亲密感，考察其对脑间同步与协作表现的影响。作者将陌生人配对随机分入无互动、闲聊或亲密感生成对话三种条件，随后让其在脑电超扫描下完成协作任务。结果发现操纵有效提升了感知亲密感，但诱导的亲密感并未影响协作表现或协作中的脑间同步，提示既往研究中亲密关系与更好协作、更高同步的关联可能源于熟悉度和共同互动历史等因素。此外，所有配对中中央区delta频段脑间同步与协作表现呈负相关，作者认为这更可能反映言语追踪与协调中的认知负荷，而非协调效率。

papers.title: Emotional Context Modulates Neural Prediction‐Error Encoding
papers.authors: Darin R. Brown
papers.abstract: Emotional experiences are closely intertwined with reinforcement learning, yet the extent to which emotional context influences the neural encoding of learning signals remains unclear. The present study examined whether emotional context modulates trialwise neural prediction error (PE) encoding during reinforcement learning. Fifty-six participants completed a drifting three-armed bandit task while electroencephalography (EEG) was recorded. Choice options were consistently paired with positive, neutral, or negative emotional images that were presented during feedback processing. Trial-by-trial PEs were estimated using a computational reinforcement-learning model and related to feedback-locked EEG activity using hierarchical linear mixed-effects modeling. Traditional condition-averaged analyses revealed robust feedback-related ERP responses to reward outcomes but minimal effects of emotional context on overt behavior or mean reward positivity (RewP) amplitude. In contrast, trialwise analyses demonstrated that emotional context significantly moderated the relationship between PE and feedback-locked neural activity. The relationship between trialwise PEs and EEG amplitude was strongest in neutral contexts, whereas it was attenuated in positive emotional contexts during the early RewP interval and in negative emotional contexts during a later posterior stage of feedback processing. Consistent with this temporal pattern, scalp topographies revealed a corresponding shift from early frontocentral to later posterior activity over the course of feedback processing. Together, these findings suggest that emotional context does not substantially alter overt learning performance or condition-averaged reward responses, but instead subtly shapes the neural encoding of PEs during reinforcement learning. More broadly, the results highlight the value of computationally informed trial-level analyses for identifying affective influences on learning signals that may be obscured by traditional condition-averaged approaches.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察情绪情境是否调节强化学习过程中逐试次的神经预测误差编码。作者让参与者完成三臂老虎机任务并同步记录脑电，用计算模型估计预测误差，再与反馈锁定的脑电活动关联。结果显示，传统条件平均分析下情绪情境对行为表现和平均奖赏正波影响很小，但逐试次分析发现情绪情境显著调节预测误差与脑电幅度的关系：中性情境下关联最强，积极情境在早期奖赏正波阶段减弱该关联，消极情境则在较晚的后部加工阶段减弱。作者据此指出，情绪情境主要微妙地塑造学习信号的神经编码，而非明显改变外显学习表现，并强调逐试次计算分析的价值。

papers.title: EEG Signatures Support a Shrinking Spotlight of Attention After Errors
papers.authors: Mark Lavelle, Alexander Fengler, Andrew Zhang, James F. Cavanagh
papers.abstract: Errors inhibit attainment of our goals, but there are many ways to get back on track: from increased caution to heightened attention. In this report we examined EEG signatures of control and perception in 21 participants who completed a luminance-varying flanker task. Hierarchical Sequential Sample Modeling with a shrinking spotlight model was used for algorithmic decomposition of post-error adjustments. Control-related changes included a relationship between frontal midline theta power and raised decision threshold, as well as faster drift rate. Yet contrary to our hypothesis, these relationships were not significantly modulated following an error. Perceptual changes elicited by the luminance manipulation scaled with posterior alpha/beta power; both these extrinsic and intrinsic features loaded on an enhanced drift rate. Most importantly, after an error, this relationship between alpha/beta power and drift rate was enhanced. These findings support separate roles of neural systems in adaptive control: midfrontal regions were linked to generic control, whereas sensory-specific mechanisms of attentional adjustment were specifically recruited to boost evidence accumulation when control is needed.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察错误发生后注意与控制的神经机制，对参与者完成亮度变化的侧抑制任务时的脑电信号进行分析，并用层级序列采样结合收缩注意聚光灯模型对错误后调整进行算法分解。结果发现，额中线theta功率与决策阈限提高及漂移率加快相关，但这一关系在错误后并未显著受到调节，未支持原假设；后部alpha/beta功率随亮度操纵变化，并与漂移率相关，且错误后该关联增强。作者据此认为，中额区域参与一般性控制，而感觉特异性注意调整机制在需要控制时被专门调用以促进证据积累。

papers.title: Blunted Neural Error Monitoring Amplifies the Adverse Effect of Childhood Maltreatment on Depressive Symptoms: Time‐Domain and Time‐Frequency Analysis
papers.authors: Jun Yang, Linghui Yang, Cong Cao
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Performance monitoring (PM) has been suggested as a promising cognitive factor to explain individual differences in the association between early maltreatment and depression, yet evidence remains limited. From a monitoring vs. executive perspective, this study thus comprehensively examined whether and how the neurophysiological (ERN and its time‐frequency decomposition components) and behavioral (posterror accuracy) indicators of PM interacted with childhood maltreatment on young adult depressive symptoms. A total of 192 Chinese university students ( M age = 21.08 ± 1.91 years; 59.4% girls) completed self‐report questionnaires and an Eriksen Flanker task while EEG activity was recorded. The results showed that blunted vs. heightened ERN and error‐related delta were more likely to amplify the adverse effect of childhood maltreatment, especially emotional neglect, on young adult depressive symptoms. However, error‐related theta and posterror accuracy did not show such interaction effects. The findings showed strong robustness across a series of sensitivity analyses. The results provide preliminary evidence that blunted error monitoring but not executive ability, reflected by ERN and error‐related delta, may be a neurobiological moderator that underlies maltreatment‐related depression, which deepens the cognitive control underpinnings of depression. However, given the high‐functioning sample, caution is warranted when generalizing these findings in high‐risk clinical samples.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察表现监测的神经生理与行为指标是否调节童年虐待与抑郁症状的关联，以192名中国大学生为对象，结合问卷、Eriksen Flanker任务和脑电记录进行分析。结果显示，ERN及错误相关delta波减弱会放大童年虐待（尤其是情感忽视）对抑郁症状的不利影响，而错误相关theta波和错误后正确率未呈现此类交互。作者据此提出，错误监测而非执行能力可能是童年虐待相关抑郁的神经生物学调节因素，但样本为高功能群体，结论向高风险临床人群推广时需谨慎。

papers.title: Double Negation Without Double Effort: ERP Evidence From Mandarin Chinese
papers.authors: Xiaodong Xu, Zichen Lin
papers.abstract: Accounts of negation processing, including two-step simulation, pragmatic, and monotonicity-based accounts, differ in their predictions about whether double negation requires additional cognitive effort relative to affirmation. Using event-related potentials, we investigated a Mandarin Chinese double-negation structure ("méiyǒu X bù Y") that is logically equivalent to its affirmative counterpart ("suǒyǒu X dōu Y"). Forty native speakers read context sentences (double negation vs. affirmation) followed by critical sentences containing semantically congruent or incongruent target words. Crucially, the target word appeared in a separate sentence, downstream from the negation operators; the design, therefore, tests whether a pragmatically licensed double negation establishes a discourse representation functionally equivalent to affirmation at the point of propositional evaluation. At the critical word, incongruent words elicited larger N400/P600 amplitudes, and these congruency effects did not differ between contexts, indicating equivalent representations and no detectable downstream cost. Post-critical analyses, however, revealed context-specific differences: the affirmation context showed a prolonged negativity to incongruency-plausibly reflecting sustained engagement with its more salient violation-whereas the double negation context did not. A representational similarity analysis (RSA) further showed greater neural tracking of incongruency magnitude in the double negation context at a later window (726-798 ms). Together, these findings indicate that a pragmatically licensed double negation supports downstream semantic integration as efficiently as affirmation, while later processing remains context-sensitive. Because this early equivalence is also consistent with a monotonicity-based account, we frame the early-equivalence/late-divergence pattern as a tentative dual-stage characterization to be tested in future work, rather than a decisive adjudication between theories.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究用事件相关电位考察汉语双重否定结构（“没有X不Y”）在语义整合上是否比肯定句需要更多认知努力，40名母语者阅读双否定或肯定语境后，再阅读含语义一致或不一致目标词的句子。结果发现，不一致词在两种语境下都诱发更大的N400/P600，且一致性效应在语境间无差异，说明双否定在命题评价阶段建立了与肯定句功能等价的话语表征，未出现可检测的下游代价；但关键词之后的加工仍受语境影响，肯定语境对不一致表现出持续负波，双否定语境则在较晚时间窗对不一致程度有更强的神经追踪。作者据此提出早期等价、晚期分化的初步双阶段描述，并指出该模式尚不能 decisive 判定各理论，需未来研究检验。

papers.title: From AI innovation to educational inclusion: comparative perspectives on AI-enabled personalized learning and transformative skill development across developed and developing country contexts
papers.authors: Shouket Ahmad Tilwani, Anas Alhur, Isa Spahiu, Yalalem Assefa, Bekalu Tadesse Moges, Huda Majeed
papers.abstract: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in higher education offers significant potential to enhance personalized learning and workforce development. However, AI adoption varies widely between developed and developing countries due to differences in digital infrastructure, socio-economic conditions, and institutional capacity. This study employs a meta-synthesis approach following PRISMA guidelines to systematically synthesize empirical studies on AI’s role in reshaping personalized learning and skill development in higher education across developing and developed country contexts. The study findings reveal that while AI can improve educational outcomes globally, equitable benefits depend on context-sensitive implementation. In developed countries, AI integration in higher education has advanced to an innovation–optimization phase, featuring adaptive learning platforms, generative instructional tools, and strong governance structures. Despite these advancements, challenges remain around algorithmic transparency, pedagogical integration, and maintaining human agency. In contrast, developing countries are often in an access–readiness phase, where AI is primarily considered for expanding access, addressing resource limitations, and fostering basic digital literacy. Barriers such as infrastructure deficits, low AI literacy, and reliance on external algorithms hinder equitable adoption and localization efforts. The study highlights the contrasting challenges faced by each context: developed regions focus on ethical oversight amid innovation, while developing regions struggle with foundational capacity and sustainability. Based on these insights, an equity-driven framework for inclusive AI integration is proposed, centered on four pillars: governance and policy alignment, infrastructure and access equity, algorithmic transparency, and AI literacy. This framework aims to guide institutions in aligning AI adoption with local realities and promoting inclusive and sustainable education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究采用遵循PRISMA指南的元综合方法，系统梳理了发达国家与发展中国家高等教育中人工智能用于个性化学习和技能发展的实证研究。分析发现，AI虽在全球范围内有望改善教育结果，但能否公平获益取决于情境适配的实施：发达国家已进入创新—优化阶段，具备自适应学习平台、生成式教学工具和较强治理结构，但仍面临算法透明度、教学整合与人类能动性等挑战；发展中国家多处于接入—准备阶段，主要用AI扩大教育机会、缓解资源限制和培养基础数字素养，受基础设施不足、AI素养偏低和依赖外部算法制约。文章据此提出以治理与政策协调、基础设施与接入公平、算法透明度和AI素养为四大支柱的公平导向框架，用以指导院校将AI应用与本地现实对齐。

papers.title: Designing and Evaluating a Socratic-Scaffolded Conversational AI Assistant for Educational Tasks: Cross-Cohort Effectiveness, User Perception, and the Effort Signature
papers.authors: Kuei-Hao Li, Chia-Kai Chang
papers.abstract: Conversational artificial intelligence (AI) assistants are proliferating, yet direct-answer interaction can yield short-term task gains alongside skill regression on later unaided work. We report the design and three-semester evaluation of a Socratic-scaffolded conversational AI assistant in an introductory programming course at a northern Taiwanese university. The system layers retrieval grounding to instructor materials, Socratic-by-default response prompting, and metacognitive interaction tracking using Bloom's taxonomy. A cross-cohort task-effectiveness study (pooled N = 82) found large pre-to-post gains (d = 1.20) replicated across cohorts, although the absence of a non-scaffolded control precludes causal attribution. A perception study (N = 203) showed positive usability, acceptance, and satisfaction (normalized means 75–79%), with no decay across semesters. An interaction-pattern study (N = 90) revealed the predicted effort signature: users judged the Socratic mode more effortful yet endorsed it for perceived depth of understanding. We discuss implications for designing assistants for skill-building rather than task completion.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究设计并评估了一款面向入门编程课程的苏格拉底式脚手架对话AI助手，系统结合了基于教师材料的检索、默认苏格拉底式回应提示以及基于布鲁姆分类法的元认知交互追踪。跨学期任务效果研究显示，学生在前后测中表现出较大提升且在不同学期重复出现，但由于缺少非脚手架对照组，作者明确无法据此作因果归因；感知研究则表明可用性、接受度和满意度均较积极，且未随学期衰减。交互模式研究进一步发现，用户认为苏格拉底模式更费力，却认可其有助于加深理解，文章据此讨论了面向技能培养而非任务完成的助手设计含义。

papers.title: How do we measure creativity? A systematic review and taxonomy of evaluative methods in human-AI co-creativity
papers.authors: Mahima Ahsan, Wenfang Shi, D. Vaughn Becker, Gonzalo Ramos, Daricia Wilkinson
papers.abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) rapidly integrates as a cognitive partner in day-to-day creative tasks, to truly understand the value and effects of this integration, it is critical to know how co-creativity is defined, measured, and understood. Without a coherent understanding of the evaluative practices in the field, it is challenging for researchers to determine which metrics are appropriate, for practitioners to adopt effective evaluative methods, and for the field to build cumulative knowledge. To address this pressing need, we conduct a systematic review of Human-AI (HAI) co-creativity measurement metrics and evaluative methods. Through a critical analysis of how creativity is conceptualized and measured, we synthesize existing evaluation practices into a taxonomy for interpreting HAI co-creativity research. This taxonomy provides a multidimensional framework for interpreting how creativity is operationalized across the literature. By mapping these measurement patterns and gaps, this study ultimately offers researchers and practitioners a deeper understanding of how creativity can be meaningfully assessed in Human-AI co-creative tasks and provides a starting point for the development of more rigorous and context-sensitive measurement strategies for HAI co-creativity and cognitive support.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了人机协同创造研究中创造力的测量指标与评估方法，并基于对创造力如何被概念化和测量的批判性分析，将现有评估实践归纳为一个分类框架。该框架从多维角度呈现文献中创造力的操作化方式，并映射出测量模式与空白，为研究者和实践者判断何种指标适用、如何更有意义地评估人机协同创造任务提供了参照，也为发展更严谨、更贴合情境的测量策略提供了起点。

papers.title: From stigma to trust: A paradigm shift for understanding perceptions of individuals with bipolar disorder.
papers.authors: Thomas Bradford Bitterly, Lisa A. O’Donnell, Melvin G. McInnis
papers.abstract: Individuals with bipolar disorder (BD) face professional and personal challenges such as underemployment. Navigating these challenges involves the dilemma of whether to disclose their illness or conceal it and risk presenting symptoms. Examinations of these challenges are often anchored in stigma, which has attributed negative employment outcomes for individuals with BD to adverse reactions from managers following disclosure. Across three experiments, including a managerial sample and a novel chatbot interaction, and eight supplemental studies (N = 8,112), the present research proposes and tests a trust-based attributional model. Mania, the hallmark symptom of BD, signals activation-based unpredictability, which serially erodes the perceived trustworthiness of an employee, ultimately compromising a manager's trust and willingness to retain the employee. The current findings demonstrate that disclosure is not uniformly harmful and that stigma operates as a distal moderator. An employee disclosing in the absence of mania can appear less predictable, and managers high in preexisting stigma toward BD generally view employees as less predictable. However, when manic symptoms are visible, disclosure buffers against their negative impact by providing an explanation for the erratic behavior. Together, this research reveals that moving beyond stigma-centric accounts clarifies managerial perceptions of employees with BD, with disclosure and stigma shaping this trust-based process. papers.summary_zh: 该研究针对双相障碍员工在披露病情与隐瞒症状之间的两难处境，提出并检验了一个以信任为核心的归因模型，通过多项实验和补充研究考察管理者对这类员工的感知。研究发现，躁狂症状会传递出激活性的不可预测信号，进而削弱员工被感知的可信度，最终降低管理者的信任和留用意愿；而披露并非一律有害，当躁狂症状可见时，披露反而能通过解释异常行为起到缓冲作用。文章据此指出，污名更多作为远端调节因素发挥作用，理解管理者的判断需要超越以污名为中心的解释，转向信任形成过程。
