papers.title: Circadian and Sleep-Wake Modulation of EEG Functional Connectivity Across Brain States and Its Associations With Cognition in Humans
papers.authors: Alpár S. Lázár, Zsolt I. Lázár, Nayantara Santhi, June Chi-Yan Lo, John A Groeger, Derk-Jan Dijk
papers.abstract: Sleep and circadian rhythms both influence human brain function, but their distinct contributions to large-scale network organization remain unclear. We quantified the effect of brain state (wake, NREM, REM), sleep-wake history, and circadian phase on functional connectivity using over 1,200 hours of artifact-free EEG recorded during a 10-day forced-desynchrony protocol. We derived principal components of functional connectivity and found that both sleep-wake history and circadian phase significantly modulated functional connectivity, with sleep-wake history exerting a broader influence. Complementary cosinor analyses further demonstrated circadian rhythmicity in several NREM and REM connectivity measures. Across sleep, global connectivity increased progressively during NREM sleep, particularly in the delta and sigma bands, but declined during REM sleep. During controlled resting wakefulness, increasing time awake was associated with higher global alpha-band connectivity, which was associated with poorer concurrent cognitive performance. Connectivity during NREM sleep was also associated with subsequent cognitive performance, with lower global theta and, to a lesser extent, higher sigma connectivity linked to better performance. REM connectivity was not associated with these cognitive measures. Together, these findings reveal opposing NREM and REM trajectories in large-scale EEG functional connectivity and show that these brain-state-specific network dynamics are shaped by both sleep-wake history and circadian phase and are associated with cognitive performance.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注睡眠与昼夜节律如何分别影响人脑大规模功能网络组织，利用强制去同步方案下长时间记录的无伪迹脑电，考察觉醒、非快速眼动睡眠和快速眼动睡眠等脑状态及睡眠-觉醒史、昼夜相位对功能连接的作用。作者发现睡眠-觉醒史和昼夜相位均显著调节功能连接，前者影响更广，部分睡眠期连接指标还呈现昼夜节律性；非快速眼动睡眠中全局连接逐步增强，快速眼动睡眠中则下降。觉醒延长与更高的全局α频段连接相关，而这种连接与较差的同期认知表现相关；非快速眼动睡眠连接也与后续认知表现相关，快速眼动睡眠连接则未见此类关联。这些结果揭示了两种睡眠状态在功能连接上的相反变化轨迹，并提示其与认知表现相关。

papers.title: Differing subjective and psychophysiological response patterns to a music-based auditory intervention for anxiety
papers.authors: Frank Russo, Yoseph Lahmany, Sean A. Gilmore, Harley Glassman, Rachel I. Ulrich, Rhiannon Y. Ueberholz, Adiel Mallik
papers.abstract: Anxiety comprises partially dissociable cognitive and somatic components, yet it remains unclear whether brief interventions modulate these systems in parallel. This randomized controlled trial examined subjective and psychophysiological responses to a brief music-based auditory intervention relative to an active auditory control (pink noise) in undergraduate students reporting recent generalized anxiety symptoms. Participants (N = 83) were randomized to the auditory intervention or pink noise. Cognitive and somatic anxiety were assessed before and after the intervention, while salivary cortisol, heart rate variability (HRV), and electroencephalography (EEG) indexed endocrine, autonomic, and neural processes. Cortisol showed a significant Condition × Time interaction, with larger reductions following the auditory intervention. Midline theta power also exhibited a significant Condition × Time interaction, reflecting opposing patterns of change across conditions, although within-condition changes were only significant in the pink noise condition. Cognitive anxiety, somatic anxiety, affective arousal, frontal alpha lateralization, and HRV did not show significant differential baseline-to-post change. During listening, HRV increased across conditions, but the Condition × Epoch interaction observed in the primary growth model was not retained when participant-specific slopes were included. Together, these findings indicate differing patterns of response across levels of analysis, with broad reductions in self-reported anxiety and arousal across both auditory conditions and greater condition sensitivity in the primary cortisol and midline-theta analyses. Because the cortisol and theta interactions were not retained in models including all physiologically valid observations, these condition-dependent findings should be interpreted cautiously.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察一段简短的音乐听觉干预能否同时调节焦虑的认知与躯体成分，以报告近期广泛性焦虑症状的大学生为对象，采用随机对照设计，与粉红噪声主动听觉对照比较，并结合主观量表、唾液皮质醇、心率变异性与脑电指标。结果显示，两种听觉条件下自我报告的焦虑与唤醒均普遍下降，而皮质醇与中线θ功率出现条件×时间交互，提示干预在部分生理指标上更具条件敏感性；但认知焦虑、躯体焦虑、额区α偏侧化和心率变异性未见显著差异，且皮质醇与θ的交互在纳入全部有效生理观测的模型中不再保留，作者因此提醒对这些条件相关发现应谨慎解读。

papers.title: High resolution EEG microstate framework in fibromyalgia: An integrated multivariate and source localization approach to pain-related dynamics
papers.authors: Dino Soldic, María Carmen Martín-Buro, Cristina Rubio, Irene Peláez, Masaya Ueda, Ryouhei Ishii, Keiko Yamada, Keita Ueno, Martín García-Montes, David Ferrera, Roberto Fernandes-Magalhaes, Francisco Mercado
papers.abstract: Fibromyalgia (FM) is a nociplastic pain syndrome associated with altered central nervous system processing consistent with central sensitization, leading to enhanced pain perception. Despite its prevalence, the underlying neurophysiological mechanisms remain unclear. In this study, we characterized resting-state EEG (RS-EEG) dynamics in FM using a high resolution microstate (MS) framework combined with multivariate pattern analysis (MVPA) and source localization. 5-min eyes-closed RS-EEG was recorded from 57 female participants (29 FM patients and 28 healthy controls), and an 11-MS template was determined using the KL-GEV criterion. To assess the discriminative value of MS spatiotemporal features, we applied linear discriminant analysis with leave-one-out cross-validation. MS features were correlated with clinical measures, and source-level group differences were estimated using exact low-resolution electromagnetic tomography (eLORETA). MVPA identified MS G as the most discriminative state (AUC = 0.63), although it remained below commonly used thresholds for clinical interpretability (AUC > 0.75). Source-level analyses revealed significant differences in the insula (MS B and G), and in the middle frontal and postcentral gyri (MS E). No clinical associations survived correction for multiple comparisons, although exploratory trends suggested relationships between pain- and fatigue-related symptoms and MS B and E features. Overall, MVPA and eLORETA findings indicated altered spatiotemporal MS dynamics within somatosensory, salience, and executive networks in FM, consistent with central sensitization and dysfunction across large-scale pain networks. These findings highlight the potential of RS-EEG MS as candidate markers of pain-related neurophysiological heterogeneity within established FM, while their diagnostic utility remains to be established.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注纤维肌痛患者静息态脑电微状态的时空动态特征，采用高分辨率微状态框架结合多变量模式分析与源定位，比较患者与健康对照的差异。多变量分析显示微状态G最具区分度，但分类性能未达到临床可解释的常用阈值；源水平分析在岛叶及额中回、中央后回等区域发现组间差异，提示躯体感觉、突显与执行网络存在异常。临床症状与微状态特征的相关性经多重比较校正后均不显著，仅呈探索性趋势。作者据此认为静息态脑电微状态有望作为刻画纤维肌痛疼痛相关神经生理异质性的候选标记，但其诊断价值尚待确立。

papers.title: How School-Based Interventions Shape the Developing Brain during 3-12 Years: A Systematic Review and Exploratory Meta-analysis
papers.authors: Jingwen Li, Runke Huang, Hui Li
papers.abstract: The effects of school-based interventions (SBIs) on children’s neurodevelopment are poorly synthesized. This systematic review integrates neuroscientific evidence on how structured educational activities influence brain development in children aged 3-12 years. Following PRISMA guidelines, we identified 17 empirical studies (published 2014–2025) using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS), electroencephalography (EEG), magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), or magnetoencephalography (MEG). Of these, 8 studies were included in a random-effects meta-analysis and all 17 in a thematic synthesis. The meta-analysis revealed a preliminary association between SBIs and reduced amygdala activity during stress regulation tasks ( r = –.28, 95% CI [–.50, –.02]), based on two studies, which should be interpreted as exploratory rather than confirmatory. No significant pooled effect for executive function, likely due to high heterogeneity. Thematic analysis distinguishes between mechanisms of plasticity and markers of intervention effectiveness: the first three characterize intra-individual mechanisms of experience-dependent plasticity, including (1) executive function interventions engaged prefrontal networks through both increased recruitment and enhanced neural efficiency; (2) socio-emotional programs modulated limbic-prefrontal circuits; (3) language and auditory programs shaped sensory-specific electrophysiological markers and cortical specialization; and the fourth theme identifies a neural marker of the effective process of intervention delivery, demonstrating that (4) teacher-child inter-brain synchrony was positively correlated with learning outcomes. By integrating findings across neural, cognitive, and affective domains, this review provides a conceptual framework linking pedagogical practices to neural plasticity and advances the understanding of the neurofunctional pathways through which educational experiences shape the developing brain.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理了3至12岁儿童中校本干预如何影响脑发育的神经科学证据，纳入17项采用fNIRS、EEG、MRI或MEG的实证研究，并对其中8项做了随机效应元分析。元分析仅基于两项研究提示校本干预与压力调节任务中杏仁核活动降低存在初步关联，作者明确将其定位为探索性而非确证性结果；执行功能未见显著合并效应，可能源于高异质性。主题综合进一步区分了经验依赖性可塑性的个体内机制与干预实施有效性的神经标记，前者涉及前额网络、边缘-前额回路及感觉特异性电生理标记，后者表现为师生脑间同步与学习结果正相关。综述据此提出连接教学实践与神经可塑性的概念框架，但整体证据仍属初步。

papers.title: What does it take to grasp a tool? A fine-grained multiple-case analysis of hand-tool and tool-object interaction errors in apraxia
papers.authors: Josselin Baumard, Marie Teodoro-Oliveira, Léna Guezouli, Natacha Guzzo, Olivier Galaverna
papers.abstract: Apraxia of tool use is a neuropsychological syndrome characterized by difficulties in selecting or using familiar tools that cannot be better explained by primary motor, sensory, attentional, or language deficits. The neuropsychological literature indicates that tool use is a complex, multifaceted ability relying on heterogeneous cognitive processes and neural substrates. Patients may commit errors at different stages of the grasp-to-use sequence, including hand-tool interaction errors (e.g., holding tools upside-down), tool-object association errors (i.e., incorrect matching of the functional parts of tools and objects), and tool-object interaction errors (i.e., inappropriate mechanical actions), resulting in reduced performance efficiency. However, the cognitive origins of these distinct error types remain unclear, making their interpretation challenging for both researchers and clinicians. We report the case of D.B., a 69-year-old right-handed woman who sustained multiple strokes. D.B. demonstrated flawless tool selection and subnormal tool-object associations, but clearly abnormal hand-tool and tool-object interactions, in the context of impaired technical reasoning and preserved semantic tool knowledge and planning skills. This profile is discussed in light of previously reported cases of apraxia and optic ataxia. This analysis suggests that tool selection and tool-object association errors may stem from deficits in semantic tool knowledge, whereas hand-tool and tool-object interaction errors are more plausibly explained by deficits in technical reasoning. Motor imagery may also represent a contributing factor and warrants further investigation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究通过一例多次卒中后运用障碍患者的精细个案分析，考察工具使用中不同阶段错误（手-工具交互、工具-物体关联与交互）的认知来源。患者D.B.工具选择完好、工具-物体关联仅轻度异常，但手-工具与工具-物体交互明显受损，同时技术推理受损而语义工具知识与计划能力保留。作者据此提出，工具选择与工具-物体关联错误可能源于语义工具知识缺陷，而交互类错误更可能由技术推理缺陷解释，运动表象或为影响因素，尚待进一步研究。

papers.title: Online learner engagement and academic support in the age of generative AI
papers.authors: Jered Borup, Charles R. Graham, Leanna Archambault, Lauren J. Woo, Michael Kristopher Barbour, Joan Kang Shin, Anya S. Evmenova

papers.title: Artificial intelligence in higher education (2019–2026): A systematic review of applications and an evidence-derived multi-axial taxonomy
papers.authors: Maria Ranieri, Gabriele Biagini
papers.abstract: Generative and agentic artificial intelligence (AI) have expanded AI functions in higher education, challenging taxonomies developed before the generative-AI wave. Following PRISMA 2020, we reviewed 228 peer-reviewed journal publications from January 2019 to March 2026. The publication was the coding unit; codes represented the dominant educational AI use foregrounded in each publication. Inter-coder agreement was near-perfect for the Axis 1 coding scheme (Cohen’s κ = 0.98) and substantial overall for the observed interpretive distinctions (κ = 0.69–0.78). Full-corpus mapping placed 164 of 228 publications (71.9%) outside the four original Zawacki-Richter et al. (2019) categories, but this included transversal ethics/governance and adjacent scholarly-practice literature. The functional-adequacy test therefore used the 154 publications with a classifiable application-focused function: 64 (41.6%) fit the original four categories, whereas 90 (58.4%) required one of three additional domains—AI-enabled student support, content creation and instructional design, or institutional analytics and management. This result was essentially unchanged after removing the 2023 cohort (39/67, 58.2%), and all three added domains persisted in the held-out 2026 search block. Within functional categories, applications also differed in agency, epistemic position, and pedagogy. For agency, the corpus supports an observed assistive–augmentative–delegative gradient; the autonomous endpoint is retained as a prospective theoretical category rather than an empirically validated level. Pedagogical paradigm was less stable and remains the most provisional interpretive axis. We propose a configurational four-axis framework with ethics and equity as a transversal layer, intended to support decisions about oversight, verification, pedagogical alignment and governance rather than to predict educational outcomes.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述按PRISMA 2020流程系统梳理了2019年至2026年间高等教育中人工智能应用的228篇同行评审期刊文献，以单篇论文为编码单位，考察其主导的教育AI功能，并据此提出一个多轴分类框架。作者发现，在154篇功能可归类的应用型文献中，约四成仍可纳入原有四类框架，而近六成需要补充学生支持、内容创建与教学设计、机构分析与管理三个新领域，且这一格局在剔除2023年文献和2026年留出检索中基本稳定。文章进一步指出，各功能类别在能动性、认识论位置和教学范式上存在差异，其中辅助—增强—委托的能动性梯度有语料支持，完全自主仍只是前瞻性理论类别，教学范式维度则最不稳定。作者据此提出以伦理与公平为横向层的四轴配置框架，意在支持监督、验证、教学对齐与治理决策，而非预测教育结果。

papers.title: Topic landscapes and cross-period semantic connections in Computers & Education
papers.authors: Xieling Chen, Di Zou, Haoran Xie, S. Joe Qin
papers.abstract: For the 50th anniversary of Computers & Education, this study describes the topic landscape and cross-period semantic connections among 5,226 articles published from 1980 to 18 June 2026. Independently fitted BERTopic models for 1980–2003, 2004–2013, 2014–2019, and 2020–2026 identified 11, 15, 18, and 9 non-noise topics, respectively. We examine publication shares, exploratory annual trends, semantic similarity networks between adjacent periods, and within-period associations with a predefined artificial intelligence (AI) vocabulary. The retained semantic similarity networks include 22, 30, and 36 topic-level connections across the three adjacent-period comparisons. These networks consist mainly of one-to-many and many-to-many components rather than one-to-one correspondences. The 2014–2019 and 2020–2026 comparison contains one many-to-many component without unlinked nodes, whereas the earlier comparisons contain multiple connected components and several unlinked target topics. In 2020–2026, online learning and teacher competence have the largest publication shares, while generative AI shows the strongest association with the selected AI vocabulary. These analyses provide descriptive evidence on topic prevalence, annual trends, cross-period semantic similarity, and AI vocabulary association. The results should be interpreted within the scope of corpus coverage, modeling decisions, period definitions, and vocabulary selection, and do not imply causal relations or historical processes beyond the observed semantic patterns.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以 Computers & Education 1980 年至 2026 年间发表的 5,226 篇文章为对象，按四个时段分别拟合 BERTopic 模型，考察主题分布、年度趋势、相邻时段间的语义相似网络以及与预设人工智能词汇的关联。结果显示，相邻时段的主题联系多为一对多和多对多结构，而非一一对应；2014—2019 与 2020—2026 的比较中出现一个无孤立节点的多对多连通成分，较早的比较则包含多个连通成分和若干未连接的目标主题。2020—2026 时段中，在线学习与教师能力的发文占比最大，生成式人工智能与所选人工智能词汇的关联最强。作者强调这些只是描述性证据，结论受语料覆盖、建模选择、时段划分和词汇选取的限制，不表示因果关系或历史过程。

papers.title: Prospective predictors of generative AI initiation, engagement, and problematic use among Japanese adults: a two-wave study
papers.authors: Atsushi Nakagomi, Satoshi Inagaki, Takahiro Tabuchi
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) adoption is rising rapidly, but how its determinants extend beyond first-level access into within-user engagement and problematic use remains poorly understood, and almost all existing evidence is cross-sectional. Using two consecutive waves of the Japan COVID-19 and Society Internet Survey (2024 baseline; 2025 follow-up), we examined 49 baseline characteristics — organized with Resources and Appropriation Theory (RAT) as a taxonomy of personal, positional, and resource-based factors of (a) generative AI initiation during 2025 among 9,411 baseline never-users and, among 2,490 new-onset users, (b) use intensity, three purpose composites (productivity/creative, daily-life/information, social/emotional), and (c) problematic AI use measured with the 11-item Problematic ChatGPT Use Scale. All predictors were measured at the baseline wave. Twenty directional expectations were separated from exploratory screening; 17 were supported. Three findings stand out. First, the correlates of adoption and within-user engagement only partially overlapped across all three RAT domains, with several factors — age, graduate education, employment role, and device type — differentiating not only whether people adopted but also what they used AI for. Second, daily-life/information use was largely undifferentiated by age, education, income, employment role, or device type, suggesting an egalitarian leading-edge use case alongside more stratified productivity, social/emotional, and problematic-use domains. Third, problematic AI use was distinct from heavy use on two complementary criteria — measurement-level non-identity and a divergent predictor profile — with predictor profiles diverging across male, agreeableness, and heavy PC/tablet use. Equity-oriented governance of generative AI should monitor not only access and intensity but also the qualitative engagement profile of use.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于日本两轮追踪调查数据，考察成年人生成式AI使用从初次接触到使用强度、用途分化及问题性使用的基线预测因素，并以资源与挪用理论将个人、位置和资源类特征组织为预测框架。研究发现，采纳与使用内参与的相关因素在三类资源维度上仅部分重叠，年龄、研究生教育、就业角色和设备类型等不仅区分是否采纳，也区分用途；日常生活与信息类使用在年龄、教育、收入、就业角色和设备类型上差异不大，而生产力、社交情感及问题性使用领域则更具分层性。问题性AI使用与高强度使用在测量层面并不等同，且预测因素轮廓不同。作者据此提示，生成式AI的公平治理除关注可及性和使用强度外，还应关注使用性质的差异。

papers.title: Self-disclosure context and parasocial relationship in LLM-based chatbot interaction: The role of mind perception
papers.authors: Xi Wang, Yujia Zhou, Guangyu Zhou
papers.abstract: Chatbots based on large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for companionship and emotional support, yet how users’ relational perceptions vary across conversational contexts remains unclear. In a within-person experiment, 102 participants completed two 30-minute chats with an LLM-based chatbot in low and high self-disclosure contexts. The final corpus contained 9,084 dialogue turns from real-time conversations. A high self-disclosure context was associated with a stronger parasocial relationship ( t = 2.46, p = .016) and greater mind perception ( t = 2.70, p = .008). Within-person differences in mind perception were positively associated with differences in parasocial relationship ( β = 0.604, p < .001). A within-person mediation model further yielded a significant indirect association between self-disclosure context and parasocial relationship through mind perception (indirect effect = 0.162, p = .018). To explore linguistic features associated with mind perception, we extracted 51 linguistic features from chatbot responses, covering subjective agency, interactional alignment, formulaic social routines, and expository informativeness. LASSO regression retained 18 candidate features ( R 2 = 0.444). Subsequent mixed-effects models showed positive associations for pronoun proportion, ellipsis usage, lexical overlap, and syntactic dependency depth, and negative associations for gratitude expressions and long-word proportion. These findings characterize within-person relational differences across conversational contexts and identify candidate linguistic correlates of mind perception for further investigation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察了在基于大语言模型的聊天机器人对话中，自我披露情境如何影响用户的准社会关系与心智感知。作者采用被试内实验，让参与者在低与高自我披露情境下分别与聊天机器人对话，并对对话语料进行语言特征分析。结果显示，高自我披露情境与更强的准社会关系和更高的心智感知相关，且心智感知的个体内差异与准社会关系差异正相关，心智感知在情境与关系之间起中介作用；部分语言特征也与心智感知相关。研究据此刻画了不同对话情境下的关系差异，并将相关语言线索定位为待进一步检验的候选因素。

papers.title: Neural Response to Monetary and Social Feedback in Childhood: Processing Reward and Loss in Relation to Peer Outcomes and Anxiety Symptoms
papers.authors: Serena J. Gu, Margaret M Redic, Danielle Kelly, Rebecca Tillman, Kirsten Gilbert

papers.title: EFL teachers' emotional scaffolding strategies in AI-mediated L2 education: A descriptive qualitative study
papers.authors: Xin Lin, Akbar A. Jahanbakhsh
papers.abstract: Recently, the emotional aspects of using Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies in second/foreign language (L2) education have been emphasized in the literature. Nevertheless, the way teachers may support their learners' emotional experiences via scaffolding practices has received comparatively limited attention in English as a foreign language (EFL) contexts. To address this gap, the present descriptive qualitative research explored Chinese EFL teachers' perceived and reported emotional scaffolding strategies used to regulate learners' emotions in AI-mediated L2 education. The data were gathered through interviews with 20 Chinese EFL teachers. The results of thematic analysis revealed five common emotional scaffolding strategies, which were perceived by the participants as useful for regulating their learners' AI-induced emotions. Particularly, they had used 1) personal stories and narratives, 2) technical-emotional support, 3) scaffolded tasks with positive reinforcement, 4) friendly and collaborative atmosphere, and 5) immediate and constructive feedback to support their learners' emotions in AI-mediated classes. The study invites teacher education programs to focus on the psycho-affective aspect of AI integration in L2 education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注在人工智能介入的二语教学中，英语教师如何通过情感支架策略调节学习者的情绪体验，采用描述性质性设计，通过访谈考察中国英语教师的感知与报告。主题分析归纳出五类常用策略：个人故事与叙事、技术与情感支持、带正向强化的支架式任务、友好协作的氛围，以及即时建设性反馈；参与者认为这些策略有助于调节学习者在AI环境中产生的情绪。文章据此建议教师教育项目重视AI融入二语教学的心理情感层面，但结论基于教师的感知与报告，而非对学生情绪变化的直接测量。

papers.title: Generative AI in K-12 creative writing instruction: A systematic review and narrative synthesis
papers.authors: Mátyás Turós, Norbert Beták, Tímea Vargáné Vincze, Vanessza Kapusi, Szabolcs Ceglédi, Zoltán Szűts
papers.abstract: Generative AI is rapidly entering writing instruction in public education; however, a systematic, quality-appraised synthesis of its effects on K-12 students' creative writing is lacking. This review synthesises and critically appraises the empirical evidence, using a scaffolding-versus-substitution framework to distinguish AI-assisted performance from the development of students' own writing. We searched seven databases without language restrictions for 2020-2026, following PRISMA 2020. Risk of bias and methodological quality were assessed with ROBINS-I, RoB 2 and CASP, the certainty of evidence with GRADE and GRADE-CERQual, and findings were synthesised without meta-analysis (SWiM), stratified by design. Seventeen studies met the criteria (total N = 736). All six comparisons of AI-supported with non-AI instruction favoured AI on text quality or creativity, but in every study the scored texts were produced with AI access or under unreported conditions; no study assessed AI-free or delayed writing performance. Effects on writing-related affect were mixed, and no intervention reported a planned withdrawal of AI support. Observational process data indicated that students used AI input to develop their ideas when they retained control, but that AI could also steer the narrative or supply text adopted with little reworking. No study was at low risk of bias, and the certainty of evidence was very low for all quantitative outcomes. The evidence therefore describes what students produce with AI rather than what they learn to do without it; studies with AI-free post-tests, delayed transfer measures and planned fading of support are needed. The protocol was pre-registered (PROSPERO: CRD420261303257).
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统梳理并批判性评估了生成式人工智能对K-12学生创意写作影响的实证证据，采用“脚手架—替代”框架区分AI辅助下的写作表现与学生自身写作能力的发展，共纳入17项研究。所有比较AI支持与非AI教学的六项研究均在文本质量或创造力上偏向AI，但评分文本均产生于可使用AI或条件未报告的情境，没有研究考察无AI或延时写作表现；写作相关情感的影响结果不一，也无干预报告计划性撤除AI支持。观察性过程数据显示，学生保留控制权时会借助AI发展想法，但AI也可能主导叙事或提供几乎未经修改便被采用的文本。作者据此指出，现有证据反映的是学生借助AI能产出什么，而非其脱离AI后学会了什么，且证据确定性很低，未来需开展无AI后测、延时迁移测量和计划性淡出支持的研究。

papers.title: Cognitively demanding motor exercise and subsequent inhibitory control: Behavioral and ERP Evidence
papers.authors: Lee-Xiang Lee, Shih‐Chun Kao, David Moreau, Cheng-Ta Yang, Chia-Chi Tsai, Chun-Hao Wang
papers.abstract: PURPOSE: Acute exercise can influence executive function, yet conventional exercise prescriptions primarily characterize its physical dose and rarely specify the cognitive operations embedded within the exercise bout. Using a Motor-Cognitive Integrated Task (MCIT) with conditions differing in cognitive demand while involving comparable physical demands, this study examined whether cognitively demanding motor exercise was associated with differences in subsequent behavioral and neurophysiological indices of inhibitory control. METHODS: Forty healthy young adults completed two counterbalanced sessions separated by at least 24 h. In the experimental session, participants performed the MCIT, which required whole-body responses to flanker stimuli. In the control session, participants performed the same motor task in response to predictable single-arrow stimuli. Heart rate (HR), physical rating of perceived exertion (RPE), cognitive RPE, response time (RT), movement time (MT), and overall response time (RMT) were assessed during the MCIT. Immediately afterward, participants completed a computerized flanker task while electroencephalography was recorded. RESULTS: Cognitive RPE, RT and RMT of the MCIT were higher in the experimental session than in the control session, whereas HR, physical RPE, and MT of the MCIT were comparable across sessions. Following the MCIT, participants showed a smaller flanker interference in the experimental than in the control session, accompanied by differences in conflict-related modulation of the N2 and smaller overall P3 amplitude, with no between-session difference in accuracy. CONCLUSIONS: Cognitive demand may represent a manipulable characteristic of acute exercise prescription beyond physical intensity alone. Motor exercise incorporating greater cognitive demands was associated with reduced subsequent behavioral interference and differences in N2 and P3 modulation. Although these effects cannot be attributed exclusively to any specific cognitive operation, the findings highlight the potential importance of considering the cognitive characteristics of exercise when examining its acute neurocognitive effects.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察在身体负荷相当的情况下，提高运动任务中的认知需求是否与随后抑制控制表现的行为和脑电指标差异相关。作者让健康年轻成人在两个场次分别完成认知需求不同的全身运动任务，随后进行计算机化侧抑制任务并记录脑电。结果发现，高认知需求条件下任务中的主观认知努力和反应时更高，而心率和体力主观负荷相当；随后高认知需求场次的行为干扰更小，冲突相关N2调制存在差异，P3波幅整体更小，但准确率无场次差异。作者据此提出，认知需求可能是急性运动处方中独立于身体强度的一个可操作特征，但相关效应不能完全归因于某一特定认知操作。

papers.title: Social appearance anxiety and adult picky eating: Associations with sleep quality, depressive symptoms, and body mass index
papers.authors: Gülşen Delikanlı Akbay, Erdinç Karakullukçu
papers.abstract: Background Although adult picky eating has traditionally received limited attention, it is now recognized as a persistent eating behaviour with important psychosocial implications. However, its associations with sleep quality, depressive symptoms, body mass index (BMI), and social appearance anxiety remain insufficiently investigated, especially in non-Western settings. This study explored the relationships between adult picky eating and these psychological and health-related variables among Turkish adults. Methods A cross-sectional study was conducted with 386 adults aged 18 years and older in Türkiye using an online snowball sampling method. Participants completed the Adult Picky Eating Questionnaire (APEQ), the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI), the Beck Depression Inventory (BDI), and the Social Appearance Anxiety Scale (SAAS). Sociodemographic information and BMI were also obtained. Between-group comparisons were performed using the Mann–Whitney U and Kruskal–Wallis tests. Spearman's rank correlation and multiple linear regression analyses were used to examine the associations and independent correlates of picky eating. Results In multivariable linear regression analysis, social appearance anxiety showed a modest, independent positive association with picky eating ( B = 0.103, β = 0.201, p < 0.001), whereas BMI exhibited a weak inverse association ( B = −0.176, β = −0.121, p = 0.033). Depressive symptoms and sleep quality were not independently associated with total picky eating scores. The overall model explained 7.7% of the variance. Exploratory bivariate correlations indicated a modest positive relationship between social appearance anxiety and total APEQ scores ( ρ = 0.264, p < 0.001) with similar patterns observed across subscales, while associations involving depressive symptoms and sleep quality were largely weak or non-significant. Conclusions In this adult sample, picky eating showed a modest positive association with social appearance anxiety and a weak inverse association with body mass index, whereas depressive symptoms and overall sleep quality were not independently associated. These observational findings suggest that appearance-related concerns may be relevant to individual variations in adult picky eating. However, the cross-sectional design, the low explanatory power of the multivariable model ( R 2 = 0.077), and the modest internal consistency of the APEQ require cautious interpretation and preclude causal, physiological, or clinical inferences. Future prospective studies incorporating comprehensive assessments of sensory sensitivity, food neophobia, body image, and dietary intake are needed to clarify the temporal and contextual factors associated with adult picky eating.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以土耳其成年人为对象，采用横断面在线调查考察成人挑食行为与睡眠质量、抑郁症状、身体质量指数（BMI）及社交外貌焦虑之间的关系。回归分析显示，社交外貌焦虑与挑食得分存在独立的正向关联，BMI则呈较弱的负向关联，而抑郁症状和睡眠质量与挑食总分无独立关联；模型解释力较低，双变量相关也仅显示社交外貌焦虑与挑食呈中等正相关。作者据此提示外貌相关担忧可能与成人挑食的个体差异有关，但横断面设计、较低的解释力和量表内部一致性限制了因果与临床推断。

papers.title: When vendor reputation does not matter: Trust decoupling and pragmatic trust in Generative AI adoption among university students
papers.authors: Achmad Nizar Hidayanto, Okky Putra Barus, Muhammad Arief Braja Putra, Muhammad Faris Umar Rahman, Kongkiti Phusavat, Rafif Naufal Rahmadika, Son Sulung Suryahatta Asnan, Dedi I. Inan, Zaenal Abidin
papers.abstract: Trust Transfer Theory predicts that trust in a reputable developer extends to its products, yet this assumption has rarely been tested for non-deterministic generative AI (GenAI) systems. This study examines how trust forms and transfers across conceptual (AI in general), institutional (vendor), and product (specific GenAI tool) levels, and how these trust layers relate to students' adoption intention. Survey data from 480 undergraduate students who actively use GenAI at a public research university in Indonesia were analysed using partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM), complemented by importance–performance map analysis and necessary condition analysis. Eight of ten hypotheses were supported. Attitude toward AI and social influence predicted trust in AI, which in turn predicted both vendor trust and trust in the specific GenAI tool. Trust in the tool was also predicted by problem-solving capability and user interface quality, and it predicted adoption intention (R 2 = 0.32). Two paths were not supported. AI anxiety was not associated with trust in AI (β = −0.02, p = 0.564), a result that applies to students who have already adopted GenAI. Vendor trust did not predict trust in the tool once the other antecedents were accounted for (β = 0.03, p = 0.450). We interpret this pattern as trust decoupling, in which product-level trust rests on direct performance evidence, termed pragmatic trust, rather than on vendor reputation. The findings suggest a boundary condition for trust transfer in GenAI contexts and inform how higher education institutions evaluate and integrate GenAI tools.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以印度尼西亚一所公立研究型大学中480名积极使用生成式人工智能的本科生为对象，通过问卷调查结合结构方程模型，考察信任在人工智能总体、供应商和具体产品三个层面如何形成与传递，以及这些信任层次与采用意愿的关系。结果显示，对人工智能的态度和社会影响预测总体信任，总体信任又预测供应商信任和具体工具信任；工具信任还受问题解决能力和界面质量影响，并进而预测采用意愿。但供应商信任在控制其他前因后并不预测工具信任，作者将此解释为“信任脱钩”，即产品层面的信任更多依赖直接性能证据（务实信任）而非供应商声誉，这为生成式人工智能情境下信任转移理论划出了边界条件。

papers.title: Profiles of the Dark Tetrad and the frequency of GAI-related academic misconduct
papers.authors: Rongjian Sun, Nguyen Thi Thuy Loan, Cheng-Yen Wang
papers.abstract: The rise of generative artificial intelligence (GAI) presents new challenges to academic integrity, enabling students to engage in academic misconduct with reduced effort and risk of detection. While previous research has examined personality predictors of academic misconduct, very few studies have adopted a person-centered approach to explore how distinct Dark Tetrad personality profiles relate to GAI-related misconduct over time. A total of 781 university students in Taiwan completed the Time 1 survey and 760 completed the follow-up one month later. Latent Profile Analysis based on the Dark Tetrad classified students into three profiles: Narc-Psych-Sad, Machiavellian, and High Dark Tetrad. The profiles differed significantly in the total frequency of GAI-related academic misconduct: students in the Narc-Psych-Sad profile reported more frequent misconduct than those in the Machiavellian profile, whereas the small High Dark Tetrad profile showed the highest observed means but did not differ significantly from the other two.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注不同暗黑四人格特质组合如何与生成式人工智能相关学术不端行为的频率相关联，采用以人为中心的方法，对台湾大学生进行间隔一个月的两次调查，并基于暗黑四人格做潜在剖面分析。结果识别出三种人格剖面：自恋—精神病态—施虐、马基雅维利主义和高暗黑四人格；不同剖面在GAI相关学术不端行为总频率上存在显著差异，自恋—精神病态—施虐剖面学生的报告频率高于马基雅维利主义剖面，而人数较少的高暗黑四人格剖面均值最高，但与其他剖面差异不显著。研究提示，人格特质组合的差异比单一特质更能区分GAI相关学术不端行为的风险，但高暗黑四人格剖面的独特风险尚不确定。

papers.title: Socially prescribed perfectionism and graduate student burnout: Dual pathways via impostor feelings and generative AI anxiety, and via academic procrastination
papers.authors: Wendai Yang, Shuya Du
papers.abstract: Graduate students increasingly navigate sustained performance pressure alongside rapidly evolving norms around generative artificial intelligence (GenAI). Drawing on stress and resource perspectives, this study examined whether socially prescribed perfectionism relates to academic burnout through two hypothesized pathways: an identity-threat route involving impostor feelings and GenAI anxiety, and a maladaptive coping route involving academic procrastination, while testing GenAI use frequency as a moderator. An anonymous cross-sectional survey of Chinese graduate students yielded N = 812 valid cases. Participants completed measures of socially prescribed perfectionism, impostor feelings, GenAI anxiety, academic procrastination, and burnout. Confirmatory factor analysis supported a five-factor measurement structure with good reliability and validity, and structural equation modeling with bootstrapped confidence intervals tested the hypothesized indirect associations. Socially prescribed perfectionism was associated with higher impostor feelings and procrastination; impostor feelings were linked to greater GenAI anxiety; and both GenAI anxiety and procrastination were positively related to burnout, with a larger statistical indirect association through procrastination. Multi-group analyses indicated metric invariance and showed that the impostor → GenAI anxiety association was stronger among higher-frequency GenAI users, whereas the procrastination → burnout association was stronger among lower-frequency users. These findings identify two distinct patterns of association linking perceived external evaluative demands with graduate burnout and indicate that the association between impostor feelings and GenAI anxiety differs by GenAI use frequency.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于压力与资源视角，考察社会规定型完美主义与研究生学业倦怠的关联路径，并检验生成式AI使用频率的调节作用。作者对812名中国研究生开展横断面问卷调查，通过结构方程模型检验了两条间接路径：一条经由冒名顶替感与生成式AI焦虑的身份威胁路径，另一条经由学业拖延的应对不良路径。结果显示，社会规定型完美主义与更高的冒名顶替感和拖延相关，冒名顶替感又与更强的生成式AI焦虑相关，而AI焦虑和拖延均与倦怠正相关，其中拖延路径的统计间接关联更大。多组分析还表明，冒名顶替感与AI焦虑的关联在高频使用者中更强，拖延与倦怠的关联则在低频使用者中更强。研究提示外部评价压力可能与研究生倦怠形成两种不同的关联模式，且相关结论受AI使用频率影响。

papers.title: ‘AI-Learner Partnership’: Psychological mechanisms and developmental trajectories of EFL learners’ writing agency in GenAI-assisted courses
papers.authors: Lei Zhang, 魏日宁, Chunli Jiang
papers.abstract: This study explores how EFL learners construct, negotiate, and develop writing agency through engagement with generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) in second language writing courses. GenAI is conceptualized as a cultural mediational means within an integrated sociocultural and positive psychological framework. Eleven Chinese EFL university students were followed over a 16-week semester as they completed multiple academic writing tasks with GenAI support. Drawing on a qualitative multi-method design, data were collected through semi-structured interviews, screen recordings of writing sessions, and reflective journals. The analysis identified three interrelated, non-linear phases in learners' agency development: initial exploration (characterized by novelty-driven engagement, dependency on AI output, and emergent self-efficacy), strategic adaptation (marked by more selective, task-contingent tool use and the strengthening of writing-specific psychological capital), and deliberate appropriation (signaled by personalized integration of GenAI into writing workflows and the emergence of a more agentic techno-authorial identity). Across these phases, cognitive processes, affective experiences, positive psychological resources, and task design features jointly shaped how learners mobilized technological affordances to enact writing agency. The findings suggest that writing agency in human-AI collaborative writing is a dynamic, context-sensitive accomplishment rather than a fixed individual trait. By connecting sociocultural accounts of mediated action with positive psychological resources, the study offers a process-oriented account of how EFL learners negotiate assistance, authorship, and autonomy in GenAI-supported academic writing.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察中国英语学习者在生成式人工智能辅助写作课程中如何建构、协商并发展写作能动性，将GenAI视为一种文化中介工具，采用质性多方法设计，对学习者在学期内完成多项写作任务的过程进行追踪。分析发现，学习者能动性发展呈现三个相互关联且非线性的阶段：初期探索、策略性适应和有意占用，认知过程、情感体验、积极心理资源与任务设计共同影响其如何调动技术可供性。研究据此提出，人机协同写作中的写作能动性是动态且情境敏感的成就，而非固定个体特质，并将社会文化的中介行动视角与积极心理资源联系起来，为学习者如何协商辅助、作者身份与自主性提供了过程性解释。

papers.title: Supporting bystander intervention through conversational AI: Experimental evidence from undergraduate samples
papers.authors: Seoyeon Bae, Marcus Trenfield, Mengyao Zhao, Grace Bauer, Liane Young
papers.abstract: Across campuses and workplaces, people are receiving bystander intervention training to empower them to support victims and mitigate situations of harm. But even after this training, many people remain insecure about their ability to intervene and hesitate to act when intervention is needed. One promising solution to bystanders' ongoing inaction is to provide a safe, judgment-free environment where people can repeatedly practice skills and receive personalized feedback. Here, we explore that solution through a chatbot-based bystander intervention practice tool, where an AI agent guides users through evidence-based training. Across two preregistered experiments with undergraduates-a pilot study conducted on a local college campus followed by a larger online study-we found preliminary evidence that chatbot-guided training may strengthen several motivational outcomes associated with bystander intervention, including bystander efficacy, attitudes, psychological safety, and norm perceptions. This work provides preliminary evidence of the impact of chatbot-guided bystander intervention training. The findings highlight the potential of AI as a pedagogical tool for supporting bystander intervention and provide an empirical foundation for future research on AI-assisted intervention training.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注旁观者干预培训后人们仍缺乏行动信心的问题，尝试用对话式AI聊天机器人提供安全、无评判的反复练习环境，并检验其效果。作者开展了两项针对本科生的预注册实验（先在校内进行试点，随后开展更大规模的在线研究），让AI代理引导用户完成基于证据的培训。结果显示初步证据表明，聊天机器人引导的培训可能增强旁观者效能感、态度、心理安全感和规范感知等多项与干预相关的动机性结果。文章据此认为AI可作为支持旁观者干预的教学工具，但强调这仅是初步证据，结论仍需后续研究验证。

papers.title: Reconceptualizing learning sciences in the era of artificial intelligence: Toward hybrid intelligence and adaptive learning systems
papers.authors: Abdul Malik, Irfan Bashir
papers.abstract: PURPOSE: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming education through intelligent tutoring systems, adaptive learning platforms, learning analytics, and large language models. However, research on Learning Sciences, AI in Education, learning analytics, adaptive learning systems, and Hybrid Intelligence has largely progressed across partially separate research streams, resulting in fragmented theoretical perspectives and limited conceptual integration. This systematic review aims to synthesize the existing literature and develop an evidence-informed Hybrid Intelligence Framework that explains the relationships among Learning Sciences, AI technologies, learning analytics, and adaptive learning systems. DESIGN/METHODOLOGY/APPROACH: A qualitative systematic literature review was conducted in accordance with the PRISMA 2020 guidelines. Literature published between 2004 and March 2026 was retrieved through a focused, intersection-based search across seven databases: Scopus, Web of Science, ScienceDirect, SpringerLink, Wiley Online Library, ACM Digital Library, and Google Scholar. Following duplicate removal and eligibility screening, 32 studies met the inclusion criteria. Data were synthesized using Braun and Clarke's six-phase thematic analysis. FINDINGS: Four interrelated themes emerged from the thematic synthesis: (1) epistemological fragmentation within Learning Sciences, (2) theory-technology contradictions between pedagogical theories and AI-supported educational systems, (3) the datafication of learning through learning analytics and adaptive technologies, and (4) Hybrid Intelligence as an emerging educational paradigm emphasizing collaboration among learners, educators, and intelligent systems. Building on these themes, the review proposes a Hybrid Intelligence Framework that integrates Learning Sciences, Artificial Intelligence, Learning Analytics, and adaptive learning systems into a coherent conceptual model for human-centred, ethical, explainable, and evidence-informed AI-supported education. ORIGINALITY/VALUE: This review advances the literature by moving beyond isolated examinations of AI technologies or learning theories to provide an integrative conceptual synthesis of their interrelationships. The proposed Hybrid Intelligence Framework offers a theoretically grounded foundation for future empirical research, instructional design, educational policy, and the development of adaptive learning environments that integrate human expertise with artificial intelligence while supporting learner agency and pedagogical integrity.
papers.summary_zh: 该综述针对学习科学、教育人工智能、学习分析与混合智能等研究长期分散、理论整合不足的问题，按PRISMA 2020指南检索多个数据库并筛选出32项研究，用主题分析进行综合。分析归纳出四个相互关联的主题：学习科学内部的认识论碎片化、教学理论与AI支持系统之间的理论—技术矛盾、学习数据化，以及强调学习者、教育者与智能系统协作的混合智能新范式。作者据此提出一个混合智能框架，将上述领域整合为以人为中心、合乎伦理、可解释且基于证据的概念模型，为后续实证研究、教学设计与政策讨论提供理论基础，而非报告实验效果。

papers.title: Evaluating multimodal explainable adaptive learning in university EFL education: Learner outcomes, teacher oversight, and implementation conditions
papers.authors: Houda Boumediene, Abeer Aljohani, Mustapha Bouakkaz
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) offers substantial potential for personalized English as a Foreign Language (EFL) instruction, yet concerns remain regarding the transparency of adaptive recommendations, the fragmentation of learner data, and the preservation of teacher oversight. This study empirically evaluates the Multimodal Explainable Adaptive Learning Framework (MEALF), a pedagogical-computational framework operationalized through a prototype system that integrates textual, oral, visual, and behavioral learner information with explainable adaptive recommendations. Grounded in sociocultural theory, situated cognition, and human-centered AI, MEALF was designed to provide differentiated learning support while keeping pedagogical decisions interpretable and subject to teacher judgment. A 16-week partially randomized quasi-experimental mixed-methods study was conducted with 100 intermediate-level EFL learners and 15 teachers across three Algerian universities. Learners in the MEALF-supported condition showed larger proficiency gains and higher post-intervention engagement and metacognitive reading-strategy awareness scores than learners in the comparison condition. Exploratory multimodal analyses further revealed heterogeneous learner patterns that provided additional context for interpreting differences in learning needs and adaptive support. Teacher and qualitative evidence indicated that explanations and override mechanisms helped educators inspect and critically evaluate system recommendations, although teacher-level findings should be interpreted cautiously given the small sample. The findings provide preliminary, context-specific evidence that combining multimodal learner information with interpretable adaptive support may contribute to language development, engagement, and metacognitive reading-strategy awareness while preserving meaningful human oversight. However, the multi-component nature of MEALF, the quasi-experimental design, the small teacher sample, and the single-country context limit causal interpretation and broader generalizability. The study contributes an integrated empirical evaluation of multimodal, explainable adaptive learning by linking measurable learner outcomes with interpretable human-AI interaction and contextual implementation evidence in university EFL education.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察多模态可解释自适应学习框架（MEALF）在大学英语外语教学中的效果，通过原型系统整合学习者的文本、口语、视觉与行为信息，并保留教师对教学决策的审查权。研究采用准实验混合方法，在阿尔及利亚三所大学对中级水平学习者和教师进行为期一学期的实施。结果显示，接受MEALF支持的学习者在语言水平提升、参与度和元认知阅读策略意识上均优于对照条件；教师访谈与质性证据表明，解释与覆盖机制有助于教师审视系统建议，但教师样本较小，相关结论需谨慎看待。作者指出，多组件设计、准实验性质与单一国家情境限制了因果推断和推广性，整体证据仍属初步且依赖具体情境。

papers.title: Silhouette-based body dissatisfaction and positive psychological functioning in Uruguayan adults
papers.authors: Mayda Alejandra Portela, Emilio Pericet-Caro, Julieta I. Sánchez-Bizama, Carla M. Pérez-Jaén, Cristian M. Olarte‐Sánchez
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to analyze the relationship between silhouette-based body dissatisfaction and positive psychological functioning (PPF) in Uruguayan adults, and to explore differences according to sex, body mass index (BMI), and body satisfaction status. METHOD: A cross-sectional study was conducted with 202 adults (M age = 35.44, SD = 12.69; 73.8% women). Participants completed the Stunkard Figure Rating Scale (SFRS), the Positive Psychological Functioning Scale (PPFS), the General Health Questionnaire-28 (GHQ-28), the Dutch Eating Behavior Questionnaire (DEBQ), and a sociodemographic survey. RESULTS: Body dissatisfaction was negatively correlated with PPF total score (r = -0.28, p < .001), as well as with several PPF dimensions, including self-esteem (r = -0.30), vitality (r = -0.29), autonomy (r = -0.18), and environmental mastery (r = -0.23). Body dissatisfaction was positively correlated with psychological distress, as measured by GHQ-28 total score (r = 0.30, p < .001). Participants classified as body dissatisfied had higher BMI and lower scores on several PPF dimensions at the uncorrected level. After Bonferroni correction for multiple comparisons, several PPF dimensions remained significantly lower among body dissatisfied participants, particularly self-esteem, vitality, environmental mastery, optimism, autonomy, resilience, and curiosity. No significant unadjusted sex differences were found in body dissatisfaction. In the adjusted logistic regression model, higher BMI, lower PPF total score, and sex were independently associated with body dissatisfaction status. CONCLUSIONS: Silhouette-based body satisfaction status was associated with higher positive psychological functioning and lower psychological distress. When age, sex, living situation, BMI, psychological distress, subjective socioeconomic level, and PPF were considered simultaneously, PPF remained independently associated with body dissatisfaction. These findings suggest that silhouette-based body satisfaction status is associated with psychological resources and may be relevant for understanding broader psychological functioning. Longitudinal research is needed to confirm causal directions.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究以乌拉圭成年人为对象，采用横断面设计考察基于剪影的身体不满与积极心理功能之间的关系，并比较不同性别、BMI和身体满意状态下的差异。结果显示，身体不满与积极心理功能总分及自尊、活力、自主性、环境掌控等维度呈负相关，与心理困扰呈正相关；身体不满者在多项积极心理功能维度上得分更低，调整后BMI、积极心理功能总分和性别与身体不满状态独立相关。作者据此指出，基于剪影的身体满意状态与心理资源和心理困扰相关，但因果方向仍需纵向研究确认。

papers.title: Navigating the N-shaped path: Nonlinear development of pre-service PE teachers' professional competencies in AI-driven STEAM instruction
papers.authors: TongKai Guan, Walton Wider, Xiaoman Wen, Qiang Song
papers.abstract: This study investigates the longitudinal developmental trajectories of pre-service physical education (PE) teachers' core competencies within a 16-week generative AI-driven STEAM basketball curriculum. Employing a parallel-group randomized controlled trial in which 80 participants were randomized and 75 completed the intervention (experimental n = 37; control n = 38), the study addresses the absence of longitudinal evidence on how Intelligent-TPACK develops over time by identifying a non-linear N-shaped trajectory across the three core competency domains, with two sub-dimensions (Professional Responsibilities, Ethics) as theoretically informative exceptions. Piecewise linear mixed-effects models show a Week-8 decline at peak instructional complexity followed by recovery; the between-group phase contrasts describing this pattern remain significant after correction for multiplicity. Two further patterns are reported as exploratory and hypothesis-generating: higher baseline AI proficiency was associated with a steeper Week-8 decline in classroom management (feature creep), and recovery co-occurred with reduced in-class AI activation (pedagogical simplification rebound). Intelligent-TPACK, interdisciplinary teaching ability and observed teaching practice were associated within persons, but because they were measured on the same occasions this is not evidence of a causal cascade. We offer the Generative AI-TPACK Fatigue Model as a hypothesis-generating framework rather than confirmed theory. The study offers preliminary, context-sensitive guidance for teacher education programs working in comparable settings, and identifies the conditions under which a mid-course performance decline might prove productive as a question for future work.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察职前体育教师在16周生成式AI驱动的STEAM篮球课程中核心能力的发展轨迹，采用平行组随机对照试验，比较实验组与对照组。结果显示，智能TPACK等三个核心能力域呈非线性N形路径：在教学复杂度最高的第8周出现下降，随后回升，组间阶段差异经多重校正后仍显著；职业责任与伦理两个子维度为例外。基线AI熟练度较高者课堂管理在第8周下降更陡，回升则伴随课内AI使用减少，这两点仅作探索性提示。作者强调能力域间的关联不构成因果级联，并提出生成式AI-TPACK疲劳模型作为待检验的假设框架。

papers.title: “It is unfair!”: Exploring EFL students' perceived forms of AI-related assessment unfairness in coursework from a self-determination theory lens
papers.authors: Shuang Liu, Yanghaoze Qin
papers.abstract: The rapid integration of generative AI into foreign language education has reshaped how students complete coursework and how teachers assess. As students increasingly rely on AI to assist with coursework, teachers often cannot reliably distinguish AI-generated from human-authored work, which raises pressing concerns about assessment fairness. Yet how assessment unfairness is actually experienced and perceived, and how learners describe its psychological significance remain under-explored. Drawing on self-determination theory, this study investigates the forms of AI-related assessment unfairness perceived by students who reported experiencing such unfairness, and its perceived implications for students' basic psychological needs. Based on semi-structured interviews with 15 university EFL students, the findings suggest that perceived AI-related assessment unfairness takes the form of false suspicions about AI-generated coursework, unstable or opaque standards, and reward misalignment. Additionally, participants described experiences of frustration in their needs for autonomy, competence, and relatedness in relation to perceived AI-related assessment unfairness, though its perceived intensity varied with learners and contextual factors. The study offers practical implications for redesigning assessment, developing teacher capacity, and establishing institutional guidelines that support fairer, more motivationally sustaining practices.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究从自我决定理论视角出发，考察外语学习者如何感知生成式人工智能带来的课程评估不公平及其对基本心理需要的影响，通过对15名大学英语学习者的半结构化访谈进行分析。研究发现，学生感知到的不公平主要表现为对AI生成作业的误判怀疑、标准不稳定或不透明以及奖励错配，并伴随自主、胜任和关系需要上的挫败感，但其感知强度因学习者和情境因素而异。文章据此讨论了评估再设计、教师能力建设和院校规范制定等实践启示。

papers.title: Explainable machine learning for identifying mild cognitive impairment in older adults with chronic diseases: Model development and temporal validation
papers.authors: Kun Ruan, Yuan Li
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to develop and validate an interpretable machine-learning classification model for identifying MCI at the time of assessment among older adults with chronic conditions. We also evaluated model performance and the stability of TreeSHAP-based feature explanations across survey waves. METHODS: Data were obtained from the CHARLS. A total of 8222 participants from the 2018 wave were stratified by MCI status and randomly divided into a development set (n = 5754) and an internal validation set (n = 2468). Data from the 2020 wave (n = 5558) were used for temporal validation. LASSO regression was performed exclusively in the development set for feature selection, resulting in 27 retained predictors. Using the same feature set, seven classification models were developed: logistic regression, support vector machine, multilayer perceptron, random forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, and k-nearest neighbors. Encoding, standardization, SMOTENC resampling, and hyperparameter tuning were performed within the training folds of 10-fold cross-validation to minimize information leakage, while the original class distributions were retained in both validation sets. Model performance was assessed using the AUROC, AUPRC, classification metrics, Brier score, calibration analysis, and decision curve analysis. TreeSHAP was then applied to the prespecified XGBoost model to characterize feature contributions and assess the stability of global feature importance across survey waves. RESULTS: In the 2018 internal validation set, the prespecified XGBoost model achieved an AUROC of 0.692 (95% CI: 0.660-0.724), an AUPRC of 0.282 (95% CI: 0.242-0.328), a sensitivity of 0.511, a specificity of 0.746, and a Brier score of 0.109. In the 2020 temporal validation set, the corresponding values were 0.702 for AUROC, 0.305 for AUPRC, 0.390 for sensitivity, 0.843 for specificity, and 0.137 for the Brier score. These findings indicate that discrimination remained broadly stable across survey waves, although sensitivity and calibration were limited. Decision curve analysis showed a positive net benefit for XGBoost mainly across low-to-moderate threshold probabilities. TreeSHAP analysis identified number of living children, sleep duration, educational attainment, activities of daily living (ADL), and age as the strongest contributors to model predictions. Global feature-importance rankings were highly consistent between the 2018 internal validation set and the 2020 temporal validation set (Spearman ρ = 0.996). CONCLUSION: This study developed an interpretable machine-learning framework for identifying current MCI status among older adults with chronic conditions. The prespecified XGBoost model showed moderate and relatively stable discrimination in both internal and temporal validation, while its TreeSHAP-based feature explanations were highly stable across survey waves. The model may serve as an adjunctive screening and preliminary risk-stratification tool before formal cognitive assessment, but it should not replace clinical diagnosis of MCI or be used to predict incident MCI or future cognitive decline. Further recalibration and external validation in independent populations are required before implementation.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究基于CHARLS数据开发并验证了一个可解释的机器学习模型，用于在患有慢性病的老年人中识别评估时点的轻度认知障碍（MCI），并考察TreeSHAP特征解释在不同调查波次间的稳定性。作者在2018年数据上训练七种分类模型，以2020年数据做时间验证，结果显示预设的XGBoost模型在内部验证和时间验证中判别能力中等且大致稳定，但敏感性和校准有限，决策曲线分析仅在低至中等阈值概率下显示净获益。TreeSHAP分析表明存活子女数、睡眠时长、教育程度、日常生活活动能力和年龄是主要预测贡献因素，且全局特征重要性排序在两波数据间高度一致。作者据此提出该模型可作为正式认知评估前的辅助筛查和初步风险分层工具，但不能替代临床诊断，也不适用于预测未来认知下降，实施前仍需重新校准和外部验证。

papers.title: Understanding Older Adults’ And Caretakers’ Attitudes Toward Social Robots Using Natural Language Processing and Thematic Analysis
papers.authors: Begüm Çonka, Burcu Aysen Urgen, Yasemin Afacan
papers.abstract: Abstract The present study aims to examine the role of social robots in enriching older adults’ environments and helping them cope with the problems that decrease their well-being and life quality. To understand how social robots can be integrated into older adults’ lives, we investigated both older adults’ and caretakers’ attitudes toward social robots. For this aim, we conducted semi-structured interviews with 30 participants. In these interviews, we showed them photos and videos of the three social robots with different looks, abilities, and degrees of resemblance to humans. Then, we asked them to answer some open-ended questions. These robots were the pet-like robot Aibo, the toy-like robot Paro, and the humanoid robot Pepper. We analyzed the answers using complementary quantitative and qualitative approaches. The quantitative approach included the Sentiment Analysis (SA) and the qualitative approach included the Thematic Analysis (TA). SA results indicate that caretakers approached negatively to Paro, and positively to Aibo and Pepper. On the other hand, older adults did not differ in the polarity of attitudes toward the three robots. The TA results yielded four overarching themes: I) Perceived and expected roles of the robot, II) Physical characteristics and design features of the robot, III) Factors influencing acceptance of the robot, and IV) Disadvantages of the robot. Under those, there were various themes and sub-themes diversified for each robot. Overall, our findings reveal significant insights into older adults’ and caretakers’ approaches to different types of social robots and enable researchers to use these robots more effectively.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究关注老年人及其照护者对不同类型社交机器人的态度差异，通过对30名参与者进行半结构化访谈，展示宠物型Aibo、玩具型Paro和人形Pepper的照片与视频并收集开放式回答，结合情感分析与主题分析进行考察。情感分析显示，照护者对Paro持负面态度，对Aibo和Pepper持正面态度，而老年人对三种机器人的态度极性没有明显差异；主题分析则归纳出机器人角色预期、外观设计特征、接受度影响因素和缺点四类主题，且各机器人下的具体主题有所不同。这些结果提示，不同使用者群体对社交机器人的态度并不一致，机器人类型与使用者身份可能共同影响接受度，相关发现可为更有针对性地设计和应用社交机器人提供参考。

papers.title: Abel: Integrating Large Language Models into the Cognitive Architecture of a Hyper-Realistic Humanoid for Natural Social Interaction
papers.authors: Lorenzo Cominelli, Francesco Bossi, Federico A. Galatolo, Mario G.C.A. Cimino, Graziano Alfredo Manduzio, Alberto Greco, Enzo Pasquale Scilingo

papers.title: Augmentation or Erosion? Regulating Cognitive Offloading in Generative AI-Supported STEM Learning
papers.authors: Daiki Nakamura
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) confronts educational psychology with sharply heterogeneous evidence: meta-analyses report positive average effects on learning alongside prediction intervals spanning harm to benefit, and experiments document gains in some configurations and learning penalties in others. This article develops an augmentation–erosion framework that accounts for part of this heterogeneity by treating the educational effect of GenAI not as a property of the tool but as a property of the partition of cognitive labor between learner and machine. Integrating research on cognitive offloading, distributed cognition, cognitive load theory, and self-regulated learning, the framework holds that offloading augments learning when it discharges operations peripheral to the current learning goal, and risks erosion, whether of acquisition or of maintenance, when it bypasses the processing constitutive of that goal, unless the learner substantively processes the output or later reconstructs it. It supplies criteria for locating operations along a graded peripheral–constitutive continuum, specifies the comparison condition against which augmentation and erosion are defined, and states seven conditioned, testable propositions, each illustrated with a common example and paired with supporting and challenging patterns. On this basis, offloading regulation is proposed as a learning-oriented dimension of AI literacy with domain-general and discipline-specific components: a competence comprising partition discernment, calibrated monitoring, disciplinary verification, and re-internalization, enacted through metacognitive control and conditioned by learners’ goals and motivation. The article closes with an intervention research program, a measurement strategy that triangulates interaction logs with process measures, and equity implications, using STEM learning as a strategically revealing case.
papers.summary_zh: 该文针对生成式AI对学习效果证据不一的问题，提出“增强—侵蚀”框架，将AI的教育效应理解为学习者与机器之间认知劳动分工的属性，而非工具本身的属性。作者整合认知卸载、分布式认知、认知负荷与自我调节学习研究，主张当卸载的是与当前学习目标无关的外围操作时可能增强学习，而当其绕过构成该目标的核心加工时则可能造成习得或维持上的侵蚀，除非学习者对输出进行实质加工或事后重建。文章据此给出区分外围与核心操作的标准、界定增强与侵蚀的比较条件，提出七条有条件的可检验命题，并将卸载调节视为AI素养的学习导向维度，包含分工辨别、校准监控、学科验证与再内化，最后提出干预研究计划与测量策略。该文为理论论文，未报告实证数据。

papers.title: Which Evaluation Strategies Help Students Spot Visual Misinformation on Social Media?
papers.authors: Shai Goldfarb Cohen, Sarit Barzilai, Linor Lea Hadar, Thuraia Copti-Mshael, Liron Primor
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background The rapid spread of visual misinformation online, intensified by advances in generative artificial intelligence, presents new challenges for adolescents' digital information literacy. Although students' difficulties in evaluating online information are well documented, little is known about how they assess different forms of visual misinformation on social media. Objectives This study examined the extent to which lower secondary school students can successfully identify different types of visual misinformation on social media, the evaluation strategies they use, and whether these strategies predict misinformation detection across types of visual misinformation. Methods The participants were 272 students in Grades 7–9 who evaluated social media posts containing visual misinformation, including manipulated videos, manipulated images, and AI‐generated images. Students rated each item's credibility and provided written justifications. Evaluation strategies were coded using a theoretically grounded scheme. Results Students were moderately successful in identifying manipulated images and videos, but struggled to detect AI‐generated images, which were often perceived as credible. Students relied primarily on evaluation of visual appearance and content, while source evaluation and corroboration strategies were infrequently used. Across all visual misinformation types, examination of visual features, knowledge‐based evaluation, sourcing, and corroboration strategies predicted misinformation detection. However, corroboration was the only strategy that reliably predicted identification of AI‐generated images. Conclusions Students mostly rely on first‐hand evaluation of visual appearance and content, but these strategies are inadequate for detecting realistic AI‐generated visual misinformation. Instruction should emphasize active verification strategies, particularly corroboration, and support students in coordinating multiple evaluation strategies when engaging with online visual information.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究考察初中生识别社交媒体上不同类型视觉虚假信息的能力、所采用的评估策略，以及这些策略能否预测识别表现。272名七至九年级学生评估了包含篡改视频、篡改图像和AI生成图像的帖子，并评定可信度、写出判断理由，评估策略按理论编码方案归类。结果显示，学生对篡改图像和视频的识别仅属中等水平，对AI生成图像则普遍难以辨别，常将其视为可信；他们主要依赖对视觉外观和内容的直接判断，较少使用来源核查与交叉验证。视觉特征检查、基于知识的评估、来源核查和交叉验证在各类型上均能预测识别，但只有交叉验证能稳定预测AI生成图像的识别。作者据此建议教学应强调主动验证，尤其是交叉验证，并帮助学生协调使用多种评估策略。
